verses.textZh: 以下是摩西在约旦河东的旷野，疏弗对面的亚拉巴，就是在巴兰和陀弗、拉班、哈洗录、底撒哈之间，向以色列人所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是摩西在约旦河东的旷野，疏弗对面的亚拉巴，就是在巴兰和陀弗、拉班、哈洗录、底撒哈之间，向以色列人所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下所记的是摩西在约旦河东的旷野、疏弗对面的亚拉巴－就是巴兰、陀弗、拉班、哈洗录、底撒哈中间－向以色列众人所说的话。（
verses.textEnNiv: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—that is, in the Arabah—opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on this side of the Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite Suph, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the words that Moses spoke to all the people of Israel while they were in the wilderness east of the Jordan River. They were camped in the Jordan Valley near Suph, between Paran on one side and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab on the other.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel across the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.textEn: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—that is, in the Arabah—opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.

verses.textZh: 从何烈山经过西珥山的路，到达加低斯．巴尼亚，共有十一天的路程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从何烈山经过西珥山的路，到达加低斯．巴尼亚，共有十一天的路程。
verses.textZhCuv: 从何烈山经过西珥山到加低斯‧巴尼亚有十一天的路程。）
verses.textEnNiv: (It takes eleven days to go from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by the Mount Seir road.)
verses.textEnEsv: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis eleven days’ journey from Horeb by way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.textEnNlt: Normally it takes only eleven days to travel from Mount Sinai to Kadesh-barnea, going by way of Mount Seir.
verses.textEnNasb: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.textEn: (It takes eleven days to go from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by the Mount Seir road.)

verses.textZh: 出埃及以后第四十年十一月一日，摩西照着耶和华吩咐他一切关于以色列人的话，都告诉了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 出埃及以后第四十年十一月一日，摩西照着耶和华吩咐他一切关于以色列人的话，都告诉了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日，摩西照耶和华藉着他所吩咐以色列人的话都晓谕他们。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the Lord had commanded him concerning them.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses spoke to the people of Israel according to all that the Lord had given him in commandment to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord had given him as commandments to them,
verses.textEnNlt: But forty years after the Israelites left Egypt, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses addressed the people of Israel, telling them everything the Lord had commanded him to say.
verses.textEnNasb: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, in accordance with everything that the Lord had commanded him to declare to them,
verses.textEn: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the Lord had commanded him concerning them.

verses.textZh: 当时，他已经击败了住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏，和住在亚斯他录与以得来的巴珊王噩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，他已经击败了住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏，和住在亚斯他录与以得来的巴珊王噩。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他已经击杀了住希实本的亚摩利王西宏和住以得来、亚斯他录的巴珊王噩。
verses.textEnNiv: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
verses.textEnEsv: after he had defeated Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
verses.textEnNkjv: after he had killed Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei.
verses.textEnNlt: This took place after he had defeated King Sihon of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated King Og of Bashan, who ruled in Ashtaroth.
verses.textEnNasb: after he had defeated Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
verses.textEn: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

verses.textZh: 摩西在约旦河东的摩押地，开始讲解这律法，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在约旦河东的摩押地，开始讲解这律法，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在约旦河东的摩押地讲律法说：
verses.textEnNiv: East of the Jordan in the territory of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:
verses.textEnEsv: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to explain this law, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: On this side of the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: While the Israelites were in the land of Moab east of the Jordan River, Moses carefully explained the Lord ’s instructions as follows.
verses.textEnNasb: Across the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this Law, saying,
verses.textEn: East of the Jordan in the territory of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:

verses.textZh: "耶和华我们的神，在何烈山告诉我们：‘你们在这山上住够了；
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华我们的神，在何烈山告诉我们：‘你们在这山上住够了；
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－我们的神在何烈山晓谕我们说：你们在这山上住的日子够了；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord our God said to us at Horeb, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord our God said to us in Horeb, ‘You have stayed long enough at this mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying: ‘You have dwelt long enough at this mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "When we were at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God said to us, ‘You have stayed at this mountain long enough.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying, ‘You have stayed long enough at this mountain.
verses.textEn: The Lord our God said to us at Horeb, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要转回，起程到亚摩利人的山地去，到那些住在亚拉巴、山地、低地、南地、沿海一带、迦南人的地、黎巴嫩，直到大河，就是幼发拉底河一带的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要转回，起程到亚摩利人的山地去，到那些住在亚拉巴、山地、低地、南地、沿海一带、迦南人的地、黎巴嫩，直到大河，就是幼发拉底河一带的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 要起行转到亚摩利人的山地和靠近这山地的各处，就是亚拉巴、山地、高原、南地，沿海一带迦南人的地，并黎巴嫩山又到幼发拉底大河。
verses.textEnNiv: Break camp and advance into the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the mountains, in the western foothills, in the Negev and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all their neighbors in the Arabah, in the hill country and in the lowland and in the Negeb and by the seacoast, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn and take your journey, and go to the mountains of the Amorites, to all the neighboring places in the plain, in the mountains and in the lowland, in the South and on the seacoast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: It is time to break camp and move on. Go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the neighboring regions—the Jordan Valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Negev, and the coastal plain. Go to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, and all the way to the great Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn and set out on your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites, and to all their neighbors in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Negev, by the seacoast, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.textEn: Break camp and advance into the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the mountains, in the western foothills, in the Negev and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我把这地摆在你面前，你们要进去，占领这地为业，就是耶和华向你们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给他们和他们的后裔的地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我把这地摆在你面前，你们要进去，占领这地为业，就是耶和华向你们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给他们和他们的后裔的地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我将这地摆在你们面前；你们要进去得这地，就是耶和华向你们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许赐给他们和他们后裔为业之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: See, I have given you this land. Go in and take possession of the land the Lord swore he would give to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—and to their descendants after them."
verses.textEnEsv: See, I have set the land before you. Go in and take possession of the land that the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their offspring after them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: See, I have set the land before you; go in and possess the land which the Lord swore to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—to give to them and their descendants after them.’
verses.textEnNlt: Look, I am giving all this land to you! Go in and occupy it, for it is the land the Lord swore to give to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to all their descendants.’"
verses.textEnNasb: See, I have placed the land before you; go in and take possession of the land which the Lord swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, and their descendants after them.’
verses.textEn: See, I have given you this land. Go in and take possession of the land the Lord swore he would give to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—and to their descendants after them."

verses.textZh: "那时，我曾经对你们说：‘你们的重担，我独自一人无法担当。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，我曾经对你们说：‘你们的重担，我独自一人无法担当。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，我对你们说：『管理你们的重任，我独自担当不起。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I said to you, "You are too heavy a burden for me to carry alone.
verses.textEnEsv: "At that time I said to you, ‘I am not able to bear you by myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I spoke to you at that time, saying: ‘I alone am not able to bear you.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses continued, "At that time I told you, ‘You are too great a burden for me to carry all by myself.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I spoke to you at that time, saying, ‘I am not able to endure you alone.
verses.textEn: At that time I said to you, "You are too heavy a burden for me to carry alone.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你们的神使你们多起来；你们看，你们今日像天上的星那样多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你们的神使你们多起来；你们看，你们今日像天上的星那样多。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你们的神使你们多起来。看哪，你们今日像天上的星那样多。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God has increased your numbers so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as numerous as the stars of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord your God has multiplied you, and here you are today, as the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God has increased your population, making you as numerous as the stars!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are this day like the stars of heaven in number.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God has increased your numbers so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华你们列祖的神，使你们比现在更多千倍，又照着他应许你们的话，赐福给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华你们列祖的神，使你们比现在更多千倍，又照着他应许你们的话，赐福给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿耶和华－你们列祖的神使你们比如今更多千倍，照他所应许你们的话赐福与你们。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord , the God of your ancestors, increase you a thousand times and bless you as he has promised!
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord , the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!
verses.textEnNkjv: May the Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times more numerous than you are, and bless you as He has promised you!
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord , the God of your ancestors, multiply you a thousand times more and bless you as he promised!
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord, the God of your fathers increase you a thousand times more than you are, and bless you, just as He has promised you!
verses.textEn: May the Lord , the God of your ancestors, increase you a thousand times and bless you as he has promised!

verses.textZh: 我独自一人怎能担得起你们的重担、责任和你们争讼的事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我独自一人怎能担得起你们的重担、责任和你们争讼的事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们的麻烦，和管理你们的重任，并你们的争讼，我独自一人怎能担当得起呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But how can I bear your problems and your burdens and your disputes all by myself?
verses.textEnEsv: How can I bear by myself the weight and burden of you and your strife?
verses.textEnNkjv: How can I alone bear your problems and your burdens and your complaints?
verses.textEnNlt: But you are such a heavy load to carry! How can I deal with all your problems and bickering?
verses.textEnNasb: How can I alone endure the burden and weight of you and your strife?
verses.textEn: But how can I bear your problems and your burdens and your disputes all by myself?

verses.textZh: 你们要按着支派选出一些有智慧、有见识、有经验的人，我就立他们作你们的首领。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要按着支派选出一些有智慧、有见识、有经验的人，我就立他们作你们的首领。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要按着各支派选举有智慧、有见识、为众人所认识的，我立他们为你们的首领。』
verses.textEnNiv: Choose some wise, understanding and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will set them over you."
verses.textEnEsv: Choose for your tribes wise, understanding, and experienced men, and I will appoint them as your heads.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Choose wise, understanding, and knowledgeable men from among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Choose some well-respected men from each tribe who are known for their wisdom and understanding, and I will appoint them as your leaders.’
verses.textEnNasb: Obtain for yourselves men who are wise, discerning, and informed from your tribes, and I will appoint them as your heads.’
verses.textEn: Choose some wise, understanding and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will set them over you."

verses.textZh: 你们回答我，说：‘你吩咐我们作的事很好。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们回答我，说：‘你吩咐我们作的事很好。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们回答我说：『照你所说的行了为妙。』
verses.textEnNiv: You answered me, "What you propose to do is good."
verses.textEnEsv: And you answered me, ‘The thing that you have spoken is good for us to do.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And you answered me and said, ‘The thing which you have told us to do is good.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you responded, ‘Your plan is a good one.’
verses.textEnNasb: And you answered me and said, ‘The thing which you have said to do is good.’
verses.textEn: You answered me, "What you propose to do is good."

verses.textZh: 我就选出你们众支派中的领袖，就是有智慧有经验的人；按着你们的支派，立他们作管理你们的首领，就是作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长和其他官长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就选出你们众支派中的领袖，就是有智慧有经验的人；按着你们的支派，立他们作管理你们的首领，就是作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长和其他官长。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便将你们各支派的首领，有智慧、为众人所认识的，照你们的支派，立他们为官长、千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，管理你们。
verses.textEnNiv: So I took the leading men of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them to have authority over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens and as tribal officials.
verses.textEnEsv: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and experienced men, and set them as heads over you, commanders of thousands, commanders of hundreds, commanders of fifties, commanders of tens, and officers, throughout your tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and knowledgeable men, and made them heads over you, leaders of thousands, leaders of hundreds, leaders of fifties, leaders of tens, and officers for your tribes.
verses.textEnNlt: So I took the wise and respected men you had selected from your tribes and appointed them to serve as judges and officials over you. Some were responsible for a thousand people, some for a hundred, some for fifty, and some for ten.
verses.textEnNasb: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and informed men, and appointed them as heads over you, commanders of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens, and officers for your tribes.
verses.textEn: So I took the leading men of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them to have authority over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens and as tribal officials.

verses.textZh: "那时，我吩咐你们的审判官，说：‘你们在兄弟中听讼，无论是兄弟彼此诉讼，或是与同居的外地人诉讼，都要按着公义审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，我吩咐你们的审判官，说：‘你们在兄弟中听讼，无论是兄弟彼此诉讼，或是与同居的外地人诉讼，都要按着公义审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当时，我嘱咐你们的审判官说：『你们听讼，无论是弟兄彼此争讼，是与同居的外人争讼，都要按公义判断。
verses.textEnNiv: And I charged your judges at that time, "Hear the disputes between your people and judge fairly, whether the case is between two Israelites or between an Israelite and a foreigner residing among you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I charged your judges at that time, ‘Hear the cases between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother or the alien who is with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I commanded your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear thecases between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother or the stranger who is with him.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time I instructed the judges, ‘You must hear the cases of your fellow Israelites and the foreigners living among you. Be perfectly fair in your decisions
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I ordered your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear the cases between your fellow countrymen and judge righteously between a person and his fellow countryman, or the stranger who is with him.
verses.textEn: And I charged your judges at that time, "Hear the disputes between your people and judge fairly, whether the case is between two Israelites or between an Israelite and a foreigner residing among you.

verses.textZh: 审判的时候，不可偏袒人；无论贵贱尊卑，都要一样地听讼；不可怕人的情面，因为审判是属于神的；如果你们遇见难断的案件，可以呈到我这里来，让我审断。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 审判的时候，不可偏袒人；无论贵贱尊卑，都要一样地听讼；不可怕人的情面，因为审判是属于神的；如果你们遇见难断的案件，可以呈到我这里来，让我审断。’
verses.textZhCuv: 审判的时候，不可看人的外貌；听讼不可分贵贱，不可惧怕人，因为审判是属乎神的。若有难断的案件，可以呈到我这里，我就判断。』
verses.textEnNiv: Do not show partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be afraid of anyone, for judgment belongs to God. Bring me any case too hard for you, and I will hear it."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not be partial in judgment. You shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be intimidated by anyone, for the judgment is God’s. And the case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small as well as the great; you shall not be afraid in any man’s presence, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, bring to me, and I will hear it.’
verses.textEnNlt: and impartial in your judgments. Hear the cases of those who are poor as well as those who are rich. Don’t be afraid of anyone’s anger, for the decision you make is God’s decision. Bring me any cases that are too difficult for you, and I will handle them.’
verses.textEnNasb: You are not to show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You are not to be afraid of any person, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too difficult for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.’
verses.textEn: Do not show partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be afraid of anyone, for judgment belongs to God. Bring me any case too hard for you, and I will hear it."

verses.textZh: 那时，我把你们当作的一切事，都吩咐了你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我把你们当作的一切事，都吩咐了你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我将你们所当行的事都吩咐你们了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And at that time I told you everything you were to do.
verses.textEnEsv: And I commanded you at that time all the things that you should do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time I gave you instructions about everything you were to do.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time I commanded you all the things that you were to do.
verses.textEn: And at that time I told you everything you were to do.

verses.textZh: "我们照着耶和华我们的神吩咐我们的，从何烈山起行，走过你们所见那大而可怕的旷野，沿着到亚摩利人山地的路而行；后来到了加低斯．巴尼亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们照着耶和华我们的神吩咐我们的，从何烈山起行，走过你们所见那大而可怕的旷野，沿着到亚摩利人山地的路而行；后来到了加低斯．巴尼亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们照着耶和华－我们神所吩咐的从何烈山起行，经过你们所看见那大而可怕的旷野，往亚摩利人的山地去，到了加低斯‧巴尼亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Then, as the Lord our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful wilderness that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then we set out from Horeb and went through all that great and terrifying wilderness that you saw, on the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the Lord our God commanded us. And we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So we departed from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw on the way to the mountains of the Amorites, as the Lord our God had commanded us. Then we came to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, just as the Lord our God commanded us, we left Mount Sinai and traveled through the great and terrifying wilderness, as you yourselves remember, and headed toward the hill country of the Amorites. When we arrived at Kadesh-barnea,
verses.textEnNasb: "Then we set out from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness that you saw on the way to the hill country of the Amorites, just as the Lord our God had commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.textEn: Then, as the Lord our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful wilderness that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.

verses.textZh: 我对你们说：‘你们已经到了亚摩利人的山地，就是耶和华我们的神赐给我们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对你们说：‘你们已经到了亚摩利人的山地，就是耶和华我们的神赐给我们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对你们说：『你们已经到了耶和华－我们神所赐给我们的亚摩利人之山地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to you, ‘You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to you, ‘You have come to the mountains of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.
verses.textEnNlt: I said to you, ‘You have now reached the hill country of the Amorites that the Lord our God is giving us.
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to you, ‘You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is about to give us.
verses.textEn: Then I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.

verses.textZh: 看哪，耶和华你的神已经把这地摆在你面前；你要照着耶和华你列祖的神告诉你的上去，占领那地；不要害怕，也不要惊惶。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，耶和华你的神已经把这地摆在你面前；你要照着耶和华你列祖的神告诉你的上去，占领那地；不要害怕，也不要惊惶。’
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华－你的神已将那地摆在你面前，你要照耶和华－你列祖的神所说的上去得那地为业；不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。』
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Lord your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."
verses.textEnEsv: See, the Lord your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the Lord , the God of your fathers, has told you. Do not fear or be dismayed.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, the Lord your God has set the land before you; go up and possess it, as the Lord God of your fathers has spoken to you; do not fear or be discouraged.’
verses.textEnNlt: Look! He has placed the land in front of you. Go and occupy it as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has promised you. Don’t be afraid! Don’t be discouraged!’
verses.textEnNasb: See, the Lord your God has placed the land before you; go up, take possession, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you. Do not fear or be dismayed.’
verses.textEn: See, the Lord your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

verses.textZh: 你们众人都走到我这里来，说：‘我们要先派些人去，替我们窥探那地，然后把我们上去该走哪一条路，该进哪些城，向我们回报。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们众人都走到我这里来，说：‘我们要先派些人去，替我们窥探那地，然后把我们上去该走哪一条路，该进哪些城，向我们回报。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们都就近我来说：『我们要先打发人去，为我们窥探那地，将我们上去该走何道，必进何城，都回报我们。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then all of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to."
verses.textEnEsv: Then all of you came near me and said, ‘Let us send men before us, that they may explore the land for us and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up and the cities into which we shall come.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And every one of you came near to me and said, ‘Let us send men before us, and let them search out the land for us, and bring back word to us of the way by which we should go up, and of the cities into which we shall come.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But you all came to me and said, ‘First, let’s send out scouts to explore the land for us. They will advise us on the best route to take and which towns we should enter.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Then all of you approached me and said, ‘Let us send men ahead of us, so that they may spy out the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we should go up, and the cities which we should enter.’
verses.textEn: Then all of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to."

verses.textZh: 这话我很同意，就从你们中间选了十二个人，每支派一人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这话我很同意，就从你们中间选了十二个人，每支派一人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这话我以为美，就从你们中间选了十二个人，每支派一人。
verses.textEnNiv: The idea seemed good to me; so I selected twelve of you, one man from each tribe.
verses.textEnEsv: The thing seemed good to me, and I took twelve men from you, one man from each tribe.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The plan pleased me well; so I took twelve of your men, one man from each tribe.
verses.textEnNlt: "This seemed like a good idea to me, so I chose twelve scouts, one from each of your tribes.
verses.textEnNasb: The plan pleased me, and I took twelve of your men, one man for each tribe.
verses.textEn: The idea seemed good to me; so I selected twelve of you, one man from each tribe.

verses.textZh: 于是他们转身出发，上了山地，到了以实各谷，窥探那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们转身出发，上了山地，到了以实各谷，窥探那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们起身上山地去，到以实各谷，窥探那地。
verses.textEnNiv: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshkol and explored it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied it out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they departed and went up into the mountains, and came to the Valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.textEnNlt: They headed for the hill country and came to the valley of Eshcol and explored it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.textEn: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshkol and explored it.

verses.textZh: 他们手里拿着那地的果子，带下来到我们这里，并且向我们回报，说：‘耶和华我们的神要赐给我们的地是美地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们手里拿着那地的果子，带下来到我们这里，并且向我们回报，说：‘耶和华我们的神要赐给我们的地是美地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们手里拿着那地的果子下来，到我们那里，回报说：『耶和华－我们的神所赐给我们的是美地。』
verses.textEnNiv: Taking with them some of the fruit of the land, they brought it down to us and reported, "It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us."
verses.textEnEsv: And they took in their hands some of the fruit of the land and brought it down to us, and brought us word again and said, ‘It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They also took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us; and they brought back word to us, saying, ‘Itis a good land which the Lord our God is giving us.’
verses.textEnNlt: They picked some of its fruit and brought it back to us. And they reported, ‘The land the Lord our God has given us is indeed a good land.’
verses.textEnNasb: And they took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us. They also brought us back a report and said, ‘The land that the Lord our God is about to give us is good.’
verses.textEn: Taking with them some of the fruit of the land, they brought it down to us and reported, "It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us."

verses.textZh: "但你们不肯上去，竟违背了耶和华你们的神的吩咐；
verses.textZhCnvs: "但你们不肯上去，竟违背了耶和华你们的神的吩咐；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们却不肯上去，竟违背了耶和华－你们神的命令，
verses.textEnNiv: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet you would not go up, but rebelled against the command of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Nevertheless you would not go up, but rebelled against the command of the Lord your God;
verses.textEnNlt: "But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God and refused to go in.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet you were unwilling to go up; instead you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God;
verses.textEn: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你们在帐幕里抱怨，说：‘耶和华因为恨我们，所以把我们从埃及地领出来，要把我们交在亚摩利人手中，消灭我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在帐幕里抱怨，说：‘耶和华因为恨我们，所以把我们从埃及地领出来，要把我们交在亚摩利人手中，消灭我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在帐棚内发怨言说：『耶和华因为恨我们，所以将我们从埃及地领出来，要交在亚摩利人手中，除灭我们。
verses.textEnNiv: You grumbled in your tents and said, "The Lord hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.
verses.textEnEsv: And you murmured in your tents and said, ‘Because the Lord hated us he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to give us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you complained in your tents, and said, ‘Because the Lord hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.textEnNlt: You complained in your tents and said, ‘The Lord must hate us. That’s why he has brought us here from Egypt—to hand us over to the Amorites to be slaughtered.
verses.textEnNasb: and you grumbled in your tents and said, ‘Because the Lord hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to hand us over to the Amorites to destroy us.
verses.textEn: You grumbled in your tents and said, "The Lord hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.

verses.textZh: 我们上哪里去呢？我们的兄弟使我们心灰意冷，说：那地的人比我们高大；他们的城邑又大又坚固，高耸入天；我们在那里还看见有亚衲族的人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们上哪里去呢？我们的兄弟使我们心灰意冷，说：那地的人比我们高大；他们的城邑又大又坚固，高耸入天；我们在那里还看见有亚衲族的人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们上哪里去呢？我们的弟兄使我们的心消化，说那地的民比我们又大又高，城邑又广大又坚固，高得顶天，并且我们在那里看见亚衲族的人。』
verses.textEnNiv: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt in fear. They say, ‘The people are stronger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the sky. We even saw the Anakites there.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying, "The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to heaven. And besides, we have seen the sons of the Anakim there."’
verses.textEnNkjv: Where can we go up? Our brethren have discouraged our hearts, saying, "The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Where can we go? Our brothers have demoralized us with their report. They tell us, "The people of the land are taller and more powerful than we are, and their towns are large, with walls rising high into the sky! We even saw giants there—the descendants of Anak!"’
verses.textEnNasb: Where can we go up? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, by saying, "The people are bigger and taller than we; the cities are large and fortified up to heaven. And besides, we saw the sons of the Anakim there." ’
verses.textEn: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt in fear. They say, ‘The people are stronger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the sky. We even saw the Anakites there.’ "

verses.textZh: 我就对你们说：‘不要惊恐，不要害怕他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就对你们说：‘不要惊恐，不要害怕他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就对你们说：『不要惊恐，也不要怕他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said to you, ‘Do not be in dread or afraid of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I said to you, ‘Do not be terrified, or afraid of them.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I said to you, ‘Don’t be shocked or afraid of them!
verses.textEnNasb: But I said to you, ‘Do not be terrified, nor fear them.
verses.textEn: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你们的神，就是那走在你们前面的那一位，他必为你们作战，好象他在埃及，在你们面前，为你们所行的一切一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你们的神，就是那走在你们前面的那一位，他必为你们作战，好象他在埃及，在你们面前，为你们所行的一切一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们前面行的耶和华－你们的神必为你们争战，正如他在埃及和旷野，在你们眼前所行的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God, who is going before you, will fight for you, as he did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord your God who goes before you will himself fight for you, just as he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord your God, who goes before you, He will fight for you, according to all He did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God is going ahead of you. He will fight for you, just as you saw him do in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord your God, who goes before you, will Himself fight for you, just as He did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.textEn: The Lord your God, who is going before you, will fight for you, as he did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes,

verses.textZh: 并且在旷野里，你们也看见了耶和华你们的神，怎样在你们所行的一切路上，背负你们，好象人背负自己的儿子一样，直到你们来到了这地方。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且在旷野里，你们也看见了耶和华你们的神，怎样在你们所行的一切路上，背负你们，好象人背负自己的儿子一样，直到你们来到了这地方。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在旷野所行的路上，也曾见耶和华－你们的神抚养你们，如同人抚养儿子一般，直等你们来到这地方。』
verses.textEnNiv: and in the wilderness. There you saw how the Lord your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place."
verses.textEnEsv: and in the wilderness, where you have seen how the Lord your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way that you went until you came to this place.’
verses.textEnNkjv: and in the wilderness where you saw how the Lord your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went until you came to this place.’
verses.textEnNlt: And you saw how the Lord your God cared for you all along the way as you traveled through the wilderness, just as a father cares for his child. Now he has brought you to this place.’
verses.textEnNasb: and in the wilderness where you saw how the Lord your God carried you, just as a man carries his son, on all of the road which you have walked until you came to this place.’
verses.textEn: and in the wilderness. There you saw how the Lord your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place."

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，你们还是不信耶和华你们的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，你们还是不信耶和华你们的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在这事上却不信耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: In spite of this, you did not trust in the Lord your God,
verses.textEnEsv: Yet in spite of this word you did not believe the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet, for all that, you did not believe the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNlt: "But even after all he did, you refused to trust the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNasb: Yet in spite of all this, you did not trust the Lord your God,
verses.textEn: In spite of this, you did not trust in the Lord your God,

verses.textZh: 他在路上走在你们前面，为你们寻找安营的地方；夜间用火柱，日间用云彩，指示你们当走的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在路上走在你们前面，为你们寻找安营的地方；夜间用火柱，日间用云彩，指示你们当走的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在路上，在你们前面行，为你们找安营的地方；夜间在火柱里，日间在云柱里，指示你们所当行的路。」
verses.textEnNiv: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.
verses.textEnEsv: who went before you in the way to seek you out a place to pitch your tents, in fire by night and in the cloud by day, to show you by what way you should go.
verses.textEnNkjv: who went in the way before you to search out a place for you to pitch your tents, to show you the way you should go, in the fire by night and in the cloud by day.
verses.textEnNlt: who goes before you looking for the best places to camp, guiding you with a pillar of fire by night and a pillar of cloud by day.
verses.textEnNasb: who goes before you on your way, to seek out a place for you to make camp, in the fire by night to show you the way by which you should go, and in the cloud by day.
verses.textEn: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.

verses.textZh: "耶和华听见了你们说话的声音，就恼怒，起誓说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华听见了你们说话的声音，就恼怒，起誓说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华听见你们这话，就发怒，起誓说：
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord heard what you said, he was angry and solemnly swore:
verses.textEnEsv: "And the Lord heard your words and was angered, and he swore,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Lord heard the sound of your words, and was angry, and took an oath, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Lord heard your complaining, he became very angry. So he solemnly swore,
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the Lord heard the sound of your words, and He was angry and swore an oath, saying,
verses.textEn: When the Lord heard what you said, he was angry and solemnly swore:

verses.textZh: ‘这个邪恶世代的人，连一个也不能看见我起誓应许赐给他们列祖的美地；
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘这个邪恶世代的人，连一个也不能看见我起誓应许赐给他们列祖的美地；
verses.textZhCuv: 『这恶世代的人，连一个也不得见我起誓应许赐给你们列祖的美地；
verses.textEnNiv: "No one from this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your ancestors,
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land that I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see that good land of which I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Not one of you from this wicked generation will live to see the good land I swore to give your ancestors,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Not one of these men, this evil generation, shall see the good land which I swore to give your fathers,
verses.textEn: "No one from this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your ancestors,

verses.textZh: 只有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒可以看见；并且我要把他踏过的地赐给他和他的子孙，因为他专心跟从了我耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒可以看见；并且我要把他踏过的地赐给他和他的子孙，因为他专心跟从了我耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒必得看见，并且我要将他所踏过的地赐给他和他的子孙，因为他专心跟从我。』
verses.textEnNiv: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land he set his feet on, because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly."
verses.textEnEsv: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it, and to him and to his children I will give the land on which he has trodden, because he has wholly followed the Lord !’
verses.textEnNkjv: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him and his children I am giving the land on which he walked, because he wholly followed the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see this land because he has followed the Lord completely. I will give to him and his descendants some of the very land he explored during his scouting mission.’
verses.textEnNasb: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him I will give the land on which he has set foot, and to his sons, because he has followed the Lord fully.’
verses.textEn: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land he set his feet on, because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly."

verses.textZh: 因为你们的缘故，耶和华也向我发怒，说：‘你也不能进入那地；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们的缘故，耶和华也向我发怒，说：‘你也不能进入那地；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华为你的缘故也向我发怒，说：『你必不得进入那地。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of you the Lord became angry with me also and said, "You shall not enter it, either.
verses.textEnEsv: Even with me the Lord was angry on your account and said, ‘You also shall not go in there.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord was also angry with me for your sakes, saying, ‘Even you shall not go in there.
verses.textEnNlt: "And the Lord was also angry with me because of you. He said to me, ‘Moses, not even you will enter the Promised Land!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord was angry with me also on your account, saying, ‘Not even you shall enter there.
verses.textEn: Because of you the Lord became angry with me also and said, "You shall not enter it, either.

verses.textZh: 但是站在你面前侍候你的嫩的儿子约书亚，他可以进到那里去；你要鼓励他，因为他要使以色列人承受那地为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是站在你面前侍候你的嫩的儿子约书亚，他可以进到那里去；你要鼓励他，因为他要使以色列人承受那地为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 伺候你、嫩的儿子约书亚，他必得进入那地；你要勉励他，因为他要使以色列人承受那地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: But your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will enter it. Encourage him, because he will lead Israel to inherit it.
verses.textEnEsv: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall enter. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will lead the people into the land. Encourage him, for he will lead Israel as they take possession of it.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall himself enter there; encourage him, for he will give it to Israel as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: But your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will enter it. Encourage him, because he will lead Israel to inherit it.

verses.textZh: 还有你们的小孩子，你们说要被掳掠的，和你们的儿女，就是今天还不知道善恶的，他们都要进入那地；我要把那地赐给他们，他们要占领那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有你们的小孩子，你们说要被掳掠的，和你们的儿女，就是今天还不知道善恶的，他们都要进入那地；我要把那地赐给他们，他们要占领那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你们的妇人孩子，就是你们所说、必被掳掠的，和今日不知善恶的儿女，必进入那地。我要将那地赐给他们，他们必得为业。
verses.textEnNiv: And the little ones that you said would be taken captive, your children who do not yet know good from bad—they will enter the land. I will give it to them and they will take possession of it.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for your little ones, who you said would become a prey, and your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in there. And to them I will give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Moreover your little ones and your children, who you say will be victims, who today have no knowledge of good and evil, they shall go in there; to them I will give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give the land to your little ones—your innocent children. You were afraid they would be captured, but they will be the ones who occupy it.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, your little ones who, you said, would become plunder, and your sons, who this day have no knowledge of good and evil, shall enter there, and I will give it to them and they shall take possession of it.
verses.textEn: And the little ones that you said would be taken captive, your children who do not yet know good from bad—they will enter the land. I will give it to them and they will take possession of it.

verses.textZh: 至于你们，你们要转回，经往红海的路，起程到旷野里去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你们，你们要转回，经往红海的路，起程到旷野里去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你们，要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。』
verses.textEnNiv: But as for you, turn around and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. "
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, turn, and journey into the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But asfor you, turn and take your journey into the wilderness by the Way of the Red Sea.’
verses.textEnNlt: As for you, turn around now and go on back through the wilderness toward the Red Sea. ’
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, turn around and set out for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.’
verses.textEn: But as for you, turn around and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. "

verses.textZh: "那时你们回答我，说：‘我们得罪了耶和华；现在我们愿意照着耶和华我们神的一切吩咐，上去作战。’于是你们都预备了兵器，轻率地上山去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时你们回答我，说：‘我们得罪了耶和华；现在我们愿意照着耶和华我们神的一切吩咐，上去作战。’于是你们都预备了兵器，轻率地上山去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，你们回答我说：『我们得罪了耶和华，情愿照耶和华－我们神一切所吩咐的上去争战。』于是你们各人带着兵器，争先上山地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you replied, "We have sinned against the Lord . We will go up and fight, as the Lord our God commanded us." So every one of you put on his weapons, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then you answered me, ‘We have sinned against the Lord . We ourselves will go up and fight, just as the Lord our God commanded us.’ And every one of you fastened on his weapons of war and thought it easy to go up into the hill country.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you answered and said to me, ‘We have sinned against the Lord; we will go up and fight, just as the Lord our God commanded us.’ And when everyone of you had girded on his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you confessed, ‘We have sinned against the Lord ! We will go into the land and fight for it, as the Lord our God has commanded us.’ So your men strapped on their weapons, thinking it would be easy to attack the hill country.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you replied to me, ‘We have sinned against the Lord; we ourselves will go up and fight, just as the Lord our God commanded us.’ And every man of you strapped on his weapons of war, and you viewed it as easy to go up into the hill country.
verses.textEn: Then you replied, "We have sinned against the Lord . We will go up and fight, as the Lord our God commanded us." So every one of you put on his weapons, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘你要对他们说："你们不要上去，也不要作战，因为我不在你们中间，免得你们在仇敌面前被击败。"’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘你要对他们说："你们不要上去，也不要作战，因为我不在你们中间，免得你们在仇敌面前被击败。"’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐我说：『你对他们说：不要上去，也不要争战；因我不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。』
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to me, "Tell them, ‘Do not go up and fight, because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, ‘Say to them, Do not go up or fight, for I am not in your midst, lest you be defeated before your enemies.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Lord said to me, ‘Tell them, "Do not go up nor fight, for I am not among you; lest you be defeated before your enemies."
verses.textEnNlt: "But the Lord told me to tell you, ‘Do not attack, for I am not with you. If you go ahead on your own, you will be crushed by your enemies.’
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to me, ‘Say to them, "Do not go up nor fight, for I am not among you; otherwise you will be defeated by your enemies." ’
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to me, "Tell them, ‘Do not go up and fight, because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.’ "

verses.textZh: 我就告诉你们，你们却不听从，竟违背耶和华的吩咐，擅自上山去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就告诉你们，你们却不听从，竟违背耶和华的吩咐，擅自上山去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就告诉了你们，你们却不听从，竟违背耶和华的命令，擅自上山地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So I told you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the Lord ’s command and in your arrogance you marched up into the hill country.
verses.textEnEsv: So I spoke to you, and you would not listen; but you rebelled against the command of the Lord and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I spoke to you; yet you would not listen, but rebelled against the command of the Lord, and presumptuously went up into the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what I told you, but you would not listen. Instead, you again rebelled against the Lord ’s command and arrogantly went into the hill country to fight.
verses.textEnNasb: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. Instead, you rebelled against the command of the Lord, and acted presumptuously and went up into the hill country.
verses.textEn: So I told you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the Lord ’s command and in your arrogance you marched up into the hill country.

verses.textZh: 住在那山上的亚摩利人，就出来攻击你们，好象蜂群一样追赶你们，在西珥击杀你们，直到何珥玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在那山上的亚摩利人，就出来攻击你们，好象蜂群一样追赶你们，在西珥击杀你们，直到何珥玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 住那山地的亚摩利人就出来攻击你们，追赶你们，如蜂拥一般，在西珥杀退你们，直到何珥玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The Amorites who lived in those hills came out against you; they chased you like a swarm of bees and beat you down from Seir all the way to Hormah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Amorites who lived in that hill country came out against you and chased you as bees do and beat you down in Seir as far as Hormah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Amorites who dwelt in that mountain came out against you and chased you as bees do, and drove you back from Seir to Hormah.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Amorites who lived there came out against you like a swarm of bees. They chased and battered you all the way from Seir to Hormah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Amorites who lived in that hill country came out against you and chased you as bees do, and they scattered you from Seir to Hormah.
verses.textEn: The Amorites who lived in those hills came out against you; they chased you like a swarm of bees and beat you down from Seir all the way to Hormah.

verses.textZh: 你们就回来，在耶和华面前哭，但耶和华不听你们的声音，也不向你们侧耳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就回来，在耶和华面前哭，但耶和华不听你们的声音，也不向你们侧耳。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们便回来，在耶和华面前哭号；耶和华却不听你们的声音，也不向你们侧耳。
verses.textEnNiv: You came back and wept before the Lord , but he paid no attention to your weeping and turned a deaf ear to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you returned and wept before the Lord , but the Lord did not listen to your voice or give ear to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you returned and wept before the Lord, but the Lord would not listen to your voice nor give ear to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you returned and wept before the Lord , but he refused to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you returned and wept before the Lord; but the Lord did not listen to your voice, nor pay attention to you.
verses.textEn: You came back and wept before the Lord , but he paid no attention to your weeping and turned a deaf ear to you.

verses.textZh: 于是你们在加低斯住了许多日子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是你们在加低斯住了许多日子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是你们在加低斯住了许多日子。」
verses.textEnNiv: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days—all the time you spent there.
verses.textEnEsv: So you remained at Kadesh many days, the days that you remained there.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So you remained in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you spent there.
verses.textEnNlt: So you stayed there at Kadesh for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: So you remained at Kadesh for many days, the days that you spent there.
verses.textEn: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days—all the time you spent there.

verses.textZh: "以后，我们照着耶和华吩咐我的，回转过来，沿着往红海的路起程到旷野去；我们在西珥山绕行了很多日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以后，我们照着耶和华吩咐我的，回转过来，沿着往红海的路起程到旷野去；我们在西珥山绕行了很多日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「此后，我们转回，从红海的路往旷野去，是照耶和华所吩咐我的。我们在西珥山绕行了许多日子。
verses.textEnNiv: Then we turned back and set out toward the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea, as the Lord had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then we turned and journeyed into the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea, as the Lord told me. And for many days we traveled around Mount Seir.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then we turned and journeyed into the wilderness of the Way of the Red Sea, as the Lord spoke to me, and we skirted Mount Seir for many days.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then we turned around and headed back across the wilderness toward the Red Sea, just as the Lord had instructed me, and we wandered around in the region of Mount Seir for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then we turned and set out for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, as the Lord spoke to me, and we circled Mount Seir for many days.
verses.textEn: Then we turned back and set out toward the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea, as the Lord had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Lord spoke to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: "Then at last the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord spoke to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me,

verses.textZh: ‘你们绕行这山的日子已经够了；现在要转向北去。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们绕行这山的日子已经够了；现在要转向北去。
verses.textZhCuv: 『你们绕行这山的日子够了，要转向北去。
verses.textEnNiv: "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘You have been traveling around this mountain country long enough. Turn northward
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You have skirted this mountain long enough; turn northward.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘You have been wandering around in this hill country long enough; turn to the north.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You have circled this mountain long enough. Now turn north,
verses.textEn: "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north.

verses.textZh: 你要吩咐人民说："你们的兄弟以扫的子孙，住在西珥，你们现在要经过他们的境界；他们必惧怕你们，所以你们要十分谨慎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要吩咐人民说："你们的兄弟以扫的子孙，住在西珥，你们现在要经过他们的境界；他们必惧怕你们，所以你们要十分谨慎。
verses.textZhCuv: 你吩咐百姓说：你们弟兄以扫的子孙住在西珥，你们要经过他们的境界。他们必惧怕你们，所以你们要分外谨慎。
verses.textEnNiv: Give the people these orders: ‘You are about to pass through the territory of your relatives the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, but be very careful.
verses.textEnEsv: and command the people, "You are about to pass through the territory of your brothers, the people of Esau, who live in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. So be very careful.
verses.textEnNkjv: And command the people, saying, "You areaboutto pass through the territory of your brethren, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore watch yourselves carefully.
verses.textEnNlt: Give these orders to the people: "You will pass through the country belonging to your relatives the Edomites, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. The Edomites will feel threatened, so be careful.
verses.textEnNasb: and command the people, saying, "You are going to pass through the territory of your brothers the sons of Esau, who live in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. So be very careful;
verses.textEn: Give the people these orders: ‘You are about to pass through the territory of your relatives the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, but be very careful.

verses.textZh: 不要与他们争执；他们的地，连脚掌那么大的一块，我都不给你们，因为我已经把西珥山赐给以扫作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要与他们争执；他们的地，连脚掌那么大的一块，我都不给你们，因为我已经把西珥山赐给以扫作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可与他们争战；他们的地，连脚掌可踏之处，我都不给你们，因我已将西珥山赐给以扫为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, not even enough to put your foot on. I have given Esau the hill country of Seir as his own.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not contend with them, for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not meddle with them, for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as one footstep, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not bother them, for I have given them all the hill country around Mount Seir as their property, and I will not give you even one square foot of their land.
verses.textEnNasb: do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even as much as a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.
verses.textEn: Do not provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, not even enough to put your foot on. I have given Esau the hill country of Seir as his own.

verses.textZh: 你们要用银子向他们买食物吃；也要用银子向他们买水喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用银子向他们买食物吃；也要用银子向他们买水喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要用钱向他们买粮吃，也要用钱向他们买水喝。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall purchase food from them with money, that you may eat, and you shall also buy water from them with money, that you may drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall buy food from them with money, that you may eat; and you shall also buy water from them with money, that you may drink.
verses.textEnNlt: If you need food to eat or water to drink, pay them for it.
verses.textEnNasb: You are to buy food from them with money so that you may eat, and you shall also purchase water from them with money so that you may drink.
verses.textEn: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’ "

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神，对于你手里所作的一切事，都已经赐福给你；他也知道你怎样走这大旷野；这四十年来，耶和华你们的神常与你同在，使你毫无缺乏。"’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神，对于你手里所作的一切事，都已经赐福给你；他也知道你怎样走这大旷野；这四十年来，耶和华你们的神常与你同在，使你毫无缺乏。"’
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你的神在你手里所办的一切事上已赐福与你。你走这大旷野，他都知道了。这四十年，耶和华－你的神常与你同在，故此你一无所缺。』
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. These forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have not lacked anything.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He knows your going through this great wilderness. These forty years the Lord your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing."’
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the Lord your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He knows your trudging through this great wilderness. These forty years the Lord your God hasbeen with you; you have lacked nothing." ’
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God has blessed you in everything you have done. He has watched your every step through this great wilderness. During these forty years, the Lord your God has been with you, and you have lacked nothing."’
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God has blessed you in all that you have done; He has known your wandering through this great wilderness. These forty years the Lord your God has been with you; you have not lacked anything." ’
verses.textEn: The Lord your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. These forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have not lacked anything.

verses.textZh: "于是我们离开我们住在西珥的兄弟以扫的子孙，继续前行；沿着亚拉巴的路，到了以拉他和以旬．迦别，然后转向摩押旷野的路去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "于是我们离开我们住在西珥的兄弟以扫的子孙，继续前行；沿着亚拉巴的路，到了以拉他和以旬．迦别，然后转向摩押旷野的路去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「于是，我们离了我们弟兄以扫子孙所住的西珥，从亚拉巴的路，经过以拉他、以旬‧迦别，转向摩押旷野的路去。
verses.textEnNiv: So we went on past our relatives the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: So we went on, away from our brothers, the people of Esau, who live in Seir, away from the Arabah road from Elath and Ezion-geber. "And we turned and went in the direction of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when we passed beyond our brethren, the descendants of Esau who dwell in Seir, away from the road of the plain, away from Elath and Ezion Geber, we turned and passed by way of the Wilderness of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: "So we bypassed the territory of our relatives, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We avoided the road through the Arabah Valley that comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber. "Then as we turned north along the desert route through Moab,
verses.textEnNasb: "So we passed beyond our brothers the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, away from the Arabah road, away from Elath and Ezion-geber. And we turned and passed through by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.textEn: So we went on past our relatives the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘你不可敌视摩押人，也不可与他们争战；他们的地我不赐给你作产业，因为我已经把亚珥赐给了罗得的子孙作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘你不可敌视摩押人，也不可与他们争战；他们的地我不赐给你作产业，因为我已经把亚珥赐给了罗得的子孙作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐我说：『不可扰害摩押人，也不可与他们争战。他们的地，我不赐给你为业，因我已将亚珥赐给罗得的子孙为业。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, ‘Do not harass Moab or contend with them in battle, for I will not give you any of their land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the people of Lot for a possession.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Do not harass Moab, nor contend with them in battle, for I will not give you any of their land as a possession, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord warned us, ‘Do not bother the Moabites, the descendants of Lot, or start a war with them. I have given them Ar as their property, and I will not give you any of their land.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Do not attack Moab, nor provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land as a possession, because I have given Ar to the sons of Lot as a possession.’
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession."

verses.textZh: 现在你们要起来，过撒烈溪。’于是我们过了撒烈溪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要起来，过撒烈溪。’于是我们过了撒烈溪。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前，有以米人住在那里，民数众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: (The Emites used to live there—a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites.
verses.textEnEsv: ( The Emim formerly lived there, a people great and many, and tall as the Anakim.
verses.textEnNkjv: (The Emim had dwelt there in times past, a people as great and numerous and tall as the Anakim.
verses.textEnNlt: (A race of giants called the Emites had once lived in the area of Ar. They were as strong and numerous and tall as the Anakites, another race of giants.
verses.textEnNasb: (The Emim lived there previously, a people as great, numerous, and tall as the Anakim.
verses.textEn: (The Emites used to live there—a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites.

verses.textZh: 自从我们离开加低斯．巴尼亚，直到过了撒烈溪的日子，共有三十八年，等到那世代的战士都从营中灭绝为止，正像耶和华向他们所起的誓一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从我们离开加低斯．巴尼亚，直到过了撒烈溪的日子，共有三十八年，等到那世代的战士都从营中灭绝为止，正像耶和华向他们所起的誓一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这以米人像亚衲人；也算为利乏音人；摩押人称他们为以米人。
verses.textEnNiv: Like the Anakites, they too were considered Rephaites, but the Moabites called them Emites.
verses.textEnEsv: Like the Anakim they are also counted as Rephaim, but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.textEnNkjv: They were also regarded as giants, like the Anakim, but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.textEnNlt: Both the Emites and the Anakites are also known as the Rephaites, though the Moabites call them Emites.
verses.textEnNasb: Like the Anakim, they too are regarded as Rephaim, but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.textEn: Like the Anakites, they too were considered Rephaites, but the Moabites called them Emites.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的手攻击了他们，把他们从营中除灭，直到灭尽为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的手攻击了他们，把他们从营中除灭，直到灭尽为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以扫的子孙将他们除灭，得了他们的地，接着居住，就如以色列在耶和华赐给他为业之地所行的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land the Lord gave them as their possession.)
verses.textEnEsv: The Horites also lived in Seir formerly, but the people of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before them and settled in their place, as Israel did to the land of their possession, which the Lord gave to them.)
verses.textEnNkjv: The Horites formerly dwelt in Seir, but the descendants of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their place, just as Israel did to the land of their possession which the Lord gave them.)
verses.textEnNlt: In earlier times the Horites had lived in Seir, but they were driven out and displaced by the descendants of Esau, just as Israel drove out the people of Canaan when the Lord gave Israel their land.)
verses.textEnNasb: The Horites previously lived in Seir, but the sons of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before them, and settled in their place; just as Israel did to the land of their possession which the Lord gave them.)
verses.textEn: Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land the Lord gave them as their possession.)

verses.textZh: "所有战士都从民中死尽以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "所有战士都从民中死尽以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 现在，起来过撒烈溪！于是我们过了撒烈溪。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said, "Now get up and cross the Zered Valley." So we crossed the valley.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Now rise up and go over the brook Zered.’ So we went over the brook Zered.
verses.textEnNkjv: " ‘Now rise and cross over the Valley of the Zered.’ So we crossed over the Valley of the Zered.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses continued, "Then the Lord said to us, ‘Get moving. Cross the Zered Brook.’ So we crossed the brook.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now arise and cross over the Wadi Zered yourselves.’ So we crossed over the Wadi Zered.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said, "Now get up and cross the Zered Valley." So we crossed the valley.

verses.textZh: 耶和华就对我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就对我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 自从离开加低斯‧巴尼亚，到过了撒烈溪的时候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都从营中灭尽，正如耶和华向他们所起的誓。
verses.textEnNiv: Thirty-eight years passed from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley. By then, that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the Lord had sworn to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the time from our leaving Kadesh-barnea until we crossed the brook Zered was thirty-eight years, until the entire generation, that is, the men of war, had perished from the camp, as the Lord had sworn to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the time we took to come from Kadesh Barnea until we crossed over the Valley of the Zered was thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war was consumed from the midst of the camp, just as the Lord had sworn to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Thirty-eight years passed from the time we first left Kadesh-barnea until we finally crossed the Zered Brook! By then, all the men old enough to fight in battle had died in the wilderness, as the Lord had vowed would happen.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the time that it took for us to come from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Wadi Zered was thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war perished from within the camp, just as the Lord had sworn to them.
verses.textEn: Thirty-eight years passed from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley. By then, that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the Lord had sworn to them.

verses.textZh: ‘你今天要经过摩押的境界亚珥；
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你今天要经过摩押的境界亚珥；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的手也攻击他们，将他们从营中除灭，直到灭尽。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s hand was against them until he had completely eliminated them from the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from the camp, until they had perished.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp until they were consumed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord struck them down until they had all been eliminated from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from within the camp until they all perished.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s hand was against them until he had completely eliminated them from the camp.

verses.textZh: 你走近亚扪人面前的时候，不可敌视他们，也不可与他们争执；亚扪人的地我不赐给你们作产业，因为我已经把那地赐给了罗得的子孙作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你走近亚扪人面前的时候，不可敌视他们，也不可与他们争执；亚扪人的地我不赐给你们作产业，因为我已经把那地赐给了罗得的子孙作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「兵丁从民中都灭尽死亡以后，
verses.textEnNiv: Now when the last of these fighting men among the people had died,
verses.textEnEsv: "So as soon as all the men of war had perished and were dead from among the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: "So it was, when all the men of war had finally perished from among the people,
verses.textEnNlt: "When all the men of fighting age had died,
verses.textEnNasb: "So it came about, when all the men of war had finally perished from among the people,
verses.textEn: Now when the last of these fighting men among the people had died,

verses.textZh: 现在你要起来，出发，过亚嫩谷；看哪，我已经把亚摩利人希实本王西宏和他的土地，交在你的手里了；你要开始占领那地作产业，与他争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要起来，出发，过亚嫩谷；看哪，我已经把亚摩利人希实本王西宏和他的土地，交在你的手里了；你要开始占领那地作产业，与他争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐我说：
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord spoke to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnNasb: that the Lord spoke to me, saying,
verses.textEn: the Lord said to me,

verses.textZh: 就在今天，我要使天下万民听见你的消息都惊慌惧怕，而且因你的缘故发抖疼痛。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在今天，我要使天下万民听见你的消息都惊慌惧怕，而且因你的缘故发抖疼痛。’
verses.textZhCuv: 『你今天要从摩押的境界亚珥经过，
verses.textEnNiv: "Today you are to pass by the region of Moab at Ar.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Today you are to cross the border of Moab at Ar.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This day you are to cross over at Ar, the boundary of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Today you will cross the border of Moab at Ar
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Today you shall cross over Ar, the border of Moab.
verses.textEn: "Today you are to pass by the region of Moab at Ar.

verses.textZh: "我从基底莫的旷野，派使者到希实本王西宏那里去，用和平的话说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "我从基底莫的旷野，派使者到希实本王西宏那里去，用和平的话说：
verses.textZhCuv: 走近亚扪人之地，不可扰害他们，也不可与他们争战。亚扪人的地，我不赐给你们为业，因我已将那地赐给罗得的子孙为业。』
verses.textEnNiv: When you come to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them to war, for I will not give you possession of any land belonging to the Ammonites. I have given it as a possession to the descendants of Lot."
verses.textEnEsv: And when you approach the territory of the people of Ammon, do not harass them or contend with them, for I will not give you any of the land of the people of Ammon as a possession, because I have given it to the sons of Lot for a possession.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you come near the people of Ammon, do not harass them or meddle with them, for I will not give you any of the land of the people of Ammon as a possession, because I have given it to the descendants of Lot as a possession.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and enter the land of the Ammonites, the descendants of Lot. But do not bother them or start a war with them. I have given the land of Ammon to them as their property, and I will not give you any of their land.’"
verses.textEnNasb: When you come opposite the sons of Ammon, do not attack them nor provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon as a possession, because I have given it to the sons of Lot as a possession.’
verses.textEn: When you come to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them to war, for I will not give you possession of any land belonging to the Ammonites. I have given it as a possession to the descendants of Lot."

verses.textZh: ‘求你让我从你的地经过；我只走大道，不偏左也不偏右。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘求你让我从你的地经过；我只走大道，不偏左也不偏右。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地也算为利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那里，亚扪人称他们为散送冥。
verses.textEnNiv: (That too was considered a land of the Rephaites, who used to live there; but the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
verses.textEnEsv: (It is also counted as a land of Rephaim. Rephaim formerly lived there—but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim—
verses.textEnNkjv: (That was also regarded as a land of giants; giants formerly dwelt there. But the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.textEnNlt: (That area was once considered the land of the Rephaites, who had lived there, though the Ammonites call them Zamzummites.
verses.textEnNasb: (It is also regarded as the land of the Rephaim, because the Rephaim previously lived in it, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummin,
verses.textEn: (That too was considered a land of the Rephaites, who used to live there; but the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.

verses.textZh: 你可以按着价钱把食物卖给我吃，也可以按着价钱把水卖给我喝；只要让我步行过去就是了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以按着价钱把食物卖给我吃，也可以按着价钱把水卖给我喝；只要让我步行过去就是了；
verses.textZhCuv: 那民众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样，但耶和华从亚扪人面前除灭他们，亚扪人就得了他们的地，接着居住。
verses.textEnNiv: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The Lord destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.
verses.textEnEsv: a people great and many, and tall as the Anakim; but the Lord destroyed them before the Ammonites, and they dispossessed them and settled in their place,
verses.textEnNkjv: a people as great and numerous and tall as the Anakim. But the Lord destroyed them before them, and they dispossessed them and dwelt in their place,
verses.textEnNlt: They were also as strong and numerous and tall as the Anakites. But the Lord destroyed them so the Ammonites could occupy their land.
verses.textEnNasb: a people as great, numerous, and tall as the Anakim; but the Lord destroyed them before them. And they dispossessed them and settled in their place,
verses.textEn: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The Lord destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.

verses.textZh: 好象住在西珥的以扫子孙，和住在亚珥的摩押人待我一样，等我过约旦河，进到耶和华我们的神赐给我们的地去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 好象住在西珥的以扫子孙，和住在亚珥的摩押人待我一样，等我过约旦河，进到耶和华我们的神赐给我们的地去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 正如耶和华从前为住西珥的以扫子孙将何利人从他们面前除灭、他们得了何利人的地、接着居住一样，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had done the same for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: as he did for the people of Esau, who live in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites before them and they dispossessed them and settled in their place even to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them. They dispossessed them and dwelt in their place, even to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: He had done the same for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, for he destroyed the Horites so they could settle there in their place. The descendants of Esau live there to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: just as He did for the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them; they dispossessed them and settled in their place, where they remain even to this day.
verses.textEn: The Lord had done the same for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.

verses.textZh: 但是希实本王西宏不肯让我们从他那里经过，因为耶和华我们的神使他的心意顽固，使他的心刚硬，为要把他交在你的手里，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是希实本王西宏不肯让我们从他那里经过，因为耶和华我们的神使他的心意顽固，使他的心刚硬，为要把他交在你的手里，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 从迦斐托出来的迦斐托人将先前住在乡村直到迦萨的亚卫人除灭，接着居住。
verses.textEnNiv: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place.)
verses.textEnEsv: As for the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came from Caphtor, destroyed them and settled in their place.)
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Avim, who dwelt in villages as far as Gaza— the Caphtorim, who came from Caphtor, destroyed them and dwelt in their place.)
verses.textEnNlt: A similar thing happened when the Caphtorites from Crete invaded and destroyed the Avvites, who had lived in villages in the area of Gaza.)
verses.textEnNasb: And as for the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came from Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)
verses.textEn: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place.)

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘看哪，我已经把西宏和他的地交给你了，你可以占领他的地作产业。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘看哪，我已经把西宏和他的地交给你了，你可以占领他的地作产业。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们起来前往，过亚嫩谷；我已将亚摩利人希实本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要与他争战，得他的地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: "Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Rise up, set out on your journey and go over the Valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession, and contend with him in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: " ‘Rise, take your journey, and cross over the River Arnon. Look, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to possess it, and engage him in battle.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses continued, "Then the Lord said, ‘Now get moving! Cross the Arnon Gorge. Look, I will hand over to you Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and I will give you his land. Attack him and begin to occupy the land.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Arise, set out, and pass through the Valley of Arnon. Look! I have handed over to you Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; start taking possession and plunge into battle with him.
verses.textEn: "Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.

verses.textZh: "那时西宏和他所有的人民都出来，攻击我们，在雅杂与我们作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时西宏和他所有的人民都出来，攻击我们，在雅杂与我们作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 从今日起，我要使天下万民听见你的名声都惊恐惧怕，且因你发颤伤恸。」
verses.textEnNiv: This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you."
verses.textEnEsv: This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole heaven, who shall hear the report of you and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon the nations under the whole heaven, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Beginning today I will make people throughout the earth terrified because of you. When they hear reports about you, they will tremble with dread and fear.’"
verses.textEnNasb: This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon the faces of people everywhere, who, when they hear the news of you, will tremble and be in anguish because of you.’
verses.textEn: This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神把他交给了我们，我们就把他、他的儿子们和他所有的人民都击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神把他交给了我们，我们就把他、他的儿子们和他所有的人民都击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我从基底莫的旷野差遣使者去见希实本王西宏，用和睦的话说：
verses.textEnNiv: From the Desert of Kedemoth I sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon offering peace and saying,
verses.textEnEsv: "So I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon the king of Heshbon, with words of peace, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I sent messengers from the Wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon, with words of peace, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses continued, "From the wilderness of Kedemoth I sent ambassadors to King Sihon of Heshbon with this proposal of peace:
verses.textEnNasb: "So I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.textEn: From the Desert of Kedemoth I sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon offering peace and saying,

verses.textZh: 那时我们夺取了他所有的城邑，把每一座城，连男带女，以及小孩子都全部毁灭，没有留下一个存活的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我们夺取了他所有的城邑，把每一座城，连男带女，以及小孩子都全部毁灭，没有留下一个存活的；
verses.textZhCuv: 『求你容我从你的地经过，只走大道，不偏左右。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let us pass through your country. We will stay on the main road; we will not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Let me pass through your land. I will go only by the road; I will turn aside neither to the right nor to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Let me pass through your land; I will keep strictly to the road, and I will turn neither to the right nor to the left.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Let us travel through your land. We will stay on the main road and won’t turn off into the fields on either side.
