verses.textEnNasb: ‘Let me pass through your land; I will travel only on the road. I will not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEn: "Let us pass through your country. We will stay on the main road; we will not turn aside to the right or to the left.

verses.textZh: 只留下我们掠为己有的牲畜，和我们夺取城邑所得的战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只留下我们掠为己有的牲畜，和我们夺取城邑所得的战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 你可以卖粮给我吃，也可以卖水给我喝，只要容我步行过去，
verses.textEnNiv: Sell us food to eat and water to drink for their price in silver. Only let us pass through on foot—
verses.textEnEsv: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat, and give me water for money, that I may drink. Only let me pass through on foot,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat, and give me water for money, that I may drink; only let me pass through on foot,
verses.textEnNlt: Sell us food to eat and water to drink, and we will pay for it. All we want is permission to pass through your land.
verses.textEnNasb: You will sell me food for money so that I may eat, and give me water for money so that I may drink, only let me pass through on foot,
verses.textEn: Sell us food to eat and water to drink for their price in silver. Only let us pass through on foot—

verses.textZh: 从亚嫩谷旁边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，没有一座城太高，是我们不能攻下的；耶和华我们的神把这一切都交给我们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从亚嫩谷旁边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，没有一座城太高，是我们不能攻下的；耶和华我们的神把这一切都交给我们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就如住西珥的以扫子孙和住亚珥的摩押人待我一样，等我过了约旦河，好进入耶和华－我们神所赐给我们的地。』
verses.textEnNiv: as the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for us—until we cross the Jordan into the land the Lord our God is giving us."
verses.textEnEsv: as the sons of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I go over the Jordan into the land that the Lord our God is giving to us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: just as the descendants of Esau who dwell in Seir and the Moabites who dwell in Ar did for me, until I cross the Jordan to the land which the Lord our God is giving us.’
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Esau who live in Seir allowed us to go through their country, and so did the Moabites, who live in Ar. Let us pass through until we cross the Jordan into the land the Lord our God is giving us.’
verses.textEnNasb: just as the sons of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I cross over the Jordan into the land that the Lord our God is giving us.’
verses.textEn: as the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for us—until we cross the Jordan into the land the Lord our God is giving us."

verses.textZh: 只有亚扪人的地，雅博河一带的地方，和山地的城市，以及耶和华我们的神吩咐我们不可去的地方，我们都没有走近。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有亚扪人的地，雅博河一带的地方，和山地的城市，以及耶和华我们的神吩咐我们不可去的地方，我们都没有走近。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但希实本王西宏不容我们从他那里经过；因为耶和华－你的神使他心中刚硬，性情顽梗，为要将他交在你手中，像今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through. For the Lord your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate in order to give him into your hands, as he has now done.
verses.textEnEsv: But Sihon the king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the Lord your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might give him into your hand, as he is this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the Lord your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "But King Sihon of Heshbon refused to allow us to pass through, because the Lord your God made Sihon stubborn and defiant so he could help you defeat him, as he has now done.
verses.textEnNasb: But Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing for us to pass through his land; for the Lord your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, in order to hand him over to you, as he is today.
verses.textEn: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through. For the Lord your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate in order to give him into your hands, as he has now done.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：『从此起首，我要将西宏和他的地交给你；你要得他的地为业。』
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：『从此起首，我要将西宏和他的地交给你；你要得他的地为业。』
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：『从此起首，我要将西宏和他的地交给你；你要得他的地为业。』
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, ‘Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land over to you. Begin to take possession, that you may occupy his land.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Lord said to me, ‘See, I have begun to give Sihon and his land over to you. Begin to possess it, that you may inherit his land.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Lord said to me, ‘Look, I have begun to hand King Sihon and his land over to you. Begin now to conquer and occupy his land.’
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, ‘See, I have begun to turn Sihon and his land over to you. Begin taking possession, so that you may possess his land.’
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land."

verses.textZh: 那时，西宏和他的众民出来攻击我们，在雅杂与我们交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，西宏和他的众民出来攻击我们，在雅杂与我们交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，西宏和他的众民出来攻击我们，在雅杂与我们交战。
verses.textEnNiv: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Sihon and all his people came out against us to fight at Jahaz.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then King Sihon declared war on us and mobilized his forces at Jahaz.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then Sihon came out with all his people to meet us in battle at Jahaz.
verses.textEn: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,

verses.textZh: 耶和华－我们的神将他交给我们，我们就把他和他的儿子，并他的众民，都击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华－我们的神将他交给我们，我们就把他和他的儿子，并他的众民，都击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神将他交给我们，我们就把他和他的儿子，并他的众民，都击杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord our God delivered him over to us and we struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord our God gave him over to us, and we defeated him and his sons and all his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord our God delivered him over to us; so we defeated him, his sons, and all his people.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord our God handed him over to us, and we crushed him, his sons, and all his people.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord our God turned him over to us, and we defeated him with his sons and all his people.
verses.textEn: the Lord our God delivered him over to us and we struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army.

verses.textZh: 我们夺了他的一切城邑，将有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭，没有留下一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们夺了他的一切城邑，将有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭，没有留下一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们夺了他的一切城邑，将有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭，没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time we took all his towns and completely destroyed them—men, women and children. We left no survivors.
verses.textEnEsv: And we captured all his cities at that time and devoted to destruction every city, men, women, and children. We left no survivors.
verses.textEnNkjv: We took all his cities at that time, and we utterly destroyed the men, women, and little ones of every city; we left none remaining.
verses.textEnNlt: We conquered all his towns and completely destroyed everyone—men, women, and children. Not a single person was spared.
verses.textEnNasb: So we captured all his cities at that time and utterly destroyed the men, women, and children of every city. We left no survivor.
verses.textEn: At that time we took all his towns and completely destroyed them—men, women and children. We left no survivors.

verses.textZh: 惟有牲畜和所夺的各城，并其中的财物，都取为自己的掠物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惟有牲畜和所夺的各城，并其中的财物，都取为自己的掠物。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有牲畜和所夺的各城，并其中的财物，都取为自己的掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: But the livestock and the plunder from the towns we had captured we carried off for ourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Only the livestock we took as spoil for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities that we captured.
verses.textEnNkjv: We took only the livestock as plunder for ourselves, with the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.textEnNlt: We took all the livestock as plunder for ourselves, along with anything of value from the towns we ransacked.
verses.textEnNasb: We took only the animals as our plunder, and the spoils of the cities which we had captured.
verses.textEn: But the livestock and the plunder from the towns we had captured we carried off for ourselves.

verses.textZh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和华－我们的神都交给我们了，没有一座城高得使我们不能攻取的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和华－我们的神都交给我们了，没有一座城高得使我们不能攻取的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和华－我们的神都交给我们了，没有一座城高得使我们不能攻取的。
verses.textEnNiv: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The Lord our God gave us all of them.
verses.textEnEsv: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and from the city that is in the valley, as far as Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The Lord our God gave all into our hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Aroer, which is on the bank of the River Arnon, and from the city that is in the ravine, as far as Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us; the Lord our God delivered all to us.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord our God also helped us conquer Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Gorge, and the town in the gorge, and the whole area as far as Gilead. No town had walls too strong for us.
verses.textEnNasb: From Aroer which is on the edge of the Valley of Arnon and from the city which is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was no city that was too high for us; the Lord our God turned it all over to us.
verses.textEn: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The Lord our God gave us all of them.

verses.textZh: 惟有亚扪人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，并山地的城邑，与耶和华－我们神所禁止我们去的地方，都没有挨近。」
verses.textZhCnvs: 惟有亚扪人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，并山地的城邑，与耶和华－我们神所禁止我们去的地方，都没有挨近。」
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有亚扪人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，并山地的城邑，与耶和华－我们神所禁止我们去的地方，都没有挨近。」
verses.textEnNiv: But in accordance with the command of the Lord our God, you did not encroach on any of the land of the Ammonites, neither the land along the course of the Jabbok nor that around the towns in the hills.
verses.textEnEsv: Only to the land of the sons of Ammon you did not draw near, that is, to all the banks of the river Jabbok and the cities of the hill country, whatever the Lord our God had forbidden us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only you did not go near the land of the people of Ammon—anywhere along the River Jabbok, or to the cities of the mountains, or wherever the Lord our God had forbidden us.
verses.textEnNlt: However, we avoided the land of the Ammonites all along the Jabbok River and the towns in the hill country—all the places the Lord our God had commanded us to leave alone.
verses.textEnNasb: Only you did not go near the land of the sons of Ammon, all along the river Jabbok and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the Lord our God had commanded us to avoid.
verses.textEn: But in accordance with the command of the Lord our God, you did not encroach on any of the land of the Ammonites, neither the land along the course of the Jabbok nor that around the towns in the hills.

verses.textZh: "后来我们回转过来，沿着到巴珊的路上去；巴珊王噩和他的众民，都出来迎着我们，在以得来与我们作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: "后来我们回转过来，沿着到巴珊的路上去；巴珊王噩和他的众民，都出来迎着我们，在以得来与我们作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以后，我们转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与我们交战。
verses.textEnNiv: Next we turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan with his whole army marched out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan; and Og king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.textEnNlt: "Next we turned and headed for the land of Bashan, where King Og and his entire army attacked us at Edrei.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og, king of Bashan, came out with all his people to meet us in battle at Edrei.
verses.textEn: Next we turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan with his whole army marched out to meet us in battle at Edrei.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘你不要怕他，因为我已经把他和他的众民，以及他的土地，都交在你的手里；你要待他，像从前你待希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏一样。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘你不要怕他，因为我已经把他和他的众民，以及他的土地，都交在你的手里；你要待他，像从前你待希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏一样。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：『不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一样。』
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to me, ‘Do not fear him, for I have given him and all his people and his land into your hand. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, ‘Do not fear him, for I have delivered him and all his people and his land into your hand; you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.’
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord told me, ‘Do not be afraid of him, for I have given you victory over Og and his entire army, and I will give you all his land. Treat him just as you treated King Sihon of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon.’
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to me, ‘Do not fear him, for I have handed him and all his people and his land over to you; and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.’
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华我们的神也把巴珊王噩和他的众民都交在我们的手里；我们击杀了他们，没有留下一个存活的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华我们的神也把巴珊王噩和他的众民都交在我们的手里；我们击杀了他们，没有留下一个存活的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华－我们的神也将巴珊王噩和他的众民都交在我们手中；我们杀了他们，没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord our God also gave into our hands Og king of Bashan and all his army. We struck them down, leaving no survivors.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord our God gave into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people, and we struck him down until he had no survivor left.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So the Lord our God also delivered into our hands Og king of Bashan, with all his people, and we attacked him until he had no survivors remaining.
verses.textEnNlt: "So the Lord our God handed King Og and all his people over to us, and we killed them all. Not a single person survived.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord our God also handed over to us Og, king of Bashan, with all his people, and we struck them until no survivor was left.
verses.textEn: So the Lord our God also gave into our hands Og king of Bashan and all his army. We struck them down, leaving no survivors.

verses.textZh: 那时，我们掠夺了他所有的城；在巴珊王噩的国土里，亚珥歌的全境，共有六十座城，没有一座城不被我们所夺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我们掠夺了他所有的城；在巴珊王噩的国土里，亚珥歌的全境，共有六十座城，没有一座城不被我们所夺。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我们夺了他所有的城，共有六十座，没有一座城不被我们所夺。这为亚珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的国。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time we took all his cities. There was not one of the sixty cities that we did not take from them—the whole region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: And we took all his cities at that time—there was not a city that we did not take from them—sixty cities, the whole region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we took all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we did not take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: We conquered all sixty of his towns—the entire Argob region in his kingdom of Bashan. Not a single town escaped our conquest.
verses.textEnNasb: We captured all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we did not take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.textEn: At that time we took all his cities. There was not one of the sixty cities that we did not take from them—the whole region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

verses.textZh: 这些城都是以高墙作堡垒，有城门，有门闩；此外，还有很多没有城墙的乡村。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些城都是以高墙作堡垒，有城门，有门闩；此外，还有很多没有城墙的乡村。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些城都有坚固的高墙，有门有闩。此外还有许多无城墙的乡村。
verses.textEnNiv: All these cities were fortified with high walls and with gates and bars, and there were also a great many unwalled villages.
verses.textEnEsv: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides very many unwalled villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these cities were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides a great many rural towns.
verses.textEnNlt: These towns were all fortified with high walls and barred gates. We also took many unwalled villages at the same time.
verses.textEnNasb: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides a great many unwalled towns.
verses.textEn: All these cities were fortified with high walls and with gates and bars, and there were also a great many unwalled villages.

verses.textZh: 我们把这些都灭尽，像从前我们待希实本王西宏一样，把各城中的男女和小孩子都灭尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们把这些都灭尽，像从前我们待希实本王西宏一样，把各城中的男女和小孩子都灭尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们将这些都毁灭了，像从前待希实本王西宏一样，把有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭；
verses.textEnNiv: We completely destroyed them, as we had done with Sihon king of Heshbon, destroying every city—men, women and children.
verses.textEnEsv: And we devoted them to destruction, as we did to Sihon the king of Heshbon, devoting to destruction every city, men, women, and children.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children of every city.
verses.textEnNlt: We completely destroyed the kingdom of Bashan, just as we had destroyed King Sihon of Heshbon. We destroyed all the people in every town we conquered—men, women, and children alike.
verses.textEnNasb: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children of every city.
verses.textEn: We completely destroyed them, as we had done with Sihon king of Heshbon, destroying every city—men, women and children.

verses.textZh: 只有城中所有的牲畜和夺得的财物，都掠为己有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有城中所有的牲畜和夺得的财物，都掠为己有。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的财物都取为自己的掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: But all the livestock and the spoil of the cities we took as our plunder.
verses.textEnNkjv: But all the livestock and the spoil of the cities we took as booty for ourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: But we kept all the livestock for ourselves and took plunder from all the towns.
verses.textEnNasb: But all the animals and the spoils of the cities we took as our plunder.
verses.textEn: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.

verses.textZh: 那时，我们从约旦河东亚摩利人的两个王手里，把从亚嫩谷直到黑门山的地夺了过来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我们从约旦河东亚摩利人的两个王手里，把从亚嫩谷直到黑门山的地夺了过来，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我们从约旦河东两个亚摩利王的手将亚嫩谷直到黑门山之地夺过来（
verses.textEnNiv: So at that time we took from these two kings of the Amorites the territory east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge as far as Mount Hermon.
verses.textEnEsv: So we took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the Valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon
verses.textEnNkjv: "And at that time we took the land from the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were on this side of the Jordan, from the River Arnon to Mount Hermon
verses.textEnNlt: "So we took the land of the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River—all the way from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon.
verses.textEnNasb: "So at that time we took the land from the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the Valley of Arnon to Mount Hermon
verses.textEn: So at that time we took from these two kings of the Amorites the territory east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge as far as Mount Hermon.

verses.textZh: 就是夺了平原上所有的城市，基列全境和巴珊全境，直到撒迦和以得来，这都是巴珊王噩国内的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是夺了平原上所有的城市，基列全境和巴珊全境，直到撒迦和以得来，这都是巴珊王噩国内的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 这黑门山，西顿人称为西连，亚摩利人称为示尼珥），
verses.textEnNiv: (Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians; the Amorites call it Senir.)
verses.textEnEsv: (the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, while the Amorites call it Senir),
verses.textEnNkjv: (the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir),
verses.textEnNlt: (Mount Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
verses.textEnNasb: (Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir):
verses.textEn: (Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians; the Amorites call it Senir.)

verses.textZh: "那时，我们占领了那地，从亚嫩谷旁边的亚罗珥起，我把基列山地的一半和其中的城市，都给了流本人和迦得人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，我们占领了那地，从亚嫩谷旁边的亚罗珥起，我把基列山地的一半和其中的城市，都给了流本人和迦得人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是夺了平原的各城、基列全地、巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得来，都是巴珊王噩国内的城邑。（
verses.textEnNiv: We took all the towns on the plateau, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Salekah and Edrei, towns of Og’s kingdom in Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: all the cities of the tableland and all Gilead and all Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the cities of the plain, all Gilead, and all Bashan, as far as Salcah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: We had now conquered all the cities on the plateau and all Gilead and Bashan, as far as the towns of Salecah and Edrei, which were part of Og’s kingdom in Bashan.
verses.textEnNasb: all the cities of the plateau, all Gilead, and all Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.textEn: We took all the towns on the plateau, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Salekah and Edrei, towns of Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

verses.textZh: 基列其余的地方和巴珊全境，就是噩王的国土，我都给了玛拿西半个支派。亚珥歌全境就是巴珊全境，这叫作利乏音人的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列其余的地方和巴珊全境，就是噩王的国土，我都给了玛拿西半个支派。亚珥歌全境就是巴珊全境，这叫作利乏音人的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是铁的，长九肘，宽四肘，都是以人肘为度。现今岂不是在亚扪人的拉巴吗？）」
verses.textEnNiv: (Og king of Bashan was the last of the Rephaites. His bed was decorated with iron and was more than nine cubits long and four cubits wide. It is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
verses.textEnEsv: (For only Og the king of Bashan was left of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bed was a bed of iron. Is it not in Rabbah of the Ammonites? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its breadth, according to the common cubit. )
verses.textEnNkjv: "For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the giants. Indeed his bedstead was an iron bedstead. (Is it not in Rabbah of the people of Ammon?) Nine cubits is its length and four cubits its width, according to the standard cubit.
verses.textEnNlt: (King Og of Bashan was the last survivor of the giant Rephaites. His bed was made of iron and was more than thirteen feet long and six feet wide. It can still be seen in the Ammonite city of Rabbah.)
verses.textEnNasb: (For only Og king of Bashan was left of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bed was a bed of iron; it is in Rabbah of the sons of Ammon. Its length was nine cubits, and its width four cubits by the usual cubit.)
verses.textEn: (Og king of Bashan was the last of the Rephaites. His bed was decorated with iron and was more than nine cubits long and four cubits wide. It is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的儿子睚珥，占了亚珥歌全境，直到基述人和玛迦人的边界，就按着自己的名字称巴珊全境为哈倭特．睚珥，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的儿子睚珥，占了亚珥歌全境，直到基述人和玛迦人的边界，就按着自己的名字称巴珊全境为哈倭特．睚珥，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，我们得了这地。从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，我将基列山地的一半，并其中的城邑，都给了吕便人和迦得人。
verses.textEnNiv: Of the land that we took over at that time, I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory north of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge, including half the hill country of Gilead, together with its towns.
verses.textEnEsv: "When we took possession of this land at that time, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory beginning at Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the River Arnon, and half the mountains of Gilead and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites.
verses.textEnNlt: "When we took possession of this land, I gave to the tribes of Reuben and Gad the territory beyond Aroer along the Arnon Gorge, plus half of the hill country of Gilead with its towns.
verses.textEnNasb: "So we took possession of this land at that time. From Aroer, which is by the Valley of Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead and its cities I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.textEn: Of the land that we took over at that time, I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory north of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge, including half the hill country of Gilead, together with its towns.

verses.textZh: 我又把基列给了玛吉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又把基列给了玛吉。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的国，我给了玛拿西半支派。亚珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；这叫做利乏音人之地。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of Gilead and also all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob in Bashan used to be known as a land of the Rephaites.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, that is, all the region of Argob, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (All that portion of Bashan is called the land of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to half the tribe of Manasseh. (All the region of Argob, with all Bashan, was called the land of the giants.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan—Og’s former kingdom—to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (This entire Argob region of Bashan used to be known as the land of the Rephaites.
verses.textEnNasb: The rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh, all the region of Argob. (As to all Bashan, it is called the land of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: The rest of Gilead and also all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob in Bashan used to be known as a land of the Rephaites.

verses.textZh: 从基列到亚嫩谷，以谷的中心为界，直到亚扪人边界的雅博河，我都给了流本人和迦得人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 从基列到亚嫩谷，以谷的中心为界，直到亚扪人边界的雅博河，我都给了流本人和迦得人；
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥占了亚珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和玛迦人的交界，就按自己的名称这巴珊地为哈倭特‧睚珥，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maakathites; it was named after him, so that to this day Bashan is called Havvoth Jair. )
verses.textEnEsv: Jair the Manassite took all the region of Argob, that is, Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called the villages after his own name, Havvoth-jair, as it is to this day.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and called Bashan after his own name, Havoth Jair, to this day.)
verses.textEnNlt: Jair, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, conquered the whole Argob region in Bashan, all the way to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites. Jair renamed this region after himself, calling it the Towns of Jair, as it is still known today.)
verses.textEnNasb: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, that is, Bashan, and named it after his own name: Havvoth-jair, as it is to this day.)
verses.textEn: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maakathites; it was named after him, so that to this day Bashan is called Havvoth Jair. )

verses.textZh: 又把亚拉巴，和以约旦河为界，从基尼烈直到亚拉巴海，就是盐海，在毘斯迦山坡下东边的地方，都给了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把亚拉巴，和以约旦河为界，从基尼烈直到亚拉巴海，就是盐海，在毘斯迦山坡下东边的地方，都给了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又将基列给了玛吉。
verses.textEnNiv: And I gave Gilead to Makir.
verses.textEnEsv: To Machir I gave Gilead,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also I gave Gilead to Machir.
verses.textEnNlt: I gave Gilead to the clan of Makir.
verses.textEnNasb: To Machir I gave Gilead.
verses.textEn: And I gave Gilead to Makir.

verses.textZh: "那时，我吩咐你们：‘耶和华你们的神，已经把这地赐给你们作产业了；你们所有的战士，都要预备好，在你们的兄弟以色列人面前过河去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，我吩咐你们：‘耶和华你们的神，已经把这地赐给你们作产业了；你们所有的战士，都要预备好，在你们的兄弟以色列人面前过河去。
verses.textZhCuv: 从基列到亚嫩谷，以谷中为界，直到亚扪人交界的雅博河，我给了吕便人和迦得人，
verses.textEnNiv: But to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory extending from Gilead down to the Arnon Gorge (the middle of the gorge being the border) and out to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: and to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead as far as the Valley of the Arnon, with the middle of the valley as a border, as far over as the river Jabbok, the border of the Ammonites;
verses.textEnNkjv: And to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave from Gilead as far as the River Arnon, the middle of the river as the border, as far as the River Jabbok, the border of the people of Ammon;
verses.textEnNlt: But I also gave part of Gilead to the tribes of Reuben and Gad. The area I gave them extended from the middle of the Arnon Gorge in the south to the Jabbok River on the Ammonite frontier.
verses.textEnNasb: To the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave from Gilead even as far as the Valley of Arnon, the middle of the valley as a border, and as far as the river Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon;
verses.textEn: But to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory extending from Gilead down to the Arnon Gorge (the middle of the gorge being the border) and out to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 只有你们的妻子、小孩子和牲畜，可以留在我赐给你们的城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有你们的妻子、小孩子和牲畜，可以留在我赐给你们的城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将亚拉巴和靠近约旦河之地，从基尼烈直到亚拉巴海，就是盐海，并毗斯迦山根东边之地，都给了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Its western border was the Jordan in the Arabah, from Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnEsv: the Arabah also, with the Jordan as the border, from Chinnereth as far as the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah on the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: the plain also, with the Jordan as the border, from Chinnereth as far as the east side of the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnNlt: They also received the Jordan Valley, all the way from the Sea of Galilee down to the Dead Sea, with the Jordan River serving as the western boundary. To the east were the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnNasb: the Arabah also, with the Jordan as a border, from Chinnereth even as far as the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, at the foot of the slopes of Pisgah on the east.
verses.textEn: Its western border was the Jordan in the Arabah, from Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), below the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.textZh: 直到耶和华使你们的兄弟，像你们一样得了安身的地方；他们也占领了耶和华你们的神在约旦河西赐给他们的地，然后你们各人才可以回到我赐给你们作产业的地去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到耶和华使你们的兄弟，像你们一样得了安身的地方；他们也占领了耶和华你们的神在约旦河西赐给他们的地，然后你们各人才可以回到我赐给你们作产业的地去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，我吩咐你们说：『耶和华－你们的神已将这地赐给你们为业；你们所有的勇士都要带着兵器，在你们的弟兄以色列人前面过去。
verses.textEnNiv: I commanded you at that time: "The Lord your God has given you this land to take possession of it. But all your able-bodied men, armed for battle, must cross over ahead of the other Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘The Lord your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor shall cross over armed before your brothers, the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I commanded you at that time, saying: ‘The Lord your God has given you this land to possess. All you men of valor shall cross over armed before your brethren, the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time I gave this command to the tribes that would live east of the Jordan: ‘Although the Lord your God has given you this land as your property, all your fighting men must cross the Jordan ahead of your Israelite relatives, armed and ready to assist them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘The Lord your God has given you this land to possess it; all you valiant men shall cross over armed ahead of your brothers, the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: I commanded you at that time: "The Lord your God has given you this land to take possession of it. But all your able-bodied men, armed for battle, must cross over ahead of the other Israelites.

verses.textZh: 那时，我吩咐约书亚：‘你亲眼看见了耶和华你们的神向这两个王所行的一切；耶和华也必向你正要去的各国照样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我吩咐约书亚：‘你亲眼看见了耶和华你们的神向这两个王所行的一切；耶和华也必向你正要去的各国照样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们的妻子、孩子、牲畜（我知道你们有许多的牲畜）可以住在我所赐给你们的各城里。
verses.textEnNiv: However, your wives, your children and your livestock (I know you have much livestock) may stay in the towns I have given you,
verses.textEnEsv: Only your wives, your little ones, and your livestock (I know that you have much livestock) shall remain in the cities that I have given you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But your wives, your little ones, and your livestock (I know that you have much livestock) shall stay in your cities which I have given you,
verses.textEnNlt: Your wives, children, and numerous livestock, however, may stay behind in the towns I have given you.
verses.textEnNasb: However, your wives, your little ones, and your livestock (I know that you have much livestock) shall remain in your cities which I have given you,
verses.textEn: However, your wives, your children and your livestock (I know you have much livestock) may stay in the towns I have given you,

verses.textZh: 你们不要怕他们，因为耶和华你们的神要为你们作战。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要怕他们，因为耶和华你们的神要为你们作战。’
verses.textZhCuv: 等到你们弟兄在约旦河那边，也得耶和华－你们神所赐给他们的地，又使他们得享平安，与你们一样，你们才可以回到我所赐给你们为业之地。』
verses.textEnNiv: until the Lord gives rest to your fellow Israelites as he has to you, and they too have taken over the land that the Lord your God is giving them across the Jordan. After that, each of you may go back to the possession I have given you."
verses.textEnEsv: until the Lord gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also occupy the land that the Lord your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then each of you may return to his possession which I have given you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: until the Lord has given rest to your brethren as to you, and they also possess the land which the Lord your God is giving them beyond the Jordan. Then each of you may return to his possession which I have given you.’
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord has given security to the rest of the Israelites, as he has to you, and when they occupy the land the Lord your God is giving them across the Jordan River, then you may all return here to the land I have given you.’
verses.textEnNasb: until the Lord gives rest to your fellow countrymen as to you, and they also take possession of the land which the Lord your God is giving them beyond the Jordan. Then you may return, each man to his possession which I have given you.’
verses.textEn: until the Lord gives rest to your fellow Israelites as he has to you, and they too have taken over the land that the Lord your God is giving them across the Jordan. After that, each of you may go back to the possession I have given you."

verses.textZh: "那时，我恳求耶和华，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，我恳求耶和华，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我吩咐约书亚说：『你亲眼看见了耶和华－你神向这二王所行的；耶和华也必向你所要去的各国照样行。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I commanded Joshua: "You have seen with your own eyes all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. The Lord will do the same to all the kingdoms over there where you are going.
verses.textEnEsv: And I commanded Joshua at that time, ‘Your eyes have seen all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. So will the Lord do to all the kingdoms into which you are crossing.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes have seen all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings; so will the Lord do to all the kingdoms through which you pass.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time I gave Joshua this charge: ‘You have seen for yourself everything the Lord your God has done to these two kings. He will do the same to all the kingdoms on the west side of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNasb: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes have seen everything that the Lord your God has done to these two kings; the Lord will do the same to all the kingdoms into which you are about to cross.
verses.textEn: At that time I commanded Joshua: "You have seen with your own eyes all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. The Lord will do the same to all the kingdoms over there where you are going.

verses.textZh: ‘主耶和华啊，你已经把你的伟大和你有能力的手显给你的仆人看；在天上地下，哪一个神能有像你所作的工作，能有像你所行的奇事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘主耶和华啊，你已经把你的伟大和你有能力的手显给你的仆人看；在天上地下，哪一个神能有像你所作的工作，能有像你所行的奇事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要怕他们，因那为你争战的是耶和华－你的神。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid of them; the Lord your God himself will fight for you."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not fear them, for it is the Lord your God who fights for you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You must not fear them, for the Lord your God Himself fights for you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be afraid of the nations there, for the Lord your God will fight for you.’
verses.textEnNasb: Do not fear them, for the Lord your God is the One fighting for you.’
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid of them; the Lord your God himself will fight for you."

verses.textZh: 求你让我过去，看看约旦河西的美地，就是那美好的山地和黎巴嫩。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你让我过去，看看约旦河西的美地，就是那美好的山地和黎巴嫩。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，我恳求耶和华说：
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I pleaded with the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: "And I pleaded with the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I pleaded with the Lord at that time, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time I pleaded with the Lord and said,
verses.textEnNasb: "I also pleaded with the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.textEn: At that time I pleaded with the Lord :

verses.textZh: 但耶和华为了你们的缘故，向我发怒，不听我的恳求；耶和华对我说：‘罢了，不要向我再提这事了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华为了你们的缘故，向我发怒，不听我的恳求；耶和华对我说：‘罢了，不要向我再提这事了。
verses.textZhCuv: 『主耶和华啊，你已将你的大力大能显给仆人看。在天上，在地下，有什么神能像你行事、像你有大能的作为呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Sovereign Lord , you have begun to show to your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do the deeds and mighty works you do?
verses.textEnEsv: ‘O Lord God , you have only begun to show your servant your greatness and your mighty hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do such works and mighty acts as yours?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘O Lord God, You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness and Your mighty hand, for what god isthere in heaven or on earth who can do anything like Your works and Your mighty deeds?
verses.textEnNlt: ‘O Sovereign Lord , you have only begun to show your greatness and the strength of your hand to me, your servant. Is there any god in heaven or on earth who can perform such great and mighty deeds as you do?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Lord God, You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness and Your strong hand; for what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do such works and mighty acts as Yours?
verses.textEn: "Sovereign Lord , you have begun to show to your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do the deeds and mighty works you do?

verses.textZh: 你要上毘斯迦山顶去，举目向东、南、西、北，亲眼观看，因为你不能过这约旦河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要上毘斯迦山顶去，举目向东、南、西、北，亲眼观看，因为你不能过这约旦河。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你容我过去，看约旦河那边的美地，就是那佳美的山地和黎巴嫩。』
verses.textEnNiv: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that fine hill country and Lebanon."
verses.textEnEsv: Please let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan, that good hill country and Lebanon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I pray, let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan, those pleasant mountains, and Lebanon.’
verses.textEnNlt: Please let me cross the Jordan to see the wonderful land on the other side, the beautiful hill country and the Lebanon mountains.’
verses.textEnNasb: Please let me cross over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that good hill country, and Lebanon.’
verses.textEn: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that fine hill country and Lebanon."

verses.textZh: 你却要吩咐约书亚，坚固他，鼓励他，因为他要在这人民前面过河去，使他们承受你看见的这地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却要吩咐约书亚，坚固他，鼓励他，因为他要在这人民前面过河去，使他们承受你看见的这地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华因你们的缘故向我发怒，不应允我，对我说：『罢了！你不要向我再提这事。
verses.textEnNiv: But because of you the Lord was angry with me and would not listen to me. "That is enough," the Lord said. "Do not speak to me anymore about this matter.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord was angry with me because of you and would not listen to me. And the Lord said to me, ‘Enough from you; do not speak to me of this matter again.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But the Lord was angry with me on your account, and would not listen to me. So the Lord said to me: ‘Enough of that! Speak no more to Me of this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the Lord was angry with me because of you, and he would not listen to me. ‘That’s enough!’ he declared. ‘Speak of it no more.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord was angry with me on your account, and would not listen to me; instead, the Lord said to me, ‘ Enough! Do not speak to Me any more about this matter.
verses.textEn: But because of you the Lord was angry with me and would not listen to me. "That is enough," the Lord said. "Do not speak to me anymore about this matter.

verses.textZh: 于是我们住在伯．毘珥对面的谷中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我们住在伯．毘珥对面的谷中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你且上毗斯迦山顶去，向东、西、南、北举目观望，因为你必不能过这约旦河。
verses.textEnNiv: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look west and north and south and east. Look at the land with your own eyes, since you are not going to cross this Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: Go up to the top of Pisgah and lift up your eyes westward and northward and southward and eastward, and look at it with your eyes, for you shall not go over this Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift your eyes toward the west, the north, the south, and the east; behold it with your eyes, for you shall not cross over this Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: But go up to Pisgah Peak, and look over the land in every direction. Take a good look, but you may not cross the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Go up to the top of Pisgah and raise your eyes to the west, the north, the south, and the east, and see it with your eyes; for you shall not cross over this Jordan.
verses.textEn: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look west and north and south and east. Look at the land with your own eyes, since you are not going to cross this Jordan.

verses.textZh: 你却要嘱咐约书亚，勉励他，使他胆壮；因为他必在这百姓前面过去，使他们承受你所要观看之地。』
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却要嘱咐约书亚，勉励他，使他胆壮；因为他必在这百姓前面过去，使他们承受你所要观看之地。』
verses.textZhCuv: 你却要嘱咐约书亚，勉励他，使他胆壮；因为他必在这百姓前面过去，使他们承受你所要观看之地。』
verses.textEnNiv: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead this people across and will cause them to inherit the land that you will see."
verses.textEnEsv: But charge Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he shall go over at the head of this people, and he shall put them in possession of the land that you shall see.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But command Joshua, and encourage him and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you will see.’
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, commission Joshua and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead the people across the Jordan. He will give them all the land you now see before you as their possession.’
verses.textEnNasb: But commission Joshua and encourage him and strengthen him, for he shall go across leading this people, and he will give to them, as an inheritance, the land which you will see.’
verses.textEn: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead this people across and will cause them to inherit the land that you will see."

verses.textZh: 于是我们住在伯‧毗珥对面的谷中。」
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我们住在伯‧毗珥对面的谷中。」
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我们住在伯‧毗珥对面的谷中。」
verses.textEnNiv: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
verses.textEnEsv: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth Peor.
verses.textEnNlt: So we stayed in the valley near Beth-peor.
verses.textEnNasb: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
verses.textEn: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

verses.textZh: "以色列人哪，现在你们要听我向来教训你们遵行的律例和典章，使你们可以活着，可以进去得着耶和华你们列祖的神赐给你们的地作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人哪，现在你们要听我向来教训你们遵行的律例和典章，使你们可以活着，可以进去得着耶和华你们列祖的神赐给你们的地作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列人哪，现在我所教训你们的律例典章，你们要听从遵行，好叫你们存活，得以进入耶和华－你们列祖之神所赐给你们的地，承受为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Israel, hear the decrees and laws I am about to teach you. Follow them so that you may live and may go in and take possession of the land the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now, O Israel, listen to the statutes and the rules that I am teaching you, and do them, that you may live, and go in and take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your fathers, is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now, O Israel, listen to the statutes and the judgments which I teach you to observe, that you may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, Israel, listen carefully to these decrees and regulations that I am about to teach you. Obey them so that you may live, so you may enter and occupy the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and the judgments which I am teaching you to perform, so that you will live and go in and take possession of the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
verses.textEn: Now, Israel, hear the decrees and laws I am about to teach you. Follow them so that you may live and may go in and take possession of the land the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

verses.textZh: 我吩咐你们的话，你们不可增加，也不可减少，好使你们遵守我吩咐你们的，就是耶和华你们的神的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我吩咐你们的话，你们不可增加，也不可减少，好使你们遵守我吩咐你们的，就是耶和华你们的神的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 所吩咐你们的话，你们不可加添，也不可删减，好叫你们遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和华－你们神的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the Lord your God that I give you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not add to the word that I command you, nor take from it, that you may keep the commandments of the Lord your God that I command you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not add to the word which I command you, nor take from it, that you may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not add to or subtract from these commands I am giving you. Just obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not add to the word which I am commanding you, nor take away from it, so that you may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I am commanding you.
verses.textEn: Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the Lord your God that I give you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华因巴力．毘珥的事所行的，你们都亲眼看见了；所有跟随巴力．毘珥的人，耶和华你们的神都从你们中间消灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华因巴力．毘珥的事所行的，你们都亲眼看见了；所有跟随巴力．毘珥的人，耶和华你们的神都从你们中间消灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华因巴力‧毗珥的事所行的，你们亲眼看见了。凡随从巴力‧毗珥的人，耶和华－你们的神都从你们中间除灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: You saw with your own eyes what the Lord did at Baal Peor. The Lord your God destroyed from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,
verses.textEnEsv: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did at Baal-peor, for the Lord your God destroyed from among you all the men who followed the Baal of Peor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did at Baal Peor; for the Lord your God has destroyed from among you all the men who followed Baal of Peor.
verses.textEnNlt: "You saw for yourself what the Lord did to you at Baal-peor. There the Lord your God destroyed everyone who had worshiped Baal, the god of Peor.
verses.textEnNasb: Your eyes have seen what the Lord has done in the case of Baal-peor, for all the men who followed Baal-peor, the Lord your God has destroyed them from among you.
verses.textEn: You saw with your own eyes what the Lord did at Baal Peor. The Lord your God destroyed from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,

verses.textZh: 只有你们紧紧倚靠耶和华你们的神的人，今日全都活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有你们紧紧倚靠耶和华你们的神的人，今日全都活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有你们专靠耶和华－你们神的人，今日全都存活。
verses.textEnNiv: but all of you who held fast to the Lord your God are still alive today.
verses.textEnEsv: But you who held fast to the Lord your God are all alive today.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you who held fast to the Lord your God are alive today, every one of you.
verses.textEnNlt: But all of you who were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today—every one of you.
verses.textEnNasb: But you who clung to the Lord your God are alive today, every one of you.
verses.textEn: but all of you who held fast to the Lord your God are still alive today.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我照着耶和华我的神吩咐我的，把律例和典章教训你们，好让你们在将要进去得为业的地上遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我照着耶和华我的神吩咐我的，把律例和典章教训你们，好让你们在将要进去得为业的地上遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 我照着耶和华－我神所吩咐的将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要进去得为业的地上遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEnEsv: See, I have taught you statutes and rules, as the Lord my God commanded me, that you should do them in the land that you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Surely I have taught you statutes and judgments, just as the Lord my God commanded me, that you should act according tothem in the land which you go to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I now teach you these decrees and regulations just as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may obey them in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: "See, I have taught you statutes and judgments just as the Lord my God commanded me, that you are to do these things in the land where you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEn: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要谨守遵行，因为在万民的眼中看来，这就是你们的智慧和聪明；他们一听见这一切律例，就必定说：‘这大国的人真是有智慧，有聪明啊。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要谨守遵行，因为在万民的眼中看来，这就是你们的智慧和聪明；他们一听见这一切律例，就必定说：‘这大国的人真是有智慧，有聪明啊。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要谨守遵行；这就是你们在万民眼前的智慧、聪明。他们听见这一切律例，必说：『这大国的人真是有智慧，有聪明！』
verses.textEnNiv: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."
verses.textEnEsv: Keep them and do them, for that will be your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples, who, when they hear all these statutes, will say, ‘Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore be careful to observe them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who will hear all these statutes, and say, ‘Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.’
verses.textEnNlt: Obey them completely, and you will display your wisdom and intelligence among the surrounding nations. When they hear all these decrees, they will exclaim, ‘How wise and prudent are the people of this great nation!’
verses.textEnNasb: So keep and do them, for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who will hear all these statutes and say, ‘Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.’
verses.textEn: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."

verses.textZh: 哪一个大国的人有神与他们这样亲近，像耶和华我们的神，在我们每次呼求他的时候，与我们亲近一样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 哪一个大国的人有神与他们这样亲近，像耶和华我们的神，在我们每次呼求他的时候，与我们亲近一样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 哪一大国的人有神与他们相近，像耶和华－我们的神、在我们求告他的时候与我们相近呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the Lord our God is near us whenever we pray to him?
verses.textEnEsv: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to it as the Lord our God is to us, whenever we call upon him?
verses.textEnNkjv: "For what great nation isthere that has God so near to it, as the Lord our God is to us, for whatever reason we may call upon Him?
verses.textEnNlt: For what great nation has a god as near to them as the Lord our God is near to us whenever we call on him?
verses.textEnNasb: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to it as is the Lord our God whenever we call on Him?
verses.textEn: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the Lord our God is near us whenever we pray to him?

verses.textZh: 又哪一个大国有这样公义的律例和典章，像我今日在你面前颁布的这一切律法呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 又哪一个大国有这样公义的律例和典章，像我今日在你面前颁布的这一切律法呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 又哪一大国有这样公义的律例典章、像我今日在你们面前所陈明的这一切律法呢？
verses.textEnNiv: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?
verses.textEnEsv: And what great nation is there, that has statutes and rules so righteous as all this law that I set before you today?
verses.textEnNkjv: And what great nation isthere that has such statutes and righteous judgments as are in all this law which I set before you this day?
verses.textEnNlt: And what great nation has decrees and regulations as righteous and fair as this body of instructions that I am giving you today?
verses.textEnNasb: Or what great nation is there that has statutes and judgments as righteous as this whole Law which I am setting before you today?
verses.textEn: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?

verses.textZh: "你只要自己谨慎，又要谨守你的心思，免得你忘了你亲眼看见的事，又免得这些事在你有生之日离开你的心；总要把这些事传给你的子子孙孙，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你只要自己谨慎，又要谨守你的心思，免得你忘了你亲眼看见的事，又免得这些事在你有生之日离开你的心；总要把这些事传给你的子子孙孙，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你只要谨慎，殷勤保守你的心灵，免得忘记你亲眼所看见的事，又免得你一生、这事离开你的心；总要传给你的子子孙孙。
verses.textEnNiv: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them fade from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Only take care, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things that your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life. Make them known to your children and your children’s children—
verses.textEnNkjv: Only take heed to yourself, and diligently keep yourself, lest you forget the things your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life. And teach them to your children and your grandchildren,
verses.textEnNlt: "But watch out! Be careful never to forget what you yourself have seen. Do not let these memories escape from your mind as long as you live! And be sure to pass them on to your children and grandchildren.
verses.textEnNasb: "Only be careful for yourself and watch over your soul diligently, so that you do not forget the things which your eyes have seen and they do not depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your sons and your grandsons.
verses.textEn: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them fade from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.

verses.textZh: 免得你忘了你在何烈山，站在耶和华你们的神面前的那天。那时耶和华对我说：‘你要为我召集众民，我要叫他们听我的话，使他们在那地上生活的日子，可以学习敬畏我，又可以教训自己的儿女。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得你忘了你在何烈山，站在耶和华你们的神面前的那天。那时耶和华对我说：‘你要为我召集众民，我要叫他们听我的话，使他们在那地上生活的日子，可以学习敬畏我，又可以教训自己的儿女。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你在何烈山站在耶和华－你神面前的那日，耶和华对我说：『你为我招聚百姓，我要叫他们听见我的话，使他们存活在世的日子，可以学习敬畏我，又可以教训儿女这样行。』
verses.textEnNiv: Remember the day you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, when he said to me, "Assemble the people before me to hear my words so that they may learn to revere me as long as they live in the land and may teach them to their children."
verses.textEnEsv: how on the day that you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, the Lord said to me, ‘Gather the people to me, that I may let them hear my words, so that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children so.’
verses.textEnNkjv: especiallyconcerning the day you stood before the Lord your God in Horeb, when the Lord said to me, ‘Gather the people to Me, and I will let them hear My words, that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.’
verses.textEnNlt: Never forget the day when you stood before the Lord your God at Mount Sinai, where he told me, ‘Summon the people before me, and I will personally instruct them. Then they will learn to fear me as long as they live, and they will teach their children to fear me also.’
verses.textEnNasb: Remember the day you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, when the Lord said to me, ‘Assemble the people to Me, that I may have them hear My words so that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.’
verses.textEn: Remember the day you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, when he said to me, "Assemble the people before me to hear my words so that they may learn to revere me as long as they live in the land and may teach them to their children."

verses.textZh: 那时，你们走前来，站在山下；山上有火烧着，火焰冲天，又有黑暗、密云和幽暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你们走前来，站在山下；山上有火烧着，火焰冲天，又有黑暗、密云和幽暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时你们近前来，站在山下；山上有火焰冲天，并有昏黑、密云、幽暗。
verses.textEnNiv: You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain while it blazed with fire to the very heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: And you came near and stood at the foot of the mountain, while the mountain burned with fire to the heart of heaven, wrapped in darkness, cloud, and gloom.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you came near and stood at the foot of the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire to the midst of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: "You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain, while flames from the mountain shot into the sky. The mountain was shrouded in black clouds and deep darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: You came forward and stood at the foot of the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire to the heart of the heavens: darkness, cloud, and thick gloom.
verses.textEn: You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain while it blazed with fire to the very heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华从火中对你们说话；你们只听见声音，却没有看见形象；只有声音，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华从火中对你们说话；你们只听见声音，却没有看见形象；只有声音，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华从火焰中对你们说话，你们只听见声音，却没有看见形象。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire. You heard the sound of words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; you only heard a voice.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord spoke to you from the heart of the fire. You heard the sound of his words but didn’t see his form; there was only a voice.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to you from the midst of the fire; you heard the sound of words, but you saw no form—there was only a voice.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice.

verses.textZh: 把他的约，就是他吩咐你们遵守的那十条诫命 ，向你们宣布出来；又把它们写在两块石版上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他的约，就是他吩咐你们遵守的那十条诫命 ，向你们宣布出来；又把它们写在两块石版上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将所吩咐你们当守的约指示你们，就是十条诫，并将这诫写在两块石版上。
verses.textEnNiv: He declared to you his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he commanded you to follow and then wrote them on two stone tablets.
verses.textEnEsv: And he declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, that is, the Ten Commandments, and he wrote them on two tablets of stone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, the Ten Commandments; and He wrote them on two tablets of stone.
verses.textEnNlt: He proclaimed his covenant—the Ten Commandments —which he commanded you to keep, and which he wrote on two stone tablets.
verses.textEnNasb: So He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, that is, the Ten Commandments; and He wrote them on two tablets of stone.
verses.textEn: He declared to you his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he commanded you to follow and then wrote them on two stone tablets.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华也吩咐我把律例和典章教训你们，使你们在将要过去得为业的地上遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华也吩咐我把律例和典章教训你们，使你们在将要过去得为业的地上遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时耶和华又吩咐我将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord directed me at that time to teach you the decrees and laws you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and rules, that you might do them in the land that you are going over to possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might observe them in the land which you cross over to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: It was at that time that the Lord commanded me to teach you his decrees and regulations so you would obey them in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, so that you would perform them in the land where you are going over to take possession of it.
verses.textEn: And the Lord directed me at that time to teach you the decrees and laws you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

verses.textZh: "所以你们要特别小心，谨慎自己，因为耶和华在何烈山从火中对你们说话的那一天，你们没有看见甚么形象；
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以你们要特别小心，谨慎自己，因为耶和华在何烈山从火中对你们说话的那一天，你们没有看见甚么形象；
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，你们要分外谨慎；因为耶和华在何烈山、从火中对你们说话的那日，你们没有看见什么形象。
verses.textEnNiv: You saw no form of any kind the day the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves very carefully,
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore watch yourselves very carefully. Since you saw no form on the day that the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the midst of the fire,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take careful heed to yourselves, for you saw no form when the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the midst of the fire,
verses.textEnNlt: "But be very careful! You did not see the Lord ’s form on the day he spoke to you from the heart of the fire at Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: "So be very careful yourselves, since you did not see any form on the day the Lord spoke to you at Horeb from the midst of the fire,
verses.textEn: You saw no form of any kind the day the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves very carefully,

verses.textZh: 恐怕你们败坏自己，为自己制造偶像，制造任何神像的形象，无论是男像或是女像，
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕你们败坏自己，为自己制造偶像，制造任何神像的形象，无论是男像或是女像，
verses.textZhCuv: 惟恐你们败坏自己，雕刻偶像，仿佛什么男像女像，
verses.textEnNiv: so that you do not become corrupt and make for yourselves an idol, an image of any shape, whether formed like a man or a woman,
verses.textEnEsv: beware lest you act corruptly by making a carved image for yourselves, in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.textEnNkjv: lest you act corruptly and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of any figure: the likeness of male or female,
verses.textEnNlt: So do not corrupt yourselves by making an idol in any form—whether of a man or a woman,
verses.textEnNasb: so that you do not act corruptly and make a carved image for yourselves in the form of any figure, a representation of male or female,
verses.textEn: so that you do not become corrupt and make for yourselves an idol, an image of any shape, whether formed like a man or a woman,

verses.textZh: 或是地上各种走兽的像，或是飞翔在空中各类有翅膀的雀鸟的像，
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是地上各种走兽的像，或是飞翔在空中各类有翅膀的雀鸟的像，
verses.textZhCuv: 或地上走兽的像，或空中飞鸟的像，
verses.textEnNiv: or like any animal on earth or any bird that flies in the air,
verses.textEnEsv: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the air,
verses.textEnNkjv: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth or the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the air,
verses.textEnNlt: an animal on the ground, a bird in the sky,
verses.textEnNasb: a representation of any animal that is on the earth, a representation of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
verses.textEn: or like any animal on earth or any bird that flies in the air,

verses.textZh: 或是地上各种爬行的动物的像，或是地底下水里各样鱼类的像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是地上各种爬行的动物的像，或是地底下水里各样鱼类的像。
verses.textZhCuv: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中鱼的像。
verses.textEnNiv: or like any creature that moves along the ground or any fish in the waters below.
verses.textEnEsv: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground or the likeness of any fish that is in the water beneath the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: a small animal that scurries along the ground, or a fish in the deepest sea.
verses.textEnNasb: a representation of anything that crawls on the ground, or a representation of any fish that is in the water below the earth.
verses.textEn: or like any creature that moves along the ground or any fish in the waters below.

verses.textZh: 又恐怕你抬头望天，看见日、月、星，就是天上万象的时候，就被勾引，去敬拜和事奉它们，那原是耶和华你们的神分给天下万民享用的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又恐怕你抬头望天，看见日、月、星，就是天上万象的时候，就被勾引，去敬拜和事奉它们，那原是耶和华你们的神分给天下万民享用的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又恐怕你向天举目观看，见耶和华－你的神为天下万民所摆列的日月星，就是天上的万象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉它。
verses.textEnNiv: And when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon and the stars—all the heavenly array—do not be enticed into bowing down to them and worshiping things the Lord your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: And beware lest you raise your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of heaven, you be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them, things that the Lord your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And takeheed, lest you lift your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun, the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, you feel driven to worship them and serve them, which the Lord your God has given to all the peoples under the whole heaven as a heritage.
verses.textEnNlt: And when you look up into the sky and see the sun, moon, and stars—all the forces of heaven—don’t be seduced into worshiping them. The Lord your God gave them to all the peoples of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And be careful not to raise your eyes to heaven and look at the sun, the moon, and the stars, all the heavenly lights, and allow yourself to be drawn away and worship them and serve them, things which the Lord your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole heaven.
verses.textEn: And when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon and the stars—all the heavenly array—do not be enticed into bowing down to them and worshiping things the Lord your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶和华却把你们从埃及，从铁炉那里领出来，作他自己的产业，自己的人民，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华却把你们从埃及，从铁炉那里领出来，作他自己的产业，自己的人民，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将你们从埃及领出来，脱离铁炉，要特作自己产业的子民，像今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for you, the Lord took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be a people of his own inheritance, as you are this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be His people, an inheritance, as you are this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that the Lord rescued you from the iron-smelting furnace of Egypt in order to make you his very own people and his special possession, which is what you are today.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be a people of His own possession, as today.
verses.textEn: But as for you, the Lord took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又因你们的缘故，向我发怒，并且起誓不让我过约旦河，也不容我进入耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的那美地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又因你们的缘故，向我发怒，并且起誓不让我过约旦河，也不容我进入耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的那美地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又因你们的缘故向我发怒，起誓必不容我过约旦河，也不容我进入耶和华－你神所赐你为业的那美地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord was angry with me because of you, and he solemnly swore that I would not cross the Jordan and enter the good land the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Furthermore, the Lord was angry with me because of you, and he swore that I should not cross the Jordan, and that I should not enter the good land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I would not cross over the Jordan, and that I would not enter the good land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the Lord was angry with me because of you. He vowed that I would not cross the Jordan River into the good land the Lord your God is giving you as your special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now the Lord was angry with me on your account, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan, and that I would not enter the good land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: The Lord was angry with me because of you, and he solemnly swore that I would not cross the Jordan and enter the good land the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance.

verses.textZh: 我只有死在此地，不得过约旦河；你们却可以过去，取得那美地作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我只有死在此地，不得过约旦河；你们却可以过去，取得那美地作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 我只得死在这地，不能过约旦河；但你们必过去得那美地。
verses.textEnNiv: I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan; but you are about to cross over and take possession of that good land.
verses.textEnEsv: For I must die in this land; I must not go over the Jordan. But you shall go over and take possession of that good land.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I must die in this land, I must not cross over the Jordan; but you shall cross over and possess that good land.
verses.textEnNlt: You will cross the Jordan to occupy the land, but I will not. Instead, I will die here on the east side of the river.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am going to die in this land; I am not crossing the Jordan, but you are going to cross, and you will take possession of this good land.
verses.textEn: I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan; but you are about to cross over and take possession of that good land.

verses.textZh: 你们要自己谨慎，免得你们忘记了耶和华你们的神与你们所立的约，你们就为自己制造偶像，制造任何神像的形象，就是耶和华你的神吩咐你不可作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要自己谨慎，免得你们忘记了耶和华你们的神与你们所立的约，你们就为自己制造偶像，制造任何神像的形象，就是耶和华你的神吩咐你不可作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华－你们神与你们所立的约，为自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和华－你神所禁止你做的偶像；
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful not to forget the covenant of the Lord your God that he made with you; do not make for yourselves an idol in the form of anything the Lord your God has forbidden.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care, lest you forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make a carved image, the form of anything that the Lord your God has forbidden you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the Lord your God which He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the Lord your God has forbidden you.
verses.textEnNlt: So be careful not to break the covenant the Lord your God has made with you. Do not make idols of any shape or form, for the Lord your God has forbidden this.
verses.textEnNasb: So be careful yourselves, that you do not forget the covenant of the Lord your God which He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of anything against which the Lord your God has commanded you.
verses.textEn: Be careful not to forget the covenant of the Lord your God that he made with you; do not make for yourselves an idol in the form of anything the Lord your God has forbidden.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神是烈火，是忌邪的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神是烈火，是忌邪的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你的神乃是烈火，是忌邪的神。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God is a devouring fire; he is a jealous God.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

verses.textZh: "你们生子生孙，在那地住久了的时候，如果你们败坏自己，制造偶像，制造任何神像的形象，行耶和华你的神看为恶的事，惹他发怒，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们生子生孙，在那地住久了的时候，如果你们败坏自己，制造偶像，制造任何神像的形象，行耶和华你的神看为恶的事，惹他发怒，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们在那地住久了，生子生孙，就雕刻偶像，仿佛什么形象，败坏自己，行耶和华－你神眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: After you have had children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time—if you then become corrupt and make any kind of idol, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God and arousing his anger,
verses.textEnEsv: "When you father children and children’s children, and have grown old in the land, and you act corruptly by making a carved image in the form of anything, and by doing what is evil in the sight of the Lord your God, so as to provoke him to anger,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you beget children and grandchildren and have grown old in the land, and act corruptly and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do evil in the sight of the Lord your God to provoke Him to anger,
verses.textEnNlt: "In the future, when you have children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time, do not corrupt yourselves by making idols of any kind. This is evil in the sight of the Lord your God and will arouse his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you father children and have grandchildren, and you grow old in the land, and you act corruptly, and make an idol in the form of anything, and do what is evil in the sight of the Lord your God to provoke Him to anger,
verses.textEn: After you have had children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time—if you then become corrupt and make any kind of idol, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God and arousing his anger,

verses.textZh: 我今日就呼天唤地向你们作证，你们必在过约旦河取得为业的地上迅速灭亡；你们必不能在那地长久生存，必全被消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今日就呼天唤地向你们作证，你们必在过约旦河取得为业的地上迅速灭亡；你们必不能在那地长久生存，必全被消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作见证，你们必在过约旦河得为业的地上速速灭尽！你们不能在那地上长久，必尽行除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live there long but will certainly be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from the land that you are going over the Jordan to possess. You will not live long in it, but will be utterly destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you will soon utterly perish from the land which you cross over the Jordan to possess; you will not prolong your days in it, but will be utterly destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Today I call on heaven and earth as witnesses against you. If you break my covenant, you will quickly disappear from the land you are crossing the Jordan to occupy. You will live there only a short time; then you will be utterly destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today, that you will certainly perish quickly from the land where you are going over the Jordan to take possession of it. You will not live long on it, but will be utterly destroyed.
verses.textEn: I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live there long but will certainly be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中；在耶和华要领你们所到的万国中，你们剩下的人数必不多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中；在耶和华要领你们所到的万国中，你们剩下的人数必不多。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中；在他所领你们到的万国里，你们剩下的人数稀少。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the Lord will drive you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the Lord will drive you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the Lord will drive you.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will scatter you among the nations, where only a few of you will survive.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the Lord drives you.
verses.textEn: The Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the Lord will drive you.

verses.textZh: 在那里你们必事奉人手所做的神，就是用木头石头做成的，不能看、不能听、不能吃、不能闻的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里你们必事奉人手所做的神，就是用木头石头做成的，不能看、不能听、不能吃、不能闻的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，你们必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成、不能看、不能听、不能吃、不能闻的神。
verses.textEnNiv: There you will worship man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
verses.textEnEsv: And there you will serve gods of wood and stone, the work of human hands, that neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.
verses.textEnNlt: There, in a foreign land, you will worship idols made from wood and stone—gods that neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.
verses.textEnNasb: There you will serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear, nor eat nor smell anything.
verses.textEn: There you will worship man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

verses.textZh: 但你们在那里必寻求耶和华你的神；如果你一心一意寻找他，就必寻见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们在那里必寻求耶和华你的神；如果你一心一意寻找他，就必寻见。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们在那里必寻求耶和华－你的神。你尽心尽性寻求他的时候，就必寻见。
verses.textEnNiv: But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find him if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnEsv: But from there you will seek the Lord your God and you will find him, if you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: But from there you will seek the Lord your God, and you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: But from there you will search again for the Lord your God. And if you search for him with all your heart and soul, you will find him.
verses.textEnNasb: But from there you will seek the Lord your God, and you will find Him if you search for Him with all your heart and all your soul.
verses.textEn: But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find him if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.textZh: 日后，你落在患难中，这些事都临到你身上的时候，你必归向耶和华你的神，听从他的话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 日后，你落在患难中，这些事都临到你身上的时候，你必归向耶和华你的神，听从他的话；
verses.textZhCuv: 日后你遭遇一切患难的时候，你必归回耶和华－你的神，听从他的话。
