verses.textEnNiv: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the Lord your God and obey him.
verses.textEnEsv: When you are in tribulation, and all these things come upon you in the latter days, you will return to the Lord your God and obey his voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you are in distress, and all these things come upon you in the latter days, when you turn to the Lord your God and obey His voice
verses.textEnNlt: "In the distant future, when you are suffering all these things, you will finally return to the Lord your God and listen to what he tells you.
verses.textEnNasb: When you are in distress and all these things happen to you, in the latter days you will return to the Lord your God and listen to His voice.
verses.textEn: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the Lord your God and obey him.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神原是满有怜悯的神，他必不丢弃你，不毁灭你，也不忘记他起誓与你的列祖所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神原是满有怜悯的神，他必不丢弃你，不毁灭你，也不忘记他起誓与你的列祖所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神原是有怜悯的神；他总不撇下你，不灭绝你，也不忘记他起誓与你列祖所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon or destroy you or forget the covenant with your ancestors, which he confirmed to them by oath.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God is a merciful God. He will not leave you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers that he swore to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: (for the Lord your God is a merciful God), He will not forsake you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the solemn covenant he made with your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God is a compassionate God; He will not abandon you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant with your fathers which He swore to them.
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon or destroy you or forget the covenant with your ancestors, which he confirmed to them by oath.

verses.textZh: "你问问在你以前过去的日子，自从神创造人在地上以来，从天这边到天那边，有没有人行过这样的大事，听过像这样的事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你问问在你以前过去的日子，自从神创造人在地上以来，从天这边到天那边，有没有人行过这样的大事，听过像这样的事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神何曾从别的国中将一国的人民领出来，用试验、神迹、奇事、争战、大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事，像耶和华－你们的神在埃及，在你们眼前为你们所行的一切事呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Ask now about the former days, long before your time, from the day God created human beings on the earth; ask from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything so great as this ever happened, or has anything like it ever been heard of?
verses.textEnEsv: "For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and ask from one end of heaven to the other, whether such a great thing as this has ever happened or was ever heard of.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For ask now concerning the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and ask from one end of heaven to the other, whether any great thing like this has happened, or anything like it has been heard.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now search all of history, from the time God created people on the earth until now, and search from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything as great as this ever been seen or heard before?
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, ask now about the earlier days that were before your time, since the day that God created mankind on the earth, and inquire from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything been done like this great thing, or has anything been heard like it?
verses.textEn: Ask now about the former days, long before your time, from the day God created human beings on the earth; ask from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything so great as this ever happened, or has anything like it ever been heard of?

verses.textZh: 有没有一个民族听见神在火中说话的声音，像你听见的一样，还能活着呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有没有一个民族听见神在火中说话的声音，像你听见的一样，还能活着呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 这是显给你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和华－他是神，除他以外，再无别神。
verses.textEnNiv: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived?
verses.textEnEsv: Did any people ever hear the voice of a god speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and still live?
verses.textEnNkjv: Did any people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
verses.textEnNlt: Has any nation ever heard the voice of God speaking from fire—as you did—and survived?
verses.textEnNasb: Has any people heard the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as you have heard it, and survived?
verses.textEn: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived?

verses.textZh: 有没有一位神尝试借着试验、神迹、奇事、战争、大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，以及大而可畏的事，把一国的人民从别的国中领出来，像耶和华你们的神在埃及，在你们面前为你们所作的一切事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有没有一位神尝试借着试验、神迹、奇事、战争、大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，以及大而可畏的事，把一国的人民从别的国中领出来，像耶和华你们的神在埃及，在你们面前为你们所作的一切事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他从天上使你听见他的声音，为要教训你，又在地上使你看见他的烈火，并且听见他从火中所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?
verses.textEnEsv: Or has any god ever attempted to go and take a nation for himself from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, and by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and by great deeds of terror, all of which the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or did God ever try to go and take for Himself a nation from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.textEnNlt: Has any other god dared to take a nation for himself out of another nation by means of trials, miraculous signs, wonders, war, a strong hand, a powerful arm, and terrifying acts? Yet that is what the Lord your God did for you in Egypt, right before your eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: Or has a god ventured to go to take for himself a nation from within another nation by trials, by signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, just as the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.textEn: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

verses.textZh: 这是要显明给你看，使你知道，只有耶和华是神；除了他以外，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是要显明给你看，使你知道，只有耶和华是神；除了他以外，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他爱你的列祖，所以拣选他们的后裔，用大能亲自领你出了埃及，
verses.textEnNiv: You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord is God; besides him there is no other.
verses.textEnEsv: To you it was shown, that you might know that the Lord is God; there is no other besides him.
verses.textEnNkjv: To you it was shown, that you might know that the Lord Himself is God; thereis none other besides Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "He showed you these things so you would know that the Lord is God and there is no other.
verses.textEnNasb: You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord, He is God; there is no other besides Him.
verses.textEn: You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord is God; besides him there is no other.

verses.textZh: 他从天上使你听见他的声音，为要教导你；又在地上使你看见他的大火，并且叫你听到他从火中所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从天上使你听见他的声音，为要教导你；又在地上使你看见他的大火，并且叫你听到他从火中所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将比你强大的国民从你面前赶出，领你进去，将他们的地赐你为业，像今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of heaven he let you hear his voice, that he might discipline you. And on earth he let you see his great fire, and you heard his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of heaven He let you hear His voice, that He might instruct you; on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: He let you hear his voice from heaven so he could instruct you. He let you see his great fire here on earth so he could speak to you from it.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of the heavens He let you hear His voice to discipline you; and on earth He let you see His great fire, and you heard His words from the midst of the fire.
verses.textEn: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire.

verses.textZh: 因为他爱你的列祖，所以才拣选了他们的 后裔，用大能亲自把你从埃及领出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他爱你的列祖，所以才拣选了他们的 后裔，用大能亲自把你从埃及领出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，今日你要知道，也要记在心上，天上地下惟有耶和华他是神，除他以外，再无别神。
verses.textEnNiv: Because he loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength,
verses.textEnEsv: And because he loved your fathers and chose their offspring after them and brought you out of Egypt with his own presence, by his great power,
verses.textEnNkjv: And because He loved your fathers, therefore He chose their descendants after them; and He brought you out of Egypt with His Presence, with His mighty power,
verses.textEnNlt: Because he loved your ancestors, he chose to bless their descendants, and he personally brought you out of Egypt with a great display of power.
verses.textEnNasb: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them. And He personally brought you from Egypt by His great power,
verses.textEn: Because he loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength,

verses.textZh: 为要把比你大比你强的民族，从你面前赶走，然后领你进去，把他们的地赐给你作产业，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要把比你大比你强的民族，从你面前赶走，然后领你进去，把他们的地赐给你作产业，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日将他的律例诫命晓谕你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孙可以得福，并使你的日子在耶和华－你神所赐的地上得以长久。」
verses.textEnNiv: to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: driving out before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day,
verses.textEnNkjv: driving out from before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land as an inheritance, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: He drove out nations far greater than you, so he could bring you in and give you their land as your special possession, as it is today.
verses.textEnNasb: driving out from before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in and to give you their land as an inheritance, as it is today.
verses.textEn: to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today.

verses.textZh: 所以今天你要知道，也要记在心里；天上地下，只有耶和华是神；除他以外，再没有别的神了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以今天你要知道，也要记在心里；天上地下，只有耶和华是神；除他以外，再没有别的神了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，摩西在约旦河东，向日出之地，分定三座城，
verses.textEnNiv: Acknowledge and take to heart this day that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other.
verses.textEnEsv: know therefore today, and lay it to your heart, that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore know this day, and consider it in your heart, that the Lord Himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; thereis no other.
verses.textEnNlt: "So remember this and keep it firmly in mind: The Lord is God both in heaven and on earth, and there is no other.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore know today, and take it to your heart, that the Lord, He is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.
verses.textEn: Acknowledge and take to heart this day that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other.

verses.textZh: 你要遵守我今日吩咐你的律例和诫命，使你和你的子孙得享福乐，也使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的那地上得享长寿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要遵守我今日吩咐你的律例和诫命，使你和你的子孙得享福乐，也使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的那地上得享长寿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使那素无仇恨、无心杀了人的，可以逃到这三城之中的一座城，就得存活：
verses.textEnNiv: Keep his decrees and commands, which I am giving you today, so that it may go well with you and your children after you and that you may live long in the land the Lord your God gives you for all time.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you shall keep his statutes and his commandments, which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land that the Lord your God is giving you for all time."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall therefore keep His statutes and His commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for all time."
verses.textEnNlt: If you obey all the decrees and commands I am giving you today, all will be well with you and your children. I am giving you these instructions so you will enjoy a long life in the land the Lord your God is giving you for all time."
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall keep His statutes and His commandments which I am giving you today, so that it may go well for you and for your children after you, and that you may live long on the land which the Lord your God is giving you for all time."
verses.textEn: Keep his decrees and commands, which I am giving you today, so that it may go well with you and your children after you and that you may live long in the land the Lord your God gives you for all time.

verses.textZh: 那时，摩西在约旦河东，日出的方向，把三座城分别出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，摩西在约旦河东，日出的方向，把三座城分别出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 为吕便人分定旷野平原的比悉；为迦得人分定基列的拉末；为玛拿西人分定巴珊的哥兰。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses set apart three cities in the east beyond the Jordan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses set apart three cities on this side of the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses set apart three cities of refuge east of the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses set apart three cities across the Jordan to the east,
verses.textEn: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan,

verses.textZh: 让那些素无仇恨、无心误杀人的，可以逃到那里去；逃到这三座城的一座去的，都可以活着：
verses.textZhCnvs: 让那些素无仇恨、无心误杀人的，可以逃到那里去；逃到这三座城的一座去的，都可以活着：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在以色列人面前所陈明的律法－
verses.textEnNiv: to which anyone who had killed a person could flee if they had unintentionally killed a neighbor without malice aforethought. They could flee into one of these cities and save their life.
verses.textEnEsv: that the manslayer might flee there, anyone who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without being at enmity with him in time past; he may flee to one of these cities and save his life:
verses.textEnNkjv: that the manslayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without having hated him in time past, and that by fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who killed another person unintentionally, without previous hostility, could flee there to live in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: for one to flee there who unintentionally killed his neighbor, without having hatred for him in time past; and by fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
verses.textEn: to which anyone who had killed a person could flee if they had unintentionally killed a neighbor without malice aforethought. They could flee into one of these cities and save their life.

verses.textZh: 为流本人，分出了在旷野平原的比悉；为迦得人，分出了基列的拉末；为玛拿西人，分出了巴珊的哥兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为流本人，分出了在旷野平原的比悉；为迦得人，分出了基列的拉末；为玛拿西人，分出了巴珊的哥兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及后所传给他们的法度、律例、典章；
verses.textEnNiv: The cities were these: Bezer in the wilderness plateau, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
verses.textEnEsv: Bezer in the wilderness on the tableland for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the cities: Bezer on the wilderness plateau for the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in Gilead for the tribe of Gad; Golan in Bashan for the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
verses.textEn: The cities were these: Bezer in the wilderness plateau, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

verses.textZh: 以下是摩西在以色列人面前所立的律法，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是摩西在以色列人面前所立的律法，
verses.textZhCuv: 在约旦河东伯‧毗珥对面的谷中，在住希实本、亚摩利王西宏之地；这西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及后所击杀的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the law Moses set before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the law that Moses set before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the body of instruction that Moses presented to the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this is the Law which Moses set before the sons of Israel;
verses.textEn: This is the law Moses set before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及以后，对他们所说的法度、律例和典章；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及以后，对他们所说的法度、律例和典章；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是两个亚摩利王，在约旦河东向日出之地。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the stipulations, decrees and laws Moses gave them when they came out of Egypt
verses.textEnEsv: These are the testimonies, the statutes, and the rules, which Moses spoke to the people of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the testimonies, the statutes, and the judgments which Moses spoke to the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the laws, decrees, and regulations that Moses gave to the people of Israel when they left Egypt,
verses.textEnNasb: these are the testimonies and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, when they came out of Egypt,
verses.textEn: These are the stipulations, decrees and laws Moses gave them when they came out of Egypt

verses.textZh: 地点是在约旦河东，伯．毘珥对面的谷中，就是住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏的地。这西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及后击杀的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地点是在约旦河东，伯．毘珥对面的谷中，就是住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏的地。这西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及后击杀的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，就是黑门山。
verses.textEnNiv: and were in the valley near Beth Peor east of the Jordan, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites as they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: beyond the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the people of Israel defeated when they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: on this side of the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel defeated after they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: and as they camped in the valley near Beth-peor east of the Jordan River. (This land was formerly occupied by the Amorites under King Sihon, who ruled from Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites destroyed him and his people when they came up from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: across the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel defeated when they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: and were in the valley near Beth Peor east of the Jordan, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites as they came out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 他们占领了他的地和巴珊王噩的地，就是两个亚摩利人的王，是住在约旦河东，日出的方向的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们占领了他的地和巴珊王噩的地，就是两个亚摩利人的王，是住在约旦河东，日出的方向的；
verses.textZhCuv: 还有约旦河东的全亚拉巴，直到亚拉巴海，靠近毗斯迦山根。
verses.textEnNiv: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took possession of his land and the land of Og, the king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who lived to the east beyond the Jordan;
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who were on this side of the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
verses.textEnNlt: Israel took possession of his land and that of King Og of Bashan—the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were across the Jordan to the east,
verses.textEn: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，西云山就是黑门山；
verses.textZhCnvs: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，西云山就是黑门山；
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，西云山就是黑门山；
verses.textEnNiv: This land extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge to Mount Sirion (that is, Hermon),
verses.textEnEsv: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, as far as Mount Sirion (that is, Hermon),
verses.textEnNkjv: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the River Arnon, even to Mount Sion (that is, Hermon),
verses.textEnNlt: So Israel conquered the entire area from Aroer at the edge of the Arnon Gorge all the way to Mount Sirion, also called Mount Hermon.
verses.textEnNasb: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of Arnon, even as far as Mount Sion (that is, Hermon),
verses.textEn: This land extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge to Mount Sirion (that is, Hermon),

verses.textZh: 还有约旦河东的亚拉巴全地，直到亚拉巴海，就是毘斯迦的山坡下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有约旦河东的亚拉巴全地，直到亚拉巴海，就是毘斯迦的山坡下。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有约旦河东的亚拉巴全地，直到亚拉巴海，就是毘斯迦的山坡下。
verses.textEnNiv: and included all the Arabah east of the Jordan, as far as the Dead Sea, below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnEsv: together with all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan as far as the Sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all the plain on the east side of the Jordan as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnNlt: And they conquered the eastern bank of the Jordan River as far south as the Dead Sea, below the slopes of Pisgah.)
verses.textEnNasb: with all the Arabah across the Jordan to the east, even as far as the sea of the Arabah, at the foot of the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEn: and included all the Arabah east of the Jordan, as far as the Dead Sea, below the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.textZh: 摩西把以色列人都召了来，对他们说："以色列人哪，我今日讲给你们听的律例和典章，你们要听从，要学习，要谨慎遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把以色列人都召了来，对他们说："以色列人哪，我今日讲给你们听的律例和典章，你们要听从，要学习，要谨慎遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将以色列众人召了来，对他们说：「以色列人哪，我今日晓谕你们的律例典章，你们要听，可以学习，谨守遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, "Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the rules that I speak in your hearing today, and you shall learn them and be careful to do them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses called all Israel, and said to them: "Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your hearing today, that you may learn them and be careful to observe them.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses called all the people of Israel together and said, "Listen carefully, Israel. Hear the decrees and regulations I am giving you today, so you may learn them and obey them!
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: "Listen, Israel, to the statutes and ordinances which I am speaking today for you to hear, so that you may learn them and be careful to do them.
verses.textEn: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神在何烈山与我们立了约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神在何烈山与我们立了约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神在何烈山与我们立约。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
verses.textEn: The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

verses.textZh: 这约，耶和华不是与我们的列祖立的，而是与我们今日在这里还活着的人立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这约，耶和华不是与我们的列祖立的，而是与我们今日在这里还活着的人立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这约不是与我们列祖立的，乃是与我们今日在这里存活之人立的。
verses.textEnNiv: It was not with our ancestors that the Lord made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today.
verses.textEnEsv: Not with our fathers did the Lord make this covenant, but with us, who are all of us here alive today.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, those who are here today, all of us who are alive.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord did not make this covenant with our ancestors, but with all of us who are alive today.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, all of us who are alive here today.
verses.textEn: It was not with our ancestors that the Lord made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在山上，从火中，面对面的与你们说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在山上，从火中，面对面的与你们说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在山上，从火中，面对面与你们说话－
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord spoke to you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke with you face to face at the mountain, out of the midst of the fire,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord talked with you face to face on the mountain from the midst of the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: At the mountain the Lord spoke to you face to face from the heart of the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord spoke with you face to face at the mountain from the midst of the fire,
verses.textEn: The Lord spoke to you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.

verses.textZh: 那时，我站在耶和华和你们中间，要把耶和华的话告诉你们；你们因为惧怕那火，所以没有上到山上来，耶和华说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我站在耶和华和你们中间，要把耶和华的话告诉你们；你们因为惧怕那火，所以没有上到山上来，耶和华说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我站在耶和华和你们中间，要将耶和华的话传给你们；因为你们惧怕那火，没有上山－说：
verses.textEnNiv: (At that time I stood between the Lord and you to declare to you the word of the Lord , because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:
verses.textEnEsv: while I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to declare to you the word of the Lord . For you were afraid because of the fire, and you did not go up into the mountain. He said:
verses.textEnNkjv: I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to declare to you the word of the Lord; for you were afraid because of the fire, and you did not go up the mountain. He said:
verses.textEnNlt: I stood as an intermediary between you and the Lord , for you were afraid of the fire and did not want to approach the mountain. He spoke to me, and I passed his words on to you. This is what he said:
verses.textEnNasb: while I was standing between the Lord and you at that time, to declare to you the word of the Lord; for you were afraid because of the fire, and you did not go up on the mountain. He said,
verses.textEn: (At that time I stood between the Lord and you to declare to you the word of the Lord , because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:

verses.textZh: "‘我是耶和华你的神，曾经把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我是耶和华你的神，曾经把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『我是耶和华－你的神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I am the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the Lord your God, who rescued you from the land of Egypt, the place of your slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I am the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEn: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

verses.textZh: "‘除我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘除我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『除了我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall have no other gods before Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not have any other god but me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall have no other gods besides Me.
verses.textEn: "You shall have no other gods before me.

verses.textZh: "‘你不可为自己做偶像，也不可做天上、地下和地底下水中各物的形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你不可为自己做偶像，也不可做天上、地下和地底下水中各物的形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做什么形象，仿佛上天、下地和地底下、水中的百物。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not make for yourself a carved image—any likeness ofanything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not make for yourself an idol of any kind, or an image of anything in the heavens or on the earth or in the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any likeness of what is in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the water under the earth.
verses.textEn: "You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

verses.textZh: 不可跪拜它们，也不可事奉它们，因为我耶和华你们的神是忌邪的神；恨恶我的，我必追讨他们的罪，从父亲到儿子，直到三四代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可跪拜它们，也不可事奉它们，因为我耶和华你们的神是忌邪的神；恨恶我的，我必追讨他们的罪，从父亲到儿子，直到三四代。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华－你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代；
verses.textEnNiv: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not bow down to them or serve them, for I the Lord your God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall not bow down to them nor serve them. For I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
verses.textEnNlt: You must not bow down to them or worship them, for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God who will not tolerate your affection for any other gods. I lay the sins of the parents upon their children; the entire family is affected—even children in the third and fourth generations of those who reject me.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not worship them nor serve them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, inflicting the punishment of the fathers on the children, even on the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
verses.textEn: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.textZh: 爱我和遵守我诫命的，我必向他们施慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱我和遵守我诫命的，我必向他们施慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱我、守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textEnNiv: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.textEnEsv: but showing steadfast love to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: but showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: But I lavish unfailing love for a thousand generations on those who love me and obey my commands.
verses.textEnNasb: but showing favor to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments.
verses.textEn: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.

verses.textZh: "‘不可妄称耶和华你神的名，因为妄称耶和华的名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不可妄称耶和华你神的名，因为妄称耶和华的名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可妄称耶和华－你神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless who takes His name in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not misuse the name of the Lord your God. The Lord will not let you go unpunished if you misuse his name.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not leave unpunished the one who takes His name in vain.
verses.textEn: "You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

verses.textZh: "‘要遵守安息日为圣日，照着耶和华你神吩咐你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘要遵守安息日为圣日，照着耶和华你神吩咐你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『当照耶和华－你神所吩咐的守安息日为圣日。
verses.textEnNiv: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the Lord your God has commanded you.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the Lord your God commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the Lord your God commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the Lord your God has commanded you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Keep the Sabbath day to treat it as holy, as the Lord your God commanded you.
verses.textEn: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the Lord your God has commanded you.

verses.textZh: 六日要劳碌，作你一切工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六日要劳碌，作你一切工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，
verses.textEnNiv: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEnEsv: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEnNkjv: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEnNlt: You have six days each week for your ordinary work,
verses.textEnNasb: For six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEn: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

verses.textZh: 但第七日是属于耶和华你神的安息日；这一日，你和你的儿女、仆婢、牛驴和一切牲畜，以及你城里的寄居者，不可作任何的工，好使你的仆婢可以和你一样享受安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但第七日是属于耶和华你神的安息日；这一日，你和你的儿女、仆婢、牛驴和一切牲畜，以及你城里的寄居者，不可作任何的工，好使你的仆婢可以和你一样享受安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 但第七日是向耶和华－你神当守的安息日。这一日，你和你的儿女、仆婢、牛、驴、牲畜，并在你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做，使你的仆婢可以和你一样安息。
verses.textEnNiv: but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your ox, your donkey or any of your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns, so that your male and female servants may rest, as you do.
verses.textEnEsv: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, you or your son or your daughter or your male servant or your female servant, or your ox or your donkey or any of your livestock, or the sojourner who is within your gates, that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord your God. Init you shall do no work: you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger who is within your gates, that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
verses.textEnNlt: but the seventh day is a Sabbath day of rest dedicated to the Lord your God. On that day no one in your household may do any work. This includes you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, your oxen and donkeys and other livestock, and any foreigners living among you. All your male and female servants must rest as you do.
verses.textEnNasb: but the seventh day is a Sabbath of the Lord your God; you shall not do any work that day, you or your son or your daughter, or your male slave or your female slave, or your ox, your donkey, or any of your cattle, or your resident who stays with you, so that your male slave and your female slave may rest as well as you.
verses.textEn: but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your ox, your donkey or any of your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns, so that your male and female servants may rest, as you do.

verses.textZh: 你要记住：你在埃及地作过奴仆；耶和华你的神用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，把你从那里领出来，因此耶和华你的神吩咐你要守安息日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记住：你在埃及地作过奴仆；耶和华你的神用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，把你从那里领出来，因此耶和华你的神吩咐你要守安息日。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆；耶和华－你神用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂将你从那里领出来。因此，耶和华－你的神吩咐你守安息日。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the Lord your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the Lord your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God brought you out from there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm; therefore the Lord your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that you were once slaves in Egypt, but the Lord your God brought you out with his strong hand and powerful arm. That is why the Lord your God has commanded you to rest on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm; therefore the Lord your God commanded you to celebrate the Sabbath day.
verses.textEn: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the Lord your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

verses.textZh: "‘要孝敬父母，照着耶和华你的神吩咐你的，使你可以得享长寿，也使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，得享福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘要孝敬父母，照着耶和华你的神吩咐你的，使你可以得享长寿，也使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，得享福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『当照耶和华－你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，并使你的日子在耶和华－你神所赐你的地上得以长久。
verses.textEnNiv: "Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God commanded you, that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, that your days may be long, and that it may be well with you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Honor your father and mother, as the Lord your God commanded you. Then you will live a long, full life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Honor your father and your mother, just as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that your days may be prolonged and that it may go well for you on the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEn: "Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.textZh: "‘不可杀人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不可杀人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可杀人。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not murder.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘You shall not murder.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not murder.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not murder.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not murder.
verses.textEn: "You shall not murder.

verses.textZh: "‘不可奸淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不可奸淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可奸淫。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And you shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEn: "You shall not commit adultery.

verses.textZh: "‘不可偷盗。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不可偷盗。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可偷盗。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not steal.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And you shall not steal.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not steal.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not steal.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not steal.
verses.textEn: "You shall not steal.

verses.textZh: "‘不可作假证供陷害你的邻舍。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不可作假证供陷害你的邻舍。
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可作假见证陷害人。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And you shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not testify falsely against your neighbor.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.textEn: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

verses.textZh: "‘不可贪爱你邻舍的妻子；不可贪图你邻舍的房屋、田地、仆婢、牛驴和你邻舍的任何东西。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不可贪爱你邻舍的妻子；不可贪图你邻舍的房屋、田地、仆婢、牛驴和你邻舍的任何东西。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不可贪恋人的妻子；也不可贪图人的房屋、田地、仆婢、牛、驴，并他一切所有的。』
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not set your desire on your neighbor’s house or land, his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. And you shall not desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife; and you shall not desire your neighbor’s house, his field, his male servant, his female servant, his ox, his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not covet your neighbor’s wife. You must not covet your neighbor’s house or land, male or female servant, ox or donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbor.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor desire your neighbor’s house, his field, his male slave or his female slave, his ox, his donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.’
verses.textEn: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not set your desire on your neighbor’s house or land, his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

verses.textZh: "这些话就是耶和华在山上，从火中、密云中、幽暗里，大声对你们全体会众所说的，并没有加添甚么；他把这些话写在两块石版上，交给了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这些话就是耶和华在山上，从火中、密云中、幽暗里，大声对你们全体会众所说的，并没有加添甚么；他把这些话写在两块石版上，交给了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这些话是耶和华在山上，从火中、云中、幽暗中，大声晓谕你们全会众的；此外并没有添别的话。他就把这话写在两块石版上，交给我了。」
verses.textEnNiv: These are the commandments the Lord proclaimed in a loud voice to your whole assembly there on the mountain from out of the fire, the cloud and the deep darkness; and he added nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.
verses.textEnEsv: "These words the Lord spoke to all your assembly at the mountain out of the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, with a loud voice; and he added no more. And he wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These words the Lord spoke to all your assembly, in the mountain from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, with a loud voice; and He added no more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord spoke these words to all of you assembled there at the foot of the mountain. He spoke with a loud voice from the heart of the fire, surrounded by clouds and deep darkness. This was all he said at that time, and he wrote his words on two stone tablets and gave them to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "These words the Lord spoke to your whole assembly at the mountain from the midst of the fire, from the cloud, and from the thick darkness, with a great voice, and He added nothing more. He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
verses.textEn: These are the commandments the Lord proclaimed in a loud voice to your whole assembly there on the mountain from out of the fire, the cloud and the deep darkness; and he added nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.

verses.textZh: 那时山上被火烧着，你们听见有声音从黑暗中发出来的时候，你们各支派的首领和你们的长老，都走到我这里来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时山上被火烧着，你们听见有声音从黑暗中发出来的时候，你们各支派的首领和你们的长老，都走到我这里来，
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，火焰烧山，你们听见从黑暗中出来的声音；你们支派中所有的首领和长老都来就近我，
verses.textEnNiv: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was ablaze with fire, all the leaders of your tribes and your elders came to me.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So it was, when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, that you came near to me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders.
verses.textEnNlt: "But when you heard the voice from the heart of the darkness, while the mountain was blazing with fire, all your tribal leaders and elders came to me.
verses.textEnNasb: And when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you approached me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders.
verses.textEn: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was ablaze with fire, all the leaders of your tribes and your elders came to me.

verses.textZh: 说：‘看哪，耶和华我们的神把他的荣耀和伟大显给我们看，我们又听见他从火中发出来的声音；今日我们看见了神与人说话，而人还能活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘看哪，耶和华我们的神把他的荣耀和伟大显给我们看，我们又听见他从火中发出来的声音；今日我们看见了神与人说话，而人还能活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『看哪，耶和华－我们神将他的荣光和他的大能显给我们看，我们又听见他的声音从火中出来。今日我们得见神与人说话，人还存活。
verses.textEnNiv: And you said, "The Lord our God has shown us his glory and his majesty, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that a person can live even if God speaks with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And you said, ‘Behold, the Lord our God has shown us his glory and greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire. This day we have seen God speak with man, and man still live.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you said: ‘Surely the Lord our God has shown us His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice from the midst of the fire. We have seen this day that God speaks with man; yet he still lives.
verses.textEnNlt: They said, ‘Look, the Lord our God has shown us his glory and greatness, and we have heard his voice from the heart of the fire. Today we have seen that God can speak to us humans, and yet we live!
verses.textEnNasb: You said, ‘Behold, the Lord our God has shown us His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice from the midst of the fire; we have seen today that God speaks with mankind, yet he lives.
verses.textEn: And you said, "The Lord our God has shown us his glory and his majesty, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that a person can live even if God speaks with them.

verses.textZh: 现在这大火快要吞灭我们了，我们为甚么要冒死呢？如果我们再听见耶和华我们神的声音，我们就必死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在这大火快要吞灭我们了，我们为甚么要冒死呢？如果我们再听见耶和华我们神的声音，我们就必死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在这大火将要烧灭我们，我们何必冒死呢？若再听见耶和华－我们神的声音就必死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: But now, why should we die? This great fire will consume us, and we will die if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, we shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the Lord our God anymore, then we shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: But now, why should we risk death again? If the Lord our God speaks to us again, we will certainly die and be consumed by this awesome fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer, then we will die!
verses.textEn: But now, why should we die? This great fire will consume us, and we will die if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer.

verses.textZh: 因为有血肉生命的人，有谁像我们一样，听见永活的神从火中说话的声音，还能活着呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有血肉生命的人，有谁像我们一样，听见永活的神从火中说话的声音，还能活着呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属血气的，曾有何人听见永生神的声音从火中出来，像我们听见还能存活呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For what mortal has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?
verses.textEnEsv: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of fire as we have, and has still lived?
verses.textEnNkjv: For who isthere of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.textEnNlt: Can any living thing hear the voice of the living God from the heart of the fire as we did and yet survive?
verses.textEnNasb: For who is there of humanity who has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.textEn: For what mortal has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?

verses.textZh: 现在求你走前去，听听耶和华我们的神要说的一切话；然后你要把耶和华我们的神对你所说的一切话，都告诉我们；我们就必听从，也必遵行。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你走前去，听听耶和华我们的神要说的一切话；然后你要把耶和华我们的神对你所说的一切话，都告诉我们；我们就必听从，也必遵行。’
verses.textZhCuv: 求你近前去，听耶和华－我们神所要说的一切话，将他对你说的话都传给我们，我们就听从遵行。』
verses.textEnNiv: Go near and listen to all that the Lord our God says. Then tell us whatever the Lord our God tells you. We will listen and obey."
verses.textEnEsv: Go near and hear all that the Lord our God will say, and speak to us all that the Lord our God will speak to you, and we will hear and do it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You go near and hear all that the Lord our God may say, and tell us all that the Lord our God says to you, and we will hear and do it.’
verses.textEnNlt: Go yourself and listen to what the Lord our God says. Then come and tell us everything he tells you, and we will listen and obey.’
verses.textEnNasb: Go near and listen to everything that the Lord our God says; then speak to us everything that the Lord our God speaks to you, and we will listen and do it.’
verses.textEn: Go near and listen to all that the Lord our God says. Then tell us whatever the Lord our God tells you. We will listen and obey."

verses.textZh: "你们对我说话的时候，耶和华听见了你们说话的声音；耶和华就对我说：‘这人民对你所说的话，我都听见了；他们所说的都很好。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们对我说话的时候，耶和华听见了你们说话的声音；耶和华就对我说：‘这人民对你所说的话，我都听见了；他们所说的都很好。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们对我说的话，耶和华都听见了。耶和华对我说：『这百姓的话，我听见了；他们所说的都是。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord heard you when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, "I have heard what this people said to you. Everything they said was good.
verses.textEnEsv: "And the Lord heard your words, when you spoke to me. And the Lord said to me, ‘I have heard the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They are right in all that they have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the Lord heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me: ‘I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They are right in all that they have spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord heard the request you made to me. And he said, ‘I have heard what the people said to you, and they are right.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now the Lord heard the sound of your words when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, ‘I have heard the sound of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
verses.textEn: The Lord heard you when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, "I have heard what this people said to you. Everything they said was good.

verses.textZh: 但愿他们常常存着这样的心，敬畏我，遵守我的一切诫命，使他们和他们的子孙永享福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿他们常常存着这样的心，敬畏我，遵守我的一切诫命，使他们和他们的子孙永享福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿他们存这样的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切诫命，使他们和他们的子孙永远得福。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that their hearts would be inclined to fear me and keep all my commands always, so that it might go well with them and their children forever!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that they had such a heart as this always, to fear me and to keep all my commandments, that it might go well with them and with their descendants forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that they had such a heart in them that they would fear Me and always keep all My commandments, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that they would always have hearts like this, that they might fear me and obey all my commands! If they did, they and their descendants would prosper forever.
verses.textEnNasb: If only they had such a heart in them, to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it would go well with them and with their sons forever!
verses.textEn: Oh, that their hearts would be inclined to fear me and keep all my commands always, so that it might go well with them and their children forever!

verses.textZh: 你去对他们说："你们回到自己的帐棚里去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你去对他们说："你们回到自己的帐棚里去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你去对他们说：你们回帐棚去吧！
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, tell them to return to their tents.
verses.textEnEsv: Go and say to them, "Return to your tents."
verses.textEnNkjv: Go and say to them, "Return to your tents."
verses.textEnNlt: Go and tell them, "Return to your tents."
verses.textEnNasb: Go, say to them, "Return to your tents."
verses.textEn: "Go, tell them to return to their tents.

verses.textZh: 至于你，你要站在我这里；我要把一切诫命、律例、典章，都告诉你；你要教导他们，使他们在我赐给他们作产业的地上遵行。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，你要站在我这里；我要把一切诫命、律例、典章，都告诉你；你要教导他们，使他们在我赐给他们作产业的地上遵行。’
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你，可以站在我这里，我要将一切诫命、律例、典章传给你；你要教训他们，使他们在我赐他们为业的地上遵行。』
verses.textEnNiv: But you stay here with me so that I may give you all the commands, decrees and laws you are to teach them to follow in the land I am giving them to possess."
verses.textEnEsv: But you, stand here by me, and I will tell you the whole commandment and the statutes and the rules that you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land that I am giving them to possess.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for you, stand here by Me, and I will speak to you all the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments which you shall teach them, that they may observe them in the land which I am giving them to possess.’
verses.textEnNlt: But you stand here with me so I can give you all my commands, decrees, and regulations. You must teach them to the people so they can obey them in the land I am giving them as their possession.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, stand here by Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments which you shall teach them, so that they may follow them in the land which I am giving them to possess.’
verses.textEn: But you stay here with me so that I may give you all the commands, decrees and laws you are to teach them to follow in the land I am giving them to possess."

verses.textZh: 所以，你们要照着耶和华你们的神吩咐你们的，谨守遵行，不可偏离左右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们要照着耶和华你们的神吩咐你们的，谨守遵行，不可偏离左右。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要照耶和华－你们神所吩咐的谨守遵行，不可偏离左右。
verses.textEnNiv: So be careful to do what the Lord your God has commanded you; do not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be careful therefore to do as the Lord your God has commanded you. You shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall be careful to do as the Lord your God has commanded you; you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses told the people, "You must be careful to obey all the commands of the Lord your God, following his instructions in every detail.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall be careful to do just as the Lord your God has commanded you; you shall not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEn: So be careful to do what the Lord your God has commanded you; do not turn aside to the right or to the left.

verses.textZh: 你们要走在耶和华你们的神吩咐你们走的路上，使你们可以活着，可以享福，并且使你在将要占领为业的地上，可以长久居住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要走在耶和华你们的神吩咐你们走的路上，使你们可以活着，可以享福，并且使你在将要占领为业的地上，可以长久居住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你们神所吩咐你们行的，你们都要去行，使你们可以存活得福，并使你们的日子在所要承受的地上得以长久。」
verses.textEnNiv: Walk in obedience to all that the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall walk in all the way that the Lord your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may go well with you, and that you may live long in the land that you shall possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God has commanded you, that you may live and thatitmaybe well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
verses.textEnNlt: Stay on the path that the Lord your God has commanded you to follow. Then you will live long and prosperous lives in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall walk entirely in the way which the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live and that it may be well for you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you will possess.
verses.textEn: Walk in obedience to all that the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

verses.textZh: "以下是耶和华你们的神吩咐我教导你们的诫命、律例、典章，使你们在将要过去占领为业的地上遵行，
verses.textZhCnvs: "以下是耶和华你们的神吩咐我教导你们的诫命、律例、典章，使你们在将要过去占领为业的地上遵行，
verses.textZhCuv: 「这是耶和华－你们神所吩咐教训你们的诫命、律例、典章，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行，
verses.textEnNiv: These are the commands, decrees and laws the Lord your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,
verses.textEnEsv: "Now this is the commandment—the statutes and the rules —that the Lord your God commanded me to teach you, that you may do them in the land to which you are going over, to possess it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now this is the commandment, andtheseare the statutes and judgments which the Lord your God has commanded to teach you, that you may observe them in the land which you are crossing over to possess,
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the commands, decrees, and regulations that the Lord your God commanded me to teach you. You must obey them in the land you are about to enter and occupy,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which the Lord your God has commanded me to teach you, so that you may do them in the land where you are going over to take possession of it,
verses.textEn: These are the commands, decrees and laws the Lord your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

verses.textZh: 好叫你和你的子子孙孙一生一世敬畏耶和华你的神，遵守他的一切律例、诫命，就是我吩咐你的，使你的日子可以长久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好叫你和你的子子孙孙一生一世敬畏耶和华你的神，遵守他的一切律例、诫命，就是我吩咐你的，使你的日子可以长久。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫你和你子子孙孙一生敬畏耶和华－你的神，谨守他的一切律例诫命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以长久。
verses.textEnNiv: so that you, your children and their children after them may fear the Lord your God as long as you live by keeping all his decrees and commands that I give you, and so that you may enjoy long life.
verses.textEnEsv: that you may fear the Lord your God, you and your son and your son’s son, by keeping all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, all the days of your life, and that your days may be long.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may fear the Lord your God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, you and your son and your grandson, all the days of your life, and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.textEnNlt: and you and your children and grandchildren must fear the Lord your God as long as you live. If you obey all his decrees and commands, you will enjoy a long life.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you, your son, and your grandson will fear the Lord your God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, all the days of your life, and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.textEn: so that you, your children and their children after them may fear the Lord your God as long as you live by keeping all his decrees and commands that I give you, and so that you may enjoy long life.

verses.textZh: 以色列啊，你要听从，就谨守遵行，使你在流奶与蜜的地可以享福，人数大大增多，像耶和华你列祖的神应许你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊，你要听从，就谨守遵行，使你在流奶与蜜的地可以享福，人数大大增多，像耶和华你列祖的神应许你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你要听，要谨守遵行，使你可以在那流奶与蜜之地得以享福，人数极其增多，正如耶和华－你列祖的神所应许你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear, Israel, and be careful to obey so that it may go well with you and that you may increase greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear therefore, O Israel, and be careful to do them, that it may go well with you, and that you may multiply greatly, as the Lord , the God of your fathers, has promised you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe it, that it may be well with you, and that you may multiply greatly as the Lord God of your fathers has promised you— ‘a land flowing with milk and honey.’
verses.textEnNlt: Listen closely, Israel, and be careful to obey. Then all will go well with you, and you will have many children in the land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Israel, you shall listen and be careful to do them, so that it may go well for you and that you may increase greatly, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, has promised you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEn: Hear, Israel, and be careful to obey so that it may go well with you and that you may increase greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.

verses.textZh: "以色列啊，你要听，耶和华我们的神是独一的耶和华；
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列啊，你要听，耶和华我们的神是独一的耶和华；
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列啊，你要听！耶和华－我们神是独一的主。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lordis one!
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, O Israel! The Lord is our God, the Lord alone.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, Israel! The Lord is our God, the Lord is one!
verses.textEn: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.

verses.textZh: 你要全心、全性、全力爱耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要全心、全性、全力爱耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱耶和华－你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.
verses.textEnNlt: And you must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your strength.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
verses.textEn: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

verses.textZh: 我今日吩咐你的这些话，都要记在你的心上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今日吩咐你的这些话，都要记在你的心上；
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，
verses.textEnNiv: These commandments that I give you today are to be on your hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: And these words that I command you today shall be on your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And these words which I command you today shall be in your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: And you must commit yourselves wholeheartedly to these commands that I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: These words, which I am commanding you today, shall be on your heart.
verses.textEn: These commandments that I give you today are to be on your hearts.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些话不断地教训你的儿女，无论你坐在家里，或行在路上，或躺下，或起来的时候，都要谈论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些话不断地教训你的儿女，无论你坐在家里，或行在路上，或躺下，或起来的时候，都要谈论。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要殷勤教训你的儿女。无论你坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论。
verses.textEnNiv: Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.textEnNlt: Repeat them again and again to your children. Talk about them when you are at home and when you are on the road, when you are going to bed and when you are getting up.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall repeat them diligently to your sons and speak of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on the road, when you lie down, and when you get up.
verses.textEn: Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

verses.textZh: 你也要把这些话系在手上作记号，戴在额上作头带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要把这些话系在手上作记号，戴在额上作头带。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；
verses.textEnNiv: Tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Tie them to your hands and wear them on your forehead as reminders.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also tie them as a sign to your hand, and they shall be as frontlets on your forehead.
verses.textEn: Tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

verses.textZh: 又要写在你房屋的门柱上和城门上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要写在你房屋的门柱上和城门上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要写在你房屋的门框上，并你的城门上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
verses.textEn: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神领你进入他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给你的地；那里有不是你建造的，又高大又美丽的城市，
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神领你进入他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给你的地；那里有不是你建造的，又高大又美丽的城市，
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你的神领你进他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给你的地。那里有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God brings you into the land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give you—a land with large, flourishing cities you did not build,
verses.textEnEsv: "And when the Lord your God brings you into the land that he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you—with great and good cities that you did not build,
verses.textEnNkjv: "So it shall be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land of which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give you large and beautiful cities which you did not build,
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord your God will soon bring you into the land he swore to give you when he made a vow to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. It is a land with large, prosperous cities that you did not build.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it shall come about when the Lord your God brings you into the land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give you, great and splendid cities which you did not build,
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God brings you into the land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give you—a land with large, flourishing cities you did not build,

verses.textZh: 有装满各样美物的房子，不是你装满的；有凿成的水池，不是你凿成的；还有葡萄园和橄榄园，不是你栽种的；你可以吃，并且吃得饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有装满各样美物的房子，不是你装满的；有凿成的水池，不是你凿成的；还有葡萄园和橄榄园，不是你栽种的；你可以吃，并且吃得饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 有房屋，装满各样美物，非你所装满的；有凿成的水井，非你所凿成的；还有葡萄园、橄榄园，非你所栽种的；你吃了而且饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: houses filled with all kinds of good things you did not provide, wells you did not dig, and vineyards and olive groves you did not plant—then when you eat and are satisfied,
verses.textEnEsv: and houses full of all good things that you did not fill, and cisterns that you did not dig, and vineyards and olive trees that you did not plant—and when you eat and are full,
verses.textEnNkjv: houses full of all good things, which you did not fill, hewn-out wells which you did not dig, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant— when you have eaten and are full—
verses.textEnNlt: The houses will be richly stocked with goods you did not produce. You will draw water from cisterns you did not dig, and you will eat from vineyards and olive trees you did not plant. When you have eaten your fill in this land,
verses.textEnNasb: and houses full of all good things which you did not fill, and carved cisterns which you did not carve out, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant, and you eat and are satisfied,
verses.textEn: houses filled with all kinds of good things you did not provide, wells you did not dig, and vineyards and olive groves you did not plant—then when you eat and are satisfied,

verses.textZh: 那时，你要谨慎，免得你忘记了耶和华，就是把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来的那一位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你要谨慎，免得你忘记了耶和华，就是把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来的那一位。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时你要谨慎，免得你忘记将你从埃及地、为奴之家领出来的耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: be careful that you do not forget the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: then take care lest you forget the Lord , who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: then beware, lest you forget the Lord who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: be careful not to forget the Lord , who rescued you from slavery in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: be careful that you do not forget the Lord who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEn: be careful that you do not forget the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

verses.textZh: 你要敬畏耶和华你的神，要事奉他，奉他的名起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要敬畏耶和华你的神，要事奉他，奉他的名起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要敬畏耶和华－你的神，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: Fear the Lord your God, serve him only and take your oaths in his name.
verses.textEnEsv: It is the Lord your God you shall fear. Him you shall serve and by his name you shall swear.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall fear the Lord your God and serve Him, and shall take oaths in His name.
verses.textEnNlt: You must fear the Lord your God and serve him. When you take an oath, you must use only his name.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall fear only the Lord your God; and you shall worship Him and swear by His name.
verses.textEn: Fear the Lord your God, serve him only and take your oaths in his name.

verses.textZh: 不可随从别的神，就是你们周围各民族的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可随从别的神，就是你们周围各民族的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可随从别神，就是你们四围国民的神；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you;
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples who are around you—
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples who are all around you
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not worship any of the gods of neighboring nations,
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not follow other gods, any of the gods of the peoples who surround you,
verses.textEn: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you;

verses.textZh: 因为在你们中间的耶和华你们的神，是忌邪的神，恐怕耶和华你的神向你发怒，就把你从这地上消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在你们中间的耶和华你们的神，是忌邪的神，恐怕耶和华你的神向你发怒，就把你从这地上消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在你们中间的耶和华－你神是忌邪的神，惟恐耶和华－你神的怒气向你发作，就把你从地上除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a jealous God and his anger will burn against you, and he will destroy you from the face of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord your God in your midst is a jealous God— lest the anger of the Lord your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: (for the Lord your God is a jealous God among you), lest the anger of the Lord your God be aroused against you and destroy you from the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: for the Lord your God, who lives among you, is a jealous God. His anger will flare up against you, and he will wipe you from the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: for the Lord your God who is in the midst of you is a jealous God; so follow Him, or else the anger of the Lord your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.
verses.textEn: for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a jealous God and his anger will burn against you, and he will destroy you from the face of the land.

verses.textZh: "你们不可试探耶和华你们的神，像你们在玛撒试探他一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可试探耶和华你们的神，像你们在玛撒试探他一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们不可试探耶和华－你们的神，像你们在玛撒那样试探他。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not put the Lord your God to the test as you did at Massah.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not put the Lord your God to the test, as you tested him at Massah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not tempt the Lord your God as you tempted Him in Massah.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not test the Lord your God as you did when you complained at Massah.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not put the Lord your God to the test, as you tested Him at Massah.
verses.textEn: Do not put the Lord your God to the test as you did at Massah.

verses.textZh: 要谨慎遵守耶和华你们的神吩咐你的诫命、法度和律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要谨慎遵守耶和华你们的神吩咐你的诫命、法度和律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 要留意遵守耶和华－你们神所吩咐的诫命、法度、律例。
verses.textEnNiv: Be sure to keep the commands of the Lord your God and the stipulations and decrees he has given you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, His testimonies, and His statutes which He has commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must diligently obey the commands of the Lord your God—all the laws and decrees he has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and His provisions and His statutes which He has commanded you.
verses.textEn: Be sure to keep the commands of the Lord your God and the stipulations and decrees he has given you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华看为正为好的事，你都要去行，使你可以享福，并且可以进去占领耶和华向你的列祖起誓应许的那美地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华看为正为好的事，你都要去行，使你可以享福，并且可以进去占领耶和华向你的列祖起誓应许的那美地，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华眼中看为正、看为善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，并可以进去得耶和华向你列祖起誓应许的那美地，
verses.textEnNiv: Do what is right and good in the Lord ’s sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors,
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall do what is right and good in the sight of the Lord , that it may go well with you, and that you may go in and take possession of the good land that the Lord swore to give to your fathers
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall do whatis right and good in the sight of the Lord, that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land of which the Lord swore to your fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: Do what is right and good in the Lord ’s sight, so all will go well with you. Then you will enter and occupy the good land that the Lord swore to give your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall do what is right and good in the sight of the Lord, so that it may go well for you and that you may go in and take possession of the good land which the Lord swore to give your fathers,
verses.textEn: Do what is right and good in the Lord ’s sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors,

verses.textZh: 照着耶和华说过的，把你所有的仇敌从你面前赶逐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照着耶和华说过的，把你所有的仇敌从你面前赶逐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 照耶和华所说的，从你面前撵出你的一切仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: thrusting out all your enemies before you, as the Lord said.
verses.textEnEsv: by thrusting out all your enemies from before you, as the Lord has promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: to cast out all your enemies from before you, as the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: You will drive out all the enemies living in the land, just as the Lord said you would.
verses.textEnNasb: by driving out all your enemies from you, as the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: thrusting out all your enemies before you, as the Lord said.

verses.textZh: "日后，如果你的儿子问你：‘耶和华我们的神吩咐的这法度、律例和典章，有甚么意思呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: "日后，如果你的儿子问你：‘耶和华我们的神吩咐的这法度、律例和典章，有甚么意思呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「日后，你的儿子问你说：『耶和华－我们神吩咐你们的这些法度、律例、典章是什么意思呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: In the future, when your son asks you, "What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the Lord our God has commanded you?"
verses.textEnEsv: "When your son asks you in time to come, ‘What is the meaning of the testimonies and the statutes and the rules that the Lord our God has commanded you?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "When your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What isthemeaningof the testimonies, the statutes, and the judgments which the Lord our God has commanded you?’
verses.textEnNlt: "In the future your children will ask you, ‘What is the meaning of these laws, decrees, and regulations that the Lord our God has commanded us to obey?’
verses.textEnNasb: "When your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What do the provisions and the statutes and the judgments mean which the Lord our God commanded you?’
verses.textEn: In the future, when your son asks you, "What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the Lord our God has commanded you?"

verses.textZh: 你就要对你的儿子说：‘我们在埃及曾经作过法老的奴仆，耶和华却用大能把我们从埃及领了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要对你的儿子说：‘我们在埃及曾经作过法老的奴仆，耶和华却用大能把我们从埃及领了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就告诉你的儿子说：『我们在埃及作过法老的奴仆；耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及领出来，
verses.textEnNiv: tell him: "We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall say to your son, ‘We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. And the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall say to your son: ‘We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you must tell them, ‘We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt, but the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his strong hand.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall say to your son, ‘We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt, and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.textEn: tell him: "We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在我们眼前，把又伟大又厉害的神迹奇事行在埃及、法老和他全家的身上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在我们眼前，把又伟大又厉害的神迹奇事行在埃及、法老和他全家的身上；
verses.textZhCuv: 在我们眼前，将重大可怕的神迹奇事施行在埃及地和法老并他全家的身上，
verses.textEnNiv: Before our eyes the Lord sent signs and wonders—great and terrible—on Egypt and Pharaoh and his whole household.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord showed signs and wonders, great and grievous, against Egypt and against Pharaoh and all his household, before our eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Lord showed signs and wonders before our eyes, great and severe, against Egypt, Pharaoh, and all his household.
