verses.textEnNlt: The Lord did miraculous signs and wonders before our eyes, dealing terrifying blows against Egypt and Pharaoh and all his people.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the Lord provided great and terrible signs and wonders before our eyes against Egypt, Pharaoh, and all his household;
verses.textEn: Before our eyes the Lord sent signs and wonders—great and terrible—on Egypt and Pharaoh and his whole household.

verses.textZh: 却把我们从那里领出来，为要领我们进入他向我们列祖起誓应许的地，要把这地赐给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却把我们从那里领出来，为要领我们进入他向我们列祖起誓应许的地，要把这地赐给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 将我们从那里领出来，要领我们进入他向我们列祖起誓应许之地，把这地赐给我们。
verses.textEnNiv: But he brought us out from there to bring us in and give us the land he promised on oath to our ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in and give us the land that he swore to give to our fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He brought us out from there, that He might bring us in, to give us the land of which He swore to our fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought us out of Egypt so he could give us this land he had sworn to give our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought us out of there in order to bring us in, to give us the land which He had sworn to our fathers.’
verses.textEn: But he brought us out from there to bring us in and give us the land he promised on oath to our ancestors.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又吩咐我们遵行这一切律例，敬畏耶和华我们的神，使我们常常得享福乐，使我们的生命得着保全，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又吩咐我们遵行这一切律例，敬畏耶和华我们的神，使我们常常得享福乐，使我们的生命得着保全，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又吩咐我们遵行这一切律例，要敬畏耶和华－我们的神，使我们常得好处，蒙他保全我们的生命，像今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear the Lord our God, so that we might always prosper and be kept alive, as is the case today.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord commanded us to observe all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that He might preserve us alive, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord our God commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear him so he can continue to bless us and preserve our lives, as he has done to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord commanded us to follow all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God for our own good always and for our survival, as it is today.
verses.textEn: The Lord commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear the Lord our God, so that we might always prosper and be kept alive, as is the case today.

verses.textZh: 我们在耶和华我们的神面前，如果照着他吩咐我们的，谨守遵行这一切诫命，这就是我们的义了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在耶和华我们的神面前，如果照着他吩咐我们的，谨守遵行这一切诫命，这就是我们的义了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若照耶和华－我们神所吩咐的一切诫命谨守遵行，这就是我们的义了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And if we are careful to obey all this law before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us, that will be our righteousness."
verses.textEnEsv: And it will be righteousness for us, if we are careful to do all this commandment before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it will be righteousness for us, if we are careful to observe all these commandments before the Lord our God, as He has commanded us.’
verses.textEnNlt: For we will be counted as righteous when we obey all the commands the Lord our God has given us.’
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be righteousness for us if we are careful to follow all this commandment before the Lord our God, just as He commanded us.
verses.textEn: And if we are careful to obey all this law before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us, that will be our righteousness."

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神领你进入你要去得为业的地，从你面前赶走许多民族，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七个比你又大又强的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神领你进入你要去得为业的地，从你面前赶走许多民族，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七个比你又大又强的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你神领你进入要得为业之地，从你面前赶出许多国民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七国的民，都比你强大。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess and drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
verses.textEnEsv: "When the Lord your God brings you into the land that you are entering to take possession of it, and clears away many nations before you, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations more numerous and mightier than you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the Lord your God brings you into the land which you go to possess, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Lord your God brings you into the land you are about to enter and occupy, he will clear away many nations ahead of you: the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. These seven nations are greater and more numerous than you.
verses.textEnNasb: "When the Lord your God brings you into the land where you are entering to take possession of it, and He drives away many nations from before you, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess and drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神把他们交给你，你打败了他们的时候，你要完全毁灭他们，不可与他们立约，也不可恩待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神把他们交给你，你打败了他们的时候，你要完全毁灭他们，不可与他们立约，也不可恩待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神将他们交给你击杀，那时你要把他们灭绝净尽，不可与他们立约，也不可怜恤他们。
verses.textEnNiv: and when the Lord your God has delivered them over to you and you have defeated them, then you must destroy them totally. Make no treaty with them, and show them no mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: and when the Lord your God gives them over to you, and you defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. You shall make no covenant with them and show no mercy to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and when the Lord your God delivers them over to you, you shall conquer them and utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them nor show mercy to them.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord your God hands these nations over to you and you conquer them, you must completely destroy them. Make no treaties with them and show them no mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: and when the Lord your God turns them over to you and you defeat them, you shall utterly destroy them. You shall not make a covenant with them nor be gracious to them.
verses.textEn: and when the Lord your God has delivered them over to you and you have defeated them, then you must destroy them totally. Make no treaty with them, and show them no mercy.

verses.textZh: 不可与他们通婚，不可把你的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，也不可为你的儿子娶他们的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可与他们通婚，不可把你的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，也不可为你的儿子娶他们的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可与他们结亲。不可将你的女儿嫁他们的儿子，也不可叫你的儿子娶他们的女儿；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not intermarry with them, giving your daughters to their sons or taking their daughters for your sons,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall you make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to their son, nor take their daughter for your son.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not intermarry with them. Do not let your daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters,
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, you shall not intermarry with them: you shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor shall you take their daughters for your sons.
verses.textEn: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,

verses.textZh: 因为他必使你的儿子离开我，去事奉别的神，以致耶和华向你们发烈怒，就快快地把你们消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他必使你的儿子离开我，去事奉别的神，以致耶和华向你们发烈怒，就快快地把你们消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他必使你儿子转离不跟从主，去事奉别神，以致耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就速速地将你们灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: for they will turn your children away from following me to serve other gods, and the Lord ’s anger will burn against you and will quickly destroy you.
verses.textEnEsv: for they would turn away your sons from following me, to serve other gods. Then the anger of the Lord would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they will turn your sons away from following Me, to serve other gods; so the anger of the Lord will be aroused against you and destroy you suddenly.
verses.textEnNlt: for they will lead your children away from me to worship other gods. Then the anger of the Lord will burn against you, and he will quickly destroy you.
verses.textEnNasb: For they will turn your sons away from following Me, and they will serve other gods; then the anger of the Lord will be kindled against you and He will quickly destroy you.
verses.textEn: for they will turn your children away from following me to serve other gods, and the Lord ’s anger will burn against you and will quickly destroy you.

verses.textZh: 你们却要这样待他们：拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的神柱，砍下他们的亚舍拉，用火焚烧他们的雕像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却要这样待他们：拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的神柱，砍下他们的亚舍拉，用火焚烧他们的雕像。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却要这样待他们：拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶，用火焚烧他们雕刻的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what you are to do to them: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols in the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: But thus shall you deal with them: you shall break down their altars and dash in pieces their pillars and chop down their Asherim and burn their carved images with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: But thus you shall deal with them: you shall destroy their altars, and break down their sacred pillars, and cut down their wooden images, and burn their carved images with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what you must do. You must break down their pagan altars and shatter their sacred pillars. Cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols.
verses.textEnNasb: But this is what you shall do to them: you shall tear down their altars, smash their memorial stones, cut their Asherim to pieces, and burn their carved images in the fire.
verses.textEn: This is what you are to do to them: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols in the fire.

verses.textZh: "因为你是归耶和华你的神作圣洁的子民的；耶和华你的神从地上的万族中，拣选了你作他自己的产业，自己的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为你是归耶和华你的神作圣洁的子民的；耶和华你的神从地上的万族中，拣选了你作他自己的产业，自己的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你归耶和华－你神为圣洁的民；耶和华－你神从地上的万民中拣选你，特作自己的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.
verses.textEnEsv: "For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you to be a people for his treasured possession, out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For you are a holy people to the Lord your God; the Lord your God has chosen you to be a people for Himself, a special treasure above all the peoples on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are a holy people, who belong to the Lord your God. Of all the people on earth, the Lord your God has chosen you to be his own special treasure.
verses.textEnNasb: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God; the Lord your God has chosen you to be a people for His personal possession out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.
verses.textEn: For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.

verses.textZh: 耶和华喜爱你们，拣选你们，并不是因为你们的人数比别的民族多，其实你们的人数在万族中是最少的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华喜爱你们，拣选你们，并不是因为你们的人数比别的民族多，其实你们的人数在万族中是最少的；
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华专爱你们，拣选你们，并非因你们的人数多于别民，原来你们的人数在万民中是最少的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord did not set his affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: It was not because you were more in number than any other people that the Lord set his love on you and chose you, for you were the fewest of all peoples,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord did not set His love on you nor choose you because you were more in number than any other people, for you were the least of all peoples;
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord did not set his heart on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other nations, for you were the smallest of all nations!
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord did not make you His beloved nor choose you because you were greater in number than any of the peoples, since you were the fewest of all peoples,
verses.textEn: The Lord did not set his affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

verses.textZh: 而是因为耶和华对你们的爱，又因为他遵守他向你们的列祖所起的誓，他才用大能的手把你们领出来，把你们从为奴之家，从埃及王法老的手里拯救出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而是因为耶和华对你们的爱，又因为他遵守他向你们的列祖所起的誓，他才用大能的手把你们领出来，把你们从为奴之家，从埃及王法老的手里拯救出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 只因耶和华爱你们，又因要守他向你们列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手领你们出来，从为奴之家救赎你们脱离埃及王法老的手。
verses.textEnNiv: But it was because the Lord loved you and kept the oath he swore to your ancestors that he brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: but it is because the Lord loves you and is keeping the oath that he swore to your fathers, that the Lord has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: but because the Lord loves you, and because He would keep the oath which He swore to your fathers, the Lord has brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Rather, it was simply that the Lord loves you, and he was keeping the oath he had sworn to your ancestors. That is why the Lord rescued you with such a strong hand from your slavery and from the oppressive hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: but because the Lord loved you and kept the oath which He swore to your forefathers, the Lord brought you out by a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.textEn: But it was because the Lord loved you and kept the oath he swore to your ancestors that he brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 所以你要知道耶和华你的神，他是神，是信实可靠的神；他向爱他和守他诫命的人，守约并且施慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要知道耶和华你的神，他是神，是信实可靠的神；他向爱他和守他诫命的人，守约并且施慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你要知道耶和华－你的神，他是神，是信实的神；向爱他、守他诫命的人守约，施慈爱，直到千代；
verses.textEnNiv: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments.
verses.textEnEsv: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and steadfast love with those who love him and keep his commandments, to a thousand generations,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore know that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations with those who love Him and keep His commandments;
verses.textEnNlt: Understand, therefore, that the Lord your God is indeed God. He is the faithful God who keeps his covenant for a thousand generations and lavishes his unfailing love on those who love him and obey his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Know therefore that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God, who keeps His covenant and His faithfulness to a thousand generations for those who love Him and keep His commandments;
verses.textEn: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments.

verses.textZh: 但向恨他的人，却要当面报应他们，把他们灭尽；恨他的，他都要当面报应他，决不迟延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但向恨他的人，却要当面报应他们，把他们灭尽；恨他的，他都要当面报应他，决不迟延。
verses.textZhCuv: 向恨他的人当面报应他们，将他们灭绝。凡恨他的人必报应他们，决不迟延。
verses.textEnNiv: But those who hate him he will repay to their face by destruction; he will not be slow to repay to their face those who hate him.
verses.textEnEsv: and repays to their face those who hate him, by destroying them. He will not be slack with one who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
verses.textEnNkjv: and He repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack with him who hates Him; He will repay him to his face.
verses.textEnNlt: But he does not hesitate to punish and destroy those who reject him.
verses.textEnNasb: but He repays those who hate Him to their faces, to eliminate them; He will not hesitate toward him who hates Him, He will repay him to his face.
verses.textEn: But those who hate him he will repay to their face by destruction; he will not be slow to repay to their face those who hate him.

verses.textZh: 所以你要谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的诫命、律例和典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的诫命、律例和典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你要谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你的诫命、律例、典章。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, take care to follow the commands, decrees and laws I give you today.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall therefore be careful to do the commandment and the statutes and the rules that I command you today.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall keep the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which I command you today, to observe them.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, you must obey all these commands, decrees, and regulations I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, you shall keep the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which I am commanding you today, to do them.
verses.textEn: Therefore, take care to follow the commands, decrees and laws I give you today.

verses.textZh: "如果你们听从这些典章，并且谨守遵行这一切，耶和华你的神就必照着他向你的列祖所起的誓，向你守约并且施慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们听从这些典章，并且谨守遵行这一切，耶和华你的神就必照着他向你的列祖所起的誓，向你守约并且施慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们果然听从这些典章，谨守遵行，耶和华－你神就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守约，施慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: If you pay attention to these laws and are careful to follow them, then the Lord your God will keep his covenant of love with you, as he swore to your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: "And because you listen to these rules and keep and do them, the Lord your God will keep with you the covenant and the steadfast love that he swore to your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then it shall come to pass, because you listen to these judgments, and keep and do them, that the Lord your God will keep with you the covenant and the mercy which He swore to your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you listen to these regulations and faithfully obey them, the Lord your God will keep his covenant of unfailing love with you, as he promised with an oath to your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it shall come about, because you listen to these judgments and keep and do them, that the Lord your God will keep His covenant with you and His faithfulness which He swore to your forefathers.
verses.textEn: If you pay attention to these laws and are careful to follow them, then the Lord your God will keep his covenant of love with you, as he swore to your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 他必爱你，赐福与你，使你人数增多，也必在他向你的列祖起誓应许给你的地上，赐福与你身所生的，你地所产的，使你的五谷、酒、油，以及牛犊和羊羔增产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必爱你，赐福与你，使你人数增多，也必在他向你的列祖起誓应许给你的地上，赐福与你身所生的，你地所产的，使你的五谷、酒、油，以及牛犊和羊羔增产。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必爱你，赐福与你，使你人数增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓应许给你的地上赐福与你身所生的，地所产的，并你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔。
verses.textEnNiv: He will love you and bless you and increase your numbers. He will bless the fruit of your womb, the crops of your land—your grain, new wine and olive oil—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.
verses.textEnEsv: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your wine and your oil, the increase of your herds and the young of your flock, in the land that he swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will love you and bless you and multiply you; He will also bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your cattle and the offspring of your flock, in the land of which He swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.textEnNlt: He will love you and bless you, and he will give you many children. He will give fertility to your land and your animals. When you arrive in the land he swore to give your ancestors, you will have large harvests of grain, new wine, and olive oil, and great herds of cattle, sheep, and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will love you, bless you, and make you numerous; He will also bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, your grain, your new wine, and your oil, the newborn of your cattle and the offspring of your flock, in the land which He swore to your forefathers to give you.
verses.textEn: He will love you and bless you and increase your numbers. He will bless the fruit of your womb, the crops of your land—your grain, new wine and olive oil—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.

verses.textZh: 你必蒙福胜过万民；在你中间没有不能生育的男女，也没有不能生殖的牲畜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必蒙福胜过万民；在你中间没有不能生育的男女，也没有不能生殖的牲畜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必蒙福胜过万民；你们的男女没有不能生养的，牲畜也没有不能生育的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor will any of your livestock be without young.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be blessed above all peoples. There shall not be male or female barren among you or among your livestock.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be blessed above all peoples; there shall not be a male or female barren among you or among your livestock.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be blessed above all the nations of the earth. None of your men or women will be childless, and all your livestock will bear young.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall be blessed above all peoples; there will be no sterile male or infertile female among you or among your cattle.
verses.textEn: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor will any of your livestock be without young.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使一切病症离开你；你所知埃及各种的恶疾，他决不加在你身上，却加在一切恨你的人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使一切病症离开你；你所知埃及各种的恶疾，他决不加在你身上，却加在一切恨你的人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使一切的病症离开你；你所知道埃及各样的恶疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will keep you free from every disease. He will not inflict on you the horrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all who hate you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will take away from you all sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you knew, will he inflict on you, but he will lay them on all who hate you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will take away from you all sickness, and will afflict you with none of the terrible diseases of Egypt which you have known, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord will protect you from all sickness. He will not let you suffer from the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all your enemies!
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will remove from you all sickness; and He will not inflict upon you any of the harmful diseases of Egypt which you have known, but He will give them to all who hate you.
verses.textEn: The Lord will keep you free from every disease. He will not inflict on you the horrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all who hate you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神交给你的所有民族，你都要把他们消灭；你的眼不可怜惜他们；你也不可事奉他们的神，因为这必成为你的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神交给你的所有民族，你都要把他们消灭；你的眼不可怜惜他们；你也不可事奉他们的神，因为这必成为你的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神所要交给你的一切人民，你要将他们除灭；你眼不可顾惜他们。你也不可事奉他们的神，因这必成为你的网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: You must destroy all the peoples the Lord your God gives over to you. Do not look on them with pity and do not serve their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall consume all the peoples that the Lord your God will give over to you. Your eye shall not pity them, neither shall you serve their gods, for that would be a snare to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also you shall destroy all the peoples whom the Lord your God delivers over to you; your eye shall have no pity on them; nor shall you serve their gods, for that willbe a snare to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must destroy all the nations the Lord your God hands over to you. Show them no mercy, and do not worship their gods, or they will trap you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall consume all the peoples whom the Lord your God will turn over to you; your eye shall not pity them, nor shall you serve their gods, for that would be a snare to you.
verses.textEn: You must destroy all the peoples the Lord your God gives over to you. Do not look on them with pity and do not serve their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

verses.textZh: "如果你心里说：‘这些国的人比我多，我怎能把他们赶出去呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你心里说：‘这些国的人比我多，我怎能把他们赶出去呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若心里说，这些国的民比我更多，我怎能赶出他们呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You may say to yourselves, "These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?"
verses.textEnEsv: "If you say in your heart, ‘These nations are greater than I. How can I dispossess them?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you should say in your heart, ‘These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?’—
verses.textEnNlt: Perhaps you will think to yourselves, ‘How can we ever conquer these nations that are so much more powerful than we are?’
verses.textEnNasb: "If you say in your heart, ‘These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?’
verses.textEn: You may say to yourselves, "These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?"

verses.textZh: 你不要怕他们，只要牢牢地记住，耶和华你的神向法老和全埃及所行的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要怕他们，只要牢牢地记住，耶和华你的神向法老和全埃及所行的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要惧怕他们，要牢牢记念耶和华－你神向法老和埃及全地所行的事，
verses.textEnNiv: But do not be afraid of them; remember well what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall not be afraid of them but you shall remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall not be afraid of them, but you shall remember well what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t be afraid of them! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: you are not to be afraid of them; you shall remember well what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
verses.textEn: But do not be afraid of them; remember well what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

verses.textZh: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验、神迹、奇事、大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，这都是耶和华你的神领你出来的时候使用的；耶和华你的神也必照样待你惧怕的所有民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验、神迹、奇事、大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，这都是耶和华你的神领你出来的时候使用的；耶和华你的神也必照样待你惧怕的所有民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是你亲眼所看见的大试验、神迹、奇事，和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，都是耶和华－你神领你出来所用的。耶和华－你神必照样待你所惧怕的一切人民。
verses.textEnNiv: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
verses.textEnEsv: the great trials that your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the Lord your God brought you out. So will the Lord your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs and the wonders, the mighty hand and the outstretched arm, by which the Lord your God brought you out. So shall the Lord your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember the great terrors the Lord your God sent against them. You saw it all with your own eyes! And remember the miraculous signs and wonders, and the strong hand and powerful arm with which he brought you out of Egypt. The Lord your God will use this same power against all the people you fear.
verses.textEnNasb: the great trials which your eyes saw and the signs and the wonders, and the mighty hand and the outstretched arm by which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
verses.textEn: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神还要打发大黄蜂飞到他们中间，直到那些残存躲藏起来的人，都从你面前消灭为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神还要打发大黄蜂飞到他们中间，直到那些残存躲藏起来的人，都从你面前消灭为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且耶和华－你神必打发黄蜂飞到他们中间，直到那剩下而藏躲的人从你面前灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the Lord your God will send hornets among them, until those who are left and hide themselves from you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Lord your God will send the hornet among them until those who are left, who hide themselves from you, are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: And then the Lord your God will send terror to drive out the few survivors still hiding from you!
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the Lord your God will send the hornet against them, until those who are left and hide themselves from you perish.
verses.textEn: Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished.

verses.textZh: 你不要因他们惊慌，因为耶和华你的神是在你们中间，他是大而可畏的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要因他们惊慌，因为耶和华你的神是在你们中间，他是大而可畏的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要因他们惊恐，因为耶和华－你神在你们中间是大而可畏的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be terrified by them, for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not be in dread of them, for the Lord your God is in your midst, a great and awesome God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not be terrified of them; for the Lord your God, the great and awesome God, is among you.
verses.textEnNlt: "No, do not be afraid of those nations, for the Lord your God is among you, and he is a great and awesome God.
verses.textEnNasb: You are not to be terrified of them, because the Lord your God is in your midst, a great and awesome God.
verses.textEn: Do not be terrified by them, for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神必把这些国的民，从你面前渐渐赶出去；你不可以把他们迅速地灭尽，恐怕田间的野兽多起来害你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神必把这些国的民，从你面前渐渐赶出去；你不可以把他们迅速地灭尽，恐怕田间的野兽多起来害你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神必将这些国的民从你面前渐渐赶出；你不可把他们速速灭尽，恐怕野地的兽多起来害你。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God will drive out those nations before you, little by little. You will not be allowed to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals will multiply around you.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord your God will clear away these nations before you little by little. You may not make an end of them at once, lest the wild beasts grow too numerous for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord your God will drive out those nations before you little by little; you will be unable to destroy them at once, lest the beasts of the field become too numerous for you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God will drive those nations out ahead of you little by little. You will not clear them away all at once, otherwise the wild animals would multiply too quickly for you.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord your God will drive away these nations from you little by little; you will not be able to put an end to them quickly, otherwise the wild animals would become too numerous for you.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God will drive out those nations before you, little by little. You will not be allowed to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals will multiply around you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神必把他们交在你面前，使他们大起扰乱，直到他们全被消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神必把他们交在你面前，使他们大起扰乱，直到他们全被消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神必将他们交给你，大大地扰乱他们，直到他们灭绝了；
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord your God will deliver them over to you, and will inflict defeat upon them until they are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord your God will hand them over to you. He will throw them into complete confusion until they are destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord your God will turn them over to you, and will throw them into great confusion until they are destroyed.
verses.textEn: But the Lord your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.

verses.textZh: 他也必把他们的君王交在你的手中，你必使他们的名从天下消灭；必没有一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你把他们都消灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也必把他们的君王交在你的手中，你必使他们的名从天下消灭；必没有一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你把他们都消灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将他们的君王交在你手中，你就使他们的名从天下消灭。必无一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你将他们灭绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: He will give their kings into your hand, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand up against you; you will destroy them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will give their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under heaven. No one shall be able to stand against you until you have destroyed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you will destroy their name from under heaven; no one shall be able to stand against you until you have destroyed them.
verses.textEnNlt: He will put their kings in your power, and you will erase their names from the face of the earth. No one will be able to stand against you, and you will destroy them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will hand over their kings to you, so that you will eliminate their name from under heaven; no one will be able to stand against you until you have destroyed them.
verses.textEn: He will give their kings into your hand, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand up against you; you will destroy them.

verses.textZh: 他们的神像，你们要用火焚烧；神像上的金银，你不可贪爱，也不可据为己有，免得你因此陷入网罗；因为这是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的神像，你们要用火焚烧；神像上的金银，你不可贪爱，也不可据为己有，免得你因此陷入网罗；因为这是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们雕刻的神像，你们要用火焚烧；其上的金银，你不可贪图，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入网罗；这原是耶和华－你神所憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: The images of their gods you are to burn in the fire. Do not covet the silver and gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it, for it is detestable to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: The carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, lest you be ensnared by it, for it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall burn the carved images of their gods with fire; you shall not covet the silver or gold thatis on them, nor take it for yourselves, lest you be snared by it; for it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must burn their idols in fire, and you must not covet the silver or gold that covers them. You must not take it or it will become a trap to you, for it is detestable to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: The carved images of their gods you are to burn with fire; you shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourselves, or you will be trapped by it; for it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: The images of their gods you are to burn in the fire. Do not covet the silver and gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it, for it is detestable to the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 可厌恶的物，你不可带进家里去，免得你与那物一样成了当毁灭的；你要非常憎恨它，十分厌恶它，因为这是当毁灭的物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可厌恶的物，你不可带进家里去，免得你与那物一样成了当毁灭的；你要非常憎恨它，十分厌恶它，因为这是当毁灭的物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 可憎的物，你不可带进家去；不然，你就成了当毁灭的，与那物一样。你要十分厌恶，十分憎嫌，因为这是当毁灭的物。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not bring a detestable thing into your house or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. Regard it as vile and utterly detest it, for it is set apart for destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not bring an abominable thing into your house and become devoted to destruction like it. You shall utterly detest and abhor it, for it is devoted to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall you bring an abomination into your house, lest you be doomed to destruction like it. You shall utterly detest it and utterly abhor it, for it is an accursed thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not bring any detestable objects into your home, for then you will be destroyed, just like them. You must utterly detest such things, for they are set apart for destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house and become designated for destruction, like it; you are to utterly detest it, and you are to utterly loathe it, for it is something designated for destruction.
verses.textEn: Do not bring a detestable thing into your house or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. Regard it as vile and utterly detest it, for it is set apart for destruction.

verses.textZh: "我今日吩咐你的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，使你们可以存活，人数增加，并且可以进去得着耶和华向你们的列祖起誓应许的那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我今日吩咐你的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，使你们可以存活，人数增加，并且可以进去得着耶和华向你们的列祖起誓应许的那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，好叫你们存活，人数增多，且进去得耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许的那地。
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: "The whole commandment that I command you today you shall be careful to do, that you may live and multiply, and go in and possess the land that the Lord swore to give to your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Every commandment which I command you today you must be careful to observe, that you may live and multiply, and go in and possess the land of which the Lord swore to your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be careful to obey all the commands I am giving you today. Then you will live and multiply, and you will enter and occupy the land the Lord swore to give your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: "All the commandments that I am commanding you today you shall be careful to do, so that you may live and increase, and go in and take possession of the land which the Lord swore to give to your forefathers.
verses.textEn: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 你也要记念耶和华你的神这四十年在旷野引导你的一切路程，为要使你受苦，要试炼你，要知道你心里怎样，看看你肯守他的诫命不肯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要记念耶和华你的神这四十年在旷野引导你的一切路程，为要使你受苦，要试炼你，要知道你心里怎样，看看你肯守他的诫命不肯。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要记念耶和华－你的神在旷野引导你这四十年，是要苦炼你，试验你，要知道你心内如何，肯守他的诫命不肯。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember how the Lord your God led you all the way in the wilderness these forty years, to humble and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall remember the whole way that the Lord your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, testing you to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall remember that the Lord your God led you all the way these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you and test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember how the Lord your God led you through the wilderness for these forty years, humbling you and testing you to prove your character, and to find out whether or not you would obey his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall remember all the way which the Lord your God has led you in the wilderness these forty years, in order to humble you, putting you to the test, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.
verses.textEn: Remember how the Lord your God led you all the way in the wilderness these forty years, to humble and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands.

verses.textZh: 他使你受苦，任你饥饿，把你和你的列祖不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道人活着，不是单靠食物，更要靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使你受苦，任你饥饿，把你和你的列祖不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道人活着，不是单靠食物，更要靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。
verses.textEnNiv: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your ancestors had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And he humbled you and let you hunger and fed you with manna, which you did not know, nor did your fathers know, that he might make you know that man does not live by bread alone, but man lives by every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So He humbled you, allowed you to hunger, and fed you with manna which you did not know nor did your fathers know, that He might make you know that man shall not live by bread alone; but man lives by every word that proceeds from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, he humbled you by letting you go hungry and then feeding you with manna, a food previously unknown to you and your ancestors. He did it to teach you that people do not live by bread alone; rather, we live by every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And He humbled you and let you go hungry, and fed you with the manna which you did not know, nor did your fathers know, in order to make you understand that man shall not live on bread alone, but man shall live on everything that comes out of the mouth of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your ancestors had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这四十年来，你身上的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这四十年来，你身上的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四十年，你的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿。
verses.textEnNiv: Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: Your clothing did not wear out on you and your foot did not swell these forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your garments did not wear out on you, nor did your foot swell these forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: For all these forty years your clothes didn’t wear out, and your feet didn’t blister or swell.
verses.textEnNasb: Your clothing did not wear out on you, nor did your foot swell these forty years.
verses.textEn: Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

verses.textZh: 因此你心里要明白，耶和华你的神管教你，好象人管教他的儿子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此你心里要明白，耶和华你的神管教你，好象人管教他的儿子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当心里思想，耶和华－你神管教你，好像人管教儿子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Know then in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the Lord your God disciplines you.
verses.textEnEsv: Know then in your heart that, as a man disciplines his son, the Lord your God disciplines you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You should know in your heart that as a man chastens his son, so the Lord your God chastens you.
verses.textEnNlt: Think about it: Just as a parent disciplines a child, the Lord your God disciplines you for your own good.
verses.textEnNasb: So you are to know in your heart that the Lord your God was disciplining you just as a man disciplines his son.
verses.textEn: Know then in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the Lord your God disciplines you.

verses.textZh: 所以你要谨守耶和华你的神的诫命，遵行他的道路，敬畏他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要谨守耶和华你的神的诫命，遵行他的道路，敬畏他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨守耶和华－你神的诫命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。
verses.textEnNiv: Observe the commands of the Lord your God, walking in obedience to him and revering him.
verses.textEnEsv: So you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God by walking in his ways and by fearing him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "So obey the commands of the Lord your God by walking in his ways and fearing him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
verses.textEn: Observe the commands of the Lord your God, walking in obedience to him and revering him.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神快要领你进入那美地；那地有河流，有泉，有源，水从谷中和山上流出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神快要领你进入那美地；那地有河流，有泉，有源，水从谷中和山上流出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你神领你进入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，从山谷中流出水来。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land—a land with brooks, streams, and deep springs gushing out into the valleys and hills;
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and springs, flowing out in the valleys and hills,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and springs, that flow out of valleys and hills;
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land of flowing streams and pools of water, with fountains and springs that gush out in the valleys and hills.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of streams of water, of fountains and springs, flowing out in valleys and hills;
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land—a land with brooks, streams, and deep springs gushing out into the valleys and hills;

verses.textZh: 那地有小麦、大麦、葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树；那地有橄榄树、油和蜜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地有小麦、大麦、葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树；那地有橄榄树、油和蜜；
verses.textZhCuv: 那地有小麦、大麦、葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树，和蜜。
verses.textEnNiv: a land with wheat and barley, vines and fig trees, pomegranates, olive oil and honey;
verses.textEnEsv: a land of wheat and barley, of vines and fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive trees and honey,
verses.textEnNkjv: a land of wheat and barley, of vines and fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey;
verses.textEnNlt: It is a land of wheat and barley; of grapevines, fig trees, and pomegranates; of olive oil and honey.
verses.textEnNasb: a land of wheat and barley, of vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey;
verses.textEn: a land with wheat and barley, vines and fig trees, pomegranates, olive oil and honey;

verses.textZh: 你在那地必不缺乏食物，在那里你必一无所缺；那地的石头就是铁；从那里的山上，你可以挖出铜来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在那地必不缺乏食物，在那里你必一无所缺；那地的石头就是铁；从那里的山上，你可以挖出铜来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在那地不缺食物，一无所缺。那地的石头是铁，山内可以挖铜。
verses.textEnNiv: a land where bread will not be scarce and you will lack nothing; a land where the rocks are iron and you can dig copper out of the hills.
verses.textEnEsv: a land in which you will eat bread without scarcity, in which you will lack nothing, a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you can dig copper.
verses.textEnNkjv: a land in which you will eat bread without scarcity, in which you will lack nothing; a land whose stones are iron and out of whose hills you can dig copper.
verses.textEnNlt: It is a land where food is plentiful and nothing is lacking. It is a land where iron is as common as stone, and copper is abundant in the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: a land where you will eat food without shortage, in which you will not lack anything; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you can dig copper.
verses.textEn: a land where bread will not be scarce and you will lack nothing; a land where the rocks are iron and you can dig copper out of the hills.

verses.textZh: 你吃饱了，就要称颂耶和华你的神，因为他把那美地赐了给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你吃饱了，就要称颂耶和华你的神，因为他把那美地赐了给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你吃得饱足，就要称颂耶和华－你的神，因他将那美地赐给你了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When you have eaten and are satisfied, praise the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you have eaten and are full, then you shall bless the Lord your God for the good land which He has given you.
verses.textEnNlt: When you have eaten your fill, be sure to praise the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: When you have eaten and are satisfied, you shall bless the Lord your God for the good land which He has given you.
verses.textEn: When you have eaten and are satisfied, praise the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.

verses.textZh: "你要自己谨慎，免得忘记耶和华你的神，不守他的诫命、典章、律例，就是我今日吩咐你的；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要自己谨慎，免得忘记耶和华你的神，不守他的诫命、典章、律例，就是我今日吩咐你的；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华－你的神，不守他的诫命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful that you do not forget the Lord your God, failing to observe his commands, his laws and his decrees that I am giving you this day.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take care lest you forget the Lord your God by not keeping his commandments and his rules and his statutes, which I command you today,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Beware that you do not forget the Lord your God by not keeping His commandments, His judgments, and His statutes which I command you today,
verses.textEnNlt: "But that is the time to be careful! Beware that in your plenty you do not forget the Lord your God and disobey his commands, regulations, and decrees that I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be careful that you do not forget the Lord your God by failing to keep His commandments, His ordinances, and His statutes which I am commanding you today;
verses.textEn: Be careful that you do not forget the Lord your God, failing to observe his commands, his laws and his decrees that I am giving you this day.

verses.textZh: 恐怕你吃饱了，建造美好的房屋居住，
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕你吃饱了，建造美好的房屋居住，
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕你吃得饱足，建造美好的房屋居住，
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses and settle down,
verses.textEnEsv: lest, when you have eaten and are full and have built good houses and live in them,
verses.textEnNkjv: lest—when you have eaten and are full, and have built beautiful houses and dwell inthem;
verses.textEnNlt: For when you have become full and prosperous and have built fine homes to live in,
verses.textEnNasb: otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, and you build good houses and live in them,
verses.textEn: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses and settle down,

verses.textZh: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，你所有的一切都增加了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，你所有的一切都增加了，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，并你所有的全都加增，
verses.textEnNiv: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all you have is multiplied,
verses.textEnEsv: and when your herds and flocks multiply and your silver and gold is multiplied and all that you have is multiplied,
verses.textEnNkjv: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold are multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
verses.textEnNlt: and when your flocks and herds have become very large and your silver and gold have multiplied along with everything else, be careful!
verses.textEnNasb: and when your herds and your flocks increase, and your silver and gold increase, and everything that you have increases,
verses.textEn: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all you have is multiplied,

verses.textZh: 那时，你就心高气傲，忘记了耶和华你的神，就是把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来的那一位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你就心高气傲，忘记了耶和华你的神，就是把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来的那一位。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就心高气傲，忘记耶和华－你的神，就是将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来的，
verses.textEnNiv: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: then your heart be lifted up, and you forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery,
verses.textEnNkjv: when your heart is lifted up, and you forget the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.textEnNlt: Do not become proud at that time and forget the Lord your God, who rescued you from slavery in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery;
verses.textEn: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

verses.textZh: 他引导你走过那大而可畏的旷野，那里有火蛇，有蝎子，有干旱无水之地；他曾经为你使水从坚硬的盘石中流出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他引导你走过那大而可畏的旷野，那里有火蛇，有蝎子，有干旱无水之地；他曾经为你使水从坚硬的盘石中流出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 引你经过那大而可怕的旷野，那里有火蛇、蝎子、干旱无水之地。他曾为你使水从坚硬的磐石中流出来，
verses.textEnNiv: He led you through the vast and dreadful wilderness, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions. He brought you water out of hard rock.
verses.textEnEsv: who led you through the great and terrifying wilderness, with its fiery serpents and scorpions and thirsty ground where there was no water, who brought you water out of the flinty rock,
verses.textEnNkjv: who led you through that great and terrible wilderness, inwhichwere fiery serpents and scorpions and thirsty land where there was no water; who brought water for you out of the flinty rock;
verses.textEnNlt: Do not forget that he led you through the great and terrifying wilderness with its poisonous snakes and scorpions, where it was so hot and dry. He gave you water from the rock!
verses.textEnNasb: He who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with its fiery serpents and scorpions, and its thirsty ground where there was no water; He who brought water for you out of the rock of flint.
verses.textEn: He led you through the vast and dreadful wilderness, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions. He brought you water out of hard rock.

verses.textZh: 他在旷野把你的列祖不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要使你受苦，要试炼你，使你终久得到福乐；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在旷野把你的列祖不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要使你受苦，要试炼你，使你终久得到福乐；
verses.textZhCuv: 又在旷野将你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要苦炼你，试验你，叫你终久享福；
verses.textEnNiv: He gave you manna to eat in the wilderness, something your ancestors had never known, to humble and test you so that in the end it might go well with you.
verses.textEnEsv: who fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers did not know, that he might humble you and test you, to do you good in the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers did not know, that He might humble you and that He might test you, to do you good in the end—
verses.textEnNlt: He fed you with manna in the wilderness, a food unknown to your ancestors. He did this to humble you and test you for your own good.
verses.textEnNasb: In the wilderness it was He who fed you manna which your fathers did not know, in order to humble you and in order to put you to the test, to do good for you in the end.
verses.textEn: He gave you manna to eat in the wilderness, something your ancestors had never known, to humble and test you so that in the end it might go well with you.

verses.textZh: 恐怕你心里说：‘这财富是我的力量，是我手的能力使我得着的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕你心里说：‘这财富是我的力量，是我手的能力使我得着的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕你心里说：『这货财是我力量、我能力得来的。』
verses.textEnNiv: You may say to yourself, "My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me."
verses.textEnEsv: Beware lest you say in your heart, ‘My power and the might of my hand have gotten me this wealth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then you say in your heart, ‘My power and the might of my hand have gained me this wealth.’
verses.textEnNlt: He did all this so you would never say to yourself, ‘I have achieved this wealth with my own strength and energy.’
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, you may say in your heart, ‘My power and the strength of my hand made me this wealth.’
verses.textEn: You may say to yourself, "My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me."

verses.textZh: 你要记念耶和华你的神，因为得财富的能力是他赐给你的，为要坚定他向你的列祖起誓所立的约，像今天一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记念耶和华你的神，因为得财富的能力是他赐给你的，为要坚定他向你的列祖起誓所立的约，像今天一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要记念耶和华－你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的，为要坚定他向你列祖起誓所立的约，像今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your ancestors, as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may confirm his covenant that he swore to your fathers, as it is this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall remember the Lord your God, for itis He who gives you power to get wealth, that He may establish His covenant which He swore to your fathers, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember the Lord your God. He is the one who gives you power to be successful, in order to fulfill the covenant he confirmed to your ancestors with an oath.
verses.textEnNasb: But you are to remember the Lord your God, for it is He who is giving you power to make wealth, in order to confirm His covenant which He swore to your fathers, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your ancestors, as it is today.

verses.textZh: 如果将来你真的忘记了耶和华你的神，去随从别的神，事奉和敬拜他们，你们必定灭亡，这是我今日警告你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果将来你真的忘记了耶和华你的神，去随从别的神，事奉和敬拜他们，你们必定灭亡，这是我今日警告你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若忘记耶和华－你的神，随从别神，事奉敬拜，你们必定灭亡；这是我今日警戒你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: If you ever forget the Lord your God and follow other gods and worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: And if you forget the Lord your God and go after other gods and serve them and worship them, I solemnly warn you today that you shall surely perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be, if you by any means forget the Lord your God, and follow other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you this day that you shall surely perish.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I assure you of this: If you ever forget the Lord your God and follow other gods, worshiping and bowing down to them, you will certainly be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall come about, if you ever forget the Lord your God and follow other gods and serve and worship them, I testify against you today that you will certainly perish.
verses.textEn: If you ever forget the Lord your God and follow other gods and worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华从你们面前怎样使万国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们没有听从耶和华你们神的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华从你们面前怎样使万国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们没有听从耶和华你们神的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在你们面前怎样使列国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们不听从耶和华－你们神的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Like the nations the Lord destroyed before you, so you will be destroyed for not obeying the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Like the nations that the Lord makes to perish before you, so shall you perish, because you would not obey the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the nations which the Lord destroys before you, so you shall perish, because you would not be obedient to the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as the Lord has destroyed other nations in your path, you also will be destroyed if you refuse to obey the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Like the nations that the Lord eliminates from you, so you shall perish, because you would not listen to the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Like the nations the Lord destroyed before you, so you will be destroyed for not obeying the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "以色列啊，你要听，你今日快要过约旦河，进去赶出比你又大又强的列国，占领坚固、高得顶天的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列啊，你要听，你今日快要过约旦河，进去赶出比你又大又强的列国，占领坚固、高得顶天的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列啊，你当听！你今日要过约旦河，进去赶出比你强大的国民，得着广大坚固、高得顶天的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear, Israel: You are now about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities that have walls up to the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear, O Israel: you are to cross over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you, cities great and fortified up to heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear, O Israel: You are to cross over the Jordan today, and go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, O Israel! Today you are about to cross the Jordan River to take over the land belonging to nations much greater and more powerful than you. They live in cities with walls that reach to the sky!
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, Israel! You are crossing the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you, cities that are great and fortified to heaven,
verses.textEn: Hear, Israel: You are now about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities that have walls up to the sky.

verses.textZh: 那地的民族又高又大，就是亚衲族的人，是你知道的，你也听过有人指着他们说：‘谁能在亚衲族人面前站立得住呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地的民族又高又大，就是亚衲族的人，是你知道的，你也听过有人指着他们说：‘谁能在亚衲族人面前站立得住呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 那民是亚衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾听见有人指着他们说：『谁能在亚衲族人面前站立得住呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: The people are strong and tall—Anakites! You know about them and have heard it said: "Who can stand up against the Anakites?"
verses.textEnEsv: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard it said, ‘Who can stand before the sons of Anak?’
verses.textEnNkjv: a people great and tall, the descendants of the Anakim, whom you know, and ofwhom you heard itsaid, ‘Who can stand before the descendants of Anak?’
verses.textEnNlt: The people are strong and tall—descendants of the famous Anakite giants. You’ve heard the saying, ‘Who can stand up to the Anakites?’
verses.textEnNasb: a people who are great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know and of whom you have heard it said, ‘Who can stand against the sons of Anak?’
verses.textEn: The people are strong and tall—Anakites! You know about them and have heard it said: "Who can stand up against the Anakites?"

verses.textZh: 所以今日你要知道，耶和华你的神要像烈火一样在你面前过去；他要消灭他们，他要在你面前把他们征服；这样你就可以照着耶和华吩咐你的，把他们赶走，使他们迅速灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以今日你要知道，耶和华你的神要像烈火一样在你面前过去；他要消灭他们，他要在你面前把他们征服；这样你就可以照着耶和华吩咐你的，把他们赶走，使他们迅速灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你今日当知道，耶和华－你的神在你前面过去，如同烈火，要灭绝他们，将他们制伏在你面前。这样，你就要照耶和华所说的赶出他们，使他们速速灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: But be assured today that the Lord your God is the one who goes across ahead of you like a devouring fire. He will destroy them; he will subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them quickly, as the Lord has promised you.
verses.textEnEsv: Know therefore today that he who goes over before you as a consuming fire is the Lord your God. He will destroy them and subdue them before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the Lord has promised you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore understand today that the Lord your God is He who goes over before you as a consuming fire. He will destroy them and bring them down before you; so you shall drive them out and destroy them quickly, as the Lord has said to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But recognize today that the Lord your God is the one who will cross over ahead of you like a devouring fire to destroy them. He will subdue them so that you will quickly conquer them and drive them out, just as the Lord has promised.
verses.textEnNasb: So be aware today that it is the Lord your God who is crossing over ahead of you as a consuming fire. He will destroy them and He will subdue them before you, so that you may drive them out and eliminate them quickly, just as the Lord has spoken to you.
verses.textEn: But be assured today that the Lord your God is the one who goes across ahead of you like a devouring fire. He will destroy them; he will subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them quickly, as the Lord has promised you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神把这些国的民从你面前驱逐出去以后，你心里不要说：‘耶和华把我领进来取得这地，是因着我的义。’其实耶和华从你面前把这些国的民赶出去，是因着他们的恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神把这些国的民从你面前驱逐出去以后，你心里不要说：‘耶和华把我领进来取得这地，是因着我的义。’其实耶和华从你面前把这些国的民赶出去，是因着他们的恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你的神将这些国民从你面前撵出以后，你心里不可说：『耶和华将我领进来得这地是因我的义。』其实，耶和华将他们从你面前赶出去是因他们的恶。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Lord your God has driven them out before you, do not say to yourself, "The Lord has brought me here to take possession of this land because of my righteousness." No, it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is going to drive them out before you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not say in your heart, after the Lord your God has thrust them out before you, ‘It is because of my righteousness that the Lord has brought me in to possess this land,’ whereas it is because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is driving them out before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not think in your heart, after the Lord your God has cast them out before you, saying, ‘Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to possess this land’; but itis because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is driving them out from before you.
verses.textEnNlt: "After the Lord your God has done this for you, don’t say in your hearts, ‘The Lord has given us this land because we are such good people!’ No, it is because of the wickedness of the other nations that he is pushing them out of your way.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not say in your heart when the Lord your God has driven them away from you, ‘Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to take possession of this land.’ Rather, it is because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is dispossessing them before you.
verses.textEn: After the Lord your God has driven them out before you, do not say to yourself, "The Lord has brought me here to take possession of this land because of my righteousness." No, it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is going to drive them out before you.

verses.textZh: 你进去取得他们的地，并不是因着你的义，也不是因着你心里的正直，而是因着这些国的民的恶，耶和华你的神才把他们从你面前赶出去，为要实践他向你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，起誓应许的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你进去取得他们的地，并不是因着你的义，也不是因着你心里的正直，而是因着这些国的民的恶，耶和华你的神才把他们从你面前赶出去，为要实践他向你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，起誓应许的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你进去得他们的地，并不是因你的义，也不是因你心里正直，乃是因这些国民的恶，耶和华－你的神将他们从你面前赶出去，又因耶和华要坚定他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓所应许的话。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not because of your righteousness or your integrity that you are going in to take possession of their land; but on account of the wickedness of these nations, the Lord your God will drive them out before you, to accomplish what he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Not because of your righteousness or the uprightness of your heart are you going in to possess their land, but because of the wickedness of these nations the Lord your God is driving them out from before you, and that he may confirm the word that the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis not because of your righteousness or the uprightness of your heart that you go in to possess their land, but because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord your God drives them out from before you, and that He may fulfill the word which the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: It is not because you are so good or have such integrity that you are about to occupy their land. The Lord your God will drive these nations out ahead of you only because of their wickedness, and to fulfill the oath he swore to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: It is not because of your righteousness or the uprightness of your heart that you are going in to take possession of their land, but it is because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord your God is driving them out from before you, and in order to confirm the oath which the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEn: It is not because of your righteousness or your integrity that you are going in to take possession of their land; but on account of the wickedness of these nations, the Lord your God will drive them out before you, to accomplish what he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

verses.textZh: 你要知道，耶和华你的神把这美地赐给你作产业，并不是因着你的义；你本来是顽固的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要知道，耶和华你的神把这美地赐给你作产业，并不是因着你的义；你本来是顽固的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你当知道，耶和华－你神将这美地赐你为业，并不是因你的义；你本是硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.textEnEsv: "Know, therefore, that the Lord your God is not giving you this good land to possess because of your righteousness, for you are a stubborn people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore understand that the Lord your God is not giving you this good land to possess because of your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.textEnNlt: You must recognize that the Lord your God is not giving you this good land because you are good, for you are not—you are a stubborn people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Know, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stubborn people.
verses.textEn: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

verses.textZh: "你要记住，不可忘记，你在旷野怎样惹耶和华你的神发怒；自从你出了埃及地的那天起，直到你们来到这地方，你们常是反抗耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要记住，不可忘记，你在旷野怎样惹耶和华你的神发怒；自从你出了埃及地的那天起，直到你们来到这地方，你们常是反抗耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当记念不忘，你在旷野怎样惹耶和华－你神发怒。自从你出了埃及地的那日，直到你们来到这地方，你们时常悖逆耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember this and never forget how you aroused the anger of the Lord your God in the wilderness. From the day you left Egypt until you arrived here, you have been rebellious against the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Remember and do not forget how you provoked the Lord your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day you came out of the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember! Do not forget how you provoked the Lord your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you departed from the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember and never forget how angry you made the Lord your God out in the wilderness. From the day you left Egypt until now, you have been constantly rebelling against him.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, do not forget how you provoked the Lord your God to anger in the wilderness; from the day that you left the land of Egypt until you arrived at this place, you have been rebellious against the Lord.
verses.textEn: Remember this and never forget how you aroused the anger of the Lord your God in the wilderness. From the day you left Egypt until you arrived here, you have been rebellious against the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们在何烈山又惹耶和华发怒，以致耶和华向你们发怒，要灭绝你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在何烈山又惹耶和华发怒，以致耶和华向你们发怒，要灭绝你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在何烈山又惹耶和华发怒；他恼怒你们，要灭绝你们。
verses.textEnNiv: At Horeb you aroused the Lord ’s wrath so that he was angry enough to destroy you.
verses.textEnEsv: Even at Horeb you provoked the Lord to wrath, and the Lord was so angry with you that he was ready to destroy you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also in Horeb you provoked the Lord to wrath, so that the Lord was angry enough with you to have destroyed you.
verses.textEnNlt: Even at Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry he was ready to destroy you.
verses.textEnNasb: Even at Horeb you provoked the Lord to anger, and the Lord was so angry with you that He would have destroyed you.
verses.textEn: At Horeb you aroused the Lord ’s wrath so that he was angry enough to destroy you.

verses.textZh: 那时，我上了山，要领受石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的石版；那时我在山上住了四十昼夜，不吃不喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我上了山，要领受石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的石版；那时我在山上住了四十昼夜，不吃不喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 我上了山，要领受两块石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的版。那时我在山上住了四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
verses.textEnNiv: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the Lord had made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.
verses.textEnEsv: When I went up the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the Lord made with you, I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I went up into the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the Lord made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.
verses.textEnNlt: This happened when I was on the mountain receiving the tablets of stone inscribed with the words of the covenant that the Lord had made with you. I was there for forty days and forty nights, and all that time I ate no food and drank no water.
verses.textEnNasb: When I went up to the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the Lord made with you, then I remained on the mountain for forty days and nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water.
verses.textEn: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the Lord had made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把那两块石版交给了我，是神用手指写的；石版上所写的，是耶和华在大会之日，在山上从火中对你们所说的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把那两块石版交给了我，是神用手指写的；石版上所写的，是耶和华在大会之日，在山上从火中对你们所说的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华把那两块石版交给我，是神用指头写的。版上所写的是照耶和华在大会的日子、在山上、从火中对你们所说的一切话。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord gave me two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God. On them were all the commandments the Lord proclaimed to you on the mountain out of the fire, on the day of the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone written with the finger of God, and on them were all the words that the Lord had spoken with you on the mountain out of the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord delivered to me two tablets of stone written with the finger of God, and on them were all the words which the Lord had spoken to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave me the two tablets on which God had written with his own finger all the words he had spoken to you from the heart of the fire when you were assembled at the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord gave me the two tablets of stone written by the finger of God; and on them were all the words which the Lord had spoken with you at the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.
verses.textEn: The Lord gave me two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God. On them were all the commandments the Lord proclaimed to you on the mountain out of the fire, on the day of the assembly.

verses.textZh: 过了四十昼夜，耶和华把那两块石版，就是约版，交给了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了四十昼夜，耶和华把那两块石版，就是约版，交给了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了四十昼夜，耶和华把那两块石版，就是约版，交给我。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of the forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: And at the end of forty days and forty nights the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: "At the end of the forty days and nights, the Lord handed me the two stone tablets inscribed with the words of the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about at the end of forty days and nights that the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEn: At the end of the forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘你起来，从这里赶快下去，因为你从埃及领出来的人已经败坏了，他们很快就偏离了我吩咐他们走的道路，为自己铸造了偶像。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘你起来，从这里赶快下去，因为你从埃及领出来的人已经败坏了，他们很快就偏离了我吩咐他们走的道路，为自己铸造了偶像。’
verses.textZhCuv: 对我说：『你起来，赶快下去！因为你从埃及领出来的百姓已经败坏了自己；他们快快地偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸成了偶像。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord told me, "Go down from here at once, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have become corrupt. They have turned away quickly from what I commanded them and have made an idol for themselves."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Arise, go down quickly from here, for your people whom you have brought from Egypt have acted corruptly. They have turned aside quickly out of the way that I commanded them; they have made themselves a metal image.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the Lord said to me, ‘Arise, go down quickly from here, for your people whom you brought out of Egypt have acted corruptly; they have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them; they have made themselves a molded image.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Get up! Go down immediately, for the people you brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned away from the way I commanded them to live! They have melted gold and made an idol for themselves!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Arise, go down from here quickly, because your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have behaved corruptly. They have quickly turned aside from the way that I commanded them; they have made a cast metal image for themselves.’
verses.textEn: Then the Lord told me, "Go down from here at once, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have become corrupt. They have turned away quickly from what I commanded them and have made an idol for themselves."

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对我说：‘你看这民族真是一个顽固的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对我说：‘你看这民族真是一个顽固的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华又对我说：『我看这百姓是硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to me, "I have seen this people, and they are a stiff-necked people indeed!
verses.textEnEsv: "Furthermore, the Lord said to me, ‘I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stubborn people.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Furthermore the Lord spoke to me, saying, ‘I have seen this people, and indeed they are a stiff-necked people.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord also said to me, ‘I have seen how stubborn and rebellious these people are.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also said to me, ‘I have seen this people, and indeed, it is a stubborn people.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to me, "I have seen this people, and they are a stiff-necked people indeed!

verses.textZh: 你不要管我，我要消灭他们，把他们的名字从天下除去；我要使你成为一个比他们更强更大的国。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要管我，我要消灭他们，把他们的名字从天下除去；我要使你成为一个比他们更强更大的国。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你且由着我，我要灭绝他们，将他们的名从天下涂抹，使你的后裔比他们成为更大更强的国。』
verses.textEnNiv: Let me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make you into a nation stronger and more numerous than they."
verses.textEnEsv: Let me alone, that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Me alone, that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.’
verses.textEnNlt: Leave me alone so I may destroy them and erase their name from under heaven. Then I will make a mighty nation of your descendants, a nation larger and more powerful than they are.’
verses.textEnNasb: Leave Me alone, that I may destroy them and wipe out their name from under heaven; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.’
verses.textEn: Let me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make you into a nation stronger and more numerous than they."

verses.textZh: 于是我转身，从山上下来，山上有火烧着；我手中拿着两块约版。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我转身，从山上下来，山上有火烧着；我手中拿着两块约版。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我转身下山，山被火烧着，两块约版在我两手之中。
verses.textEnNiv: So I turned and went down from the mountain while it was ablaze with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my hands.
