verses.textEnEsv: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire; and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.textEnNlt: "So while the mountain was blazing with fire I turned and came down, holding in my hands the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I turned and came down from the mountain while the mountain was burning with fire, and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.textEn: So I turned and went down from the mountain while it was ablaze with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my hands.

verses.textZh: 我观看，见你们自己铸造了牛犊，很快就离开了耶和华吩咐你们走的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见你们自己铸造了牛犊，很快就离开了耶和华吩咐你们走的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一看见你们得罪了耶和华－你们的神，铸成了牛犊，快快地偏离了耶和华所吩咐你们的道，
verses.textEnNiv: When I looked, I saw that you had sinned against the Lord your God; you had made for yourselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the Lord had commanded you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the Lord your God. You had made yourselves a golden calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the Lord had commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the Lord your God—had made for yourselves a molded calf! You had turned aside quickly from the way which the Lord had commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: There below me I could see that you had sinned against the Lord your God. You had melted gold and made a calf idol for yourselves. How quickly you had turned away from the path the Lord had commanded you to follow!
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw that you had indeed sinned against the Lord your God. You had made for yourselves a cast metal image of a calf; you had quickly turned aside from the way that the Lord had commanded you.
verses.textEn: When I looked, I saw that you had sinned against the Lord your God; you had made for yourselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the Lord had commanded you.

verses.textZh: 我拿着那两块石版，从我两手中扔下去，在你们眼前摔碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我拿着那两块石版，从我两手中扔下去，在你们眼前摔碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就把那两块版从我手中扔下去，在你们眼前摔碎了。
verses.textEnNiv: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, breaking them to pieces before your eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: So I took hold of the two tablets and threw them out of my two hands and broke them before your eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I took the two tablets and threw them out of my two hands and broke them before your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: So I took the stone tablets and threw them to the ground, smashing them before your eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: So I took hold of the two tablets and threw them from my two hands, and smashed them to pieces before your eyes!
verses.textEn: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, breaking them to pieces before your eyes.

verses.textZh: 为了你们所犯的一切罪，作了耶和华看为恶的事，惹他发怒，我就像先前那样，俯伏在耶和华面前，四十昼夜，不吃不喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了你们所犯的一切罪，作了耶和华看为恶的事，惹他发怒，我就像先前那样，俯伏在耶和华面前，四十昼夜，不吃不喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你们所犯的一切罪，行了耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒，我就像从前俯伏在耶和华面前四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
verses.textEnNiv: Then once again I fell prostrate before the Lord for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all the sin you had committed, doing what was evil in the Lord ’s sight and so arousing his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I lay prostrate before the Lord as before, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all the sin that you had committed, in doing what was evil in the sight of the Lord to provoke him to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I fell down before the Lord, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you committed in doing wickedly in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, as before, I threw myself down before the Lord for forty days and nights. I ate no bread and drank no water because of the great sin you had committed by doing what the Lord hated, provoking him to anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I fell down before the Lord like the first time, for forty days and nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you had committed by doing what was evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
verses.textEn: Then once again I fell prostrate before the Lord for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all the sin you had committed, doing what was evil in the Lord ’s sight and so arousing his anger.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华向你们大发烈怒，要消灭你们，我就很惧怕；但是那一次耶和华也听了我的恳求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华向你们大发烈怒，要消灭你们，我就很惧怕；但是那一次耶和华也听了我的恳求。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因耶和华向你们大发烈怒，要灭绝你们，就甚害怕；但那次耶和华又应允了我。
verses.textEnNiv: I feared the anger and wrath of the Lord , for he was angry enough with you to destroy you. But again the Lord listened to me.
verses.textEnEsv: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure that the Lord bore against you, so that he was ready to destroy you. But the Lord listened to me that time also.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the Lord was angry with you, to destroy you. But the Lord listened to me at that time also.
verses.textEnNlt: I feared that the furious anger of the Lord , which turned him against you, would drive him to destroy you. But again he listened to me.
verses.textEnNasb: For I was afraid of the anger and the rage with which the Lord was angry with you so as to destroy you; but the Lord listened to me that time as well.
verses.textEn: I feared the anger and wrath of the Lord , for he was angry enough with you to destroy you. But again the Lord listened to me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华也向亚伦发怒，要消灭他；那时候我也为亚伦祈祷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华也向亚伦发怒，要消灭他；那时候我也为亚伦祈祷。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华也向亚伦甚是发怒，要灭绝他；那时我又为亚伦祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I prayed for Aaron too.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord was so angry with Aaron that he was ready to destroy him. And I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord was very angry with Aaron and would have destroyed him; so I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was so angry with Aaron that he wanted to destroy him, too. But I prayed for Aaron, and the Lord spared him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord was also angry enough with Aaron to destroy him; so I also prayed for Aaron at the same time.
verses.textEn: And the Lord was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I prayed for Aaron too.

verses.textZh: 我把你们的罪，就是你们铸造的牛犊，拿去用火烧了，又把它捣碎，磨成细粉，像灰尘一样；我把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把你们的罪，就是你们铸造的牛犊，拿去用火烧了，又把它捣碎，磨成细粉，像灰尘一样；我把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我把那叫你们犯罪所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，又捣碎磨得很细，以致细如灰尘，我就把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。
verses.textEnNiv: Also I took that sinful thing of yours, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and threw the dust into a stream that flowed down the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I took the sinful thing, the calf that you had made, and burned it with fire and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. And I threw the dust of it into the brook that ran down from the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire and crushed it and ground it very small, until it was as fine as dust; and I threw its dust into the brook that descended from the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: I took your sin—the calf you had made—and I melted it down in the fire and ground it into fine dust. Then I threw the dust into the stream that flows down the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: And I took your sinful thing which you had made, the calf, and burned it in the fire and crushed it, grinding it thoroughly until it was as fine as dust; and I threw its dust into the stream that came down from the mountain.
verses.textEn: Also I took that sinful thing of yours, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and threw the dust into a stream that flowed down the mountain.

verses.textZh: "后来你们在他备拉、玛撒、基博罗．哈他瓦，又惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "后来你们在他备拉、玛撒、基博罗．哈他瓦，又惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们在他备拉、玛撒、基博罗‧哈他瓦又惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: You also made the Lord angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.
verses.textEnEsv: "At Taberah also, and at Massah and at Kibroth-hattaavah you provoked the Lord to wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also at Taberah and Massah and Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the Lord to wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: "You also made the Lord angry at Taberah, Massah, and Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah you kept provoking the Lord to anger.
verses.textEn: You also made the Lord angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.

verses.textZh: 耶和华打发你们离开加低斯．巴尼亚，说：‘你们上去得我赐给你们作产业的地。’那时你们竟违背耶和华你们的神的命令，不相信他，不听从他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华打发你们离开加低斯．巴尼亚，说：‘你们上去得我赐给你们作产业的地。’那时你们竟违背耶和华你们的神的命令，不相信他，不听从他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华打发你们离开加低斯‧巴尼亚，说：『你们上去得我所赐给你们的地。』那时你们违背了耶和华－你们神的命令，不信服他，不听从他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, he said, "Go up and take possession of the land I have given you." But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God. You did not trust him or obey him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Lord sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, ‘Go up and take possession of the land that I have given you,’ then you rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God and did not believe him or obey his voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise, when the Lord sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, ‘Go up and possess the land which I have given you,’ then you rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God, and you did not believe Him nor obey His voice.
verses.textEnNlt: And at Kadesh-barnea the Lord sent you out with this command: ‘Go up and take over the land I have given you.’ But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God and refused to put your trust in him or obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Lord sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, ‘Go up and take possession of the land which I have given you,’ you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God; you neither trusted Him nor listened to His voice.
verses.textEn: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, he said, "Go up and take possession of the land I have given you." But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God. You did not trust him or obey him.

verses.textZh: 自从我认识了你们那一天起，你们就常常悖逆耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从我认识了你们那一天起，你们就常常悖逆耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我认识你们以来，你们常常悖逆耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: You have been rebellious against the Lord ever since I have known you.
verses.textEnEsv: You have been rebellious against the Lord from the day that I knew you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have been rebellious against the Lord from the day that I knew you.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you have been rebelling against the Lord as long as I have known you.
verses.textEnNasb: You have been rebellious toward the Lord since the day I knew you.
verses.textEn: You have been rebellious against the Lord ever since I have known you.

verses.textZh: "因为耶和华说要消灭你们，我就俯伏在耶和华面前，共俯伏了四十昼夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为耶和华说要消灭你们，我就俯伏在耶和华面前，共俯伏了四十昼夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我因耶和华说要灭绝你们，就在耶和华面前照旧俯伏四十昼夜。
verses.textEnNiv: I lay prostrate before the Lord those forty days and forty nights because the Lord had said he would destroy you.
verses.textEnEsv: "So I lay prostrate before the Lord for these forty days and forty nights, because the Lord had said he would destroy you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus I prostrated myself before the Lord; forty days and forty nights I kept prostrating myself, because the Lord had said He would destroy you.
verses.textEnNlt: "That is why I threw myself down before the Lord for forty days and nights—for the Lord said he would destroy you.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I fell down before the Lord for the forty days and nights, which I did because the Lord said He would destroy you.
verses.textEn: I lay prostrate before the Lord those forty days and forty nights because the Lord had said he would destroy you.

verses.textZh: 我祈求耶和华，说：‘主耶和华啊，求你不要毁灭你的子民，你的产业，就是你借着你的大能救赎，借着你有力的手从埃及领出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我祈求耶和华，说：‘主耶和华啊，求你不要毁灭你的子民，你的产业，就是你借着你的大能救赎，借着你有力的手从埃及领出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我祈祷耶和华说：『主耶和华啊，求你不要灭绝你的百姓。他们是你的产业，是你用大力救赎的，用大能从埃及领出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: I prayed to the Lord and said, "Sovereign Lord , do not destroy your people, your own inheritance that you redeemed by your great power and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.textEnEsv: And I prayed to the Lord , ‘O Lord God , do not destroy your people and your heritage, whom you have redeemed through your greatness, whom you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I prayed to the Lord, and said: ‘O Lord God, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance whom You have redeemed through Your greatness, whom You have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.textEnNlt: I prayed to the Lord and said, ‘O Sovereign Lord , do not destroy them. They are your own people. They are your special possession, whom you redeemed from Egypt by your mighty power and your strong hand.
verses.textEnNasb: And I prayed to the Lord and said, ‘Lord God, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You have redeemed through Your greatness, whom You have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand!
verses.textEn: I prayed to the Lord and said, "Sovereign Lord , do not destroy your people, your own inheritance that you redeemed by your great power and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.textZh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各；不要看这民族的顽固、邪恶和罪过，
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各；不要看这民族的顽固、邪恶和罪过，
verses.textZhCuv: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，不要想念这百姓的顽梗、邪恶、罪过，
verses.textEnNiv: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness and their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Do not regard the stubbornness of this people, or their wickedness or their sin,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not look on the stubbornness of this people, or on their wickedness or their sin,
verses.textEnNlt: Please overlook the stubbornness and the awful sin of these people, and remember instead your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not turn Your attention to the stubbornness of this people, or to their wickedness, or their sin.
verses.textEn: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness and their sin.

verses.textZh: 免得你领我们从那里出来的那地的人说："耶和华因为不能把他们领进他应许的地，又因为恨他们，所以才把他们领出来，要在旷野杀死他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得你领我们从那里出来的那地的人说："耶和华因为不能把他们领进他应许的地，又因为恨他们，所以才把他们领出来，要在旷野杀死他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 免得你领我们出来的那地之人说，耶和华因为不能将这百姓领进他所应许之地，又因恨他们，所以领他们出去，要在旷野杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, the country from which you brought us will say, ‘Because the Lord was not able to take them into the land he had promised them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.’
verses.textEnEsv: lest the land from which you brought us say, "Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land that he promised them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNkjv: lest the land from which You brought us should say, "Because the Lord was not able to bring them to the land which He promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNlt: If you destroy these people, the Egyptians will say, "The Israelites died because the Lord wasn’t able to bring them to the land he had promised to give them." Or they might say, "He destroyed them because he hated them; he deliberately took them into the wilderness to slaughter them."
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, the people of the land from which You brought us will say, "Since the Lord was not able to bring them into the land which He had promised them, and since He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness!"
verses.textEn: Otherwise, the country from which you brought us will say, ‘Because the Lord was not able to take them into the land he had promised them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.’

verses.textZh: 但是，他们是你的子民，是你的产业，又是你借着大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，他们是你的子民，是你的产业，又是你借着大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 其实他们是你的百姓，你的产业，是你用大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But they are your people, your inheritance that you brought out by your great power and your outstretched arm."
verses.textEnEsv: For they are your people and your heritage, whom you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your mighty power and by Your outstretched arm.’
verses.textEnNlt: But they are your people and your special possession, whom you brought out of Egypt by your great strength and powerful arm.’
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they are Your people, and Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and Your outstretched arm.’
verses.textEn: But they are your people, your inheritance that you brought out by your great power and your outstretched arm."

verses.textZh: "那时，耶和华对我说：‘你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，然后上山到我这里来；又要做一个木柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，耶和华对我说：‘你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，然后上山到我这里来；又要做一个木柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，耶和华吩咐我说：『你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，上山到我这里来，又要做一木柜。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time the Lord said to me, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden ark.
verses.textEnEsv: "At that time the Lord said to me, ‘Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to me on the mountain and make an ark of wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At that time the Lord said to me, ‘Hew for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to Me on the mountain and make yourself an ark of wood.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time the Lord said to me, ‘Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones. Also make a wooden Ark—a sacred chest to store them in. Come up to me on the mountain,
verses.textEnNasb: "At that time the Lord said to me, ‘Cut out for yourself two tablets of stone like the first two, and come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood for yourself.
verses.textEn: At that time the Lord said to me, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden ark.

verses.textZh: 我要把你摔碎的先前那两块版上的话，写在这两块版上；你要把它们放在柜中。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你摔碎的先前那两块版上的话，写在这两块版上；你要把它们放在柜中。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你先前摔碎的那版，其上的字我要写在这版上；你要将这版放在柜中。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the ark."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets that you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you shall put them in the ark.’
verses.textEnNlt: and I will write on the tablets the same words that were on the ones you smashed. Then place the tablets in the Ark.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you smashed to pieces, and you shall put them in the ark.’
verses.textEn: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the ark."

verses.textZh: 于是我用皂荚木做了一个柜，又凿出了两块石版，和先前的一样；然后我手里拿着这两块石版，上山去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我用皂荚木做了一个柜，又凿出了两块石版，和先前的一样；然后我手里拿着这两块石版，上山去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我用皂荚木做了一柜，又凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，手里拿这两块版上山去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.
verses.textEnEsv: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two tablets of stone like the first, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So I made an ark of acacia wood, hewed two tablets of stone like the first, and went up the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "So I made an Ark of acacia wood and cut two stone tablets like the first two. Then I went up the mountain with the tablets in my hand.
verses.textEnNasb: So I made an ark of acacia wood and cut out two tablets of stone like the first two, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hand.
verses.textEn: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把先前所写的，就是在集会的日子，在山上从火中告诉你们的十诫，都写在这两块版上；耶和华把石版交给了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把先前所写的，就是在集会的日子，在山上从火中告诉你们的十诫，都写在这两块版上；耶和华把石版交给了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将那大会之日、在山上从火中所传与你们的十条诫，照先前所写的，写在这版上，将版交给我了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the Lord gave them to me.
verses.textEnEsv: And he wrote on the tablets, in the same writing as before, the Ten Commandments that the Lord had spoken to you on the mountain out of the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly. And the Lord gave them to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He wrote on the tablets according to the first writing, the Ten Commandments, which the Lord had spoken to you in the mountain from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the Lord gave them to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on the tablets and gave them to me. They were the same words the Lord had spoken to you from the heart of the fire on the day you were assembled at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He wrote on the tablets, like the first writing, the Ten Commandments which the Lord had spoken to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly; and the Lord gave them to me.
verses.textEn: The Lord wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the Lord gave them to me.

verses.textZh: 于是我转身从山上下来，把石版放在我所做的柜中，照着耶和华吩咐我的，现在石版还放在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我转身从山上下来，把石版放在我所做的柜中，照着耶和华吩咐我的，现在石版还放在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我转身下山，将这版放在我所做的柜中，现今还在那里，正如耶和华所吩咐我的。」 （
verses.textEnNiv: Then I came back down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the Lord commanded me, and they are there now.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I turned and came down from the mountain and put the tablets in the ark that I had made. And there they are, as the Lord commanded me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are, just as the Lord commanded me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I turned and came down the mountain and placed the tablets in the Ark of the Covenant, which I had made, just as the Lord commanded me. And the tablets are still there in the Ark."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and they are there, just as the Lord commanded me."
verses.textEn: Then I came back down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the Lord commanded me, and they are there now.

verses.textZh: "以色列人从比罗比尼．亚干起程，到了摩西拉。亚伦在那里死了，也埋葬在那里；他的儿子以利亚撒接替他供祭司的职分。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人从比罗比尼．亚干起程，到了摩西拉。亚伦在那里死了，也埋葬在那里；他的儿子以利亚撒接替他供祭司的职分。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从比罗比尼‧亚干 起行，到了摩西拉。亚伦死在那里，就葬在那里。他儿子以利亚撒接续他供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: (The Israelites traveled from the wells of Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.
verses.textEnEsv: (The people of Israel journeyed from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried. And his son Eleazar ministered as priest in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Now the children of Israel journeyed from the wells of Bene Jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died, and where he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered as priest in his stead.
verses.textEnNlt: (The people of Israel set out from the wells of the people of Jaakan and traveled to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried. His son Eleazar ministered as high priest in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: (Now the sons of Israel set out from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and there he was buried, and his son Eleazar served as priest in his place.
verses.textEn: (The Israelites traveled from the wells of Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.

verses.textZh: 他们从那里起程，到了谷歌大，又从谷歌大到约巴他，就是多溪水的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从那里起程，到了谷歌大，又从谷歌大到约巴他，就是多溪水的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从那里起行，到了谷歌大，又从谷歌大到了有溪水之地的约巴他。
verses.textEnNiv: From there they traveled to Gudgodah and on to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.
verses.textEnEsv: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with brooks of water.
verses.textEnNkjv: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of rivers of water.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from there to Jotbathah, a land with many brooks and streams.
verses.textEnNasb: From there they set out to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.
verses.textEn: From there they traveled to Gudgodah and on to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华把利未支派分别出来，叫他们抬耶和华的约柜，侍立在耶和华面前事奉他，并且奉他的名祝福，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华把利未支派分别出来，叫他们抬耶和华的约柜，侍立在耶和华面前事奉他，并且奉他的名祝福，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华将利未支派分别出来，抬耶和华的约柜，又侍立在耶和华面前事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , to stand before the Lord to minister and to pronounce blessings in his name, as they still do today.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord to stand before the Lord to minister to him and to bless in his name, to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to minister to Him and to bless in His name, to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant, and to stand before the Lord as his ministers, and to pronounce blessings in his name. These are their duties to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time the Lord singled out the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to serve Him and to bless in His name, until this day.
verses.textEn: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , to stand before the Lord to minister and to pronounce blessings in his name, as they still do today.

verses.textZh: 所以利未人在兄弟中无分无业；照着耶和华你的神应许他的，耶和华自己就是他的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以利未人在兄弟中无分无业；照着耶和华你的神应许他的，耶和华自己就是他的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以利未人在他弟兄中无分无业，耶和华是他的产业，正如耶和华－你神所应许他的。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why the Levites have no share or inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the Lord is their inheritance, as the Lord your God told them.)
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Levi has no portion or inheritance with his brothers. The Lord is his inheritance, as the Lord your God said to him.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; the Lordis his inheritance, just as the Lord your God promised him.)
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Levites have no share of property or possession of land among the other Israelite tribes. The Lord himself is their special possession, as the Lord your God told them.)
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, Levi does not have a portion or inheritance with his brothers; the Lord is his inheritance, just as the Lord your God spoke to him.)
verses.textEn: That is why the Levites have no share or inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the Lord is their inheritance, as the Lord your God told them.)

verses.textZh: "我又像以前那样，在山上停留了四十昼夜；那一次耶和华也听了我的呼求，他不愿把你毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我又像以前那样，在山上停留了四十昼夜；那一次耶和华也听了我的呼求，他不愿把你毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我又像从前在山上住了四十昼夜。那次耶和华也应允我，不忍将你灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I had stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, as I did the first time, and the Lord listened to me at this time also. It was not his will to destroy you.
verses.textEnEsv: "I myself stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights, and the Lord listened to me that time also. The Lord was unwilling to destroy you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As at the first time, I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty nights; the Lord also heard me at that time, and the Lord chose not to destroy you.
verses.textEnNlt: "As for me, I stayed on the mountain in the Lord ’s presence for forty days and nights, as I had done the first time. And once again the Lord listened to my pleas and agreed not to destroy you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, moreover, stayed on the mountain for forty days and forty nights like the first time, and the Lord listened to me that time also; the Lord was not willing to destroy you.
verses.textEn: Now I had stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, as I did the first time, and the Lord listened to me at this time also. It was not his will to destroy you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘你起来，走在人民的前面，使他们可以进去，得着我向他们列祖起誓赐给他们的那地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘你起来，走在人民的前面，使他们可以进去，得着我向他们列祖起誓赐给他们的那地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐我说：『你起来引导这百姓，使他们进去得我向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go," the Lord said to me, "and lead the people on their way, so that they may enter and possess the land I swore to their ancestors to give them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, ‘Arise, go on your journey at the head of the people, so that they may go in and possess the land, which I swore to their fathers to give them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Arise, begin your journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Get up and resume the journey, and lead the people to the land I swore to give to their ancestors, so they may take possession of it.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, ‘Arise, proceed on your journey ahead of the people, so that they may go in and take possession of the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.’
verses.textEn: "Go," the Lord said to me, "and lead the people on their way, so that they may enter and possess the land I swore to their ancestors to give them."

verses.textZh: "以色列啊，现在耶和华你的神向你要的是甚么呢？只要你敬畏耶和华你的神，行在他的一切道路上，爱他，一心一意事奉耶和华你的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列啊，现在耶和华你的神向你要的是甚么呢？只要你敬畏耶和华你的神，行在他的一切道路上，爱他，一心一意事奉耶和华你的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列啊，现在耶和华－你神向你所要的是什么呢？只要你敬畏耶和华－你的神，遵行他的道，爱他，尽心尽性事奉他，
verses.textEnNiv: And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnEsv: "And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God require of you, but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God require of you, but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways and to love Him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God require of you? He requires only that you fear the Lord your God, and live in a way that pleases him, and love him and serve him with all your heart and soul.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God require of you, but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways and love Him, and to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEn: And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.textZh: 遵守耶和华的诫命和律例，就是我今日吩咐你的，为要叫你得福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遵守耶和华的诫命和律例，就是我今日吩咐你的，为要叫你得福。
verses.textZhCuv: 遵守他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，为要叫你得福。
verses.textEnNiv: and to observe the Lord ’s commands and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good?
verses.textEnEsv: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the Lord , which I am commanding you today for your good?
verses.textEnNkjv: and to keep the commandments of the Lord and His statutes which I command you today for your good?
verses.textEnNlt: And you must always obey the Lord ’s commands and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good.
verses.textEnNasb: and to keep the Lord’s commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today for your good?
verses.textEn: and to observe the Lord ’s commands and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good?

verses.textZh: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上的一切都是属于耶和华你的神的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上的一切都是属于耶和华你的神的。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上所有的，都属耶和华－你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: To the Lord your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, to the Lord your God belong heaven and the heaven of heavens, the earth with all that is in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed heaven and the highest heavens belong to the Lord your God, also the earth with all that is in it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, the highest heavens and the earth and everything in it all belong to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, to the Lord your God belong heaven and the highest heavens, the earth and all that is in it.
verses.textEn: To the Lord your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华只喜悦你的列祖，爱他们；他从万民中拣选了他们的后裔，就是你们，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华只喜悦你的列祖，爱他们；他从万民中拣选了他们的后裔，就是你们，像今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华但喜悦你的列祖，爱他们，从万民中拣选他们的后裔，就是你们，像今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet the Lord set his affection on your ancestors and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations—as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the Lord set his heart in love on your fathers and chose their offspring after them, you above all peoples, as you are this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord delighted only in your fathers, to love them; and He chose their descendants after them, you above all peoples, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet the Lord chose your ancestors as the objects of his love. And he chose you, their descendants, above all other nations, as is evident today.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord set His affection on your fathers, to love them, and He chose their descendants after them, you over all the other peoples, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: Yet the Lord set his affection on your ancestors and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations—as it is today.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要给你们的心行割礼，不可再顽固。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要给你们的心行割礼，不可再顽固。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要将心里的污秽除掉，不可再硬着颈项。
verses.textEnNiv: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.
verses.textEnEsv: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no longer stubborn.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and be stiff-necked no longer.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, change your hearts and stop being stubborn.
verses.textEnNasb: So circumcise your heart, and do not stiffen your neck any longer.
verses.textEn: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你们的神，他是万神之神、万主之主、伟大有力和可畏的神；他不徇情面，也不受贿赂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你们的神，他是万神之神、万主之主、伟大有力和可畏的神；他不徇情面，也不受贿赂。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你们的神－他是万神之神，万主之主，至大的神，大有能力，大而可畏，不以貌取人，也不受贿赂。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who is not partial and takes no bribe.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality nor takes a bribe.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the Lord your God is the God of gods and Lord of lords. He is the great God, the mighty and awesome God, who shows no partiality and cannot be bribed.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God is the God of gods and the Lord of lords, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who does not show partiality, nor take a bribe.
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.

verses.textZh: 他为孤儿寡妇伸张正义，又把衣食给寄居的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为孤儿寡妇伸张正义，又把衣食给寄居的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为孤儿寡妇伸冤，又怜爱寄居的，赐给他衣食。
verses.textEnNiv: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the foreigner residing among you, giving them food and clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: He executes justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the sojourner, giving him food and clothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: He administers justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the stranger, giving him food and clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: He ensures that orphans and widows receive justice. He shows love to the foreigners living among you and gives them food and clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: He executes justice for the orphan and the widow, and shows His love for the stranger by giving him food and clothing.
verses.textEn: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the foreigner residing among you, giving them food and clothing.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要爱寄居的人，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要爱寄居的人，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Love the sojourner, therefore, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So you, too, must show love to foreigners, for you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So show your love for the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 你要敬畏耶和华你的神，事奉他，依靠他，奉他的名起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要敬畏耶和华你的神，事奉他，依靠他，奉他的名起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要敬畏耶和华－你的神，事奉他，专靠他，也要指着他的名起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: Fear the Lord your God and serve him. Hold fast to him and take your oaths in his name.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall fear the Lord your God. You shall serve him and hold fast to him, and by his name you shall swear.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall fear the Lord your God; you shall serve Him, and to Him you shall hold fast, and take oaths in His name.
verses.textEnNlt: You must fear the Lord your God and worship him and cling to him. Your oaths must be in his name alone.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall fear the Lord your God; you shall serve Him, and cling to Him, and you shall swear by His name.
verses.textEn: Fear the Lord your God and serve him. Hold fast to him and take your oaths in his name.

verses.textZh: 他是你当颂赞的；他是你的神，他为你作了那些大而可畏的事，就是你亲眼见过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是你当颂赞的；他是你的神，他为你作了那些大而可畏的事，就是你亲眼见过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是你所赞美的，是你的神，为你做了那大而可畏的事，是你亲眼所看见的。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the one you praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: He is your praise. He is your God, who has done for you these great and terrifying things that your eyes have seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is your praise, and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
verses.textEnNlt: He alone is your God, the only one who is worthy of your praise, the one who has done these mighty miracles that you have seen with your own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: He is your glory and He is your God, who has done these great and awesome things for you which your eyes have seen.
verses.textEn: He is the one you praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.

verses.textZh: 你的列祖下到埃及的时候，一共不过七十人，现在耶和华你的神却使你的人数像天上的星那么多了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的列祖下到埃及的时候，一共不过七十人，现在耶和华你的神却使你的人数像天上的星那么多了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的列祖七十人下埃及；现在耶和华－你的神使你如同天上的星那样多。」
verses.textEnNiv: Your ancestors who went down into Egypt were seventy in all, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: Your fathers went down to Egypt seventy persons, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your fathers went down to Egypt with seventy persons, and now the Lord your God has made you as the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: When your ancestors went down into Egypt, there were only seventy of them. But now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky!
verses.textEnNasb: Your fathers went down to Egypt seventy persons in all, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars of heaven.
verses.textEn: Your ancestors who went down into Egypt were seventy in all, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

verses.textZh: "所以你要爱耶和华你的神，常常遵守他的吩咐、律例、典章和诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以你要爱耶和华你的神，常常遵守他的吩咐、律例、典章和诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要爱耶和华－你的神，常守他的吩咐、律例、典章、诫命。
verses.textEnNiv: Love the Lord your God and keep his requirements, his decrees, his laws and his commands always.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall therefore love the Lord your God and keep his charge, his statutes, his rules, and his commandments always.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall love the Lord your God, and keep His charge, His statutes, His judgments, and His commandments always.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must love the Lord your God and always obey his requirements, decrees, regulations, and commands.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall therefore love the Lord your God, and always keep His directive, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
verses.textEn: Love the Lord your God and keep his requirements, his decrees, his laws and his commands always.

verses.textZh: 今日你们要知道，我并不是与你们的儿女说话，因为他们不知道，也没有见过耶和华你们的神的管教、伟大有力的手和伸出来的膀臂，
verses.textZhCnvs: 今日你们要知道，我并不是与你们的儿女说话，因为他们不知道，也没有见过耶和华你们的神的管教、伟大有力的手和伸出来的膀臂，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们今日当知道，我本不是和你们的儿女说话；因为他们不知道，也没有看见耶和华－你们神的管教、威严、大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，
verses.textEnNiv: Remember today that your children were not the ones who saw and experienced the discipline of the Lord your God: his majesty, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm;
verses.textEnEsv: And consider today (since I am not speaking to your children who have not known or seen it), consider the discipline of the Lord your God, his greatness, his mighty hand and his outstretched arm,
verses.textEnNkjv: Know today that Ido not speak with your children, who have not known and who have not seen the chastening of the Lord your God, His greatness and His mighty hand and His outstretched arm—
verses.textEnNlt: Keep in mind that I am not talking now to your children, who have never experienced the discipline of the Lord your God or seen his greatness and his strong hand and powerful arm.
verses.textEnNasb: Know this day that I am not speaking with your sons who have not known and who have not seen the discipline of the Lord your God—His greatness, His mighty hand, His outstretched arm,
verses.textEn: Remember today that your children were not the ones who saw and experienced the discipline of the Lord your God: his majesty, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm;

verses.textZh: 以及他在埃及向埃及王法老和法老的全国所行的神迹和作为；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及他在埃及向埃及王法老和法老的全国所行的神迹和作为；
verses.textZhCuv: 并他在埃及中向埃及王法老和其全地所行的神迹奇事；
verses.textEnNiv: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;
verses.textEnEsv: his signs and his deeds that he did in Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to all his land,
verses.textEnNkjv: His signs and His acts which He did in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to all his land;
verses.textEnNlt: They didn’t see the miraculous signs and wonders he performed in Egypt against Pharaoh and all his land.
verses.textEnNasb: and His signs and His works which He did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to all his land;
verses.textEn: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;

verses.textZh: 他们也没有见过他怎样对待埃及的军队、马匹和车辆；他们追赶你们的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水淹没了他们，把他们灭绝，这事一直传到今日；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也没有见过他怎样对待埃及的军队、马匹和车辆；他们追赶你们的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水淹没了他们，把他们灭绝，这事一直传到今日；
verses.textZhCuv: 也没有看见他怎样待埃及的军兵、车马，他们追赶你们的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水淹没他们，将他们灭绝，直到今日，
verses.textEnNiv: what he did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots, how he overwhelmed them with the waters of the Red Sea as they were pursuing you, and how the Lord brought lasting ruin on them.
verses.textEnEsv: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and to their chariots, how he made the water of the Red Sea flow over them as they pursued after you, and how the Lord has destroyed them to this day,
verses.textEnNkjv: what He did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and their chariots: how He made the waters of the Red Sea overflow them as they pursued you, and how the Lord has destroyed them to this day;
verses.textEnNlt: They didn’t see what the Lord did to the armies of Egypt and to their horses and chariots—how he drowned them in the Red Sea as they were chasing you. He destroyed them, and they have not recovered to this very day!
verses.textEnNasb: and what He did to Egypt’s army, to its horses and its chariots, when He made the water of the Red Sea engulf them while they were pursuing you, and the Lord completely eliminated them;
verses.textEn: what he did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots, how he overwhelmed them with the waters of the Red Sea as they were pursuing you, and how the Lord brought lasting ruin on them.

verses.textZh: 并且耶和华在旷野怎样待你们，直到你们来到了这个地方；
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且耶和华在旷野怎样待你们，直到你们来到了这个地方；
verses.textZhCuv: 并他在旷野怎样待你们，以致你们来到这地方；
verses.textEnNiv: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the wilderness until you arrived at this place,
verses.textEnEsv: and what he did to you in the wilderness, until you came to this place,
verses.textEnNkjv: what He did for you in the wilderness until you came to this place;
verses.textEnNlt: "Your children didn’t see how the Lord cared for you in the wilderness until you arrived here.
verses.textEnNasb: and what He did to you in the wilderness, until you came to this place;
verses.textEn: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the wilderness until you arrived at this place,

verses.textZh: 也没有见过他怎样对待流本的子孙以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰；大地怎样在全体以色列人中间裂开了，把他们和他们的家人、帐棚，以及与他们在一起一切有生命之物都吞下去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 也没有见过他怎样对待流本的子孙以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰；大地怎样在全体以色列人中间裂开了，把他们和他们的家人、帐棚，以及与他们在一起一切有生命之物都吞下去；
verses.textZhCuv: 也没有看见他怎样待吕便子孙以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，地怎样在以色列人中间开口，吞了他们和他们的家眷，并帐棚与跟他们的一切活物。
verses.textEnNiv: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth right in the middle of all Israel and swallowed them up with their households, their tents and every living thing that belonged to them.
verses.textEnEsv: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, son of Reuben, how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the midst of all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, their households, their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel—
verses.textEnNlt: They didn’t see what he did to Dathan and Abiram (the sons of Eliab, a descendant of Reuben) when the earth opened its mouth in the Israelite camp and swallowed them, along with their households and tents and every living thing that belonged to them.
verses.textEnNasb: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben, when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, among all Israel—
verses.textEn: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth right in the middle of all Israel and swallowed them up with their households, their tents and every living thing that belonged to them.

verses.textZh: 只有你们亲眼看见了耶和华所作的一切伟大的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有你们亲眼看见了耶和华所作的一切伟大的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有你们亲眼看见耶和华所做的一切大事。」
verses.textEnNiv: But it was your own eyes that saw all these great things the Lord has done.
verses.textEnEsv: For your eyes have seen all the great work of the Lord that he did.
verses.textEnNkjv: but your eyes have seen every great act of the Lord which He did.
verses.textEnNlt: But you have seen the Lord perform all these mighty deeds with your own eyes!
verses.textEnNasb: but your own eyes have seen all the great work of the Lord which He did.
verses.textEn: But it was your own eyes that saw all these great things the Lord has done.

verses.textZh: "所以你们要遵守我今日吩咐你的一切诫命，使你们坚强起来，可以进去得着你们将要过去得的那地，
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以你们要遵守我今日吩咐你的一切诫命，使你们坚强起来，可以进去得着你们将要过去得的那地，
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，你们要守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，使你们胆壮，能以进去，得你们所要得的那地，
verses.textEnNiv: Observe therefore all the commands I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and take over the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall therefore keep the whole commandment that I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and take possession of the land that you are going over to possess,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall keep every commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land which you cross over to possess,
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, be careful to obey every command I am giving you today, so you may have strength to go in and take over the land you are about to enter.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall therefore keep every commandment which I am commanding you today, so that you may be strong and go in and take possession of the land into which you are about to cross to possess it;
verses.textEn: Observe therefore all the commands I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and take over the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

verses.textZh: 又使你们在耶和华向你们的列祖起誓应许赐给他们和他们后裔的地上，就是流奶与蜜的地，可以长久居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又使你们在耶和华向你们的列祖起誓应许赐给他们和他们后裔的地上，就是流奶与蜜的地，可以长久居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 并使你们的日子在耶和华向你们列祖起誓、应许给他们和他们后裔的地上得以长久；那是流奶与蜜之地。
verses.textEnNiv: and so that you may live long in the land the Lord swore to your ancestors to give to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnEsv: and that you may live long in the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that you may prolong your days in the land which the Lord swore to give your fathers, to them and their descendants, ‘a land flowing with milk and honey.’
verses.textEnNlt: If you obey, you will enjoy a long life in the land the Lord swore to give to your ancestors and to you, their descendants—a land flowing with milk and honey!
verses.textEnNasb: and so that you may prolong your days on the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them and to their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEn: and so that you may live long in the land the Lord swore to your ancestors to give to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.textZh: 因为你要进去得的那地，并不像你出来的埃及地；在那里你撒了种，还要用脚灌溉，像菜园一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你要进去得的那地，并不像你出来的埃及地；在那里你撒了种，还要用脚灌溉，像菜园一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要进去得为业的那地，本不像你出来的埃及地。你在那里撒种，用脚浇灌，像浇灌菜园一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The land you are entering to take over is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you planted your seed and irrigated it by foot as in a vegetable garden.
verses.textEnEsv: For the land that you are entering to take possession of it is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you sowed your seed and irrigated it, like a garden of vegetables.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the land which you go to possess is not like the land of Egypt from which you have come, where you sowed your seed and watered it by foot, as a vegetable garden;
verses.textEnNlt: For the land you are about to enter and take over is not like the land of Egypt from which you came, where you planted your seed and made irrigation ditches with your foot as in a vegetable garden.
verses.textEnNasb: For the land, into which you are entering to possess it, is not like the land of Egypt from which you came, where you used to sow your seed and water it by your foot like a vegetable garden.
verses.textEn: The land you are entering to take over is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you planted your seed and irrigated it by foot as in a vegetable garden.

verses.textZh: 但你们要过去得为业的地，却是一个有山有谷的地，有天上雨水滋润的地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们要过去得为业的地，却是一个有山有谷的地，有天上雨水滋润的地，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要过去得为业的那地乃是有山有谷、雨水滋润之地，
verses.textEnNiv: But the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks rain from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: But the land that you are going over to possess is a land of hills and valleys, which drinks water by the rain from heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: but the land which you cross over to possess is a land of hills and valleys, which drinks water from the rain of heaven,
verses.textEnNlt: Rather, the land you will soon take over is a land of hills and valleys with plenty of rain—
verses.textEnNasb: But the land into which you are about to cross to possess it, a land of hills and valleys, drinks water from the rain of heaven,
verses.textEn: But the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks rain from heaven.

verses.textZh: 就是耶和华你的神眷顾的地；从岁首到年终，耶和华你的神的眼目常常眷顾这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是耶和华你的神眷顾的地；从岁首到年终，耶和华你的神的眼目常常眷顾这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 是耶和华－你神所眷顾的；从岁首到年终，耶和华－你神的眼目时常看顾那地。
verses.textEnNiv: It is a land the Lord your God cares for; the eyes of the Lord your God are continually on it from the beginning of the year to its end.
verses.textEnEsv: a land that the Lord your God cares for. The eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year.
verses.textEnNkjv: a land for which the Lord your God cares; the eyes of the Lord your God are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the very end of the year.
verses.textEnNlt: a land that the Lord your God cares for. He watches over it through each season of the year!
verses.textEnNasb: a land for which the Lord your God cares; the eyes of the Lord your God are continually on it, from the beginning even to the end of the year.
verses.textEn: It is a land the Lord your God cares for; the eyes of the Lord your God are continually on it from the beginning of the year to its end.

verses.textZh: "如果你们留心听我今日吩咐你们的诫命，爱耶和华你们的神，一心一意事奉他，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们留心听我今日吩咐你们的诫命，爱耶和华你们的神，一心一意事奉他，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们若留意听从我今日所吩咐的诫命，爱耶和华－你们的神，尽心尽性事奉他，
verses.textEnNiv: So if you faithfully obey the commands I am giving you today—to love the Lord your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul—
verses.textEnEsv: "And if you will indeed obey my commandments that I command you today, to love the Lord your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And it shall be that if you earnestly obey My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnNlt: "If you carefully obey the commands I am giving you today, and if you love the Lord your God and serve him with all your heart and soul,
verses.textEnNasb: "And it shall come about, if you listen obediently to my commandments which I am commanding you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and all your soul,
verses.textEn: So if you faithfully obey the commands I am giving you today—to love the Lord your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul—

verses.textZh: 他 必按时降雨在你们的地上，就是降秋雨和春雨，使你们可以丰收五谷、新酒和新油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他 必按时降雨在你们的地上，就是降秋雨和春雨，使你们可以丰收五谷、新酒和新油。
verses.textZhCuv: 他 必按时降秋雨春雨在你们的地上，使你们可以收藏五谷、新酒，和油，
verses.textEnNiv: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: he will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the later rain, that you may gather in your grain and your wine and your oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will give you the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.
verses.textEnNlt: then he will send the rains in their proper seasons—the early and late rains—so you can bring in your harvests of grain, new wine, and olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: that He will provide rain for your land in its season, the early and late rain, so that you may gather your grain, your new wine, and your oil.
verses.textEn: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and olive oil.

verses.textZh: 他也必使田野为你的牲畜长出青草来，你也可以吃得饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也必使田野为你的牲畜长出青草来，你也可以吃得饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 也必使你吃得饱足，并使田野为你的牲畜长草。
verses.textEnNiv: I will provide grass in the fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will send grass in your fields for your livestock, that you may eat and be filled.’
verses.textEnNlt: He will give you lush pastureland for your livestock, and you yourselves will have all you want to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: He will also provide grass in your field for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.
verses.textEn: I will provide grass in the fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨慎，免得你们的心受迷惑，你们就偏离了我，去事奉别的神，并且敬拜它们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨慎，免得你们的心受迷惑，你们就偏离了我，去事奉别的神，并且敬拜它们；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨慎，免得心中受迷惑，就偏离正路，去事奉敬拜别神。
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful, or you will be enticed to turn away and worship other gods and bow down to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods and worship them;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnNlt: "But be careful. Don’t let your heart be deceived so that you turn away from the Lord and serve and worship other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: Beware that your hearts are not easily deceived, and that you do not turn away and serve other gods, and worship them.
verses.textEn: Be careful, or you will be enticed to turn away and worship other gods and bow down to them.

verses.textZh: 叫耶和华的怒气向你发作，就把天封闭，不降下雨水，地也不生出土产，使你们从耶和华赐给你们的美地上，快快地灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫耶和华的怒气向你发作，就把天封闭，不降下雨水，地也不生出土产，使你们从耶和华赐给你们的美地上，快快地灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就使天闭塞不下雨，地也不出产，使你们在耶和华所赐给你们的美地上速速灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord ’s anger will burn against you, and he will shut up the heavens so that it will not rain and the ground will yield no produce, and you will soon perish from the good land the Lord is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: then the anger of the Lord will be kindled against you, and he will shut up the heavens, so that there will be no rain, and the land will yield no fruit, and you will perish quickly off the good land that the Lord is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest the Lord’s anger be aroused against you, and He shut up the heavens so that there be no rain, and the land yield no produce, and you perish quickly from the good land which the Lord is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: If you do, the Lord ’s anger will burn against you. He will shut up the sky and hold back the rain, and the ground will fail to produce its harvests. Then you will quickly die in that good land the Lord is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, the anger of the Lord will be kindled against you, and He will shut up the sky so that there will be no rain, and the ground will not yield its produce; then you will quickly perish from the good land which the Lord is giving you.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord ’s anger will burn against you, and he will shut up the heavens so that it will not rain and the ground will yield no produce, and you will soon perish from the good land the Lord is giving you.

verses.textZh: "所以你们要把我这些话放在心里，存在意念中；要系在手上作记号，戴在额上作头带。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以你们要把我这些话放在心里，存在意念中；要系在手上作记号，戴在额上作头带。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要将我这话存在心内，留在意中，系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；
verses.textEnNiv: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall therefore lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul, and you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul, and bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "So commit yourselves wholeheartedly to these words of mine. Tie them to your hands and wear them on your forehead as reminders.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall therefore take these words of mine to heart and to soul; and you shall tie them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets on your forehead.
verses.textEn: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

verses.textZh: 你们也要把这些话教训你们的儿女，无论你是坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，或是起来，都要讲论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也要把这些话教训你们的儿女，无论你是坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，或是起来，都要讲论。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要教训你们的儿女，无论坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论；
verses.textEnNiv: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you are sitting in your house, and when you are walking by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach them to your children. Talk about them when you are at home and when you are on the road, when you are going to bed and when you are getting up.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also teach them to your sons, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk along the road, when you lie down, and when you get up.
verses.textEn: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些话写在你房屋的门柱上和城门上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些话写在你房屋的门柱上和城门上，
verses.textZhCuv: 又要写在房屋的门框上，并城门上，
verses.textEnNiv: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
verses.textEnNlt: Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
verses.textEn: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,

verses.textZh: 为要叫你们和你们的子孙的日子，在耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许给他们的地上，可以增多，像天覆地的年日那样多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要叫你们和你们的子孙的日子，在耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许给他们的地上，可以增多，像天覆地的年日那样多。
verses.textZhCuv: 使你们和你们子孙的日子在耶和华向你们列祖起誓、应许给他们的地上得以增多，如天覆地的日子那样多。
verses.textEnNiv: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land the Lord swore to give your ancestors, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied in the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give them, as long as the heavens are above the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied in the land of which the Lord swore to your fathers to give them, like the days of the heavens above the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: so that as long as the sky remains above the earth, you and your children may flourish in the land the Lord swore to give your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: so that your days and the days of your sons may be increased on the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give them, as long as the heavens are above the earth.
verses.textEn: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land the Lord swore to give your ancestors, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.

verses.textZh: 如果你们殷勤谨守遵行我吩咐你们的这一切诫命，爱耶和华你们的神，行他的一切道路，又紧紧地依靠他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们殷勤谨守遵行我吩咐你们的这一切诫命，爱耶和华你们的神，行他的一切道路，又紧紧地依靠他，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若留意谨守遵行我所吩咐这一切的诫命，爱耶和华－你们的神，行他的道，专靠他，
verses.textEnNiv: If you carefully observe all these commands I am giving you to follow—to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him and to hold fast to him—
verses.textEnEsv: For if you will be careful to do all this commandment that I command you to do, loving the Lord your God, walking in all his ways, and holding fast to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For if you carefully keep all these commandments which I command you to do—to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him—
verses.textEnNlt: "Be careful to obey all these commands I am giving you. Show love to the Lord your God by walking in his ways and holding tightly to him.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you are careful to keep all of this commandment which I am commanding you to do, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways and cling to Him,
verses.textEn: If you carefully observe all these commands I am giving you to follow—to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him and to hold fast to him—

verses.textZh: 耶和华就必从你们面前把这些国民都赶出去，你们就必占领比你们大比你们强的国民的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就必从你们面前把这些国民都赶出去，你们就必占领比你们大比你们强的国民的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必从你们面前赶出这一切国民，就是比你们更大更强的国民，你们也要得他们的地。
verses.textEnNiv: then the Lord will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.
verses.textEnEsv: then the Lord will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations greater and mightier than you.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the Lord will drive out all these nations from before you, and you will dispossess greater and mightier nations than yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will drive out all the nations ahead of you, though they are much greater and stronger than you, and you will take over their land.
verses.textEnNasb: then the Lord will dispossess all these nations from you, and you will dispossess nations greater and mightier than you.
verses.textEn: then the Lord will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.

verses.textZh: 你们脚掌所踏的地，都必属于你们；从旷野到黎巴嫩，从幼发拉底河直到西海，都要作你们的境界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们脚掌所踏的地，都必属于你们；从旷野到黎巴嫩，从幼发拉底河直到西海，都要作你们的境界。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地都必归你们；从旷野和黎巴嫩，并幼发拉底大河，直到西海，都要作你们的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: Every place where you set your foot will be yours: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours. Your territory shall be from the wilderness to the Lebanon, and from the River, the river Euphrates, to the western sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the River Euphrates, even to the Western Sea, shall be your territory.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever you set foot, that land will be yours. Your frontiers will stretch from the wilderness in the south to Lebanon in the north, and from the Euphrates River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
verses.textEnNasb: Every place on which the sole of your foot steps shall be yours; your border will be from the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the river, the river Euphrates, as far as the western sea.
verses.textEn: Every place where you set your foot will be yours: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.textZh: 必没有一人能在你们面前站立得住；耶和华你们的神，必照着他对你们所说的，使害怕和惊惧你们的心临到你们将要踏足之地的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必没有一人能在你们面前站立得住；耶和华你们的神，必照着他对你们所说的，使害怕和惊惧你们的心临到你们将要踏足之地的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 必无一人能在你们面前站立得住；耶和华－你们的神必照他所说的，使惧怕惊恐临到你们所踏之地的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: No one will be able to stand against you. The Lord your God, as he promised you, will put the terror and fear of you on the whole land, wherever you go.
verses.textEnEsv: No one shall be able to stand against you. The Lord your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you shall tread, as he promised you.
verses.textEnNkjv: No man shall be able to stand against you; the Lord your God will put the dread of you and the fear of you upon all the land where you tread, just as He has said to you.
verses.textEnNlt: No one will be able to stand against you, for the Lord your God will cause the people to fear and dread you, as he promised, wherever you go in the whole land.
verses.textEnNasb: No one will be able to stand against you; the Lord your God will instill the dread of you and the fear of you in all the land on which you set foot, just as He has spoken to you.
verses.textEn: No one will be able to stand against you. The Lord your God, as he promised you, will put the terror and fear of you on the whole land, wherever you go.

verses.textZh: "看哪，我今日把祝福和咒诅都摆在你们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，我今日把祝福和咒诅都摆在你们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，我今日将祝福与咒诅的话都陈明在你们面前。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse—
verses.textEnEsv: "See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, today I am giving you the choice between a blessing and a curse!
verses.textEnNasb: "See, I am placing before you today a blessing and a curse:
verses.textEn: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse—

verses.textZh: 如果你们听从耶和华你们的神的诫命，就是我今日吩咐你们的，你们就必蒙赐福；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们听从耶和华你们的神的诫命，就是我今日吩咐你们的，你们就必蒙赐福；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若听从耶和华－你们神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你们的，就必蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: the blessing if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today;
verses.textEnEsv: the blessing, if you obey the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you today,
verses.textEnNkjv: the blessing, if you obey the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you today;
verses.textEnNlt: You will be blessed if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the Lord your God, which I am commanding you today;
verses.textEn: the blessing if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today;

verses.textZh: 如果你们不听从耶和华你们的神的诫命，偏离了我今日吩咐你们要走的道路，去随从你们素来不认识的别神，你们就必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不听从耶和华你们的神的诫命，偏离了我今日吩咐你们要走的道路，去随从你们素来不认识的别神，你们就必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不听从耶和华－你们神的诫命，偏离我今日所吩咐你们的道，去事奉你们素来所不认识的别神，就必受祸。
verses.textEnNiv: the curse if you disobey the commands of the Lord your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.
verses.textEnEsv: and the curse, if you do not obey the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn aside from the way that I am commanding you today, to go after other gods that you have not known.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the curse, if you do not obey the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn aside from the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.
verses.textEnNlt: But you will be cursed if you reject the commands of the Lord your God and turn away from him and worship gods you have not known before.
verses.textEnNasb: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn aside from the way which I am commanding you today, by following other gods which you have not known.
verses.textEn: the curse if you disobey the commands of the Lord your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神领你进入你要占领为业之地以后，你就要把祝福摆在基利心山上，把咒诅摆在以巴路山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神领你进入你要占领为业之地以后，你就要把祝福摆在基利心山上，把咒诅摆在以巴路山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至耶和华－你的神领你进入要去得为业的那地，你就要将祝福的话陈明在基利心山上，将咒诅的话陈明在以巴路山上。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God has brought you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim on Mount Gerizim the blessings, and on Mount Ebal the curses.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Lord your God brings you into the land that you are entering to take possession of it, you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it shall be, when the Lord your God has brought you into the land which you go to possess, that you shall put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Lord your God brings you into the land and helps you take possession of it, you must pronounce the blessing at Mount Gerizim and the curse at Mount Ebal.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it shall come about, when the Lord your God brings you into the land where you are entering to possess it, that you shall place the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God has brought you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim on Mount Gerizim the blessings, and on Mount Ebal the curses.

verses.textZh: 这两座山不是在约旦河西、日落的地方，在住亚拉巴的迦南人之地，与吉甲相对，靠近摩利橡树那里吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这两座山不是在约旦河西、日落的地方，在住亚拉巴的迦南人之地，与吉甲相对，靠近摩利橡树那里吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这二山岂不是在约旦河那边，日落之处，在住亚拉巴的迦南人之地与吉甲相对，靠近摩利橡树吗？
verses.textEnNiv: As you know, these mountains are across the Jordan, westward, toward the setting sun, near the great trees of Moreh, in the territory of those Canaanites living in the Arabah in the vicinity of Gilgal.
verses.textEnEsv: Are they not beyond the Jordan, west of the road, toward the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oak of Moreh?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are they not on the other side of the Jordan, toward the setting sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the plain opposite Gilgal, beside the terebinth trees of Moreh?
verses.textEnNlt: (These two mountains are west of the Jordan River in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Jordan Valley, near the town of Gilgal, not far from the oaks of Moreh.)
verses.textEnNasb: Are they not across the Jordan, west of the road toward the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
verses.textEn: As you know, these mountains are across the Jordan, westward, toward the setting sun, near the great trees of Moreh, in the territory of those Canaanites living in the Arabah in the vicinity of Gilgal.

verses.textZh: 现在你们快要过约旦河，进去得耶和华你们的神要赐给你们为业之地；你们取得了那地，就住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们快要过约旦河，进去得耶和华你们的神要赐给你们为业之地；你们取得了那地，就住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要过约旦河，进去得耶和华－你们神所赐你们为业之地，在那地居住。
verses.textEnNiv: You are about to cross the Jordan to enter and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you. When you have taken it over and are living there,
verses.textEnEsv: For you are to cross over the Jordan to go in to take possession of the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you possess it and live in it,
verses.textEnNkjv: For you will cross over the Jordan and go in to possess the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and you will possess it and dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are about to cross the Jordan River to take over the land the Lord your God is giving you. When you take that land and are living in it,
verses.textEnNasb: For you are about to cross the Jordan to go in to take possession of the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and you shall possess it and live in it,
verses.textEn: You are about to cross the Jordan to enter and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you. When you have taken it over and are living there,

verses.textZh: 你们要谨守遵行我今日在你们的面前颁布的一切律例和典章。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨守遵行我今日在你们的面前颁布的一切律例和典章。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨守遵行我今日在你们面前所陈明的一切律例典章。」
verses.textEnNiv: be sure that you obey all the decrees and laws I am setting before you today.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall be careful to do all the statutes and the rules that I am setting before you today.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall be careful to observe all the statutes and judgments which I set before you today.
verses.textEnNlt: you must be careful to obey all the decrees and regulations I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall be careful to do all the statutes and the judgments which I am placing before you today.
verses.textEn: be sure that you obey all the decrees and laws I am setting before you today.

verses.textZh: "你们活在地上的一切日子，在耶和华你列祖的神赐给你作产业的地上，要谨守遵行的律例和典章，就是这些：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们活在地上的一切日子，在耶和华你列祖的神赐给你作产业的地上，要谨守遵行的律例和典章，就是这些：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们存活于世的日子，在耶和华－你们列祖的神所赐你们为业的地上，要谨守遵行的律例典章乃是这些：
verses.textEnNiv: These are the decrees and laws you must be careful to follow in the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you to possess—as long as you live in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: "These are the statutes and rules that you shall be careful to do in the land that the Lord , the God of your fathers, has given you to possess, all the days that you live on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These are the statutes and judgments which you shall be careful to observe in the land which the Lord God of your fathers is giving you to possess, all the days that you live on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the decrees and regulations you must be careful to obey when you live in the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you. You must obey them as long as you live.
verses.textEnNasb: "These are the statutes and the judgments which you shall carefully follow in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess as long as you live on the earth.
verses.textEn: These are the decrees and laws you must be careful to follow in the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you to possess—as long as you live in the land.

verses.textZh: 你们要把你们赶走的列国的人事奉神的地方，无论是在高山上，在山冈上，或是在各青翠树下，都要完全毁坏；
