verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把你们赶走的列国的人事奉神的地方，无论是在高山上，在山冈上，或是在各青翠树下，都要完全毁坏；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将所赶出的国民事奉神的各地方，无论是在高山，在小山，在各青翠树下，都毁坏了；
verses.textEnNiv: Destroy completely all the places on the high mountains, on the hills and under every spreading tree, where the nations you are dispossessing worship their gods.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall surely destroy all the places where the nations whom you shall dispossess served their gods, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall utterly destroy all the places where the nations which you shall dispossess served their gods, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you drive out the nations that live there, you must destroy all the places where they worship their gods—high on the mountains, up on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall utterly destroy all the places where the nations whom you are going to dispossess serve their gods, on the high mountains, on the hills, and under every leafy tree.
verses.textEn: Destroy completely all the places on the high mountains, on the hills and under every spreading tree, where the nations you are dispossessing worship their gods.

verses.textZh: 也要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的神柱；用火焚烧他们的亚舍拉，砍倒他们的神的雕像，并且把他们的名字从这地方除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的神柱；用火焚烧他们的亚舍拉，砍倒他们的神的雕像，并且把他们的名字从这地方除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，用火焚烧他们的木偶，砍下他们雕刻的神像，并将其名从那地方除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and burn their Asherah poles in the fire; cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall tear down their altars and dash in pieces their pillars and burn their Asherim with fire. You shall chop down the carved images of their gods and destroy their name out of that place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall destroy their altars, break their sacred pillars, and burn their wooden images with fire; you shall cut down the carved images of their gods and destroy their names from that place.
verses.textEnNlt: Break down their altars and smash their sacred pillars. Burn their Asherah poles and cut down their carved idols. Completely erase the names of their gods!
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall tear down their altars and smash their memorial stones to pieces, and burn their Asherim in the fire, and cut to pieces the carved images of their gods; and you shall eliminate their name from that place.
verses.textEn: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and burn their Asherah poles in the fire; cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.

verses.textZh: 你们不可像他们那样事奉耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可像他们那样事奉耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可照他们那样事奉耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not worship the Lord your God in that way.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not worship the Lord your God with such things.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not worship the Lord your God in the way these pagan peoples worship their gods.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not act this way toward the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你们的神从你们各支派中，选择了甚么地方作立他名的居所，你们就当到那里求问他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你们的神从你们各支派中，选择了甚么地方作立他名的居所，你们就当到那里求问他；
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华－你们的神从你们各支派中选择何处为立他名的居所，你们就当往那里去求问，
verses.textEnNiv: But you are to seek the place the Lord your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go;
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall seek the place that the Lord your God will choose out of all your tribes to put his name and make his habitation there. There you shall go,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you shall seek the place where the Lord your God chooses, out of all your tribes, to put His name for His dwelling place; and there you shall go.
verses.textEnNlt: Rather, you must seek the Lord your God at the place of worship he himself will choose from among all the tribes—the place where his name will be honored.
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall seek the Lord at the place which the Lord your God will choose from all your tribes, to establish His name there for His dwelling, and you shall come there.
verses.textEn: But you are to seek the place the Lord your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go;

verses.textZh: 把你们的燔祭和其他的祭物、十分之一的礼物和手中的贡献、还愿祭和甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中头生的，都要带到那里去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把你们的燔祭和其他的祭物、十分之一的礼物和手中的贡献、还愿祭和甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中头生的，都要带到那里去；
verses.textZhCuv: 将你们的燔祭、平安祭、十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并还愿祭、甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中头生的，都奉到那里。
verses.textEnNiv: there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: and there you shall bring your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution that you present, your vow offerings, your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: There you shall take your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the heave offerings of your hand, your vowed offerings, your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: There you will bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, your sacred offerings, your offerings to fulfill a vow, your voluntary offerings, and your offerings of the firstborn animals of your herds and flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall bring there your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the contribution of your hand, your vowed offerings, your voluntary offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock.
verses.textEn: there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

verses.textZh: 在那里，就是在耶和华你们的神面前，你们和你们的家人都可以吃；并且要因你们手所作的一切事，都蒙耶和华你的神赐福而欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里，就是在耶和华你们的神面前，你们和你们的家人都可以吃；并且要因你们手所作的一切事，都蒙耶和华你的神赐福而欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，耶和华－你们神的面前，你们和你们的家属都可以吃，并且因你手所办的一切事蒙耶和华－你的神赐福，就都欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: There, in the presence of the Lord your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnEsv: And there you shall eat before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your households, in all that you undertake, in which the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there you shall eat before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice in all to which you have put your hand, you and your households, in which the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnNlt: There you and your families will feast in the presence of the Lord your God, and you will rejoice in all you have accomplished because the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnNasb: There you and your households shall eat before the Lord your God, and rejoice in all your undertakings in which the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEn: There, in the presence of the Lord your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the Lord your God has blessed you.

verses.textZh: 我们今日在这里所行的，是行各人看为正的事，你们将来不可以这样行；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们今日在这里所行的，是行各人看为正的事，你们将来不可以这样行；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们今日在这里所行的是各人行自己眼中看为正的事，你们将来不可这样行；
verses.textEnNiv: You are not to do as we do here today, everyone doing as they see fit,
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not do according to all that we are doing here today, everyone doing whatever is right in his own eyes,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not at all do as we are doing here today— every man doing whatever is right in his own eyes—
verses.textEnNlt: "Your pattern of worship will change. Today all of you are doing as you please,
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not do at all what we are doing here today, everyone doing whatever is right in his own eyes;
verses.textEn: You are not to do as we do here today, everyone doing as they see fit,

verses.textZh: 因为你们现在还没有到耶和华你的神赐给你的安息地和产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们现在还没有到耶和华你的神赐给你的安息地和产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们还没有到耶和华－你神所赐你的安息地，所给你的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: for you have not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: for as yet you have not come to the rest and the inheritance which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: because you have not yet arrived at the place of rest, the land the Lord your God is giving you as your special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: for you have not as yet come to the resting place and the inheritance which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEn: since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.textZh: 但是你们过了约旦河，住在耶和华你们的神使你们承受为业的地，又使你们太平，脱离你们周围的所有仇敌，安居乐业，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是你们过了约旦河，住在耶和华你们的神使你们承受为业的地，又使你们太平，脱离你们周围的所有仇敌，安居乐业，
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们过了约旦河，得以住在耶和华－你们神使你们承受为业之地，又使你们太平，不被四围的一切仇敌扰乱，安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: But when you go over the Jordan and live in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, and when he gives you rest from all your enemies around, so that you live in safety,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when you cross over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, and He gives you rest from all your enemies round about, so that you dwell in safety,
verses.textEnNlt: But you will soon cross the Jordan River and live in the land the Lord your God is giving you. When he gives you rest from all your enemies and you’re living safely in the land,
verses.textEnNasb: When you cross the Jordan and live in the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and He gives you rest from all your enemies around you so that you live in security,
verses.textEn: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.

verses.textZh: 那时，你要把我吩咐你们的燔祭和其他的祭物、十分之一的礼物和手中的贡献，以及你们向耶和华许愿要献的最美的一切还愿祭，都要带到耶和华你们的神选择作为立他名的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你要把我吩咐你们的燔祭和其他的祭物、十分之一的礼物和手中的贡献，以及你们向耶和华许愿要献的最美的一切还愿祭，都要带到耶和华你们的神选择作为立他名的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时要将我所吩咐你们的燔祭、平安祭、十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并向耶和华许愿献的一切美祭，都奉到耶和华－你们神所选择要立为他名的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: Then to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name—there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: then to the place that the Lord your God will choose, to make his name dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution that you present, and all your finest vow offerings that you vow to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: then there will be the place where the Lord your God chooses to make His name abide. There you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the heave offerings of your hand, and all your choice offerings which you vow to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: you must bring everything I command you—your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, your sacred offerings, and your offerings to fulfill a vow—to the designated place of worship, the place the Lord your God chooses for his name to be honored.
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall come about that the place in which the Lord your God will choose for His name to dwell, there you shall bring everything that I command you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution of your hand, and all your choice vowed offerings which you will vow to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name—there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们和你们的儿女、仆婢，以及住在你们城里的利未人，都要在耶和华你们的神面前欢乐，因为利未人在你们中间无分无业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们和你们的儿女、仆婢，以及住在你们城里的利未人，都要在耶和华你们的神面前欢乐，因为利未人在你们中间无分无业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们和儿女、仆婢，并住在你们城里无分无业的利未人，都要在耶和华－你们的神面前欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: And there rejoice before the Lord your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, your male servants and your female servants, and the Levite that is within your towns, since he has no portion or inheritance with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must celebrate there in the presence of the Lord your God with your sons and daughters and all your servants. And remember to include the Levites who live in your towns, for they will receive no allotment of land among you.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and daughters, your male and female slaves, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance with you.
verses.textEn: And there rejoice before the Lord your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

verses.textZh: 你要自己谨慎，不可在你看见的任何地方献上你的燔祭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要自己谨慎，不可在你看见的任何地方献上你的燔祭；
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨慎，不可在你所看中的各处献燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care that you do not offer your burnt offerings at any place that you see,
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed to yourself that you do not offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings just anywhere you like.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be careful that you do not offer your burnt offerings in any cultic place that you see,
verses.textEn: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.

verses.textZh: 只要在耶和华从你的一个支派中拣选的地方，在那里献上你的燔祭，在那里行我吩咐你的一切事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要在耶和华从你的一个支派中拣选的地方，在那里献上你的燔祭，在那里行我吩咐你的一切事。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独耶和华从你那一支派中所选择的地方，你就要在那里献燔祭，行我一切所吩咐你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Offer them only at the place the Lord will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.
verses.textEnEsv: but at the place that the Lord will choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I am commanding you.
verses.textEnNkjv: but in the place which the Lord chooses, in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.
verses.textEnNlt: You may do so only at the place the Lord will choose within one of your tribal territories. There you must offer your burnt offerings and do everything I command you.
verses.textEnNasb: but only in the place which the Lord chooses in one of your tribes: there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do everything that I command you.
verses.textEn: Offer them only at the place the Lord will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.

verses.textZh: "不过在你的各城里，你都可以照着耶和华你的神赐给你的福分，随意杀牲吃肉。不洁净的人和洁净的人都可以吃，像吃羚羊和鹿的肉一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不过在你的各城里，你都可以照着耶和华你的神赐给你的福分，随意杀牲吃肉。不洁净的人和洁净的人都可以吃，像吃羚羊和鹿的肉一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「然而，在你各城里都可以照耶和华－你神所赐你的福分，随心所欲宰牲吃肉；无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the Lord your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: "However, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your towns, as much as you desire, according to the blessing of the Lord your God that he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and as of the deer.
verses.textEnNkjv: "However, you may slaughter and eat meat within all your gates, whatever your heart desires, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you; the unclean and the clean may eat of it, of the gazelle and the deer alike.
verses.textEnNlt: "But you may butcher your animals and eat their meat in any town whenever you want. You may freely eat the animals with which the Lord your God blesses you. All of you, whether ceremonially clean or unclean, may eat that meat, just as you now eat gazelle and deer.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your gates, whatever you desire, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it, as the gazelle and the deer.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the Lord your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.

verses.textZh: 只有血，你们不可吃；要倒在地上，像倒水一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有血，你们不可吃；要倒在地上，像倒水一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEnEsv: Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out on the earth like water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it on the earth like water.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must not consume the blood. You must pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEnNasb: Only you shall not eat the blood; you are to pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEn: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

verses.textZh: 你的五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一，你牛群羊群中头生的和你所许一切还愿的祭、你甘心献的祭和你手中的贡献，都不可在你的城里吃；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一，你牛群羊群中头生的和你所许一切还愿的祭、你甘心献的祭和你手中的贡献，都不可在你的城里吃；
verses.textZhCuv: 你的五谷、新酒，和油的十分之一，或是牛群羊群中头生的，或是你许愿献的，甘心献的，或是手中的举祭，都不可在你城里吃。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and olive oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.
verses.textEnEsv: You may not eat within your towns the tithe of your grain or of your wine or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, or any of your vow offerings that you vow, or your freewill offerings or the contribution that you present,
verses.textEnNkjv: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain or your new wine or your oil, of the firstborn of your herd or your flock, of any of your offerings which you vow, of your freewill offerings, or of the heave offering of your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "But you may not eat your offerings in your hometown—neither the tithe of your grain and new wine and olive oil, nor the firstborn of your flocks and herds, nor any offering to fulfill a vow, nor your voluntary offerings, nor your sacred offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: You are not allowed to eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, new wine, or oil, or the firstborn of your herd or flock, or any of your vowed offerings which you vow, or your voluntary offerings, or the contribution of your hand.
verses.textEn: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and olive oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

verses.textZh: 你只要在耶和华你的神面前，和在耶和华你的神选择的地方吃，你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及在你城里的利未人，都可以吃；你也要因你手所作的一切事在耶和华你的神面前欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你只要在耶和华你的神面前，和在耶和华你的神选择的地方吃，你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及在你城里的利未人，都可以吃；你也要因你手所作的一切事在耶和华你的神面前欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 但要在耶和华－你的神面前吃，在耶和华－你神所要选择的地方，你和儿女、仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，都可以吃；也要因你手所办的，在耶和华－你神面前欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place the Lord your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns—and you are to rejoice before the Lord your God in everything you put your hand to.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall eat them before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord your God will choose, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your towns. And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in all that you undertake.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you must eat them before the Lord your God in the place which the Lord your God chooses, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates; and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in all to which you put your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: You must eat these in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose. Eat them there with your children, your servants, and the Levites who live in your towns, celebrating in the presence of the Lord your God in all you do.
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall eat them before the Lord your God in the place which the Lord your God will choose, you and your son and daughter, and your male and female slaves, and the Levite who is within your gates; and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in all your undertakings.
verses.textEn: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place the Lord your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns—and you are to rejoice before the Lord your God in everything you put your hand to.

verses.textZh: 你要自己谨慎，你在你那地上的日子，永不可丢弃利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要自己谨慎，你在你那地上的日子，永不可丢弃利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨慎，在你所住的地方永不可丢弃利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care that you do not neglect the Levite as long as you live in your land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed to yourself that you do not forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.
verses.textEnNlt: And be very careful never to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.
verses.textEnNasb: Be careful that you do not abandon the Levite as long as you live in your land.
verses.textEn: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神，照着他应许你的，扩张了你的境界的时候，如果你因心里渴想吃肉，说：‘我想吃肉。’那么，你就可以随意吃肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神，照着他应许你的，扩张了你的境界的时候，如果你因心里渴想吃肉，说：‘我想吃肉。’那么，你就可以随意吃肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你的神照他所应许扩张你境界的时候，你心里想要吃肉，说：『我要吃肉』，就可以随心所欲地吃肉。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much of it as you want.
verses.textEnEsv: "When the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he has promised you, and you say, ‘I will eat meat,’ because you crave meat, you may eat meat whenever you desire.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the Lord your God enlarges your border as He has promised you, and you say, ‘Let me eat meat,’ because you long to eat meat, you may eat as much meat as your heart desires.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Lord your God expands your territory as he has promised, and you have the urge to eat meat, you may freely eat meat whenever you want.
verses.textEnNasb: "When the Lord your God extends your border as He has promised you, and you say, ‘I will eat meat,’ because you desire to eat meat, then you may eat meat, whatever you desire.
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much of it as you want.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神选择作立他名的地方，如果离开你太远，你就可以照着我吩咐你的，把耶和华赐给你的牛羊取些宰杀了，可以在你的城里随意地吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神选择作立他名的地方，如果离开你太远，你就可以照着我吩咐你的，把耶和华赐给你的牛羊取些宰杀了，可以在你的城里随意地吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神所选择要立他名的地方若离你太远，就可以照我所吩咐的，将耶和华赐给你的牛羊取些宰了，可以随心所欲在你城里吃。
verses.textEnNiv: If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want.
verses.textEnEsv: If the place that the Lord your God will choose to put his name there is too far from you, then you may kill any of your herd or your flock, which the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your towns whenever you desire.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put His name is too far from you, then you may slaughter from your herd and from your flock which the Lord has given you, just as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your gates as much as your heart desires.
verses.textEnNlt: It might happen that the designated place of worship—the place the Lord your God chooses for his name to be honored—is a long way from your home. If so, you may butcher any of the cattle, sheep, or goats the Lord has given you, and you may freely eat the meat in your hometown, as I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNasb: If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put His name is too far from you, then you may slaughter animals from your herd and flock which the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates whatever you desire.
verses.textEn: If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want.

verses.textZh: 你吃那肉，好象人吃羚羊和鹿的肉一样；不洁净的人和洁净的人都可以一起吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你吃那肉，好象人吃羚羊和鹿的肉一样；不洁净的人和洁净的人都可以一起吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 你吃那肉，要像吃羚羊与鹿一般；无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.
verses.textEnEsv: Just as the gazelle or the deer is eaten, so you may eat of it. The unclean and the clean alike may eat of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you may eat them; the unclean and the clean alike may eat them.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone, whether ceremonially clean or unclean, may eat that meat, just as you do now with gazelle and deer.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as a gazelle or a deer is eaten, so you may eat it; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it.
verses.textEn: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.

verses.textZh: 只是你要心意坚定，不可吃血，因为血就是生命；你不可把生命和肉一起吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是你要心意坚定，不可吃血，因为血就是生命；你不可把生命和肉一起吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你要心意坚定，不可吃血，因为血是生命；不可将血 与肉同吃。
verses.textEnNiv: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.
verses.textEnEsv: Only be sure that you do not eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only be sure that you do not eat the blood, for the blood is the life; you may not eat the life with the meat.
verses.textEnNlt: But never consume the blood, for the blood is the life, and you must not consume the lifeblood with the meat.
verses.textEnNasb: Only be sure not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.textEn: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

verses.textZh: 你不可吃血，要倒在地上，像倒水一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可吃血，要倒在地上，像倒水一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out on the earth like water.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it on the earth like water.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, pour out the blood on the ground like water.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEn: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

verses.textZh: 你不可吃血，好使你和你的子子孙孙得享福乐，因为你行了耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可吃血，好使你和你的子子孙孙得享福乐，因为你行了耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可吃血。这样，你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，你和你的子孙就可以得福。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not eat it, that all may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do what is right in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and your children after you, when you do whatis right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not consume the blood, so that all may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what pleases the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well for you and your sons after you, since you will be doing what is right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 只是你要把你应有的圣物和你的还愿祭，都带到耶和华选择的地方去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是你要把你应有的圣物和你的还愿祭，都带到耶和华选择的地方去，
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你分别为圣的物和你的还愿祭要奉到耶和华所选择的地方去。
verses.textEnNiv: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the Lord will choose.
verses.textEnEsv: But the holy things that are due from you, and your vow offerings, you shall take, and you shall go to the place that the Lord will choose,
verses.textEnNkjv: Only the holy things which you have, and your vowed offerings, you shall take and go to the place which the Lord chooses.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take your sacred gifts and your offerings given to fulfill a vow to the place the Lord chooses.
verses.textEnNasb: Only your holy things which you may have and your vowed offerings, you shall take and go to the place which the Lord chooses.
verses.textEn: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the Lord will choose.

verses.textZh: 把你的燔祭、肉和血，都献在耶和华你的神的祭坛上；其他的祭的血，要倒在耶和华你的神的祭坛上；至于那肉，你却可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把你的燔祭、肉和血，都献在耶和华你的神的祭坛上；其他的祭的血，要倒在耶和华你的神的祭坛上；至于那肉，你却可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的燔祭，连肉带血，都要献在耶和华－你神的坛上。平安祭的血要倒在耶和华－你神的坛上；平安祭的肉，你自己可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the Lord your God, but you may eat the meat.
verses.textEnEsv: and offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on the altar of the Lord your God. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the Lord your God, but the flesh you may eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the altar of the Lord your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the Lord your God, and you shall eat the meat.
verses.textEnNlt: You must offer the meat and blood of your burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out on the altar of the Lord your God, but you may eat the meat.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on the altar of the Lord your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the Lord your God, and you shall eat the flesh.
verses.textEn: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the Lord your God, but you may eat the meat.

verses.textZh: 你要谨慎听从我吩咐你的这一切话，好使你和你的子子孙孙永远得享福乐，因为你行了耶和华看为好为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要谨慎听从我吩咐你的这一切话，好使你和你的子子孙孙永远得享福乐，因为你行了耶和华看为好为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨守听从我所吩咐的一切话，行耶和华－你神眼中看为善，看为正的事。这样，你和你的子孙就可以永远享福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Be careful to obey all these words that I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the sight of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Observe and obey all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and your children after you forever, when you do whatis good and right in the sight of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful to obey all my commands, so that all will go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and pleasing to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be careful and listen to all these words which I am commanding you, so that it may go well for you and your sons after you forever, for you will be doing what is good and right in the sight of the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神把你将要进去赶走的列国的民，从你的面前除灭以后，你就得着他们的地，住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神把你将要进去赶走的列国的民，从你的面前除灭以后，你就得着他们的地，住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你神将你要去赶出的国民从你面前剪除，你得了他们的地居住，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God will cut off before you the nations you are about to invade and dispossess. But when you have driven them out and settled in their land,
verses.textEnEsv: "When the Lord your God cuts off before you the nations whom you go in to dispossess, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the Lord your God cuts off from before you the nations which you go to dispossess, and you displace them and dwell in their land,
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Lord your God goes ahead of you and destroys the nations and you drive them out and live in their land,
verses.textEnNasb: "When the Lord your God cuts off from you the nations which you are going in to dispossess, and you dispossess them and live in their land,
verses.textEn: The Lord your God will cut off before you the nations you are about to invade and dispossess. But when you have driven them out and settled in their land,

verses.textZh: 那时，你要自己谨慎，不可在他们从你的面前被消灭以后，随从他们的恶俗而陷入网罗，也不可求问他们的神，说：‘这些国的人怎样事奉他们的神，我也要这样行。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你要自己谨慎，不可在他们从你的面前被消灭以后，随从他们的恶俗而陷入网罗，也不可求问他们的神，说：‘这些国的人怎样事奉他们的神，我也要这样行。’
verses.textZhCuv: 那时就要谨慎，不可在他们除灭之后随从他们的恶俗，陷入网罗，也不可访问他们的神说：『这些国民怎样事奉他们的神，我也要照样行。』
verses.textEnNiv: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, "How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same."
verses.textEnEsv: take care that you be not ensnared to follow them, after they have been destroyed before you, and that you do not inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their gods?—that I also may do the same.’
verses.textEnNkjv: take heed to yourself that you are not ensnared to follow them, after they are destroyed from before you, and that you do not inquire after their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their gods? I also will do likewise.’
verses.textEnNlt: do not fall into the trap of following their customs and worshiping their gods. Do not inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How do these nations worship their gods? I want to follow their example.’
verses.textEnNasb: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them, after they are destroyed from your presence, and that you do not inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How do these nations serve their gods, that I also may do likewise?’
verses.textEn: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, "How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same."

verses.textZh: 你不可向耶和华你的神这样行，因为耶和华恨恶的一切可厌恶的事，他们都向他们的神行了，甚至把自己的儿女用火焚烧，献给他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可向耶和华你的神这样行，因为耶和华恨恶的一切可厌恶的事，他们都向他们的神行了，甚至把自己的儿女用火焚烧，献给他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可向耶和华－你的神这样行，因为他们向他们的神行了耶和华所憎嫌所恨恶的一切事，甚至将自己的儿女用火焚烧，献与他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the Lord hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not worship the Lord your God in that way, for every abominable thing that the Lord hates they have done for their gods, for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not worship the Lord your God in that way; for every abomination to the Lord which He hates they have done to their gods; for they burn even their sons and daughters in the fire to their gods.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not worship the Lord your God the way the other nations worship their gods, for they perform for their gods every detestable act that the Lord hates. They even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices to their gods.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not behave this way toward the Lord your God, because every abominable act which the Lord hates, they have done for their gods; for they even burn their sons and daughters in the fire for their gods.
verses.textEn: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the Lord hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

verses.textZh: "我吩咐你们的一切话，你们都要谨守遵行，不可加添，也不可减少。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我吩咐你们的一切话，你们都要谨守遵行，不可加添，也不可减少。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡我所吩咐的，你们都要谨守遵行，不可加添，也不可删减。
verses.textEnNiv: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Everything that I command you, you shall be careful to do. You shall not add to it or take from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whatever I command you, be careful to observe it; you shall not add to it nor take away from it.
verses.textEnNlt: "So be careful to obey all the commands I give you. You must not add anything to them or subtract anything from them.
verses.textEnNasb: " Whatever I command you, you shall be careful to do; you shall not add to nor take anything away from it.
verses.textEn: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.

verses.textZh: "你们中间如果有先知，或作梦的人兴起来，给你显示神迹或奇事；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们中间如果有先知，或作梦的人兴起来，给你显示神迹或奇事；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们中间若有先知或是做梦的起来，向你显个神迹奇事，
verses.textEnNiv: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a sign or wonder,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you and gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If there arises among you a prophet or a dreamer of dreams, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose there are prophets among you or those who dream dreams about the future, and they promise you signs or miracles,
verses.textEnNasb: " If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you and gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.textEn: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a sign or wonder,

verses.textZh: 他告诉你的神迹和奇事应验了，以致他对你说：‘我们去随从别的、你不认识的神，事奉他们吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他告诉你的神迹和奇事应验了，以致他对你说：‘我们去随从别的、你不认识的神，事奉他们吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 对你说：『我们去随从你素来所不认识的别神，事奉它吧。』他所显的神迹奇事虽有应验，
verses.textEnNiv: and if the sign or wonder spoken of takes place, and the prophet says, "Let us follow other gods" (gods you have not known) "and let us worship them,"
verses.textEnEsv: and the sign or wonder that he tells you comes to pass, and if he says, ‘Let us go after other gods,’ which you have not known, ‘and let us serve them,’
verses.textEnNkjv: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, ‘Let us go after other gods’—which you have not known—‘and let us serve them,’
verses.textEnNlt: and the predicted signs or miracles occur. If they then say, ‘Come, let us worship other gods’—gods you have not known before—
verses.textEnNasb: and the sign or the wonder comes true, of which he spoke to you, saying, ‘Let’s follow other gods (whom you have not known) and let’s serve them,’
verses.textEn: and if the sign or wonder spoken of takes place, and the prophet says, "Let us follow other gods" (gods you have not known) "and let us worship them,"

verses.textZh: 你不可听从那先知或作梦的人的话；因为耶和华你们的神试验你们，要知道你们是不是一心一意爱耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可听从那先知或作梦的人的话；因为耶和华你们的神试验你们，要知道你们是不是一心一意爱耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也不可听那先知或是那做梦之人的话；因为这是耶和华－你们的神试验你们，要知道你们是尽心尽性爱耶和华－你们的神不是。
verses.textEnNiv: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The Lord your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams. For the Lord your God is testing you, to know whether you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams, for the Lord your God is testing you to know whether you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: do not listen to them. The Lord your God is testing you to see if you truly love him with all your heart and soul.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer of dreams; for the Lord your God is testing you to find out whether you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEn: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The Lord your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.textZh: 你们要顺从耶和华你们的神，敬畏他，遵守他的诫命，听从他的话，事奉他，紧靠他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要顺从耶和华你们的神，敬畏他，遵守他的诫命，听从他的话，事奉他，紧靠他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要顺从耶和华－你们的神，敬畏他，谨守他的诫命，听从他的话，事奉他，专靠他。
verses.textEnNiv: It is the Lord your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall walk after the Lord your God and fear him and keep his commandments and obey his voice, and you shall serve him and hold fast to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall walk after the Lord your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments and obey His voice; you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Serve only the Lord your God and fear him alone. Obey his commands, listen to his voice, and cling to him.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall follow the Lord your God and fear Him; and you shall keep His commandments, listen to His voice, serve Him, and cling to Him.
verses.textEn: It is the Lord your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.

verses.textZh: 至于那先知，或作梦的人，你们要把他处死，因为他说了叛逆的话，叛逆了那领你们出埃及地，救赎你脱离为奴之家的耶和华你们的神，要你离弃耶和华你的神吩咐你走的道路。这样你就把那恶从你们中间除掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那先知，或作梦的人，你们要把他处死，因为他说了叛逆的话，叛逆了那领你们出埃及地，救赎你脱离为奴之家的耶和华你们的神，要你离弃耶和华你的神吩咐你走的道路。这样你就把那恶从你们中间除掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那先知或是那做梦的既用言语叛逆那领你们出埃及地、救赎你脱离为奴之家的耶和华－你们的神，要勾引你离开耶和华－你神所吩咐你行的道，你便要将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death for inciting rebellion against the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. That prophet or dreamer tried to turn you from the way the Lord your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnEsv: But that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has taught rebellion against the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of slavery, to make you leave the way in which the Lord your God commanded you to walk. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: But that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken in order to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of bondage, to entice you from the way in which the Lord your God commanded you to walk. So you shall put away the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNlt: The false prophets or visionaries who try to lead you astray must be put to death, for they encourage rebellion against the Lord your God, who redeemed you from slavery and brought you out of the land of Egypt. Since they try to lead you astray from the way the Lord your God commanded you to live, you must put them to death. In this way you will purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: But that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken falsely against the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery, to drive you from the way in which the Lord your God commanded you to walk. So you shall eliminate the evil from among you.
verses.textEn: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death for inciting rebellion against the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. That prophet or dreamer tried to turn you from the way the Lord your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.

verses.textZh: "你的同母兄弟或你的儿女，你怀中的妻子或视你如自己性命的朋友，如果暗中引诱你，说：‘我们去事奉别的神吧。’就是你和你的列祖向来不认识的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的同母兄弟或你的儿女，你怀中的妻子或视你如自己性命的朋友，如果暗中引诱你，说：‘我们去事奉别的神吧。’就是你和你的列祖向来不认识的，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的同胞弟兄，或是你的儿女，或是你怀中的妻，或是如同你性命的朋友，若暗中引诱你，说：『我们不如去事奉你和你列祖素来所不认识的别神－

verses.textEnEsv: "If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or the wife you embrace or your friend who is as your own soul entices you secretly, saying, ‘Let us go and serve other gods,’ which neither you nor your fathers have known,

verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose someone secretly entices you—even your brother, your son or daughter, your beloved wife, or your closest friend—and says, ‘Let us go worship other gods’—gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known.

verses.textZh: 你都不可依从他，也不可听从他；你的眼不可顾惜他，你不可怜悯他，也不可袒护他；

verses.textZhCuv: 你不可依从他，也不可听从他，眼不可顾惜他。你不可怜恤他，也不可遮庇他，
verses.textEnNiv: do not yield to them or listen to them. Show them no pity. Do not spare them or shield them.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall not yield to him or listen to him, nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare him, nor shall you conceal him.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall not consent to him or listen to him, nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare him or conceal him;
verses.textEnNlt: But do not give in or listen. Have no pity, and do not spare or protect them.

verses.textEn: do not yield to them or listen to them. Show them no pity. Do not spare them or shield them.

verses.textZh: 总要把他杀死，你要先向他动手，然后全民才动手打死他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总要把他杀死，你要先向他动手，然后全民才动手打死他。
verses.textZhCuv: 总要杀他；你先下手，然后众民也下手，将他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: You must certainly put them to death. Your hand must be the first in putting them to death, and then the hands of all the people.
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall kill him. Your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: but you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.
verses.textEnNlt: You must put them to death! Strike the first blow yourself, and then all the people must join in.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, you shall most certainly kill him; your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.
verses.textEn: You must certainly put them to death. Your hand must be the first in putting them to death, and then the hands of all the people.

verses.textZh: 你要用石头打死他，因为他要使你离弃那领你出埃及地，脱离为奴之家的耶和华你的神。

verses.textZhCuv: 要用石头打死他，因为他想要勾引你离开那领你出埃及地为奴之家的耶和华－你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Stone them to death, because they tried to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he sought to draw you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall stone him with stones until he dies, because he sought to entice you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: Stone the guilty ones to death because they have tried to draw you away from the Lord your God, who rescued you from the land of Egypt, the place of slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall stone him to death, because he has attempted to drive you away from the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEn: Stone them to death, because they tried to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

verses.textZh: 这样，全以色列听见了，必然害怕，就不会再在你们中间行这样的恶了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，全以色列听见了，必然害怕，就不会再在你们中间行这样的恶了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人都要听见害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel shall hear and fear and never again do any such wickedness as this among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all Israel shall hear and fear, and not again do such wickedness as this among you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all Israel will hear about it and be afraid, and no one will act so wickedly again.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all Israel will hear about it and be afraid, and will not do such a wicked thing among you again.
verses.textEn: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.

verses.textZh: 有些匪徒从你中间出来，把本城的居民引离，说：‘我们去事奉别的神吧。’那些神是你们素来不认识的；

verses.textZhCuv: 你必要用刀杀那城里的居民，把城里所有的，连牲畜，都用刀杀尽。
verses.textEnNiv: that troublemakers have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods you have not known),

verses.textZh: "你们是耶和华你们的神的儿女，不可为了死人割伤自己的身体，也不可使你们的额上光秃；

verses.textEnNiv: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the mountain goat, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the addax, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
verses.textEn: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.

verses.textZh: 在走兽中，分蹄成两蹄趾，又反刍的走兽，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在走兽中，分蹄成两蹄趾，又反刍的走兽，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡分蹄成为两瓣又倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.
verses.textEnEsv: Every animal that parts the hoof and has the hoof cloven in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you may eat every animal with cloven hooves, having the hoof split into two parts, andthat chews the cud, among the animals.
verses.textEnNlt: "You may eat any animal that has completely split hooves and chews the cud,
verses.textEnNasb: And any animal that has a divided hoof and has its hoofs split in two, and chews the cud, among the animals, that animal you may eat.
verses.textEn: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.

verses.textZh: 但是那些反刍或分蹄的走兽中，你们不可吃的有：骆驼、兔子和石貛，因为牠们反刍却不分蹄，就对你们不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是那些反刍或分蹄的走兽中，你们不可吃的有：骆驼、兔子和石貛，因为牠们反刍却不分蹄，就对你们不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那些倒嚼或是分蹄之中不可吃的乃是骆驼、兔子、沙番－因为是倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
verses.textEnNiv: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a divided hoof you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the hyrax. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet of those that chew the cud or have the hoof cloven you shall not eat these: the camel, the hare, and the rock badger, because they chew the cud but do not part the hoof, are unclean for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, of those that chew the cud or have cloven hooves, you shall not eat, suchas these: the camel, the hare, and the rock hyrax; for they chew the cud but do not have cloven hooves; they are unclean for you.
verses.textEnNlt: but if the animal doesn’t have both, it may not be eaten. So you may not eat the camel, the hare, or the hyrax. They chew the cud but do not have split hooves, so they are ceremonially unclean for you.
verses.textEnNasb: However, you are not to eat these among the ones that chew the cud, or among those that have the hoof divided in two: the camel, the rabbit, and the rock hyrax, for though they chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof; they are unclean to you.
verses.textEn: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a divided hoof you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the hyrax. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.

verses.textZh: 至于猪，因为牠分蹄却不反刍，就对你们不洁净。牠们的肉，你们不可吃；牠们的尸体，你们不可触摸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于猪，因为牠分蹄却不反刍，就对你们不洁净。牠们的肉，你们不可吃；牠们的尸体，你们不可触摸。
verses.textZhCuv: 猪－因为是分蹄却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。这些兽的肉，你们不可吃，死的也不可摸。
verses.textEnNiv: The pig is also unclean; although it has a divided hoof, it does not chew the cud. You are not to eat their meat or touch their carcasses.
verses.textEnEsv: And the pig, because it parts the hoof but does not chew the cud, is unclean for you. Their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the swine is unclean for you, because it has cloven hooves, yet does not chew the cud; you shall not eat their flesh or touch their dead carcasses.
verses.textEnNlt: And you may not eat the pig. It has split hooves but does not chew the cud, so it is ceremonially unclean for you. You may not eat the meat of these animals or even touch their carcasses.
verses.textEnNasb: And the pig, because it has a divided hoof but does not chew the cud, it is unclean for you. You shall not eat any of their flesh, nor touch their carcasses.
verses.textEn: The pig is also unclean; although it has a divided hoof, it does not chew the cud. You are not to eat their meat or touch their carcasses.

verses.textZh: "在水中，你们可以吃的，有以下这些：有鳍有鳞的，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在水中，你们可以吃的，有以下这些：有鳍有鳞的，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「水中可吃的乃是这些：凡有翅有鳞的都可以吃；
verses.textEnNiv: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.
verses.textEnEsv: "Of all that are in the waters you may eat these: whatever has fins and scales you may eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat all that have fins and scales.
verses.textEnNlt: "Of all the marine animals, you may eat whatever has both fins and scales.
verses.textEnNasb: "These you may eat of everything that is in the water: anything that has fins and scales you may eat,
verses.textEn: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.

verses.textZh: 没有鳍没有鳞的，你们都不可吃；这是对你们不洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有鳍没有鳞的，你们都不可吃；这是对你们不洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡无翅无鳞的都不可吃，是与你们不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat; it is unclean for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat; it is unclean for you.
verses.textEnNlt: You may not, however, eat marine animals that do not have both fins and scales. They are ceremonially unclean for you.
verses.textEnNasb: but anything that does not have fins and scales, you shall not eat; it is unclean for you.
verses.textEn: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.

verses.textZh: "洁净的鸟类，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "洁净的鸟类，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: You may eat any clean bird.
verses.textEnEsv: "You may eat all clean birds.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All clean birds you may eat.
verses.textEnNlt: "You may eat any bird that is ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: "You may eat any clean bird.
verses.textEn: You may eat any clean bird.

verses.textZh: 你们不可吃的鸟类有以下这些：鹰、狗头鹰、红头鹰、
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可吃的鸟类有以下这些：鹰、狗头鹰、红头鹰、
verses.textZhCuv: 不可吃的乃是雕、狗头雕、红头雕、
verses.textEnNiv: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
verses.textEnEsv: But these are the ones that you shall not eat: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
verses.textEnNkjv: But these you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the buzzard,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the birds you may not eat: the griffon vulture, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
verses.textEnNasb: But these are the ones that you shall not eat: the eagle and the vulture and the buzzard,
verses.textEn: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

verses.textZh: 鸢、隼、黑隼，以及这一类的鸟；
verses.textZhCnvs: 鸢、隼、黑隼，以及这一类的鸟；
verses.textZhCuv: 鹯、小鹰、鹞鹰与其类，
verses.textEnNiv: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,
verses.textEnEsv: the kite, the falcon of any kind;
verses.textEnNkjv: the red kite, the falcon, and the kite after their kinds;
verses.textEnNlt: the kite, the falcon, buzzards of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: and the red kite, the falcon, and the kite in their kinds,
verses.textEn: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,

verses.textZh: 乌鸦和这一类的鸟；
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌鸦和这一类的鸟；
verses.textZhCuv: 乌鸦与其类，
verses.textEnNiv: any kind of raven,
verses.textEnEsv: every raven of any kind;
verses.textEnNkjv: every raven after its kind;
verses.textEnNlt: ravens of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: and every raven in its kind,
verses.textEn: any kind of raven,

verses.textZh: 驼鸟、夜鹰、海鹰、雀鹰，以及这一类的鸟；
verses.textZhCnvs: 驼鸟、夜鹰、海鹰、雀鹰，以及这一类的鸟；
verses.textZhCuv: 鸵鸟、夜鹰、鱼鹰、鹰与其类，
verses.textEnNiv: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
verses.textEnEsv: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the sea gull, the hawk of any kind;
verses.textEnNkjv: the ostrich, the short-eared owl, the sea gull, and the hawk after their kinds;
verses.textEnNlt: the eagle owl, the short-eared owl, the seagull, hawks of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: and the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, and the hawk in their kinds,
verses.textEn: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

verses.textZh: 小猫头鹰、猫头鹰、角鸱、
verses.textZhCnvs: 小猫头鹰、猫头鹰、角鸱、
verses.textZhCuv: 鸮鸟、猫头鹰、角鸱、
verses.textEnNiv: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,
verses.textEnEsv: the little owl and the short-eared owl, the barn owl
verses.textEnNkjv: the little owl, the screech owl, the white owl,
verses.textEnNlt: the little owl, the great owl, the barn owl,
verses.textEnNasb: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,
verses.textEn: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,

verses.textZh: 小枭、秃鵰、鱼鹰、
verses.textZhCnvs: 小枭、秃鵰、鱼鹰、
verses.textZhCuv: 鹈鹕、秃雕、鸬鹚、
verses.textEnNiv: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,
verses.textEnEsv: and the tawny owl, the carrion vulture and the cormorant,
verses.textEnNkjv: the jackdaw, the carrion vulture, the fisher owl,
verses.textEnNlt: the desert owl, the Egyptian vulture, the cormorant,
verses.textEnNasb: the pelican, the carrion vulture, the cormorant,
verses.textEn: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,

verses.textZh: 鹳、鹭，以及这一类的鸟；戴胜和蝙蝠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鹳、鹭，以及这一类的鸟；戴胜和蝙蝠。
verses.textZhCuv: 鹳、鹭鸶与其类，戴𬸊与蝙蝠。
verses.textEnNiv: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.
verses.textEnEsv: the stork, the heron of any kind; the hoopoe and the bat.
verses.textEnNkjv: the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe and the bat.
verses.textEnNlt: the stork, herons of all kinds, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.textEnNasb: the stork, and the heron in their kinds, and the hoopoe and the bat.
verses.textEn: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

verses.textZh: 有翅膀的昆虫，对你们都不洁净，你们都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有翅膀的昆虫，对你们都不洁净，你们都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有翅膀爬行的物是与你们不洁净，都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: All flying insects are unclean to you; do not eat them.
verses.textEnEsv: And all winged insects are unclean for you; they shall not be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also every creeping thing that flies is unclean for you; they shall not be eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: "All winged insects that walk along the ground are ceremonially unclean for you and may not be eaten.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the swarming insects with wings are unclean to you; they shall not be eaten.
verses.textEn: All flying insects are unclean to you; do not eat them.

verses.textZh: 洁净的鸟类，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洁净的鸟类，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.
verses.textEnEsv: All clean winged things you may eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You may eat all clean birds.
verses.textEnNlt: But you may eat any winged bird or insect that is ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: You may eat any clean bird.
verses.textEn: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.

verses.textZh: "自死的动物，你们都不可吃；可以送给你城里的寄居者吃，或是卖给外族人吃，因为你是归耶和华为圣的子民；不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: "自死的动物，你们都不可吃；可以送给你城里的寄居者吃，或是卖给外族人吃，因为你是归耶和华为圣的子民；不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡自死的，你们都不可吃，可以给你城里寄居的吃，或卖与外人吃，因为你是归耶和华－你神为圣洁的民。 「不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to the foreigner residing in any of your towns, and they may eat it, or you may sell it to any other foreigner. But you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not eat anything that has died naturally. You may give it to the sojourner who is within your towns, that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not eat anything that dies ofitself; you may give it to the alien who is within your gates, that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the Lord your God. " You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not eat anything that has died a natural death. You may give it to a foreigner living in your town, or you may sell it to a stranger. But do not eat it yourselves, for you are set apart as holy to the Lord your God. "You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not eat anything which dies of itself. You may give it to the stranger who is in your town, so that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a stranger; for you are a holy people to the Lord your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEn: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to the foreigner residing in any of your towns, and they may eat it, or you may sell it to any other foreigner. But you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.

verses.textZh: "你要把你撒种所产的，就是田地每年所出的，献上十分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把你撒种所产的，就是田地每年所出的，献上十分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要把你撒种所产的，就是你田地每年所出的，十分取一分；
verses.textEnNiv: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall tithe all the yield of your seed that comes from the field year by year.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall truly tithe all the increase of your grain that the field produces year by year.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must set aside a tithe of your crops—one-tenth of all the crops you harvest each year.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall certainly tithe all the produce from what you sow, which comes from the field every year.
verses.textEn: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.

verses.textZh: 又要把你的五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一，以及你牛群羊群中头生的，在耶和华你的神面前吃，就是在他选择作他名的居所的地方吃，好使你可以学习常常敬畏耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要把你的五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一，以及你牛群羊群中头生的，在耶和华你的神面前吃，就是在他选择作他名的居所的地方吃，好使你可以学习常常敬畏耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把你的五谷、新酒、和油的十分之一，并牛群羊群中头生的，吃在耶和华－你神面前，就是他所选择要立为他名的居所。这样，你可以学习时常敬畏耶和华－你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always.
verses.textEnEsv: And before the Lord your God, in the place that he will choose, to make his name dwell there, you shall eat the tithe of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and flock, that you may learn to fear the Lord your God always.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall eat before the Lord your God, in the place where He chooses to make His name abide, the tithe of your grain and your new wine and your oil, of the firstborn of your herds and your flocks, that you may learn to fear the Lord your God always.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring this tithe to the designated place of worship—the place the Lord your God chooses for his name to be honored—and eat it there in his presence. This applies to your tithes of grain, new wine, olive oil, and the firstborn males of your flocks and herds. Doing this will teach you always to fear the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall eat in the presence of the Lord your God, at the place where He chooses to establish His name, the tithe of your grain, your new wine, your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and your flock, so that you may learn to fear the Lord your God always.
verses.textEn: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神赐福与你的时候，耶和华你的神选择要立为他名的地方，如果离你太远，那路又太长，使你不能把供物带到那里去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神赐福与你的时候，耶和华你的神选择要立为他名的地方，如果离你太远，那路又太长，使你不能把供物带到那里去；
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华－你神赐福与你的时候，耶和华－你神所选择要立为他名的地方若离你太远，那路也太长，使你不能把这物带到那里去，
verses.textEnNiv: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the Lord your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the Lord will choose to put his Name is so far away),
verses.textEnEsv: And if the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry the tithe, when the Lord your God blesses you, because the place is too far from you, which the Lord your God chooses, to set his name there,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the journey is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry thetithe, or if the place where the Lord your God chooses to put His name is too far from you, when the Lord your God has blessed you,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now when the Lord your God blesses you with a good harvest, the place of worship he chooses for his name to be honored might be too far for you to bring the tithe.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the distance is so great for you that you are not able to bring the tithe, since the place where the Lord your God chooses to set His name is too far away from you when the Lord your God blesses you,
verses.textEn: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the Lord your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the Lord will choose to put his Name is so far away),

verses.textZh: 你就可以换成银子，把银子拿在手里，到耶和华你的神选择的地方去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就可以换成银子，把银子拿在手里，到耶和华你的神选择的地方去，
verses.textZhCuv: 你就可以换成银子，将银子包起来，拿在手中，往耶和华－你神所要选择的地方去。
verses.textEnNiv: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the Lord your God will choose.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall turn it into money and bind up the money in your hand and go to the place that the Lord your God chooses
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall exchange it for money, take the money in your hand, and go to the place which the Lord your God chooses.
verses.textEnNlt: If so, you may sell the tithe portion of your crops and herds, put the money in a pouch, and go to the place the Lord your God has chosen.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall exchange it for money, and bind the money in your hand and go to the place which the Lord your God chooses.
verses.textEn: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the Lord your God will choose.

verses.textZh: 你可以用这银子随意买牛羊、清酒和烈酒；你心想要的，都可以买；在那里，你和你的家人，都要在耶和华你的神面前吃喝欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以用这银子随意买牛羊、清酒和烈酒；你心想要的，都可以买；在那里，你和你的家人，都要在耶和华你的神面前吃喝欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你用这银子，随心所欲，或买牛羊，或买清酒浓酒，凡你心所想的都可以买；你和你的家属在耶和华－你神的面前吃喝快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the Lord your God and rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: and spend the money for whatever you desire—oxen or sheep or wine or strong drink, whatever your appetite craves. And you shall eat there before the Lord your God and rejoice, you and your household.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall spend that money for whatever your heart desires: for oxen or sheep, for wine or similar drink, for whatever your heart desires; you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.
verses.textEnNlt: When you arrive, you may use the money to buy any kind of food you want—cattle, sheep, goats, wine, or other alcoholic drink. Then feast there in the presence of the Lord your God and celebrate with your household.
verses.textEnNasb: And you may spend the money on whatever your heart desires: on oxen, sheep, wine, other strong drink, or whatever your heart desires; and there you shall eat in the presence of the Lord your God and rejoice, you and your household.
verses.textEn: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the Lord your God and rejoice.

verses.textZh: 住在你城里的利未人，你不可丢弃他，因为他在你们中间无分无业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在你城里的利未人，你不可丢弃他，因为他在你们中间无分无业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「住在你城里的利未人，你不可丢弃他，因为他在你们中间无分无业。
verses.textEnNiv: And do not neglect the Levites living in your towns, for they have no allotment or inheritance of their own.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not neglect the Levite who is within your towns, for he has no portion or inheritance with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.textEnNlt: And do not neglect the Levites in your town, for they will receive no allotment of land among you.
verses.textEnNasb: Also you shall not neglect the Levite who is in your town, for he has no portion or inheritance among you.
verses.textEn: And do not neglect the Levites living in your towns, for they have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

verses.textZh: "每三年之末，你要把那一年的全部出产的十分之一取出来，积存在你的城里；
verses.textZhCnvs: "每三年之末，你要把那一年的全部出产的十分之一取出来，积存在你的城里；
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢三年的末一年，你要将本年的土产十分之一都取出来，积存在你的城中。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year’s produce and store it in your towns,
verses.textEnEsv: "At the end of every three years you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce in the same year and lay it up within your towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At the end of every third year you shall bring out the tithe of your produce of that year and store it up within your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: "At the end of every third year, bring the entire tithe of that year’s harvest and store it in the nearest town.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the end of every third year you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce in that year, and you shall deposit it in your town.
verses.textEn: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year’s produce and store it in your towns,

verses.textZh: 这样，利未人 ，以及在你城里的寄居者和孤儿寡妇，就可以来，吃得饱足；好叫耶和华你的神在你手所作的一切事上，赐福给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，利未人 ，以及在你城里的寄居者和孤儿寡妇，就可以来，吃得饱足；好叫耶和华你的神在你手所作的一切事上，赐福给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在你城里无分无业的利未人，和你城里寄居的，并孤儿寡妇，都可以来，吃得饱足。这样，耶和华－你的神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。」
verses.textEnNiv: so that the Levites (who have no allotment or inheritance of their own) and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns may come and eat and be satisfied, and so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levite, because he has no portion or inheritance with you, and the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, who are within your towns, shall come and eat and be filled, that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands that you do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, and the stranger and the fatherless and the widow who are within your gates, may come and eat and be satisfied, that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
verses.textEnNlt: Give it to the Levites, who will receive no allotment of land among you, as well as to the foreigners living among you, the orphans, and the widows in your towns, so they can eat and be satisfied. Then the Lord your God will bless you in all your work.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Levite, because he has no portion or inheritance among you, and the stranger, the orphan, and the widow who are in your town, shall come and eat and be satisfied, in order that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
verses.textEn: so that the Levites (who have no allotment or inheritance of their own) and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns may come and eat and be satisfied, and so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

verses.textZh: "每七年的最后一年，你要施行豁免。
verses.textZhCnvs: "每七年的最后一年，你要施行豁免。
verses.textZhCuv: 「每逢七年末一年，你要施行豁免。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts.
verses.textEnEsv: "At the end of every seven years you shall grant a release.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At the end of every seven years you shall grant a release ofdebts.
verses.textEnNlt: "At the end of every seventh year you must cancel the debts of everyone who owes you money.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the end of every seven years you shall grant a release of debts.
verses.textEn: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts.

verses.textZh: 豁免的方式是这样：债主都要把借给邻舍的一切豁免了，不可向邻舍和兄弟追讨，因为耶和华的豁免年已经宣告了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 豁免的方式是这样：债主都要把借给邻舍的一切豁免了，不可向邻舍和兄弟追讨，因为耶和华的豁免年已经宣告了。
verses.textZhCuv: 豁免的定例乃是这样：凡债主要把所借给邻舍的豁免了；不可向邻舍和弟兄追讨，因为耶和华的豁免年已经宣告了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel any loan they have made to a fellow Israelite. They shall not require payment from anyone among their own people, because the Lord ’s time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the manner of the release: every creditor shall release what he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not exact it of his neighbor, his brother, because the Lord ’s release has been proclaimed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the form of the release: Every creditor who has lent anything to his neighbor shall release it; he shall not require it of his neighbor or his brother, because it is called the Lord’s release.
verses.textEnNlt: This is how it must be done. Everyone must cancel the loans they have made to their fellow Israelites. They must not demand payment from their neighbors or relatives, for the Lord ’s time of release has arrived.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is the regulation for the release of debts: every creditor is to forgive what he has loaned to his neighbor; he shall not require it of his neighbor and his brother, because the Lord’s release has been proclaimed.
verses.textEn: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel any loan they have made to a fellow Israelite. They shall not require payment from anyone among their own people, because the Lord ’s time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.

verses.textZh: 如果借给外族人，你可以向他追讨，但借给你的兄弟，无论你借的是甚么，你都要豁免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果借给外族人，你可以向他追讨，但借给你的兄弟，无论你借的是甚么，你都要豁免。
verses.textZhCuv: 若借给外邦人，你可以向他追讨；但借给你弟兄，无论是什么，你要松手豁免了。
verses.textEnNiv: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your fellow Israelite owes you.
verses.textEnEsv: Of a foreigner you may exact it, but whatever of yours is with your brother your hand shall release.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of a foreigner you may require it; but you shall give up your claim to what is owed by your brother,
verses.textEnNlt: This release from debt, however, applies only to your fellow Israelites—not to the foreigners living among you.
verses.textEnNasb: From a foreigner you may require it, but your hand shall forgive whatever of yours is with your brother.
verses.textEn: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your fellow Israelite owes you.

verses.textZh: 在你中间必没有穷人，因为在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地上，耶和华必大大赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你中间必没有穷人，因为在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地上，耶和华必大大赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你的神必照他所应许你的赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不致向他们借贷；你必管辖许多国民，他们却不能管辖你。
verses.textEnNiv: However, there need be no poor people among you, for in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,
verses.textEnEsv: But there will be no poor among you; for the Lord will bless you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance to possess—
verses.textEnNkjv: except when there may be no poor among you; for the Lord will greatly bless you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance—
verses.textEnNlt: "There should be no poor among you, for the Lord your God will greatly bless you in the land he is giving you as a special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: However, there will be no poor among you, since the Lord will certainly bless you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess,
verses.textEn: However, there need be no poor people among you, for in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,

verses.textZh: 只要你留心听从耶和华你的神的话，谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的一切诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要你留心听从耶和华你的神的话，谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的一切诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在耶和华－你神所赐你的地上，无论哪一座城里，你弟兄中若有一个穷人，你不可忍着心、揝着手不帮补你穷乏的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: if only you fully obey the Lord your God and are careful to follow all these commands I am giving you today.
verses.textEnEsv: if only you will strictly obey the voice of the Lord your God, being careful to do all this commandment that I command you today.
verses.textEnNkjv: only if you carefully obey the voice of the Lord your God, to observe with care all these commandments which I command you today.
verses.textEnNlt: You will receive this blessing if you are careful to obey all the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: if only you listen obediently to the voice of the Lord your God, to follow carefully all this commandment which I am commanding you today.
verses.textEn: if only you fully obey the Lord your God and are careful to follow all these commands I am giving you today.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神，必照着他应许你的，赐福给你；你必借贷给许多国的民，却不会向他们借贷；你必统治许多国的民，他们却不会统治你。
