verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神，必照着他应许你的，赐福给你；你必借贷给许多国的民，却不会向他们借贷；你必统治许多国的民，他们却不会统治你。
verses.textZhCuv: 总要向他松开手，照他所缺乏的借给他，补他的不足。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God will bless you, as he promised you, and you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow, and you shall rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord your God will bless you just as He promised you; you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow; you shall reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God will bless you as he has promised. You will lend money to many nations but will never need to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they will not rule over you.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God will have blessed you just as He has promised you, and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow; and you will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.

verses.textZh: "但是在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，无论哪一座城里，在你中间如果有一个穷人，又是你的兄弟，你对这穷苦的兄弟不可硬着心肠，也不可袖手不理。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但是在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，无论哪一座城里，在你中间如果有一个穷人，又是你的兄弟，你对这穷苦的兄弟不可硬着心肠，也不可袖手不理。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨慎，不可心里起恶念，说：『第七年的豁免年快到了』，你便恶眼看你穷乏的弟兄，什么都不给他，以致他因你求告耶和华，罪便归于你了。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone is poor among your fellow Israelites in any of the towns of the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not be hardhearted or tightfisted toward them.
verses.textEnEsv: "If among you, one of your brothers should become poor, in any of your towns within your land that the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart or shut your hand against your poor brother,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If there is among you a poor man of your brethren, within any of the gates in your land which the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart nor shut your hand from your poor brother,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if there are any poor Israelites in your towns when you arrive in the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not be hard-hearted or tightfisted toward them.
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is a poor person among you, one of your brothers, in any of your towns in your land which the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart, nor close your hand from your poor brother;
verses.textEn: If anyone is poor among your fellow Israelites in any of the towns of the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not be hardhearted or tightfisted toward them.

verses.textZh: 你一定要向他伸手，照着他缺乏的借给他，补足他的缺乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一定要向他伸手，照着他缺乏的借给他，补足他的缺乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 你总要给他，给他的时候心里不可愁烦；因耶和华－你的神必在你这一切所行的，并你手里所办的事上，赐福与你。
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, be openhanded and freely lend them whatever they need.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall open your hand to him and lend him sufficient for his need, whatever it may be.
verses.textEnNkjv: but you shall open your hand wide to him and willingly lend him sufficient for his need, whatever he needs.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, be generous and lend them whatever they need.
verses.textEnNasb: but you shall fully open your hand to him, and generously lend him enough for his need in whatever he lacks.
verses.textEn: Rather, be openhanded and freely lend them whatever they need.

verses.textZh: 你要自己谨慎，不可心里起恶念，说：‘第七年的豁免年近了’，你就冷眼对待你穷苦的兄弟，甚么都不给他，以致他因你求告耶和华，你就有罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要自己谨慎，不可心里起恶念，说：‘第七年的豁免年近了’，你就冷眼对待你穷苦的兄弟，甚么都不给他，以致他因你求告耶和华，你就有罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来那地上的穷人永不断绝；所以我吩咐你说：『总要向你地上困苦穷乏的弟兄松开手。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: "The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near," so that you do not show ill will toward the needy among your fellow Israelites and give them nothing. They may then appeal to the Lord against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care lest there be an unworthy thought in your heart and you say, ‘The seventh year, the year of release is near,’ and your eye look grudgingly on your poor brother, and you give him nothing, and he cry to the Lord against you, and you be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware lest there be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, ‘The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,’ and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing, and he cry out to the Lord against you, and it become sin among you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be mean-spirited and refuse someone a loan because the year for canceling debts is close at hand. If you refuse to make the loan and the needy person cries out to the Lord , you will be considered guilty of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Be careful that there is no mean-spirited thought in your heart, such as, ‘The seventh year, the year of release of debts, is near,’ and your eye is malicious toward your poor brother, and you give him nothing; then he may cry out to the Lord against you, and it will be a sin in you.
verses.textEn: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: "The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near," so that you do not show ill will toward the needy among your fellow Israelites and give them nothing. They may then appeal to the Lord against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.

verses.textZh: 你必须给他，给他的时候，你不要心里难受，因为为了这事，耶和华你的神必在你一切工作上，和你所办的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必须给他，给他的时候，你不要心里难受，因为为了这事，耶和华你的神必在你一切工作上，和你所办的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你弟兄中，若有一个希伯来男人或希伯来女人被卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年就要任他自由出去。
verses.textEnNiv: Give generously to them and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall give to him freely, and your heart shall not be grudging when you give to him, because for this the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you undertake.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall surely give to him, and your heart should not be grieved when you give to him, because for this thing the Lord your God will bless you in all your works and in all to which you put your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Give generously to the poor, not grudgingly, for the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall generously give to him, and your heart shall not be grudging when you give to him, because for this thing the Lord your God will bless you in all your work, and in all your undertakings.
verses.textEn: Give generously to them and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.

verses.textZh: 既然在地上必有穷人存在，所以我吩咐你说：‘你总要向你地上的困苦和贫穷的兄弟大伸援助之手。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然在地上必有穷人存在，所以我吩咐你说：‘你总要向你地上的困苦和贫穷的兄弟大伸援助之手。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你任他自由的时候，不可使他空手而去，
verses.textEnNiv: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your fellow Israelites who are poor and needy in your land.
verses.textEnEsv: For there will never cease to be poor in the land. Therefore I command you, ‘You shall open wide your hand to your brother, to the needy and to the poor, in your land.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For the poor will never cease from the land; therefore I command you, saying, ‘You shall open your hand wide to your brother, to your poor and your needy, in your land.’
verses.textEnNlt: There will always be some in the land who are poor. That is why I am commanding you to share freely with the poor and with other Israelites in need.
verses.textEnNasb: For the poor will not cease to exist in the land; therefore I am commanding you, saying, ‘You shall fully open your hand to your brother, to your needy and poor in your land.’
verses.textEn: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your fellow Israelites who are poor and needy in your land.

verses.textZh: "你的兄弟，无论是希伯来男人，或是希伯来女人，如果卖身给你，要服事你六年；到第七年，就要让他离开你得自由。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的兄弟，无论是希伯来男人，或是希伯来女人，如果卖身给你，要服事你六年；到第七年，就要让他离开你得自由。
verses.textZhCuv: 要从你羊群、禾场、酒榨之中多多地给他；耶和华－你的神怎样赐福与你，你也要照样给他。
verses.textEnNiv: If any of your people—Hebrew men or women—sell themselves to you and serve you six years, in the seventh year you must let them go free.
verses.textEnEsv: "If your brother, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you, he shall serve you six years, and in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a fellow Hebrew sells himself or herself to be your servant and serves you for six years, in the seventh year you must set that servant free.
verses.textEnNasb: "If your fellow countryman, a Hebrew man or woman, is sold to you, then he shall serve you for six years, but in the seventh year you shall set him free.
verses.textEn: If any of your people—Hebrew men or women—sell themselves to you and serve you six years, in the seventh year you must let them go free.

verses.textZh: 你使他自由离开的时候，不可让他空手而去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他自由离开的时候，不可让他空手而去；
verses.textZhCuv: 要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华－你的神将你救赎；因此，我今日吩咐你这件事。
verses.textEnNiv: And when you release them, do not send them away empty-handed.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you send him away free from you, you shall not let him go away empty-handed;
verses.textEnNlt: "When you release a male servant, do not send him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNasb: And when you set him free, you shall not send him away empty-handed.
verses.textEn: And when you release them, do not send them away empty-handed.

verses.textZh: 要从你的羊群、禾场、榨酒池中，多多地供给他；耶和华你的神怎样赐福给你，你也要怎样分给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要从你的羊群、禾场、榨酒池中，多多地供给他；耶和华你的神怎样赐福给你，你也要怎样分给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若对你说：『我不愿意离开你』，是因他爱你和你的家，且因在你那里很好，
verses.textEnNiv: Supply them liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to them as the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your winepress. As the Lord your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall supply him liberally from your flock, from your threshing floor, and from your winepress. Fromwhat the Lord your God has blessed you with, you shall give to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Give him a generous farewell gift from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. Share with him some of the bounty with which the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall give generously to him from your flock, your threshing floor, and from your wine vat; you shall give to him as the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEn: Supply them liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to them as the Lord your God has blessed you.

verses.textZh: 你要记得你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华你的神救赎了你；因此我今日吩咐你这件事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记得你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华你的神救赎了你；因此我今日吩咐你这件事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就要拿锥子将他的耳朵在门上刺透，他便永为你的奴仆了。你待婢女也要这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you; therefore I command you this today.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you; therefore I command you this thing today.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that you were once slaves in the land of Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you! That is why I am giving you this command.
verses.textEnNasb: And you are to remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you; therefore I am commanding this of you today.
verses.textEn: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.

verses.textZh: 如果他对你说：‘我不愿离开你。’他说这话是因为他爱你和你的家，又因为他喜欢和你相处，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他对你说：‘我不愿离开你。’他说这话是因为他爱你和你的家，又因为他喜欢和你相处，
verses.textZhCuv: 你任他自由的时候，不可以为难事，因他服事你六年，较比雇工的工价多加一倍了。耶和华－你的神就必在你所做的一切事上赐福与你。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if your servant says to you, "I do not want to leave you," because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,
verses.textEnEsv: But if he says to you, ‘I will not go out from you,’ because he loves you and your household, since he is well-off with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if it happens that he says to you, ‘I will not go away from you,’ because he loves you and your house, since he prospers with you,
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose your servant says, ‘I will not leave you,’ because he loves you and your family, and he has done well with you.
verses.textEnNasb: But it shall come about, if he says to you, ‘I will not leave you,’ because he loves you and your household, since he is doing well with you,
verses.textEn: But if your servant says to you, "I do not want to leave you," because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,

verses.textZh: 那么，你就要拿锥子，把他的耳朵在门上刺透，他就永远作你的奴仆；对待你的婢女，你也要这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，你就要拿锥子，把他的耳朵在门上刺透，他就永远作你的奴仆；对待你的婢女，你也要这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你牛群羊群中头生的，凡是公的，都要分别为圣，归耶和华－你的神。牛群中头生的，不可用它耕地；羊群中头生的，不可剪毛。
verses.textEnNiv: then take an awl and push it through his earlobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your female servant.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall take an awl, and put it through his ear into the door, and he shall be your slave forever. And to your female slave you shall do the same.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall take an awl and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.
verses.textEnNlt: In that case, take an awl and push it through his earlobe into the door. After that, he will be your servant for life. And do the same for your female servants.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall take an awl and pierce it through his ear into the door, and he shall be your servant permanently. You shall also do the same to your female slave.
verses.textEn: then take an awl and push it through his earlobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your female servant.

verses.textZh: 你使他自由离开你的时候，不要为难，因为他服事了你六年，应得雇工双倍的工资；这样，耶和华你的神必在你所作的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他自由离开你的时候，不要为难，因为他服事了你六年，应得雇工双倍的工资；这样，耶和华你的神必在你所作的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 这头生的，你和你的家属，每年要在耶和华所选择的地方，在耶和华－你神面前吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because their service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for at half the cost of a hired worker he has served you six years. So the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall not seem hard to you when you send him away free from you; for he has been worth a double hired servant in serving you six years. Then the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not consider it a hardship when you release your servants. Remember that for six years they have given you services worth double the wages of hired workers, and the Lord your God will bless you in all you do.
verses.textEnNasb: "It shall not seem difficult for you when you set him free, because he has given you six years with double the service of a hired worker; so the Lord your God will bless you in whatever you do.
verses.textEn: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because their service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.

verses.textZh: "你的牛群羊群中所生，是头生雄性的，你都要把牠分别为圣归给耶和华你的神。你的牛群中头生的，你不可用牠去耕田；你的羊群中头生的，你不可给牠剪毛。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的牛群羊群中所生，是头生雄性的，你都要把牠分别为圣归给耶和华你的神。你的牛群中头生的，你不可用牠去耕田；你的羊群中头生的，你不可给牠剪毛。
verses.textZhCuv: 这头生的若有什么残疾，就如瘸腿的、瞎眼的，无论有什么恶残疾，都不可献给耶和华－你的神；
verses.textEnNiv: Set apart for the Lord your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your cows to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: "All the firstborn males that are born of your herd and flock you shall dedicate to the Lord your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the firstborn males that come from your herd and your flock you shall sanctify to the Lord your God; you shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must set aside for the Lord your God all the firstborn males from your flocks and herds. Do not use the firstborn of your herds to work your fields, and do not shear the firstborn of your flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall consecrate to the Lord your God all the firstborn males that are born in your herd and in your flock; you shall not work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
verses.textEn: Set apart for the Lord your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your cows to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.

verses.textZh: 你和你的家人，年年要在耶和华选择的地方，在耶和华你的神面前，吃这头生的牲畜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的家人，年年要在耶和华选择的地方，在耶和华你的神面前，吃这头生的牲畜。
verses.textZhCuv: 可以在你城里吃；洁净人与不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat it, you and your household, before the Lord your God year by year at the place that the Lord will choose.
verses.textEnNkjv: You and your household shall eat it before the Lord your God year by year in the place which the Lord chooses.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you and your family must eat these animals in the presence of the Lord your God each year at the place he chooses.
verses.textEnNasb: You and your household shall eat it every year before the Lord your God in the place which the Lord chooses.
verses.textEn: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose.

verses.textZh: 这头生的，如果有甚么残疾，像瘸腿或是瞎眼，无论有任何严重的残疾，你都不可献给耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这头生的，如果有甚么残疾，像瘸腿或是瞎眼，无论有任何严重的残疾，你都不可献给耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是不可吃它的血；要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: But if it has any blemish, if it is lame or blind or has any serious blemish whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if there is a defect in it, ifitis lame or blind orhas any serious defect, you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: But if this firstborn animal has any defect, such as lameness or blindness, or if anything else is wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: But if it has any impairment, such as a limp, or blindness, or any serious impairment, you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你可以在家里吃，不洁净的人和洁净的人都一样可以吃，像吃羚羊和鹿一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以在家里吃，不洁净的人和洁净的人都一样可以吃，像吃羚羊和鹿一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你可以在家里吃，不洁净的人和洁净的人都一样可以吃，像吃羚羊和鹿一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat it within your towns. The unclean and the clean alike may eat it, as though it were a gazelle or a deer.
verses.textEnNkjv: You may eat it within your gates; the unclean and the clean person alike mayeatit, as ifitwere a gazelle or a deer.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, use it for food for your family in your hometown. Anyone, whether ceremonially clean or unclean, may eat it, just as anyone may eat a gazelle or deer.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall eat it within your gates; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it, as a gazelle or a deer.
verses.textEn: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.

verses.textZh: 只是不可吃牠的血；要把血倒在地上，像倒水一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是不可吃牠的血；要把血倒在地上，像倒水一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是不可吃牠的血；要把血倒在地上，像倒水一样。"
verses.textEnNiv: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEnEsv: Only you shall not eat its blood; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only you shall not eat its blood; you shall pour it on the ground like water.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must not consume the blood. You must pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEnNasb: Only you shall not eat its blood; you are to pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.textEn: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

verses.textZh: "你要守亚笔月，向耶和华你的神守逾越节，因为耶和华你的神在亚笔月的一个晚上，把你从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要守亚笔月，向耶和华你的神守逾越节，因为耶和华你的神在亚笔月的一个晚上，把你从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要注意亚笔月，向耶和华－你的神守逾越节，因为耶和华－你的神在亚笔月夜间领你出埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: Observe the month of Aviv and celebrate the Passover of the Lord your God, because in the month of Aviv he brought you out of Egypt by night.
verses.textEnEsv: "Observe the month of Abib and keep the Passover to the Lord your God, for in the month of Abib the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the Lord your God, for in the month of Abib the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
verses.textEnNlt: "In honor of the Lord your God, celebrate the Passover each year in the early spring, in the month of Abib, for that was the month in which the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
verses.textEnNasb: "Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God, for in the month of Abib the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
verses.textEn: Observe the month of Aviv and celebrate the Passover of the Lord your God, because in the month of Aviv he brought you out of Egypt by night.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华选择立为他名的居所的地方，把羊和牛作逾越节的祭牲献给耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华选择立为他名的居所的地方，把羊和牛作逾越节的祭牲献给耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当在耶和华所选择要立为他名的居所，从牛群羊群中，将逾越节的祭牲献给耶和华－你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Sacrifice as the Passover to the Lord your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the Lord will choose as a dwelling for his Name.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall offer the Passover sacrifice to the Lord your God, from the flock or the herd, at the place that the Lord will choose, to make his name dwell there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall sacrifice the Passover to the Lord your God, from the flock and the herd, in the place where the Lord chooses to put His name.
verses.textEnNlt: Your Passover sacrifice may be from either the flock or the herd, and it must be sacrificed to the Lord your God at the designated place of worship—the place he chooses for his name to be honored.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the Lord your God from the flock and the herd, in the place where the Lord chooses to establish His name.
verses.textEn: Sacrifice as the Passover to the Lord your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the Lord will choose as a dwelling for his Name.

verses.textZh: 你吃这祭的时候，不可和有酵的饼一同吃；七日之内，你要吃无酵饼，就是困苦饼，因为你是急急忙忙从埃及地出来的，好使你一生的年日都可以记念你从埃及地出来的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你吃这祭的时候，不可和有酵的饼一同吃；七日之内，你要吃无酵饼，就是困苦饼，因为你是急急忙忙从埃及地出来的，好使你一生的年日都可以记念你从埃及地出来的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你吃这祭牲，不可吃有酵的饼；七日之内要吃无酵饼，就是困苦饼－你本是急忙出了埃及地－要叫你一生一世记念你从埃及地出来的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste—so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. Seven days you shall eat it with unleavened bread, the bread of affliction—for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste—that all the days of your life you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, thatis, the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste), that you may remember the day in which you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.textEnNlt: Eat it with bread made without yeast. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, as when you escaped from Egypt in such a hurry. Eat this bread—the bread of suffering—so that as long as you live you will remember the day you departed from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in a hurry), so that you will remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.textEn: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste—so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 七天之内，在你的全境不可见有酵。第一天晚上你献的祭肉，一点也不可剩下，留到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七天之内，在你的全境不可见有酵。第一天晚上你献的祭肉，一点也不可剩下，留到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你四境之内，七日不可见面酵，头一日晚上所献的肉，一点不可留到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.
verses.textEnEsv: No leaven shall be seen with you in all your territory for seven days, nor shall any of the flesh that you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain all night until morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And no leaven shall be seen among you in all your territory for seven days, nor shall any of the meat which you sacrifice the first day at twilight remain overnight until morning.
verses.textEnNlt: Let no yeast be found in any house throughout your land for those seven days. And when you sacrifice the Passover lamb on the evening of the first day, do not let any of the meat remain until the next morning.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days no leaven shall be seen with you in your entire territory, and none of the meat which you sacrifice on the evening of the first day shall be left overnight until the morning.
verses.textEn: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.

verses.textZh: 你不能在耶和华你的神赐给你的任何一座城里，宰杀逾越节的祭牲；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不能在耶和华你的神赐给你的任何一座城里，宰杀逾越节的祭牲；
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华－你神所赐的各城中，你不可献逾越节的祭；
verses.textEnNiv: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the Lord your God gives you
verses.textEnEsv: You may not offer the Passover sacrifice within any of your towns that the Lord your God is giving you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the Lord your God gives you;
verses.textEnNlt: "You may not sacrifice the Passover in just any of the towns that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: You are not allowed to sacrifice the Passover in any of your towns which the Lord your God is giving you;
verses.textEn: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the Lord your God gives you

verses.textZh: 只能在耶和华你的神选择作他名的居所的地方，晚上日落的时候，就是你出埃及的时刻，宰杀逾越节的祭牲；
verses.textZhCnvs: 只能在耶和华你的神选择作他名的居所的地方，晚上日落的时候，就是你出埃及的时刻，宰杀逾越节的祭牲；
verses.textZhCuv: 只当在耶和华－你神所选择要立为他名的居所，晚上日落的时候，乃是你出埃及的时候，献逾越节的祭。
verses.textEnNiv: except in the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name. There you must sacrifice the Passover in the evening, when the sun goes down, on the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: but at the place that the Lord your God will choose, to make his name dwell in it, there you shall offer the Passover sacrifice, in the evening at sunset, at the time you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: but at the place where the Lord your God chooses to make His name abide, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at twilight, at the going down of the sun, at the time you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: You must offer it only at the designated place of worship—the place the Lord your God chooses for his name to be honored. Sacrifice it there in the evening as the sun goes down on the anniversary of your exodus from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: but only at the place where the Lord your God chooses to establish His name, you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening at sunset, at the time that you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: except in the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name. There you must sacrifice the Passover in the evening, when the sun goes down, on the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华你的神选择的地方，把祭肉煮了吃；到了早晨，你才可以回到家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华你的神选择的地方，把祭肉煮了吃；到了早晨，你才可以回到家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 当在耶和华－你神所选择的地方把肉烤了吃 ，次日早晨就回到你的帐棚去。
verses.textEnNiv: Roast it and eat it at the place the Lord your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall cook it and eat it at the place that the Lord your God will choose. And in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall roast and eat it in the place which the Lord your God chooses, and in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.
verses.textEnNlt: Roast the lamb and eat it in the place the Lord your God chooses. Then you may go back to your tents the next morning.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall cook and eat it in the place which the Lord your God chooses. In the morning you are to return to your tents.
verses.textEn: Roast it and eat it at the place the Lord your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.

verses.textZh: 六日之内你要吃无酵饼；到了第七日，要向耶和华你的神守圣会；甚么工都不可作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六日之内你要吃无酵饼；到了第七日，要向耶和华你的神守圣会；甚么工都不可作。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要吃无酵饼六日，第七日要向耶和华－你的神守严肃会，不可做工。」
verses.textEnNiv: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the Lord your God and do no work.
verses.textEnEsv: For six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a solemn assembly to the Lord your God. You shall do no work on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shallbe a sacred assembly to the Lord your God. You shall do no work onit.
verses.textEnNlt: For the next six days you may not eat any bread made with yeast. On the seventh day proclaim another holy day in honor of the Lord your God, and no work may be done on that day.
verses.textEnNasb: For six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a festive assembly to the Lord your God; you shall do no work on it.
verses.textEn: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the Lord your God and do no work.

verses.textZh: "你要计算七个七日，从开镰收割禾稼的时候算起，共计七个七日。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要计算七个七日，从开镰收割禾稼的时候算起，共计七个七日。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要计算七七日：从你开镰收割禾稼时算起，共计七七日。
verses.textEnNiv: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall count seven weeks. Begin to count the seven weeks from the time the sickle is first put to the standing grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall count seven weeks for yourself; begin to count the seven weeks from thetime you begin toput the sickle to the grain.
verses.textEnNlt: "Count off seven weeks from when you first begin to cut the grain at the time of harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall count seven weeks for yourself; you shall begin to count seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.
verses.textEn: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

verses.textZh: 你要向耶和华你的神举行七七节，照着耶和华你的神赐福你的，尽你所能的献上你手里的甘心祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要向耶和华你的神举行七七节，照着耶和华你的神赐福你的，尽你所能的献上你手里的甘心祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要照耶和华－你神所赐你的福，手里拿着甘心祭，献在耶和华－你的神面前，守七七节。
verses.textEnNiv: Then celebrate the Festival of Weeks to the Lord your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall keep the Feast of Weeks to the Lord your God with the tribute of a freewill offering from your hand, which you shall give as the Lord your God blesses you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall keep the Feast of Weeks to the Lord your God with the tribute of a freewill offering from your hand, which you shall give as the Lord your God blesses you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then celebrate the Festival of Harvest to honor the Lord your God. Bring him a voluntary offering in proportion to the blessings you have received from him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the Lord your God with a voluntary offering of your hand in a proportional amount, which you shall give just as the Lord your God blesses you;
verses.textEn: Then celebrate the Festival of Weeks to the Lord your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the Lord your God has given you.

verses.textZh: 你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及在你城里的利未人、在你们中间的寄居者、孤儿和寡妇，都要在耶和华你的神选择作他名的居所的地方欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及在你城里的利未人、在你们中间的寄居者、孤儿和寡妇，都要在耶和华你的神选择作他名的居所的地方欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你儿女、仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及在你们中间寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要在耶和华－你神所选择立为他名的居所，在耶和华－你的神面前欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: And rejoice before the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, the Levites in your towns, and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows living among you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, the Levite who is within your towns, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, at the place that the Lord your God will choose, to make his name dwell there.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the stranger and the fatherless and the widow who are among you, at the place where the Lord your God chooses to make His name abide.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a time to celebrate before the Lord your God at the designated place of worship he will choose for his name to be honored. Celebrate with your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, the Levites from your towns, and the foreigners, orphans, and widows who live among you.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you, your son and your daughter, and your male and female slaves, and the Levite who is in your town, and the stranger, the orphan, and the widow who are in your midst, at the place where the Lord your God chooses to establish His name.
verses.textEn: And rejoice before the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, the Levites in your towns, and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows living among you.

verses.textZh: 你也要记得你在埃及作过奴仆；你要谨守遵行这些律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要记得你在埃及作过奴仆；你要谨守遵行这些律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。你要谨守遵行这些律例。」
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt; and you shall be careful to observe these statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall be careful to observe these statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that you were once slaves in Egypt, so be careful to obey all these decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall be careful and comply with these statutes.
verses.textEn: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.

verses.textZh: "你从禾场上和榨酒池里收藏了出产以后，就要举行住棚节七日。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你从禾场上和榨酒池里收藏了出产以后，就要举行住棚节七日。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你把禾场的谷、酒榨的酒收藏以后，就要守住棚节七日。
verses.textEnNiv: Celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall keep the Feast of Booths seven days, when you have gathered in the produce from your threshing floor and your winepress.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall observe the Feast of Tabernacles seven days, when you have gathered from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must observe the Festival of Shelters for seven days at the end of the harvest season, after the grain has been threshed and the grapes have been pressed.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall celebrate the Feast of Booths for seven days when you have gathered in from your threshing floor and your wine vat;
verses.textEn: Celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

verses.textZh: 在这节期以内，你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及住在你城里的利未人、寄居者、孤儿和寡妇，都要欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这节期以内，你和你的儿女、仆婢，以及住在你城里的利未人、寄居者、孤儿和寡妇，都要欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 守节的时候，你和你儿女、仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Be joyful at your festival—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites, the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall rejoice in your feast, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, the Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant and the Levite, the stranger and the fatherless and the widow, who are within your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: This festival will be a happy time of celebrating with your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows from your towns.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son and your daughter, and your male and female slaves, and the Levite, the stranger, the orphan, and the widow who are in your towns.
verses.textEn: Be joyful at your festival—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites, the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华选择的地方，向耶和华你的神守节七日，因为耶和华你的神，要在你一切土产上，和你手所作的一切事上，赐福给你，你就满有欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华选择的地方，向耶和华你的神守节七日，因为耶和华你的神，要在你一切土产上，和你手所作的一切事上，赐福给你，你就满有欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华所选择的地方，你当向耶和华－你的神守节七日；因为耶和华－你神在你一切的土产上和你手里所办的事上要赐福与你，你就非常地欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days celebrate the festival to the Lord your God at the place the Lord will choose. For the Lord your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.
verses.textEnEsv: For seven days you shall keep the feast to the Lord your God at the place that the Lord will choose, because the Lord your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you will be altogether joyful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven days you shall keep a sacred feast to the Lord your God in the place which the Lord chooses, because the Lord your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you surely rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: For seven days you must celebrate this festival to honor the Lord your God at the place he chooses, for it is he who blesses you with bountiful harvests and gives you success in all your work. This festival will be a time of great joy for all.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the Lord your God in the place which the Lord chooses, because the Lord your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you will be altogether joyful.
verses.textEn: For seven days celebrate the festival to the Lord your God at the place the Lord will choose. For the Lord your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.

verses.textZh: 每年三次，就是在除酵节、七七节、住棚节，你所有的男丁都要在耶和华选择的地方，朝见耶和华你的神；但不可空手朝见耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每年三次，就是在除酵节、七七节、住棚节，你所有的男丁都要在耶和华选择的地方，朝见耶和华你的神；但不可空手朝见耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你一切的男丁要在除酵节、七七节、住棚节，一年三次，在耶和华－你神所选择的地方朝见他，却不可空手朝见。
verses.textEnNiv: Three times a year all your men must appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the Lord empty-handed:
verses.textEnEsv: "Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord your God at the place that he will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Booths. They shall not appear before the Lord empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord your God in the place which He chooses: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles; and they shall not appear before the Lord empty-handed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Each year every man in Israel must celebrate these three festivals: the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Harvest, and the Festival of Shelters. On each of these occasions, all men must appear before the Lord your God at the place he chooses, but they must not appear before the Lord without a gift for him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord your God at the place which He chooses: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Booths; and they are not to appear before the Lord empty-handed.
verses.textEn: Three times a year all your men must appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the Lord empty-handed:

verses.textZh: 各人要按手中的力量，照着耶和华你的神赐你的福，奉献礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人要按手中的力量，照着耶和华你的神赐你的福，奉献礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人要按自己的力量，照耶和华－你神所赐的福分，奉献礼物。」
verses.textEnNiv: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.textEnEsv: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord your God that he has given you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every man shallgive as he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you.
verses.textEnNlt: All must give as they are able, according to the blessings given to them by the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone shall give as he is able, in accordance with the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you.
verses.textEn: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the Lord your God has blessed you.

verses.textZh: "在耶和华你的神赐给你的各城里，你要按着各支派设立审判官和官长；他们要按着公义的判断审判人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在耶和华你的神赐给你的各城里，你要按着各支派设立审判官和官长；他们要按着公义的判断审判人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要在耶和华－你神所赐的各城里，按着各支派设立审判官和官长。他们必按公义的审判判断百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the Lord your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall appoint judges and officers in all your towns that the Lord your God is giving you, according to your tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall appoint judges and officers in all your gates, which the Lord your God gives you, according to your tribes, and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: "Appoint judges and officials for yourselves from each of your tribes in all the towns the Lord your God is giving you. They must judge the people fairly.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall appoint for yourself judges and officers in all your towns which the Lord your God is giving you, according to your tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
verses.textEn: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the Lord your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.

verses.textZh: 不可屈枉正直，不可徇人的情面，不可收受贿赂，因为贿赂能使智慧人的眼变瞎，也能使义人的话颠倒过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可屈枉正直，不可徇人的情面，不可收受贿赂，因为贿赂能使智慧人的眼变瞎，也能使义人的话颠倒过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可屈枉正直；不可看人的外貌。也不可受贿赂；因为贿赂能叫智慧人的眼变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the innocent.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality, and you shall not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and subverts the cause of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not pervert justice; you shall not show partiality, nor take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: You must never twist justice or show partiality. Never accept a bribe, for bribes blind the eyes of the wise and corrupt the decisions of the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not distort justice, you shall not show partiality; and you shall not accept a bribe, because a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and distorts the words of the righteous.
verses.textEn: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the innocent.

verses.textZh: 你要追求公正公义，好使你能存活，并且能承受耶和华你的神赐给你的地作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要追求公正公义，好使你能存活，并且能承受耶和华你的神赐给你的地作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要追求至公至义，好叫你存活，承受耶和华－你神所赐你的地。
verses.textEnNiv: Follow justice and justice alone, so that you may live and possess the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: Justice, and only justice, you shall follow, that you may live and inherit the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall follow what is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: Let true justice prevail, so you may live and occupy the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: Justice, and only justice, you shall pursue, so that you may live and possess the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEn: Follow justice and justice alone, so that you may live and possess the land the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.textZh: "在你为耶和华你的神筑的祭坛旁边，不可栽种甚么树木，作亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在你为耶和华你的神筑的祭坛旁边，不可栽种甚么树木，作亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你为耶和华－你的神筑坛，不可在坛旁栽什么树木作为木偶。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the Lord your God,
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not plant any tree as an Asherah beside the altar of the Lord your God that you shall make.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not plant for yourself any tree, as a wooden image, near the altar which you build for yourself to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must never set up a wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build for the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not plant for yourself an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the altar of the Lord your God, which you shall make for yourself.
verses.textEn: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the Lord your God,

verses.textZh: 也不可为自己竖立神柱，这是耶和华你的神所恨恶的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不可为自己竖立神柱，这是耶和华你的神所恨恶的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也不可为自己设立柱像；这是耶和华－你神所恨恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: and do not erect a sacred stone, for these the Lord your God hates.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not set up a pillar, which the Lord your God hates.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not set up a sacred pillar, which the Lord your God hates.
verses.textEnNlt: And never set up sacred pillars for worship, for the Lord your God hates them.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not set up for yourself a memorial stone, which the Lord your God hates.
verses.textEn: and do not erect a sacred stone, for these the Lord your God hates.

verses.textZh: "有残疾，或有甚么缺点的牛羊，都不可献给耶和华你的神，因为这是耶和华你的神所憎恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "有残疾，或有甚么缺点的牛羊，都不可献给耶和华你的神，因为这是耶和华你的神所憎恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡有残疾，或有什么恶病的牛羊，你都不可献给耶和华－你的神，因为这是耶和华－你神所憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep in which is a blemish, any defect whatever, for that is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God a bull or sheep which has any blemish or defect, for that is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Never sacrifice sick or defective cattle, sheep, or goats to the Lord your God, for he detests such gifts.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep which has a blemish or any defect, for that is a detestable thing to the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Do not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.

verses.textZh: "在你中间，就是耶和华你的神赐给你的任何一座城里，如果发现有人，无论是男是女，行耶和华你的神眼中看为恶的事，违犯了他的约，
verses.textZhCnvs: "在你中间，就是耶和华你的神赐给你的任何一座城里，如果发现有人，无论是男是女，行耶和华你的神眼中看为恶的事，违犯了他的约，
verses.textZhCuv: 「在你们中间，在耶和华－你神所赐你的诸城中，无论哪座城里，若有人，或男或女，行耶和华－你神眼中看为恶的事，违背了他的约，
verses.textEnNiv: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the Lord gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God in violation of his covenant,
verses.textEnEsv: "If there is found among you, within any of your towns that the Lord your God is giving you, a man or woman who does what is evil in the sight of the Lord your God, in transgressing his covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If there is found among you, within any of your gates which the Lord your God gives you, a man or a woman who has been wicked in the sight of the Lord your God, in transgressing His covenant,
verses.textEnNlt: "When you begin living in the towns the Lord your God is giving you, a man or woman among you might do evil in the sight of the Lord your God and violate the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is found in your midst, in any of your towns which the Lord your God is giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the sight of the Lord your God, by violating His covenant,
verses.textEn: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the Lord gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God in violation of his covenant,

verses.textZh: 去事奉别的神，并且敬拜它们，敬拜太阳或月亮，或任何天象，是我耶和华没有吩咐的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 去事奉别的神，并且敬拜它们，敬拜太阳或月亮，或任何天象，是我耶和华没有吩咐的；
verses.textZhCuv: 去事奉敬拜别神，或拜日头，或拜月亮，或拜天象，是主不曾吩咐的；
verses.textEnNiv: and contrary to my command has worshiped other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or the moon or the stars in the sky,
verses.textEnEsv: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun or the moon or any of the host of heaven, which I have forbidden,
verses.textEnNkjv: who has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, either the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, they might serve other gods or worship the sun, the moon, or any of the stars—the forces of heaven—which I have strictly forbidden.
verses.textEnNasb: and that person has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, the moon, or any of the heavenly lights, which I have commanded not to do,
verses.textEn: and contrary to my command has worshiped other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or the moon or the stars in the sky,

verses.textZh: 有人告诉你，你也听见了，就要好好调查；如果确有这些事，真的在以色列中行了这可憎可厌的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉你，你也听见了，就要好好调查；如果确有这些事，真的在以色列中行了这可憎可厌的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉你，你也听见了，就要细细地探听，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在以色列中，
verses.textEnNiv: and this has been brought to your attention, then you must investigate it thoroughly. If it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: and it is told you and you hear of it, then you shall inquire diligently, and if it is true and certain that such an abomination has been done in Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: and it is told you, and you hear ofit, then you shall inquire diligently. And if itis indeed true and certain that such an abomination has been committed in Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: When you hear about it, investigate the matter thoroughly. If it is true that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: and if it is reported to you and you have heard about it, then you shall investigate thoroughly. And if it is true and the report is trustworthy that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,
verses.textEn: and this has been brought to your attention, then you must investigate it thoroughly. If it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,

verses.textZh: 你就要把那个行了这恶事的男人或女人带出来，到城门那里去，用石头把他们打死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要把那个行了这恶事的男人或女人带出来，到城门那里去，用石头把他们打死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就要将行这恶事的男人或女人拉到城门外，用石头将他打死。
verses.textEnNiv: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall bring out to your gates that man or woman who has done this evil thing, and you shall stone that man or woman to death with stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall bring out to your gates that man or woman who has committed that wicked thing, and shall stone to death that man or woman with stones.
verses.textEnNlt: then the man or woman who has committed such an evil act must be taken to the gates of the town and stoned to death.
verses.textEnNasb: then you are to bring out to your gates that man or woman who has done this evil deed, that is, the man or the woman, and you shall stone them to death.
verses.textEn: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.

verses.textZh: 凭着两个或三个见证人的口供，就可以把那该死的人处死；只是凭着一个见证人的口供，却不可以把人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凭着两个或三个见证人的口供，就可以把那该死的人处死；只是凭着一个见证人的口供，却不可以把人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 要凭两三个人的口作见证将那当死的人治死；不可凭一个人的口作见证将他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a person is to be put to death, but no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.
verses.textEnEsv: On the evidence of two witnesses or of three witnesses the one who is to die shall be put to death; a person shall not be put to death on the evidence of one witness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever is deserving of death shall be put to death on the testimony of two or three witnesses; he shall not be put to death on the testimony of one witness.
verses.textEnNlt: But never put a person to death on the testimony of only one witness. There must always be two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNasb: On the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses, the condemned shall be put to death; he shall not be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.
verses.textEn: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a person is to be put to death, but no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

verses.textZh: 见证人要先下手，然后众民也下手，把他处死。这样，你就把那恶从你中间除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 见证人要先下手，然后众民也下手，把他处死。这样，你就把那恶从你中间除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 见证人要先下手，然后众民也下手将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting that person to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnEsv: The hand of the witnesses shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hands of the witnesses shall be the first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall put away the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: The witnesses must throw the first stones, and then all the people may join in. In this way, you will purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: The hands of the witnesses shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall eliminate the evil from your midst.
verses.textEn: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting that person to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.

verses.textZh: "在你的城里如果有甚么争讼的事：或是流血，或是诉讼，或是殴打，是你很难处决的案件，你就要起来，上到耶和华你的神选择的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: "在你的城里如果有甚么争讼的事：或是流血，或是诉讼，或是殴打，是你很难处决的案件，你就要起来，上到耶和华你的神选择的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你城中若起了争讼的事，或因流血，或因争竞，或因殴打，是你难断的案件，你就当起来，往耶和华－你神所选择的地方
verses.textEnNiv: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge—whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults—take them to the place the Lord your God will choose.
verses.textEnEsv: "If any case arises requiring decision between one kind of homicide and another, one kind of legal right and another, or one kind of assault and another, any case within your towns that is too difficult for you, then you shall arise and go up to the place that the Lord your God will choose.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a matter arises which is too hard for you to judge, between degrees of guilt for bloodshed, between one judgment or another, or between one punishment or another, matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise and go up to the place which the Lord your God chooses.
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a case arises in a local court that is too hard for you to decide—for instance, whether someone is guilty of murder or only of manslaughter, or a difficult lawsuit, or a case involving different kinds of assault. Take such legal cases to the place the Lord your God will choose,
verses.textEnNasb: "If a case is too difficult for you to decide, between one kind of homicide or another, between one kind of lawsuit or another, and between one kind of assault or another, that are cases of dispute in your courts, then you shall arise and go up to the place which the Lord your God chooses.
verses.textEn: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge—whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults—take them to the place the Lord your God will choose.

verses.textZh: 去见利未支派的祭司和当时的审判官，询问他们，他们就必指示你们怎样判断这案件。
verses.textZhCnvs: 去见利未支派的祭司和当时的审判官，询问他们，他们就必指示你们怎样判断这案件。
verses.textZhCuv: 去见祭司利未人，并当时的审判官，求问他们，他们必将判语指示你。
verses.textEnNiv: Go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall come to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office in those days, and you shall consult them, and they shall declare to you the decision.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall come to the priests, the Levites, and to the judge there in those days, and inquire ofthem; they shall pronounce upon you the sentence of judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: and present them to the Levitical priests or the judge on duty at that time. They will hear the case and declare the verdict.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall come to the Levitical priests or the judge who is in office in those days, and you shall inquire of them and they will declare to you the verdict.
verses.textEn: Go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.

verses.textZh: 你要照着他们从耶和华选择的那地方，向你指示的话去行；他们指教你的，你都要谨守遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要照着他们从耶和华选择的那地方，向你指示的话去行；他们指教你的，你都要谨守遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在耶和华所选择的地方指示你的判语，你必照着他们所指教你的一切话谨守遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the Lord will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you to do.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall do according to what they declare to you from that place that the Lord will choose. And you shall be careful to do according to all that they direct you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall do according to the sentence which they pronounce upon you in that place which the Lord chooses. And you shall be careful to do according to all that they order you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must carry out the verdict they announce and the sentence they prescribe at the place the Lord chooses. You must do exactly what they say.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall act in accordance with the terms of the verdict which they declare to you from that place which the Lord chooses; and you shall be careful to act in accordance with everything that they instruct you to do.
verses.textEn: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the Lord will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you to do.

verses.textZh: 你要按着他们指教你的律法，和照着他们告诉你的判断去行；他们告诉你的话，你不可偏左或偏右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要按着他们指教你的律法，和照着他们告诉你的判断去行；他们告诉你的话，你不可偏左或偏右。
verses.textZhCuv: 要按他们所指教你的律法，照他们所断定的去行；他们所指示你的判语，你不可偏离左右。
verses.textEnNiv: Act according to whatever they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnEsv: According to the instructions that they give you, and according to the decision which they pronounce to you, you shall do. You shall not turn aside from the verdict that they declare to you, either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the sentence of the law in which they instruct you, according to the judgment which they tell you, you shall do; you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left from the sentence which they pronounce upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: After they have interpreted the law and declared their verdict, the sentence they impose must be fully executed; do not modify it in any way.
verses.textEnNasb: In accordance with the terms of the law about which they instruct you, and in accordance with the verdict which they tell you, you shall act; you shall not turn aside from the word which they declare to you, to the right or the left.
verses.textEn: Act according to whatever they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.

verses.textZh: 如果有人擅自行事，不听从祭司，就是侍立在那里事奉耶和华你的神的，或是不听从审判官，那人就必须处死；这样，你就可以把这恶从以色列中肃清了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人擅自行事，不听从祭司，就是侍立在那里事奉耶和华你的神的，或是不听从审判官，那人就必须处死；这样，你就可以把这恶从以色列中肃清了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人擅敢不听从那侍立在耶和华－你神面前的祭司，或不听从审判官，那人就必治死；这样，便将那恶从以色列中除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who shows contempt for the judge or for the priest who stands ministering there to the Lord your God is to be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The man who acts presumptuously by not obeying the priest who stands to minister there before the Lord your God, or the judge, that man shall die. So you shall purge the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the man who acts presumptuously and will not heed the priest who stands to minister there before the Lord your God, or the judge, that man shall die. So you shall put away the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone arrogant enough to reject the verdict of the judge or of the priest who represents the Lord your God must die. In this way you will purge the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But the person who acts insolently by not listening to the priest who stands there to serve the Lord your God, nor to the judge, that person shall die; so you shall eliminate the evil from Israel.
verses.textEn: Anyone who shows contempt for the judge or for the priest who stands ministering there to the Lord your God is to be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

verses.textZh: 众民都会听见，而且惧怕，也不再擅自行事了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民都会听见，而且惧怕，也不再擅自行事了。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓都要听见害怕，不再擅敢行事。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people shall hear and fear and not act presumptuously again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people shall hear and fear, and no longer act presumptuously.
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone else will hear about it and be afraid to act so arrogantly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will not act insolently again.
verses.textEn: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.

verses.textZh: "你进了耶和华你的神赐给你的地，占领了那地，居住在那里的时候，如果你说：‘我要立一位君王治理我，像我四围的列国一样。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你进了耶和华你的神赐给你的地，占领了那地，居住在那里的时候，如果你说：‘我要立一位君王治理我，像我四围的列国一样。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「到了耶和华－你神所赐你的地，得了那地居住的时候，若说：『我要立王治理我，像四围的国一样。』
verses.textEnNiv: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, "Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,"
verses.textEnEsv: "When you come to the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and you possess it and dwell in it and then say, ‘I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,’
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you come to the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, ‘I will set a king over me like all the nations that are around me,’
verses.textEnNlt: "You are about to enter the land the Lord your God is giving you. When you take it over and settle there, you may think, ‘We should select a king to rule over us like the other nations around us.’
verses.textEnNasb: "When you enter the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and you take possession of it and live in it, and you say, ‘I will appoint a king over me like all the nations who are around me,’
verses.textEn: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, "Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,"

verses.textZh: 你总要立耶和华你的神拣选的人作君王管理你；你要从你的兄弟中立一位作你的君王；不可立你的兄弟以外的人作王管理你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你总要立耶和华你的神拣选的人作君王管理你；你要从你的兄弟中立一位作你的君王；不可立你的兄弟以外的人作王管理你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你总要立耶和华－你神所拣选的人为王。必从你弟兄中立一人；不可立你弟兄以外的人为王。
verses.textEnNiv: be sure to appoint over you a king the Lord your God chooses. He must be from among your fellow Israelites. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not an Israelite.
verses.textEnEsv: you may indeed set a king over you whom the Lord your God will choose. One from among your brothers you shall set as king over you. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall surely set a king over you whom the Lord your God chooses; one from among your brethren you shall set as king over you; you may not set a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.
verses.textEnNlt: If this happens, be sure to select as king the man the Lord your God chooses. You must appoint a fellow Israelite; he may not be a foreigner.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall in fact appoint a king over you whom the Lord your God chooses. One from among your countrymen you shall appoint as king over yourselves; you may not put a foreigner over yourselves, anyone who is not your countryman.
verses.textEn: be sure to appoint over you a king the Lord your God chooses. He must be from among your fellow Israelites. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not an Israelite.

verses.textZh: 只是君王不可为自己加添马匹，也不可使人民回埃及去，为要加添马匹，因为耶和华曾经对你们说过：‘你们不可再回到那条路去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是君王不可为自己加添马匹，也不可使人民回埃及去，为要加添马匹，因为耶和华曾经对你们说过：‘你们不可再回到那条路去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 只是王不可为自己加添马匹，也不可使百姓回埃及去，为要加添他的马匹，因耶和华曾吩咐你们说：『不可再回那条路去。』
verses.textEnNiv: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the Lord has told you, "You are not to go back that way again."
verses.textEnEsv: Only he must not acquire many horses for himself or cause the people to return to Egypt in order to acquire many horses, since the Lord has said to you, ‘You shall never return that way again.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt to multiply horses, for the Lord has said to you, ‘You shall not return that way again.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The king must not build up a large stable of horses for himself or send his people to Egypt to buy horses, for the Lord has told you, ‘You must never return to Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: In any case, he is not to acquire many horses for himself, nor shall he make the people return to Egypt in order to acquire many horses, since the Lord has said to you, ‘You shall never again return that way.’
verses.textEn: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the Lord has told you, "You are not to go back that way again."

verses.textZh: 他也不可为自己加添妃嫔，恐怕他的心偏离了耶和华；也不可为自己积蓄极多的金钱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也不可为自己加添妃嫔，恐怕他的心偏离了耶和华；也不可为自己积蓄极多的金钱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也不可为自己多立妃嫔，恐怕他的心偏邪；也不可为自己多积金银。
verses.textEnNiv: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall not acquire many wives for himself, lest his heart turn away, nor shall he acquire for himself excessive silver and gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither shall he multiply wives for himself, lest his heart turn away; nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold for himself.
verses.textEnNlt: The king must not take many wives for himself, because they will turn his heart away from the Lord . And he must not accumulate large amounts of wealth in silver and gold for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall not acquire many wives for himself, so that his heart does not turn away; nor shall he greatly increase silver and gold for himself.
verses.textEn: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.

verses.textZh: "他登上了国位的时候，就要把利未支派的祭司面前的律法书，为自己抄录一份副本。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他登上了国位的时候，就要把利未支派的祭司面前的律法书，为自己抄录一份副本。
verses.textZhCuv: 他登了国位，就要将祭司利未人面前的这律法书，为自己抄录一本，
verses.textEnNiv: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the Levitical priests.
verses.textEnEsv: "And when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, he shall write for himself in a book a copy of this law, approved by the Levitical priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also it shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write for himself a copy of this law in a book, from theone before the priests, the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: "When he sits on the throne as king, he must copy for himself this body of instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now it shall come about, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write for himself a copy of this Law on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.
verses.textEn: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the Levitical priests.

verses.textZh: 那份副本要常在他身边，他一生的年日都要诵读，好学习敬畏耶和华他的神，谨守遵行这律法书上的一切话和这些律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那份副本要常在他身边，他一生的年日都要诵读，好学习敬畏耶和华他的神，谨守遵行这律法书上的一切话和这些律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 存在他那里，要平生诵读，好学习敬畏耶和华－他的神，谨守遵行这律法书上的一切言语和这些律例，
verses.textEnNiv: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the Lord his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the Lord his God by keeping all the words of this law and these statutes, and doing them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the Lord his God and be careful to observe all the words of this law and these statutes,
verses.textEnNlt: He must always keep that copy with him and read it daily as long as he lives. That way he will learn to fear the Lord his God by obeying all the terms of these instructions and decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the days of his life, so that he will learn to fear the Lord his God, by carefully following all the words of this Law and these statutes,
verses.textEn: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the Lord his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees

verses.textZh: 这样，他的心就不会高傲，轻看自己的兄弟，也不会偏左偏右，离了这诫命；好使他和他的子孙在以色列中，在他的国位上，可以日子长久。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他的心就不会高傲，轻看自己的兄弟，也不会偏左偏右，离了这诫命；好使他和他的子孙在以色列中，在他的国位上，可以日子长久。"
verses.textZhCuv: 免得他向弟兄心高气傲，偏左偏右，离了这诫命。这样，他和他的子孙便可在以色列中，在国位上年长日久。」
verses.textEnNiv: and not consider himself better than his fellow Israelites and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he may not turn aside from the commandment, either to the right hand or to the left, so that he may continue long in his kingdom, he and his children, in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: that his heart may not be lifted above his brethren, that he may not turn aside from the commandment to the right hand or to the left, and that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children in the midst of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: This regular reading will prevent him from becoming proud and acting as if he is above his fellow citizens. It will also prevent him from turning away from these commands in the smallest way. And it will ensure that he and his descendants will reign for many generations in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: so that his heart will not be haughty toward his countrymen, and that he will not turn away from the commandment to the right or the left, so that he and his sons may live long in his kingdom in the midst of Israel.
verses.textEn: and not consider himself better than his fellow Israelites and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.

verses.textZh: "利未支派的祭司和利未整个支派，在以色列中，必无分无业；他们所吃的，是献给耶和华的火祭和他们应得的一份 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "利未支派的祭司和利未整个支派，在以色列中，必无分无业；他们所吃的，是献给耶和华的火祭和他们应得的一份 。
verses.textZhCuv: 「祭司利未人和利未全支派必在以色列中无分无业；他们所吃用的就是献给耶和华的火祭和一切所捐的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levitical priests—indeed, the whole tribe of Levi—are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the food offerings presented to the Lord , for that is their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Levitical priests, all the tribe of Levi, shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the Lord ’s food offerings as their inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The priests, the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and His portion.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember that the Levitical priests—that is, the whole of the tribe of Levi—will receive no allotment of land among the other tribes in Israel. Instead, the priests and Levites will eat from the special gifts given to the Lord , for that is their share.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall not have a portion or inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the Lord’s offerings by fire and His property.
verses.textEn: The Levitical priests—indeed, the whole tribe of Levi—are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the food offerings presented to the Lord , for that is their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 利未人在兄弟中必没有产业，耶和华就是他们的产业，正如耶和华应许他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人在兄弟中必没有产业，耶和华就是他们的产业，正如耶和华应许他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在弟兄中必没有产业；耶和华是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
verses.textEnNiv: They shall have no inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the Lord is their inheritance, as he promised them.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the Lord is their inheritance, as he promised them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord is their inheritance, as He said to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They will have no land of their own among the Israelites. The Lord himself is their special possession, just as he promised them.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall not have an inheritance among their countrymen; the Lord is their inheritance, as He promised them.
verses.textEn: They shall have no inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the Lord is their inheritance, as he promised them.

verses.textZh: "祭司从人民应得的分是这样：人无论是献牛或是献羊，要把前腿、两腮和胃给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: "祭司从人民应得的分是这样：人无论是献牛或是献羊，要把前腿、两腮和胃给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司从百姓所当得的分乃是这样：凡献牛或羊为祭的，要把前腿和两腮并脾胃给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the internal organs and the meat from the head.
verses.textEnEsv: And this shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those offering a sacrifice, whether an ox or a sheep: they shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether itis bull or sheep: they shall give to the priest the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the parts the priests may claim as their share from the cattle, sheep, and goats that the people bring as offerings: the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now this shall be the priests’ portion from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, either an ox or a sheep: they shall give the priest the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the stomach.
verses.textEn: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the internal organs and the meat from the head.

verses.textZh: 你也要把初熟的五谷、新酒、新油和初剪的羊毛给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要把初熟的五谷、新酒、新油和初剪的羊毛给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 初收的五谷、新酒和油，并初剪的羊毛，也要给他；
verses.textEnNiv: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,
verses.textEnEsv: The firstfruits of your grain, of your wine and of your oil, and the first fleece of your sheep, you shall give him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The firstfruits of your grain and your new wine and your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep, you shall give him.
verses.textEnNlt: You must also give to the priests the first share of the grain, the new wine, the olive oil, and the wool at shearing time.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, your new wine, and your oil, and the first fleece of your sheep.
verses.textEn: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神从你的各支派中把他拣选出来，使他和他的子孙，可以常常奉耶和华的名侍立供祭司的职。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神从你的各支派中把他拣选出来，使他和他的子孙，可以常常奉耶和华的名侍立供祭司的职。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你的神从你各支派中将他拣选出来，使他和他子孙永远奉耶和华的名侍立，事奉。
verses.textEnNiv: for the Lord your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the Lord ’s name always.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the name of the Lord , him and his sons for all time.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the name of the Lord, him and his sons forever.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God chose the tribe of Levi out of all your tribes to minister in the Lord ’s name forever.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God has chosen him and his sons from all your tribes, to stand to serve in the name of the Lord always.
