verses.textEn: for the Lord your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the Lord ’s name always.

verses.textZh: "如果有住在以色列中任何一座城里的利未人，离开了那里，一心一意到耶和华选择的地方去，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有住在以色列中任何一座城里的利未人，离开了那里，一心一意到耶和华选择的地方去，
verses.textZhCuv: 「利未人无论寄居在以色列中的哪一座城，若从那里出来，一心愿意到耶和华所选择的地方，
verses.textEnNiv: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the Lord will choose,
verses.textEnEsv: "And if a Levite comes from any of your towns out of all Israel, where he lives—and he may come when he desires — to the place that the Lord will choose,
verses.textEnNkjv: "So if a Levite comes from any of your gates, from where he dwells among all Israel, and comes with all the desire of his mind to the place which the Lord chooses,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a Levite chooses to move from his town in Israel, wherever he is living, to the place the Lord chooses for worship.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if a Levite comes from any of your towns throughout Israel where he resides, and he comes whenever he desires to the place which the Lord chooses,
verses.textEn: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the Lord will choose,

verses.textZh: 他就可以奉耶和华他的神的名供职，像他的众兄弟利未人在那里侍立在耶和华面前一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就可以奉耶和华他的神的名供职，像他的众兄弟利未人在那里侍立在耶和华面前一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要奉耶和华－他神的名事奉，像他众弟兄利未人侍立在耶和华面前事奉一样。
verses.textEnNiv: he may minister in the name of the Lord his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and ministers in the name of the Lord his God, like all his fellow Levites who stand to minister there before the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: then he may serve in the name of the Lord his God as all his brethren the Levites do, who stand there before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He may minister there in the name of the Lord his God, just like all his fellow Levites who are serving the Lord there.
verses.textEnNasb: then he shall serve in the name of the Lord his God, like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the Lord.
verses.textEn: he may minister in the name of the Lord his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 除了他从父家承受的产业以外，他还可以得着和他的兄弟相等分量的祭物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了他从父家承受的产业以外，他还可以得着和他的兄弟相等分量的祭物。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了他卖祖父产业所得的以外，还要得一分祭物与他们同吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: then he may have equal portions to eat, besides what he receives from the sale of his patrimony.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall have equal portions to eat, besides what comes from the sale of his inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: He may eat his share of the sacrifices and offerings, even if he also receives support from his family.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall eat equal portions, except for what they receive from the sale of their fathers’ estates.
verses.textEn: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.

verses.textZh: "你到了耶和华你的神要赐给你的那地的时候，那些外族人可厌可恶的事，你不可学习去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你到了耶和华你的神要赐给你的那地的时候，那些外族人可厌可恶的事，你不可学习去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你到了耶和华－你神所赐之地，那些国民所行可憎恶的事，你不可学着行。
verses.textEnNiv: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not learn to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you come into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not learn to follow the abominable practices of those nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you come into the land which the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not learn to follow the abominations of those nations.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, be very careful not to imitate the detestable customs of the nations living there.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you enter the land which the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not learn to imitate the detestable things of those nations.
verses.textEn: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not learn to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

verses.textZh: 在你中间不可有人把自己的儿女献作火祭 ，也不可有占卜的、算命的、用法术的、行邪术的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你中间不可有人把自己的儿女献作火祭 ，也不可有占卜的、算命的、用法术的、行邪术的、
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间不可有人使儿女经火，也不可有占卜的、观兆的、用法术的、行邪术的、
verses.textEnNiv: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices their son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,
verses.textEnEsv: There shall not be found among you anyone who burns his son or his daughter as an offering, anyone who practices divination or tells fortunes or interprets omens, or a sorcerer
verses.textEnNkjv: There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, orone who practices witchcraft, or a soothsayer, or one who interprets omens, or a sorcerer,
verses.textEnNlt: For example, never sacrifice your son or daughter as a burnt offering. And do not let your people practice fortune-telling, or use sorcery, or interpret omens, or engage in witchcraft,
verses.textEnNasb: There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, one who uses divination, a soothsayer, one who interprets omens, or a sorcerer,
verses.textEn: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices their son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,

verses.textZh: 念咒的、问鬼的、行巫术的、过阴的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 念咒的、问鬼的、行巫术的、过阴的。
verses.textZhCuv: 用迷术的、交鬼的、行巫术的、过阴的。
verses.textEnNiv: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: or a charmer or a medium or a necromancer or one who inquires of the dead,
verses.textEnNkjv: or one who conjures spells, or a medium, or a spiritist, or one who calls up the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: or cast spells, or function as mediums or psychics, or call forth the spirits of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: or one who casts a spell, or a medium, or a spiritist, or one who consults the dead.
verses.textEn: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.

verses.textZh: 因为行这些事的，都是耶和华厌恶的；就是因为这些可厌可恶的事的缘故，耶和华你的神才把他们从你的面前赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为行这些事的，都是耶和华厌恶的；就是因为这些可厌可恶的事的缘故，耶和华你的神才把他们从你的面前赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡行这些事的都为耶和华所憎恶；因那些国民行这可憎恶的事，所以耶和华－你的神将他们从你面前赶出。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the Lord ; because of these same detestable practices the Lord your God will drive out those nations before you.
verses.textEnEsv: for whoever does these things is an abomination to the Lord . And because of these abominations the Lord your God is driving them out before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all who do these things are an abomination to the Lord, and because of these abominations the Lord your God drives them out from before you.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the Lord . It is because the other nations have done these detestable things that the Lord your God will drive them out ahead of you.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever does these things is detestable to the Lord; and because of these detestable things the Lord your God is going to drive them out before you.
verses.textEn: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the Lord ; because of these same detestable practices the Lord your God will drive out those nations before you.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华你的神面前作完全人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华你的神面前作完全人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在耶和华－你的神面前作完全人。」
verses.textEnNiv: You must be blameless before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be blameless before the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be blameless before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must be blameless before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You are to be blameless before the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: You must be blameless before the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "因为你要赶走的那些民族，都听从算命的和占卜的；至于你，耶和华你的神却不容许你这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为你要赶走的那些民族，都听从算命的和占卜的；至于你，耶和华你的神却不容许你这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因你所要赶出的那些国民都听信观兆的和占卜的，至于你，耶和华－你的神从来不许你这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the Lord your God has not permitted you to do so.
verses.textEnEsv: for these nations, which you are about to dispossess, listen to fortune-tellers and to diviners. But as for you, the Lord your God has not allowed you to do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: For these nations which you will dispossess listened to soothsayers and diviners; but as for you, the Lord your God has not appointed such for you.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations you are about to displace consult sorcerers and fortune-tellers, but the Lord your God forbids you to do such things."
verses.textEnNasb: For these nations, which you are going to dispossess, listen to soothsayers and diviners, but as for you, the Lord your God has not allowed you to do so.
verses.textEn: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the Lord your God has not permitted you to do so.

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神要从你中间，就是从你的众兄弟中间，给你兴起一位先知来，像我一样；你们要听从他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神要从你中间，就是从你的众兄弟中间，给你兴起一位先知来，像我一样；你们要听从他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神要从你们弟兄中间给你兴起一位先知，像我，你们要听从他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your brothers—it is to him you shall listen—
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your midst, from your brethren. Him you shall hear,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses continued, "The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your countrymen; to him you shall listen.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him.

verses.textZh: 这正是你在何烈山开大会的日子，求耶和华你的神的一切话，说：‘不要让我再听见耶和华我的神的声音了；也不要让我再看见这大火了，免得我死亡。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这正是你在何烈山开大会的日子，求耶和华你的神的一切话，说：‘不要让我再听见耶和华我的神的声音了；也不要让我再看见这大火了，免得我死亡。’
verses.textZhCuv: 正如你在何烈山大会的日子求耶和华－你神一切的话，说：『求你不再叫我听见耶和华－我神的声音，也不再叫我看见这大火，免得我死亡。』
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what you asked of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, "Let us not hear the voice of the Lord our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die."
verses.textEnEsv: just as you desired of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, ‘Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord my God or see this great fire any more, lest I die.’
verses.textEnNkjv: according to all you desired of the Lord your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, ‘Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord my God, nor let me see this great fire anymore, lest I die.’
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what you yourselves requested of the Lord your God when you were assembled at Mount Sinai. You said, ‘Don’t let us hear the voice of the Lord our God anymore or see this blazing fire, for we will die.’
verses.textEnNasb: This is in accordance with everything that you asked of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, ‘Do not let me hear the voice of the Lord my God again, and do not let me see this great fire anymore, or I will die!’
verses.textEn: For this is what you asked of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, "Let us not hear the voice of the Lord our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说：‘他们所说的都很好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说：‘他们所说的都很好。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就对我说：『他们所说的是。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me: "What they say is good.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, ‘They are right in what they have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Lord said to me: ‘What they have spoken is good.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Lord said to me, ‘What they have said is right.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, ‘They have spoken well.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me: "What they say is good.

verses.textZh: 我要从他们的兄弟中间，给他们兴起一位先知，像你一样；我要把我的话放在他口里，他必把我吩咐他们的一切话都对他们说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要从他们的兄弟中间，给他们兴起一位先知，像你一样；我要把我的话放在他口里，他必把我吩咐他们的一切话都对他们说。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在他们弟兄中间给他们兴起一位先知，像你。我要将当说的话传给他；他要将我一切所吩咐的都传给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him.
verses.textEnEsv: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. And I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will raise up for them a Prophet like you from among their brethren, and will put My words in His mouth, and He shall speak to them all that I command Him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will raise up a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites. I will put my words in his mouth, and he will tell the people everything I command him.
verses.textEnNasb: I will raise up for them a prophet from among their countrymen like you, and I will put My words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them everything that I command him.
verses.textEn: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him.

verses.textZh: 如果有人不听从他奉我的名所说的话，我必亲自追讨那人的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人不听从他奉我的名所说的话，我必亲自追讨那人的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁不听他奉我名所说的话，我必讨谁的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will call to account anyone who does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever will not listen to my words that he shall speak in my name, I myself will require it of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that whoever will not hear My words, which He speaks in My name, I will require it of him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will personally deal with anyone who will not listen to the messages the prophet proclaims on my behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall come about that whoever does not listen to My words which he speaks in My name, I Myself will require it of him.
verses.textEn: I myself will call to account anyone who does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name.

verses.textZh: "‘不过，如果有先知擅自奉我的名，说我没有吩咐他说的话，或是奉别神的名说话，那先知就必须处死。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不过，如果有先知擅自奉我的名，说我没有吩咐他说的话，或是奉别神的名说话，那先知就必须处死。’
verses.textZhCuv: 若有先知擅敢托我的名说我所未曾吩咐他说的话，或是奉别神的名说话，那先知就必治死。』
verses.textEnNiv: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, is to be put to death."
verses.textEnEsv: But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in my name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in My name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.’
verses.textEnNlt: But any prophet who falsely claims to speak in my name or who speaks in the name of another god must die.’
verses.textEnNasb: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in My name, a word which I have not commanded him to speak, or which he speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.’
verses.textEn: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, is to be put to death."

verses.textZh: 如果你心里说：‘耶和华没有说过的话，我们怎能知道呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你心里说：‘耶和华没有说过的话，我们怎能知道呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你心里若说：『耶和华所未曾吩咐的话，我们怎能知道呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: You may say to yourselves, "How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the Lord ?"
verses.textEnEsv: And if you say in your heart, ‘How may we know the word that the Lord has not spoken?’—
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you say in your heart, ‘How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?’—
verses.textEnNlt: "But you may wonder, ‘How will we know whether or not a prophecy is from the Lord ?’
verses.textEnNasb: And if you say in your heart, ‘How will we recognize the word which the Lord has not spoken?’
verses.textEn: You may say to yourselves, "How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the Lord ?"

verses.textZh: 一位先知奉耶和华的名说话，如果那话不成就，也不应验，这话就不是耶和华说的；是那先知擅自说的，你不要怕他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 一位先知奉耶和华的名说话，如果那话不成就，也不应验，这话就不是耶和华说的；是那先知擅自说的，你不要怕他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先知托耶和华的名说话，所说的若不成就，也无效验，这就是耶和华所未曾吩咐的，是那先知擅自说的，你不要怕他。」
verses.textEnNiv: If what a prophet proclaims in the name of the Lord does not take place or come true, that is a message the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken presumptuously, so do not be alarmed.
verses.textEnEsv: when a prophet speaks in the name of the Lord , if the word does not come to pass or come true, that is a word that the Lord has not spoken; the prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You need not be afraid of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: when a prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, if the thing does not happen or come to pass, that is the thing which the Lord has not spoken; the prophet has spoken it presumptuously; you shall not be afraid of him.
verses.textEnNlt: If the prophet speaks in the Lord ’s name but his prediction does not happen or come true, you will know that the Lord did not give that message. That prophet has spoken without my authority and need not be feared.
verses.textEnNasb: When the prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, and the thing does not happen or come true, that is the thing which the Lord has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously; you are not to be afraid of him.
verses.textEn: If what a prophet proclaims in the name of the Lord does not take place or come true, that is a message the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken presumptuously, so do not be alarmed.

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神把列国的民剪除了，耶和华你的神把他们的地赐给了你，你赶走了那些国民，住在他们的城市和房屋以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神把列国的民剪除了，耶和华你的神把他们的地赐给了你，你赶走了那些国民，住在他们的城市和房屋以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你神将列国之民剪除的时候，耶和华－你神也将他们的地赐给你，你接着住他们的城邑并他们的房屋，
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,
verses.textEnEsv: "When the Lord your God cuts off the nations whose land the Lord your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the Lord your God has cut off the nations whose land the Lord your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Lord your God destroys the nations whose land he is giving you, you will take over their land and settle in their towns and homes.
verses.textEnNasb: "When the Lord your God cuts off the nations whose land the Lord your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and settle in their cities and in their houses,
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,

verses.textZh: 你就要在耶和华你的神赐给你得为业的地上，为自己分别三座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要在耶和华你的神赐给你得为业的地上，为自己分别三座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要在耶和华－你神所赐你为业的地上分定三座城。
verses.textEnNiv: then set aside for yourselves three cities in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall separate three cities for yourself in the midst of your land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you must set apart three cities of refuge in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall set aside for yourself three cities in the midst of your land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEn: then set aside for yourselves three cities in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.

verses.textZh: 你要为自己预备道路，又要把耶和华你的神给你作产业的地分为三区，使误杀人的可以逃到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为自己预备道路，又要把耶和华你的神给你作产业的地分为三区，使误杀人的可以逃到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将耶和华－你神使你承受为业的地分为三段；又要预备道路，使误杀人的，都可以逃到那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Determine the distances involved and divide into three parts the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that a person who kills someone may flee for refuge to one of these cities.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall measure the distances and divide into three parts the area of the land that the Lord your God gives you as a possession, so that any manslayer can flee to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall prepare roads for yourself, and divide into three parts the territory of your land which the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, that any manslayer may flee there.
verses.textEnNlt: Survey the territory, and divide the land the Lord your God is giving you into three districts, with one of these cities in each district. Then anyone who has killed someone can flee to one of the cities of refuge for safety.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall prepare the roads for yourself, and divide into three regions the territory of your land which the Lord your God will give you as an inheritance, so that anyone who commits manslaughter may flee there.
verses.textEn: Determine the distances involved and divide into three parts the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that a person who kills someone may flee for refuge to one of these cities.

verses.textZh: "误杀人的逃到那里，就可以存活，规例是这样：无意杀了人，彼此又素无仇恨的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "误杀人的逃到那里，就可以存活，规例是这样：无意杀了人，彼此又素无仇恨的，
verses.textZhCuv: 「误杀人的逃到那里可以存活，定例乃是这样：凡素无仇恨，无心杀了人的，
verses.textEnNiv: This is the rule concerning anyone who kills a person and flees there for safety—anyone who kills a neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the provision for the manslayer, who by fleeing there may save his life. If anyone kills his neighbor unintentionally without having hated him in the past—
verses.textEnNkjv: "And this is the case of the manslayer who flees there, that he may live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, not having hated him in time past—
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone kills another person unintentionally, without previous hostility, the slayer may flee to any of these cities to live in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now this is the case of the one who commits manslaughter, who may flee there and live: when he kills his friend unintentionally, not hating him previously—
verses.textEn: This is the rule concerning anyone who kills a person and flees there for safety—anyone who kills a neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.

verses.textZh: 譬如他和邻舍同进森林砍伐树木，他手里挥着斧子砍伐树木的时候，斧头竟脱了把，落在邻舍身上，以致那人死了，他就可以逃到这些城中的一座去，这样他就可以活命，
verses.textZhCnvs: 譬如他和邻舍同进森林砍伐树木，他手里挥着斧子砍伐树木的时候，斧头竟脱了把，落在邻舍身上，以致那人死了，他就可以逃到这些城中的一座去，这样他就可以活命，
verses.textZhCuv: 就如人与邻舍同入树林砍伐树木，手拿斧子一砍，本想砍下树木，不料，斧头脱了把，飞落在邻舍身上，以致于死，这人逃到那些城的一座城，就可以存活，
verses.textEnNiv: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.
verses.textEnEsv: as when someone goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and his hand swings the axe to cut down a tree, and the head slips from the handle and strikes his neighbor so that he dies—he may flee to one of these cities and live,
verses.textEnNkjv: as when aman goes to the woods with his neighbor to cut timber, and his hand swings a stroke with the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and strikes his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live;
verses.textEnNlt: For example, suppose someone goes into the forest with a neighbor to cut wood. And suppose one of them swings an ax to chop down a tree, and the ax head flies off the handle, killing the other person. In such cases, the slayer may flee to one of the cities of refuge to live in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: as when a person goes into the forest with his friend to cut wood, and his hand swings the axe to cut down the tree, and the iron head slips off the handle and strikes his friend so that he dies—he may flee to one of these cities and live.
verses.textEn: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.

verses.textZh: 免得报血仇的，心中怒火如焚的时候，追赶那误杀人的，因为路途长远，就追上了他，把他杀死；其实他没有该死的罪，因为他和那人素无仇恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得报血仇的，心中怒火如焚的时候，追赶那误杀人的，因为路途长远，就追上了他，把他杀死；其实他没有该死的罪，因为他和那人素无仇恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得报血仇的，心中火热追赶他，因路远就追上，将他杀死；其实他不该死，因为他与被杀的素无仇恨。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.
verses.textEnEsv: lest the avenger of blood in hot anger pursue the manslayer and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him fatally, though the man did not deserve to die, since he had not hated his neighbor in the past.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest the avenger of blood, while his anger is hot, pursue the manslayer and overtake him, because the way is long, and kill him, though he was not deserving of death, since he had not hated the victim in time past.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the distance to the nearest city of refuge is too far, an enraged avenger might be able to chase down and kill the person who caused the death. Then the slayer would die unfairly, since he had never shown hostility toward the person who died.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in the heat of his anger, and overtake him because the way is long, and take his life, though he was not sentenced to death since he had not hated him previously.
verses.textEn: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.

verses.textZh: 因此我吩咐你：‘你要为自己分别三座城。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我吩咐你：‘你要为自己分别三座城。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我吩咐你说，要分定三座城。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I command you, You shall set apart three cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I command you, saying, ‘You shall separate three cities for yourself.’
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I am commanding you to set aside three cities of refuge.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I command you, saying, ‘You shall set aside for yourself three cities.’
verses.textEn: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.

verses.textZh: 如果耶和华你的神照着他向你列祖起过的誓，扩张你的境界，把他应许赐给你列祖的全地，都赐给了你，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果耶和华你的神照着他向你列祖起过的誓，扩张你的境界，把他应许赐给你列祖的全地，都赐给了你，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神若照他向你列祖所起的誓扩张你的境界，将所应许赐你列祖的地全然给你，
verses.textEnNiv: If the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your ancestors, and gives you the whole land he promised them,
verses.textEnEsv: And if the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land that he promised to give to your fathers—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now if the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you the land which He promised to give to your fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: "And if the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he swore to your ancestors, and gives you all the land he promised them,
verses.textEnNasb: "And if the Lord your God enlarges your territory, just as He has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land that He promised to give your fathers—
verses.textEn: If the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your ancestors, and gives you the whole land he promised them,

verses.textZh: 如果你谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的这一切诫命，爱耶和华你的神，常常行他的道路，你就要在这三座城以外，再加添三座城；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的这一切诫命，爱耶和华你的神，常常行他的道路，你就要在这三座城以外，再加添三座城；
verses.textZhCuv: 你若谨守遵行我今日所吩咐的这一切诫命，爱耶和华－你的神，常常遵行他的道，就要在这三座城之外，再添三座城，
verses.textEnNiv: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today—to love the Lord your God and to walk always in obedience to him—then you are to set aside three more cities.
verses.textEnEsv: provided you are careful to keep all this commandment, which I command you today, by loving the Lord your God and by walking ever in his ways— then you shall add three other cities to these three,
verses.textEnNkjv: and if you keep all these commandments and do them, which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to walk always in His ways, then you shall add three more cities for yourself besides these three,
verses.textEnNlt: you must designate three additional cities of refuge. (He will give you this land if you are careful to obey all the commands I have given you—if you always love the Lord your God and walk in his ways.)
verses.textEnNasb: if you carefully follow all of this commandment which I am commanding you today, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in His ways always—then you shall add three more cities for yourself, besides these three.
verses.textEn: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today—to love the Lord your God and to walk always in obedience to him—then you are to set aside three more cities.

verses.textZh: 免得无辜人的血，流在耶和华你的神要赐给你作产业的地上，以致流人血的罪归在你身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得无辜人的血，流在耶和华你的神要赐给你作产业的地上，以致流人血的罪归在你身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得无辜之人的血流在耶和华－你神所赐你为业的地上，流血的罪就归于你。
verses.textEnNiv: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.
verses.textEnEsv: lest innocent blood be shed in your land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance, and so the guilt of bloodshed be upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest innocent blood be shed in the midst of your land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and thus guilt of bloodshed be upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: That way you will prevent the death of innocent people in the land the Lord your God is giving you as your special possession. You will not be held responsible for the death of innocent people.
verses.textEnNasb: So innocent blood will not be shed in the midst of your land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and guilt for bloodshed will not be on you.
verses.textEn: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.

verses.textZh: "但是，如果有人恨他的邻舍，埋伏着等他，起来攻击他，把他杀死了，然后逃到这些城中的一座；
verses.textZhCnvs: "但是，如果有人恨他的邻舍，埋伏着等他，起来攻击他，把他杀死了，然后逃到这些城中的一座；
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有人恨他的邻舍，埋伏着起来击杀他，以致于死，便逃到这些城的一座城，
verses.textEnNiv: But if out of hate someone lies in wait, assaults and kills a neighbor, and then flees to one of these cities,
verses.textEnEsv: "But if anyone hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him and attacks him and strikes him fatally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if anyone hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises against him and strikes him mortally, so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose someone is hostile toward a neighbor and deliberately ambushes and murders him and then flees to one of the cities of refuge.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if there is a person who hates his neighbor, and waits in ambush for him and rises up against him and strikes him so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,
verses.textEn: But if out of hate someone lies in wait, assaults and kills a neighbor, and then flees to one of these cities,

verses.textZh: 他本城的长老要派人去，把他从那里带出来，交在报血仇的人手中，好把他处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他本城的长老要派人去，把他从那里带出来，交在报血仇的人手中，好把他处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 本城的长老就要打发人去，从那里带出他来，交在报血仇的手中，将他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: the killer shall be sent for by the town elders, be brought back from the city, and be handed over to the avenger of blood to die.
verses.textEnEsv: then the elders of his city shall send and take him from there, and hand him over to the avenger of blood, so that he may die.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him from there, and deliver him over to the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
verses.textEnNlt: In that case, the elders of the murderer’s hometown must send agents to the city of refuge to bring him back and hand him over to the dead person’s avenger to be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: then the elders of his city shall send men and take him from there, and hand him over to the avenger of blood, so that he may die.
verses.textEn: the killer shall be sent for by the town elders, be brought back from the city, and be handed over to the avenger of blood to die.

verses.textZh: 你的眼睛不可顾惜他，却要把流无辜人的血的罪从以色列中除掉，好使你平安无事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的眼睛不可顾惜他，却要把流无辜人的血的罪从以色列中除掉，好使你平安无事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你眼不可顾惜他，却要从以色列中除掉流无辜血的罪，使你可以得福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Show no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, so that it may be well with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall put away theguiltof innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not feel sorry for that murderer! Purge from Israel the guilt of murdering innocent people; then all will go well with you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not pity him, but you shall eliminate the guilt for the bloodshed of the innocent from Israel, so that it may go well for you.
verses.textEn: Show no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.

verses.textZh: "在耶和华你的神要赐给你承受为业的地上，不可挪移你邻舍的地界，因为那是先人立定的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在耶和华你的神要赐给你承受为业的地上，不可挪移你邻舍的地界，因为那是先人立定的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在耶和华－你神所赐你承受为业之地，不可挪移你邻舍的地界，那是先人所定的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not move your neighbor’s boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not move your neighbor’s landmark, which the men of old have set, in the inheritance that you will hold in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which the men of old have set, in your inheritance which you will inherit in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you arrive in the land the Lord your God is giving you as your special possession, you must never steal anyone’s land by moving the boundary markers your ancestors set up to mark their property.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not displace your neighbor’s boundary marker, which the ancestors have set, in your inheritance which you will inherit in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
verses.textEn: Do not move your neighbor’s boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.

verses.textZh: "人无论有甚么过错，或是犯了甚么罪恶，不可凭着一个见证人的指证，总要凭着两个见证人的口供，或是三个见证人的口供，才可以确定。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人无论有甚么过错，或是犯了甚么罪恶，不可凭着一个见证人的指证，总要凭着两个见证人的口供，或是三个见证人的口供，才可以确定。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人无论犯什么罪，作什么恶，不可凭一个人的口作见证，总要凭两三个人的口作见证才可定案。
verses.textEnNiv: One witness is not enough to convict anyone accused of any crime or offense they may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: "A single witness shall not suffice against a person for any crime or for any wrong in connection with any offense that he has committed. Only on the evidence of two witnesses or of three witnesses shall a charge be established.
verses.textEnNkjv: "One witness shall not rise against a man concerning any iniquity or any sin that he commits; by the mouth of two or three witnesses the matter shall be established.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not convict anyone of a crime on the testimony of only one witness. The facts of the case must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNasb: "A single witness shall not rise up against a person regarding any wrongdoing or any sin that he commits; on the testimony of two or three witnesses a matter shall be confirmed.
verses.textEn: One witness is not enough to convict anyone accused of any crime or offense they may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

verses.textZh: 如果有强横的见证人起来，指证某人作恶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有强横的见证人起来，指证某人作恶，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有凶恶的见证人起来，见证某人作恶，
verses.textEnNiv: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse someone of a crime,
verses.textEnEsv: If a malicious witness arises to accuse a person of wrongdoing,
verses.textEnNkjv: If a false witness rises against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
verses.textEnNlt: "If a malicious witness comes forward and accuses someone of a crime,
verses.textEnNasb: If a malicious witness rises up against a person to testify against him of wrongdoing,
verses.textEn: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse someone of a crime,

verses.textZh: 那么，两个彼此争讼的人，就要站在耶和华面前，和当时在职的祭司与审判官面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，两个彼此争讼的人，就要站在耶和华面前，和当时在职的祭司与审判官面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 这两个争讼的人就要站在耶和华面前，和当时的祭司，并审判官面前，
verses.textEnNiv: the two people involved in the dispute must stand in the presence of the Lord before the priests and the judges who are in office at the time.
verses.textEnEsv: then both parties to the dispute shall appear before the Lord , before the priests and the judges who are in office in those days.
verses.textEnNkjv: then both men in the controversy shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges who serve in those days.
verses.textEnNlt: then both the accuser and accused must appear before the Lord by coming to the priests and judges in office at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: then both people who have the dispute shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges who will be in office in those days.
verses.textEn: the two people involved in the dispute must stand in the presence of the Lord before the priests and the judges who are in office at the time.

verses.textZh: 审判官要仔细查问；如果见证人是个假证人，作假见证陷害自己的兄弟，
verses.textZhCnvs: 审判官要仔细查问；如果见证人是个假证人，作假见证陷害自己的兄弟，
verses.textZhCuv: 审判官要细细地查究，若见证人果然是作假见证的，以假见证陷害弟兄，
verses.textEnNiv: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against a fellow Israelite,
verses.textEnEsv: The judges shall inquire diligently, and if the witness is a false witness and has accused his brother falsely,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the judges shall make careful inquiry, and indeed, if the witness is a false witness, who has testified falsely against his brother,
verses.textEnNlt: The judges must investigate the case thoroughly. If the accuser has brought false charges against his fellow Israelite,
verses.textEnNasb: And the judges shall investigate thoroughly, and if the witness is a false witness and he has testified against his brother falsely,
verses.textEn: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against a fellow Israelite,

verses.textZh: 你们就要像他想怎样对待自己的兄弟一样对待他，这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就要像他想怎样对待自己的兄弟一样对待他，这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就要待他如同他想要待的弟兄。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: then do to the false witness as that witness intended to do to the other party. You must purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall do to him as he had meant to do to his brother. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall do to him as he thought to have done to his brother; so you shall put away the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: you must impose on the accuser the sentence he intended for the other person. In this way, you will purge such evil from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall do to him just as he had planned to do to his brother. So you shall eliminate the evil from among you.
verses.textEn: then do to the false witness as that witness intended to do to the other party. You must purge the evil from among you.

verses.textZh: 其余的人听见了，就必害怕，不敢再在你中间行这样的恶事了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的人听见了，就必害怕，不敢再在你中间行这样的恶事了。
verses.textZhCuv: 别人听见都要害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest shall hear and fear, and shall never again commit any such evil among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who remain shall hear and fear, and hereafter they shall not again commit such evil among you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the rest of the people will hear about it and be afraid to do such an evil thing.
verses.textEnNasb: And the rest of the people will hear and be afraid, and will never again do such an evil thing among you.
verses.textEn: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.

verses.textZh: 你的眼睛不可顾惜，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的眼睛不可顾惜，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你眼不可顾惜，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。」
verses.textEnNiv: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.textEnEsv: Your eye shall not pity. It shall be life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your eye shall not pity: life shallbe for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.textEnNlt: You must show no pity for the guilty! Your rule should be life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall not show pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, and foot for foot.
verses.textEn: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

verses.textZh: "你出去和你的仇敌作战的时候，看见马匹、车辆和比你多的人群，你不要怕他们，因为那把你们从埃及地领上来的耶和华你的神，与你同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你出去和你的仇敌作战的时候，看见马匹、车辆和比你多的人群，你不要怕他们，因为那把你们从埃及地领上来的耶和华你的神，与你同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你出去与仇敌争战的时候，看见马匹、车辆，并有比你多的人民，不要怕他们，因为领你出埃及地的耶和华－你神与你同在。
verses.textEnNiv: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt, will be with you.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you go out to war against your enemies, and see horses and chariots and an army larger than your own, you shall not be afraid of them, for the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses and chariots and people more numerous than you, do not be afraid of them; for the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you go out to fight your enemies and you face horses and chariots and an army greater than your own, do not be afraid. The Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, is with you!
verses.textEnNasb: "When you go out to battle against your enemies and see horses, chariots, and people more numerous than you, do not be afraid of them; for the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt, is with you.
verses.textEn: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt, will be with you.

verses.textZh: 你们快要上战场的时候，祭司要上前来，对人民说话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们快要上战场的时候，祭司要上前来，对人民说话，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们将要上阵的时候，祭司要到百姓面前宣告
verses.textEnNiv: When you are about to go into battle, the priest shall come forward and address the army.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you draw near to the battle, the priest shall come forward and speak to the people
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be, when you are on the verge of battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people.
verses.textEnNlt: When you prepare for battle, the priest must come forward to speak to the troops.
verses.textEnNasb: When you are approaching the battle, the priest shall come forward and speak to the people.
verses.textEn: When you are about to go into battle, the priest shall come forward and address the army.

verses.textZh: 对他们说：‘以色列人哪，你们要听，你们今日快要和仇敌作战，你们不要胆怯，不要惧怕，不要惊慌，不要因他们的缘故战兢；
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说：‘以色列人哪，你们要听，你们今日快要和仇敌作战，你们不要胆怯，不要惧怕，不要惊慌，不要因他们的缘故战兢；
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『以色列人哪，你们当听，你们今日将要与仇敌争战，不要胆怯，不要惧怕战兢，也不要因他们惊恐；
verses.textEnNiv: He shall say: "Hear, Israel: Today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not panic or be terrified by them.
verses.textEnEsv: and shall say to them, ‘Hear, O Israel, today you are drawing near for battle against your enemies: let not your heart faint. Do not fear or panic or be in dread of them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall say to them, ‘Hear, O Israel: Today you are on the verge of battle with your enemies. Do not let your heart faint, do not be afraid, and do not tremble or be terrified because of them;
verses.textEnNlt: He will say to them, ‘Listen to me, all you men of Israel! Do not be afraid as you go out to fight your enemies today! Do not lose heart or panic or tremble before them.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall say to them, ‘Hear, Israel, you are approaching the battle against your enemies today. Do not be fainthearted. Do not be afraid, or panic, or be terrified by them,
verses.textEn: He shall say: "Hear, Israel: Today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not panic or be terrified by them.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你们的神和你们同去，要为你们攻打你们的仇敌，要拯救你们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你们的神和你们同去，要为你们攻打你们的仇敌，要拯救你们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你们的神与你们同去，要为你们与仇敌争战，拯救你们。』
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory."
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord your God is he who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to give you the victory.’
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Lord your God is He who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.’
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God is going with you! He will fight for you against your enemies, and he will give you victory!’
verses.textEnNasb: for the Lord your God is the One who is going with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.’
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory."

verses.textZh: 官长也要对人民宣告：‘谁建造了新房屋，还没有行过奉献礼的，他可以回家去，恐怕他死在战场上，别人去为他的房屋行奉献礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 官长也要对人民宣告：‘谁建造了新房屋，还没有行过奉献礼的，他可以回家去，恐怕他死在战场上，别人去为他的房屋行奉献礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 官长也要对百姓宣告说：『谁建造房屋，尚未奉献，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去奉献。
verses.textEnNiv: The officers shall say to the army: "Has anyone built a new house and not yet begun to live in it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may begin to live in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the officers shall speak to the people, saying, ‘Is there any man who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go back to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man dedicate it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the officers shall speak to the people, saying: ‘What man isthere who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man dedicate it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the officers of the army must address the troops and say, ‘Has anyone here just built a new house but not yet dedicated it? If so, you may go home! You might be killed in the battle, and someone else would dedicate your house.
verses.textEnNasb: The officers also shall speak to the people, saying, ‘Who is the man that has built a new house but has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, otherwise he might die in the battle and another man would dedicate it.
verses.textEn: The officers shall say to the army: "Has anyone built a new house and not yet begun to live in it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may begin to live in it.

verses.textZh: 谁栽种了葡萄园，还没有享用过它的果子的，他可以回家去，恐怕他死在战场上，别人去享用它的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁栽种了葡萄园，还没有享用过它的果子的，他可以回家去，恐怕他死在战场上，别人去享用它的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁种葡萄园，尚未用所结的果子，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去用。
verses.textEnNiv: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.
verses.textEnEsv: And is there any man who has planted a vineyard and has not enjoyed its fruit? Let him go back to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man enjoy its fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also what man isthere who has planted a vineyard and has not eaten of it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man eat of it.
verses.textEnNlt: Has anyone here just planted a vineyard but not yet eaten any of its fruit? If so, you may go home! You might die in battle, and someone else would eat the first fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: And who is the man that has planted a vineyard but has not put it to use? Let him go and return to his house, otherwise he might die in the battle and another man would put it to use.
verses.textEn: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.

verses.textZh: 谁与女子订了婚，还没有迎娶的，他可以回家去，恐怕他死在战场上，别人去娶了她。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁与女子订了婚，还没有迎娶的，他可以回家去，恐怕他死在战场上，别人去娶了她。’
verses.textZhCuv: 谁聘定了妻，尚未迎娶，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去娶。』
verses.textEnNiv: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her."
verses.textEnEsv: And is there any man who has betrothed a wife and has not taken her? Let him go back to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man take her.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And what man isthere who is betrothed to a woman and has not married her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man marry her.’
verses.textEnNlt: Has anyone here just become engaged to a woman but not yet married her? Well, you may go home and get married! You might die in the battle, and someone else would marry her.’
verses.textEnNasb: And who is the man that is betrothed to a woman and has not married her? Let him go and return to his house, otherwise he might die in the battle and another man would marry her.’
verses.textEn: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her."

verses.textZh: 官长又要对人民宣告：‘谁是惧怕、胆怯的，他可以回家去，恐怕他使他兄弟的心融化，像他的心一样。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 官长又要对人民宣告：‘谁是惧怕、胆怯的，他可以回家去，恐怕他使他兄弟的心融化，像他的心一样。’
verses.textZhCuv: 官长又要对百姓宣告说：『谁惧怕胆怯，他可以回家去，恐怕他弟兄的心消化，和他一样。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then the officers shall add, "Is anyone afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his fellow soldiers will not become disheartened too."
verses.textEnEsv: And the officers shall speak further to the people, and say, ‘Is there any man who is fearful and fainthearted? Let him go back to his house, lest he make the heart of his fellows melt like his own.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "The officers shall speak further to the people, and say, ‘What man istherewhois fearful and fainthearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest the heart of his brethren faint like his heart.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the officers will also say, ‘Is anyone here afraid or worried? If you are, you may go home before you frighten anyone else.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the officers shall speak further to the people and say, ‘Who is the man that is afraid and fainthearted? Let him go and return to his house, so that he does not make his brothers’ hearts melt like his heart!’
verses.textEn: Then the officers shall add, "Is anyone afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his fellow soldiers will not become disheartened too."

verses.textZh: 官长对人民讲完了话，就要指派军官统率他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 官长对人民讲完了话，就要指派军官统率他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 官长对百姓宣告完了，就当派军长率领他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the officers have finished speaking to the people, then commanders shall be appointed at the head of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.
verses.textEnNlt: When the officers have finished speaking to their troops, they will appoint the unit commanders.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the officers have finished speaking to the people, they shall appoint commanders of armies at the head of the people.
verses.textEn: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.

verses.textZh: "你临近一座城，要攻打那城的时候，要先向那城提和议。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你临近一座城，要攻打那城的时候，要先向那城提和议。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你临近一座城、要攻打的时候，先要对城里的民宣告和睦的话。
verses.textEnNiv: When you march up to attack a city, make its people an offer of peace.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you draw near to a city to fight against it, offer terms of peace to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you go near a city to fight against it, then proclaim an offer of peace to it.
verses.textEnNlt: "As you approach a town to attack it, you must first offer its people terms for peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you approach a city to fight against it, you shall offer it terms of peace.
verses.textEn: When you march up to attack a city, make its people an offer of peace.

verses.textZh: 如果那城以和平的话回答你，给你开门，城里所有的人都要给你作苦工，服事你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那城以和平的话回答你，给你开门，城里所有的人都要给你作苦工，服事你。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若以和睦的话回答你，给你开了城，城里所有的人都要给你效劳，服事你；
verses.textEnNiv: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.
verses.textEnEsv: And if it responds to you peaceably and it opens to you, then all the people who are found in it shall do forced labor for you and shall serve you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that if they accept your offer of peace, and open to you, then all the people whoare found in it shall be placed under tribute to you, and serve you.
verses.textEnNlt: If they accept your terms and open the gates to you, then all the people inside will serve you in forced labor.
verses.textEnNasb: And if it agrees to make peace with you and opens to you, then all the people who are found in it shall become your forced labor and serve you.
verses.textEn: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.

verses.textZh: 如果那城不肯与你言和，却要与你作战，你就要围困那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那城不肯与你言和，却要与你作战，你就要围困那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不肯与你和好，反要与你打仗，你就要围困那城。
verses.textEnNiv: If they refuse to make peace and they engage you in battle, lay siege to that city.
verses.textEnEsv: But if it makes no peace with you, but makes war against you, then you shall besiege it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if thecity will not make peace with you, but makes war against you, then you shall besiege it.
verses.textEnNlt: But if they refuse to make peace and prepare to fight, you must attack the town.
verses.textEnNasb: However, if it does not make peace with you, but makes war against you, then you shall besiege it.
verses.textEn: If they refuse to make peace and they engage you in battle, lay siege to that city.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神把城交在你手里的时候，你要用利刃杀尽城里所有的男丁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神把城交在你手里的时候，你要用利刃杀尽城里所有的男丁。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神把城交付你手，你就要用刀杀尽这城的男丁。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Lord your God gives it into your hand, you shall put all its males to the sword,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Lord your God delivers it into your hands, you shall strike every male in it with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord your God hands the town over to you, use your swords to kill every man in the town.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord your God gives it into your hand, you shall strike all the men in it with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.

verses.textZh: 只有妇人、小孩子、牲畜和城里所有的一切，就是一切战利品，你都可以据为己有，你的仇敌的战利品，你都可以吃用，因为这是耶和华你的神赐给你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有妇人、小孩子、牲畜和城里所有的一切，就是一切战利品，你都可以据为己有，你的仇敌的战利品，你都可以吃用，因为这是耶和华你的神赐给你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有妇女、孩子、牲畜，和城内一切的财物，你可以取为自己的掠物。耶和华－你神把你仇敌的财物赐给你，你可以吃用。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the Lord your God gives you from your enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: but the women and the little ones, the livestock, and everything else in the city, all its spoil, you shall take as plunder for yourselves. And you shall enjoy the spoil of your enemies, which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, all its spoil, you shall plunder for yourself; and you shall eat the enemies’ plunder which the Lord your God gives you.
verses.textEnNlt: But you may keep for yourselves all the women, children, livestock, and other plunder. You may enjoy the plunder from your enemies that the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the women, the children, the animals, and everything that is in the city, all of its spoils, you shall take as plunder for yourself; and you shall use the spoils of your enemies which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEn: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the Lord your God gives you from your enemies.

verses.textZh: 离开你很远的各城，不是属于这些国民的城，你都要这样对待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 离开你很远的各城，不是属于这些国民的城，你都要这样对待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 离你甚远的各城，不是这些国民的城，你都要这样待他。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus you shall do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not cities of the nations here.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you shall do to all the cities whichare very far from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.
verses.textEnNlt: "But these instructions apply only to distant towns, not to the towns of the nations in the land you will enter.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what you shall do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not of the cities of these nations nearby.
verses.textEn: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.

verses.textZh: 只是在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的这些国民的城市里，凡有气息的，连一个你也不可让他活着；
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的这些国民的城市里，凡有气息的，连一个你也不可让他活着；
verses.textZhCuv: 但这些国民的城，耶和华－你神既赐你为业，其中凡有气息的，一个不可存留；
verses.textEnNiv: However, in the cities of the nations the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the cities of these peoples that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But of the cities of these peoples which the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance, you shall let nothing that breathes remain alive,
verses.textEnNlt: In those towns that the Lord your God is giving you as a special possession, destroy every living thing.
verses.textEnNasb: Only in the cities of these peoples that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, you shall not leave anything that breathes alive.
verses.textEn: However, in the cities of the nations the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.

verses.textZh: 只要照着耶和华你的神吩咐你的，把赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，完全灭绝；
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要照着耶和华你的神吩咐你的，把赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，完全灭绝；
verses.textZhCuv: 只要照耶和华－你神所吩咐的将这赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人都灭绝净尽，
verses.textEnNiv: Completely destroy them—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—as the Lord your God has commanded you.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall devote them to complete destruction, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites and the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites, as the Lord your God has commanded,
verses.textEnNkjv: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite and the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, just as the Lord your God has commanded you,
verses.textEnNlt: You must completely destroy the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, just as the Lord your God has commanded you.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, you shall utterly destroy them, the Hittite and the Amorite, the Canaanite and the Perizzite, the Hivite and the Jebusite, just as the Lord your God has commanded you,
verses.textEn: Completely destroy them—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—as the Lord your God has commanded you.

verses.textZh: 免得他们教导你们学习一切可憎的事，就是他们对自己的神所行的事，以致你们得罪耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得他们教导你们学习一切可憎的事，就是他们对自己的神所行的事，以致你们得罪耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得他们教导你们学习一切可憎恶的事，就是他们向自己神所行的，以致你们得罪耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may not teach you to do according to all their abominable practices that they have done for their gods, and so you sin against the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest they teach you to do according to all their abominations which they have done for their gods, and you sin against the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: This will prevent the people of the land from teaching you to imitate their detestable customs in the worship of their gods, which would cause you to sin deeply against the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: so that they will not teach you to do all the same detestable practices of theirs which they have done for their gods, by which you would sin against the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "如果你围困一座城，很久才能攻取占领它，你就不可挥斧破坏那里的树木；因为你可以吃树上的果子，却不可以砍伐树木。难道田间的树木是人，可以被你围困的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你围困一座城，很久才能攻取占领它，你就不可挥斧破坏那里的树木；因为你可以吃树上的果子，却不可以砍伐树木。难道田间的树木是人，可以被你围困的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若许久围困、攻打所要取的一座城，就不可举斧子砍坏树木；因为你可以吃那树上的果子，不可砍伐。田间的树木岂是人，叫你糟蹋吗？
verses.textEnNiv: When you lay siege to a city for a long time, fighting against it to capture it, do not destroy its trees by putting an ax to them, because you can eat their fruit. Do not cut them down. Are the trees people, that you should besiege them?
verses.textEnEsv: "When you besiege a city for a long time, making war against it in order to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an axe against them. You may eat from them, but you shall not cut them down. Are the trees in the field human, that they should be besieged by you?
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you besiege a city for a long time, while making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; if you can eat of them, do not cut them down to use in the siege, for the tree of the field is man’s food.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you are attacking a town and the war drags on, you must not cut down the trees with your axes. You may eat the fruit, but do not cut down the trees. Are the trees your enemies, that you should attack them?
verses.textEnNasb: "When you besiege a city for a long time, to make war against it in order to capture it, you shall not destroy its trees by swinging an axe against them; for you may eat from them, so you shall not cut them down. For is the tree of the field a human, that it should be besieged by you?
verses.textEn: When you lay siege to a city for a long time, fighting against it to capture it, do not destroy its trees by putting an ax to them, because you can eat their fruit. Do not cut them down. Are the trees people, that you should besiege them?

verses.textZh: 只有你知道不结果子的树木，你才可以毁坏砍伐，用来建造围城的设备，攻击那与你作战的城，直到把它攻下为止。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有你知道不结果子的树木，你才可以毁坏砍伐，用来建造围城的设备，攻击那与你作战的城，直到把它攻下为止。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独你所知道不是结果子的树木可以毁坏、砍伐，用以修筑营垒，攻击那与你打仗的城，直到攻塌了。」
verses.textEnNiv: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.
verses.textEnEsv: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food you may destroy and cut down, that you may build siegeworks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only the trees which you know are not trees for food you may destroy and cut down, to build siegeworks against the city that makes war with you, until it is subdued.
verses.textEnNlt: You may only cut down trees that you know are not valuable for food. Use them to make the equipment you need to attack the enemy town until it falls.
verses.textEnNasb: Only the trees that you know are not fruit trees you shall destroy and cut down, so that you may construct siegeworks against the city that is making war against you until it falls.
verses.textEn: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.

verses.textZh: "在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地上，如果发现有被杀的人，倒卧在田野，又不知道是谁杀死他的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地上，如果发现有被杀的人，倒卧在田野，又不知道是谁杀死他的，
verses.textZhCuv: 「在耶和华－你神所赐你为业的地上，若遇见被杀的人倒在田野，不知道是谁杀的，
verses.textEnNiv: If someone is found slain, lying in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who the killer was,
verses.textEnEsv: "If in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess someone is found slain, lying in the open country, and it is not known who killed him,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If anyone is found slain, lying in the field in the land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who killed him,
verses.textEnNlt: "When you are in the land the Lord your God is giving you, someone may be found murdered in a field, and you don’t know who committed the murder.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a person who has been killed by someone is found lying in the open country in the land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who struck him,
verses.textEn: If someone is found slain, lying in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who the killer was,

verses.textZh: 这样，你的长老和审判官就要出去，量一下从被杀的人那里到四周城市的距离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你的长老和审判官就要出去，量一下从被杀的人那里到四周城市的距离。
verses.textZhCuv: 长老和审判官就要出去，从被杀的人那里量起，直量到四围的城邑，
verses.textEnNiv: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.
verses.textEnEsv: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure the distance to the surrounding cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure thedistance from the slain man to the surrounding cities.
verses.textEnNlt: In such a case, your elders and judges must measure the distance from the site of the crime to the nearby towns.
verses.textEnNasb: then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure the distance to the cities which are around the one who was killed.
verses.textEn: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.

verses.textZh: 看看哪一座城离那被杀的人最近，那城的长老就要从牛群中取一只母牛犊，就是还没有耕过地、没有负过轭的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看看哪一座城离那被杀的人最近，那城的长老就要从牛群中取一只母牛犊，就是还没有耕过地、没有负过轭的。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪城离被杀的人最近，那城的长老就要从牛群中取一只未曾耕地、未曾负轭的母牛犊，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke
verses.textEnEsv: And the elders of the city that is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer that has never been worked and that has not pulled in a yoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that the elders of the city nearest to the slain man will take a heifer which has not been worked and which has not pulled with a yoke.
verses.textEnNlt: When the nearest town has been determined, that town’s elders must select from the herd a heifer that has never been trained or yoked to a plow.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be that the city which is nearest to the person killed, that is, that the elders of that city shall take a heifer of the herd that has not been worked and has not pulled in a yoke;
verses.textEn: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke

verses.textZh: 那城的长老要把母牛犊牵下去，到一个有活水长流的山谷，就是未曾耕种过、未曾撒过种的地方，在那里要打折母牛犊的颈项。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那城的长老要把母牛犊牵下去，到一个有活水长流的山谷，就是未曾耕种过、未曾撒过种的地方，在那里要打折母牛犊的颈项。
verses.textZhCuv: 把母牛犊牵到流水、未曾耕种的山谷去，在谷中打折母牛犊的颈项。
verses.textEnNiv: and lead it down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and where there is a flowing stream. There in the valley they are to break the heifer’s neck.
verses.textEnEsv: And the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.
verses.textEnNkjv: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with flowing water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and they shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.
verses.textEnNlt: They must lead it down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and that has a stream running through it. There in the valley they must break the heifer’s neck.
verses.textEnNasb: and the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which has not been plowed or sown, and they shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.
verses.textEn: and lead it down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and where there is a flowing stream. There in the valley they are to break the heifer’s neck.

verses.textZh: 利未支派的祭司的子孙要上前来，因为耶和华你的神拣选了他们事奉他，奉耶和华的名祝福。一切争讼和一切殴打的事，都要凭他们的话决定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未支派的祭司的子孙要上前来，因为耶和华你的神拣选了他们事奉他，奉耶和华的名祝福。一切争讼和一切殴打的事，都要凭他们的话决定。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司利未的子孙要近前来；因为耶和华－你的神拣选了他们事奉他，奉耶和华的名祝福，所有争讼殴打的事都要凭他们判断。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levitical priests shall step forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the Lord and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister to him and to bless in the name of the Lord , and by their word every dispute and every assault shall be settled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come near, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister to Him and to bless in the name of the Lord; by their word every controversy and every assault shall be settled.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Levitical priests must step forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in the Lord ’s name. They are to decide all legal and criminal cases.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, because the Lord your God has chosen them to serve Him and to bless in the name of the Lord; and every dispute and violent crime shall be settled by them.
verses.textEn: The Levitical priests shall step forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the Lord and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.

verses.textZh: 那城所有的长老，就是离那被杀的人最近的，都要在山谷中，在被折断颈项的母牛犊以上洗手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那城所有的长老，就是离那被杀的人最近的，都要在山谷中，在被折断颈项的母牛犊以上洗手。
verses.textZhCuv: 那城的众长老，就是离被杀的人最近的，要在那山谷中，在所打折颈项的母牛犊以上洗手，
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
verses.textEnNlt: "The elders of the town must wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the elders of that city which is nearest to the person killed shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley;
verses.textEn: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,

verses.textZh: 他们要声明，说：‘我们的手未曾流过这人的血，我们的眼也未曾看见这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要声明，说：‘我们的手未曾流过这人的血，我们的眼也未曾看见这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 祷告 说：『我们的手未曾流这人的血；我们的眼也未曾看见这事。
verses.textEnNiv: and they shall declare: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall testify, ‘Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it shed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall answer and say, ‘Our hands have not shed this blood, nor have our eyes seen it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they must say, ‘Our hands did not shed this person’s blood, nor did we see it happen.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall respond and say, ‘Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see who did.
verses.textEn: and they shall declare: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你赦免你的子民以色列，就是你救赎的，不要使流无辜人的血的罪归在你的子民以色列中间。’这样，他们流人血的罪就得到赦免了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你赦免你的子民以色列，就是你救赎的，不要使流无辜人的血的罪归在你的子民以色列中间。’这样，他们流人血的罪就得到赦免了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你赦免你所救赎的以色列民，不要使流无辜血的罪归在你的百姓以色列中间。』这样，流血的罪必得赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, Lord , and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent person." Then the bloodshed will be atoned for,
verses.textEnEsv: Accept atonement, O Lord , for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and do not set the guilt of innocent blood in the midst of your people Israel, so that their blood guilt be atoned for.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Provide atonement, O Lord, for Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, and do not lay innocent blood to the charge of Your people Israel.’ And atonement shall be provided on their behalf for the blood.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , forgive your people Israel whom you have redeemed. Do not charge your people with the guilt of murdering an innocent person.’ Then they will be absolved of the guilt of this person’s blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Forgive Your people Israel whom You have redeemed, Lord, and do not place the guilt for innocent blood in the midst of Your people Israel.’ And the guilt for bloodshed shall be forgiven them.
verses.textEn: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, Lord , and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent person." Then the bloodshed will be atoned for,

verses.textZh: 如果你行耶和华看为正的事，就可以从你中间除掉流无辜人的血的罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你行耶和华看为正的事，就可以从你中间除掉流无辜人的血的罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，就可以从你们中间除掉流无辜血的罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: and you will have purged from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So you shall purge the guilt of innocent blood from your midst, when you do what is right in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall put away the guiltof innocent blood from among you when you do whatis right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: By following these instructions, you will do what is right in the Lord ’s sight and will cleanse the guilt of murder from your community.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall remove the guilt for innocent blood from your midst, when you do what is right in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.textEn: and you will have purged from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你出去和仇敌作战的时候，耶和华你的神把他们交在你手里，你就把他们掳了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你出去和仇敌作战的时候，耶和华你的神把他们交在你手里，你就把他们掳了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你出去与仇敌争战的时候，耶和华－你的神将他们交在你手中，你就掳了他们去。
verses.textEnNiv: When you go to war against your enemies and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands and you take captives,
verses.textEnEsv: "When you go out to war against your enemies, and the Lord your God gives them into your hand and you take them captive,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you go out to war against your enemies, and the Lord your God delivers them into your hand, and you take them captive,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose you go out to war against your enemies and the Lord your God hands them over to you, and you take some of them as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the Lord your God hands them over to you and you take them away captive,
verses.textEn: When you go to war against your enemies and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands and you take captives,

verses.textZh: 如果你在被掳的人中看见了容貌美好的女子，就恋慕她，要娶她作妻子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你在被掳的人中看见了容貌美好的女子，就恋慕她，要娶她作妻子，
verses.textZhCuv: 若在被掳的人中见有美貌的女子，恋慕她，要娶她为妻，
verses.textEnNiv: if you notice among the captives a beautiful woman and are attracted to her, you may take her as your wife.
verses.textEnEsv: and you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you desire to take her to be your wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: and you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and desire her and would take her for your wife,
verses.textEnNlt: And suppose you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her and want to marry her.
verses.textEnNasb: and you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and are strongly attracted to her and would take her as a wife for yourself,
verses.textEn: if you notice among the captives a beautiful woman and are attracted to her, you may take her as your wife.

verses.textZh: 那么，你可以把她带进你的家里；她要剃头修甲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，你可以把她带进你的家里；她要剃头修甲，
verses.textZhCuv: 就可以领她到你家里去；她便要剃头发，修指甲，
verses.textEnNiv: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails
verses.textEnEsv: and you bring her home to your house, she shall shave her head and pare her nails.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall bring her home to your house, and she shall shave her head and trim her nails.
verses.textEnNlt: If this happens, you may take her to your home, where she must shave her head, cut her nails,
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall bring her into your home, and she shall shave her head and trim her nails.
verses.textEn: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails

verses.textZh: 脱去被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里，为自己的父母哀哭一个月，然后你才可以亲近她；你作她的丈夫，她作你的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 脱去被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里，为自己的父母哀哭一个月，然后你才可以亲近她；你作她的丈夫，她作你的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 脱去被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里哀哭父母一个整月，然后可以与她同房。你作她的丈夫，她作你的妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.
verses.textEnEsv: And she shall take off the clothes in which she was captured and shall remain in your house and lament her father and her mother a full month. After that you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
