verses.textEnNkjv: She shall put off the clothes of her captivity, remain in your house, and mourn her father and her mother a full month; after that you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
verses.textEnNlt: and change the clothes she was wearing when she was captured. She will stay in your home, but let her mourn for her father and mother for a full month. Then you may marry her, and you will be her husband and she will be your wife.
verses.textEnNasb: She shall also remove the clothes of her captivity and shall remain in your house, and weep for her father and mother a full month; and after that you may have relations with her and become her husband and she shall be your wife.
verses.textEn: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.

verses.textZh: 如果将来你不喜欢她，就要让她随意离去，决不可为了钱把她出卖，也不可以她为奴，因为你已经污辱了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果将来你不喜欢她，就要让她随意离去，决不可为了钱把她出卖，也不可以她为奴，因为你已经污辱了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来你若不喜悦她，就要由她随意出去，决不可为钱卖她，也不可当婢女待她，因为你玷污了她。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you no longer delight in her, you shall let her go where she wants. But you shall not sell her for money, nor shall you treat her as a slave, since you have humiliated her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall set her free, but you certainly shall not sell her for money; you shall not treat her brutally, because you have humbled her.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you marry her and she does not please you, you must let her go free. You may not sell her or treat her as a slave, for you have humiliated her.
verses.textEnNasb: But it shall be, if you are not pleased with her, then you shall let her go wherever she wishes; and you certainly shall not sell her for money, you shall not treat her as merchandise, since you have humiliated her.
verses.textEn: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.

verses.textZh: "如果人有两个妻子，一个是他喜爱的，一个是他不喜爱的，两个都给他生了儿子；但长子是他不喜爱的妻子生的；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人有两个妻子，一个是他喜爱的，一个是他不喜爱的，两个都给他生了儿子；但长子是他不喜爱的妻子生的；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若有二妻，一为所爱，一为所恶，所爱的、所恶的都给他生了儿子，但长子是所恶之妻生的。
verses.textEnNiv: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man has two wives, the one loved and the other unloved, and both the loved and the unloved have borne him children, and if the firstborn son belongs to the unloved,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man has two wives, one loved and the other unloved, and they have borne him children, both the loved and the unloved, and if the firstborn son is of her who is unloved,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a man has two wives, but he loves one and not the other, and both have given him sons. And suppose the firstborn son is the son of the wife he does not love.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a man has two wives, the one loved and the other unloved, and both the loved and the unloved have borne him sons, and the firstborn son belongs to the unloved,
verses.textEn: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,

verses.textZh: 到了他把所有的产业分给儿子承受的日子，他不可把他喜爱的妻子的儿子立为长子，排在他不喜爱的妻子的儿子以上，他才是长子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了他把所有的产业分给儿子承受的日子，他不可把他喜爱的妻子的儿子立为长子，排在他不喜爱的妻子的儿子以上，他才是长子；
verses.textZhCuv: 到了把产业分给儿子承受的时候，不可将所爱之妻生的儿子立为长子，在所恶之妻生的儿子以上，
verses.textEnNiv: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.
verses.textEnEsv: then on the day when he assigns his possessions as an inheritance to his sons, he may not treat the son of the loved as the firstborn in preference to the son of the unloved, who is the firstborn,
verses.textEnNkjv: then it shall be, on the day he bequeaths his possessions to his sons, that he must not bestow firstborn status on the son of the loved wife in preference to the son of the unloved, the true firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: When the man divides his inheritance, he may not give the larger inheritance to his younger son, the son of the wife he loves, as if he were the firstborn son.
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall be on the day that he wills what he owns as an inheritance to his sons, he is not allowed to treat the son of the loved wife as the firstborn, at the expense of the son of the unloved, who actually is the firstborn son.
verses.textEn: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.

verses.textZh: 却要承认他不喜爱的妻子的儿子为长子，把所有的产业分两分给他，因为这儿子是他强壮有力的时候所生的头生子，长子的权利本是属于他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却要承认他不喜爱的妻子的儿子为长子，把所有的产业分两分给他，因为这儿子是他强壮有力的时候所生的头生子，长子的权利本是属于他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 却要认所恶之妻生的儿子为长子，将产业多加一分给他；因这儿子是他力量强壮的时候生的，长子的名分本当归他。」
verses.textEnNiv: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father’s strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.
verses.textEnEsv: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the unloved, by giving him a double portion of all that he has, for he is the firstfruits of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he shall acknowledge the son of the unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double portion of all that he has, for he is the beginning of his strength; the right of the firstborn is his.
verses.textEnNlt: He must recognize the rights of his oldest son, the son of the wife he does not love, by giving him a double portion. He is the first son of his father’s virility, and the rights of the firstborn belong to him.
verses.textEnNasb: On the contrary, he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the unloved wife, by giving him a double portion of everything that he owns, for he was the beginning of his strength; to him belongs the right of the firstborn.
verses.textEn: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father’s strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.

verses.textZh: "如果人有忤逆倔强的儿子，不听从父母的话；父母管教他以后，他还是不听从；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人有忤逆倔强的儿子，不听从父母的话；父母管教他以后，他还是不听从；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若有顽梗悖逆的儿子，不听从父母的话，他们虽惩治他，他仍不听从，
verses.textEnNiv: If someone has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and, though they discipline him, will not listen to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and who, when they have chastened him, will not heed them,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey his father or mother, even though they discipline him.
verses.textEnNasb: "If any person has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father or his mother, and when they discipline him, he does not listen to them,
verses.textEn: If someone has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,

verses.textZh: 他的父母就要捉住他，把他带到当地的城门，去见本城的长老，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父母就要捉住他，把他带到当地的城门，去见本城的长老，
verses.textZhCuv: 父母就要抓住他，将他带到本地的城门、本城的长老那里，
verses.textEnNiv: his father and mother shall take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his town.
verses.textEnEsv: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city at the gate of the place where he lives,
verses.textEnNkjv: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city, to the gate of his city.
verses.textEnNlt: In such a case, the father and mother must take the son to the elders as they hold court at the town gate.
verses.textEnNasb: then his father and mother shall seize him, and bring him out to the elders of his city at the gateway of his hometown.
verses.textEn: his father and mother shall take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his town.

verses.textZh: 对本城的长老说：‘我们这个儿子忤逆倔强，不听从我们的话，是个贪食好酒的人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 对本城的长老说：‘我们这个儿子忤逆倔强，不听从我们的话，是个贪食好酒的人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 对长老说：『我们这儿子顽梗悖逆，不听从我们的话，是贪食好酒的人。』
verses.textEnNiv: They shall say to the elders, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard."
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall say to the elders of his city, ‘This our son is stubborn and rebellious; he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton and a drunkard.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall say to the elders of his city, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton and a drunkard.’
verses.textEnNlt: The parents must say to the elders, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious and refuses to obey. He is a glutton and a drunkard.’
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall say to the elders of his city, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not obey us, he is thoughtless and given to drinking.’
verses.textEn: They shall say to the elders, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard."

verses.textZh: 全城的人就要用石头打死他；这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除掉。以色列众人听见了，就都惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全城的人就要用石头打死他；这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除掉。以色列众人听见了，就都惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 本城的众人就要用石头将他打死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉，以色列众人都要听见害怕。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the men of his town are to stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the men of the city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall purge the evil from your midst, and all Israel shall hear, and fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones; so you shall put away the evil from among you, and all Israel shall hear and fear.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the men of his town must stone him to death. In this way, you will purge this evil from among you, and all Israel will hear about it and be afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the men of his city shall stone him to death; so you shall eliminate the evil from your midst, and all Israel will hear about it and fear.
verses.textEn: Then all the men of his town are to stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.

verses.textZh: "如果人犯了该死的罪，被处死以后，你就把他挂在木头上；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人犯了该死的罪，被处死以后，你就把他挂在木头上；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若犯该死的罪，被治死了，你将他挂在木头上，
verses.textEnNiv: If someone guilty of a capital offense is put to death and their body is exposed on a pole,
verses.textEnEsv: "And if a man has committed a crime punishable by death and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man has committed a sin deserving of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone has committed a crime worthy of death and is executed and hung on a tree,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if a person has committed a sin carrying a sentence of death and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
verses.textEn: If someone guilty of a capital offense is put to death and their body is exposed on a pole,

verses.textZh: 他的尸体不可留在树上过夜，必须在当日把他埋葬，因为被挂在木头上的，是受神咒诅的；这样，你就不至于玷污耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的尸体不可留在树上过夜，必须在当日把他埋葬，因为被挂在木头上的，是受神咒诅的；这样，你就不至于玷污耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的尸首不可留在木头上过夜，必要当日将他葬埋，免得玷污了耶和华－你神所赐你为业之地。因为被挂的人是在神面前受咒诅的。
verses.textEnNiv: you must not leave the body hanging on the pole overnight. Be sure to bury it that same day, because anyone who is hung on a pole is under God’s curse. You must not desecrate the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall bury him the same day, for a hanged man is cursed by God. You shall not defile your land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: his body shall not remain overnight on the tree, but you shall surely bury him that day, so that you do not defile the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance; for he who is hanged is accursed of God.
verses.textEnNlt: the body must not remain hanging from the tree overnight. You must bury the body that same day, for anyone who is hung is cursed in the sight of God. In this way, you will prevent the defilement of the land the Lord your God is giving you as your special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: his body is not to be left overnight on the tree, but you shall certainly bury him on the same day (for he who is hanged is cursed of God), so that you do not defile your land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: you must not leave the body hanging on the pole overnight. Be sure to bury it that same day, because anyone who is hung on a pole is under God’s curse. You must not desecrate the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

verses.textZh: "如果你看见你兄弟的牛或羊走迷了，你不可不理，总要把牠们牵回你的兄弟那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你看见你兄弟的牛或羊走迷了，你不可不理，总要把牠们牵回你的兄弟那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若看见弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯为不见，总要把它牵回来交给你的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: If you see your fellow Israelite’s ox or sheep straying, do not ignore it but be sure to take it back to its owner.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep going astray and ignore them. You shall take them back to your brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep going astray, and hide yourself from them; you shall certainly bring them back to your brother.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you see your neighbor’s ox or sheep or goat wandering away, don’t ignore your responsibility. Take it back to its owner.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not see your countryman’s ox or his sheep straying away, and avoid them; you shall certainly bring them back to your countryman.
verses.textEn: If you see your fellow Israelite’s ox or sheep straying, do not ignore it but be sure to take it back to its owner.

verses.textZh: 如果你的兄弟离你很远，或是你不认识他，你就要把牠牵到你家中，留在你那里，等到你的兄弟来寻找牠，你就还给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你的兄弟离你很远，或是你不认识他，你就要把牠牵到你家中，留在你那里，等到你的兄弟来寻找牠，你就还给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你弟兄若离你远，或是你不认识他，就要牵到你家去，留在你那里，等你弟兄来寻找就还给他。
verses.textEnNiv: If they do not live near you or if you do not know who owns it, take it home with you and keep it until they come looking for it. Then give it back.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he does not live near you and you do not know who he is, you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall stay with you until your brother seeks it. Then you shall restore it to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if your brother is not near you, or if you do not know him, then you shall bring it to your own house, and it shall remain with you until your brother seeks it; then you shall restore it to him.
verses.textEnNlt: If its owner does not live nearby or you don’t know who the owner is, take it to your place and keep it until the owner comes looking for it. Then you must return it.
verses.textEnNasb: And if your countryman is not near you, or if you do not know him, then you shall bring it to your house, and it shall remain with you until your countryman looks for it; then you shall restore it to him.
verses.textEn: If they do not live near you or if you do not know who owns it, take it home with you and keep it until they come looking for it. Then give it back.

verses.textZh: 对他的驴，你要这样行；对你的兄弟失去而被你找到的任何东西，你都要这样行，不可不理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他的驴，你要这样行；对你的兄弟失去而被你找到的任何东西，你都要这样行，不可不理。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的弟兄无论失落什么，或是驴，或是衣服，你若遇见，都要这样行，不可佯为不见。
verses.textEnNiv: Do the same if you find their donkey or cloak or anything else they have lost. Do not ignore it.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall do the same with his donkey or with his garment, or with any lost thing of your brother’s, which he loses and you find; you may not ignore it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall do the same with his donkey, and so shall you do with his garment; with any lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found, you shall do likewise; you must not hide yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: Do the same if you find your neighbor’s donkey, clothing, or anything else your neighbor loses. Don’t ignore your responsibility.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also do this with his donkey, and you shall do the same with his garment, and you shall do likewise with any lost property of your countryman, which has been lost by him and you have found. You are not allowed to avoid them.
verses.textEn: Do the same if you find their donkey or cloak or anything else they have lost. Do not ignore it.

verses.textZh: 如果你看见你兄弟的驴或牛跌倒在路上，你不可不理，总要帮助他把牠们拉起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你看见你兄弟的驴或牛跌倒在路上，你不可不理，总要帮助他把牠们拉起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若看见弟兄的牛或驴跌倒在路上，不可佯为不见，总要帮助他拉起来。
verses.textEnNiv: If you see your fellow Israelite’s donkey or ox fallen on the road, do not ignore it. Help the owner get it to its feet.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way and ignore them. You shall help him to lift them up again.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fall down along the road, and hide yourself from them; you shall surely help him lift them up again.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you see that your neighbor’s donkey or ox has collapsed on the road, do not look the other way. Go and help your neighbor get it back on its feet!
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not see your countryman’s donkey or his ox fallen down on the road, and avoid them; you shall certainly help him raise them up.
verses.textEn: If you see your fellow Israelite’s donkey or ox fallen on the road, do not ignore it. Help the owner get it to its feet.

verses.textZh: "妇女不可穿男子的服装；男子也不可穿妇人的衣服；因为这样作的人，都是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "妇女不可穿男子的服装；男子也不可穿妇人的衣服；因为这样作的人，都是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「妇女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿妇女的衣服，因为这样行都是耶和华－你神所憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: A woman must not wear men’s clothing, nor a man wear women’s clothing, for the Lord your God detests anyone who does this.
verses.textEnEsv: "A woman shall not wear a man’s garment, nor shall a man put on a woman’s cloak, for whoever does these things is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "A woman shall not wear anything that pertains to a man, nor shall a man put on a woman’s garment, for all who do so are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "A woman must not put on men’s clothing, and a man must not wear women’s clothing. Anyone who does this is detestable in the sight of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "A woman shall not wear a man’s clothing, nor shall a man put on a woman’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: A woman must not wear men’s clothing, nor a man wear women’s clothing, for the Lord your God detests anyone who does this.

verses.textZh: "如果你在路上遇见鸟窝，或是在树上，或是在地上；里面有雏鸟，或是有蛋；母鸟伏在雏鸟身上，或在蛋上；你不可连母带子一起取去；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你在路上遇见鸟窝，或是在树上，或是在地上；里面有雏鸟，或是有蛋；母鸟伏在雏鸟身上，或在蛋上；你不可连母带子一起取去；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若路上遇见鸟窝，或在树上或在地上，里头有雏或有蛋，母鸟伏在雏上或在蛋上，你不可连母带雏一并取去。
verses.textEnNiv: If you come across a bird’s nest beside the road, either in a tree or on the ground, and the mother is sitting on the young or on the eggs, do not take the mother with the young.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you come across a bird’s nest in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs and the mother sitting on the young or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a bird’s nest happens to be before you along the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, with the mother sitting on the young or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young;
verses.textEnNlt: "If you happen to find a bird’s nest in a tree or on the ground, and there are young ones or eggs in it with the mother sitting in the nest, do not take the mother with the young.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you happen to come upon a bird’s nest along the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs in it, and the mother sitting on the young or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young;
verses.textEn: If you come across a bird’s nest beside the road, either in a tree or on the ground, and the mother is sitting on the young or on the eggs, do not take the mother with the young.

verses.textZh: 总要让母鸟飞去，只可以取子；这样你就可以得着好处，得享长寿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总要让母鸟飞去，只可以取子；这样你就可以得着好处，得享长寿。
verses.textZhCuv: 总要放母，只可取雏；这样你就可以享福，日子得以长久。
verses.textEnNiv: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall let the mother go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may go well with you, and that you may live long.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall surely let the mother go, and take the young for yourself, that it may be well with you and that you may prolong your days.
verses.textEnNlt: You may take the young, but let the mother go, so that you may prosper and enjoy a long life.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall certainly let the mother go, but the young you may take for yourself, in order that it may go well for you and that you may prolong your days.
verses.textEn: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.

verses.textZh: "如果你建造新房屋，要在屋顶上作栏杆；免得有人从那里跌下来，流血的罪就归到你家。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你建造新房屋，要在屋顶上作栏杆；免得有人从那里跌下来，流血的罪就归到你家。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若建造房屋，要在房上的四围安栏杆，免得有人从房上掉下来，流血的罪就归于你家。
verses.textEnNiv: When you build a new house, make a parapet around your roof so that you may not bring the guilt of bloodshed on your house if someone falls from the roof.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof, that you may not bring the guilt of blood upon your house, if anyone should fall from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you build a new house, then you shall make a parapet for your roof, that you may not bring guilt of bloodshed on your household if anyone falls from it.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you build a new house, you must build a railing around the edge of its flat roof. That way you will not be considered guilty of murder if someone falls from the roof.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof, so that you will not bring guilt for bloodshed on your house if anyone falls from it.
verses.textEn: When you build a new house, make a parapet around your roof so that you may not bring the guilt of bloodshed on your house if someone falls from the roof.

verses.textZh: "不可把两样的种子撒在你的葡萄园里，免得你所种的全部收成和葡萄园的出产，都要被充公归与圣所 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可把两样的种子撒在你的葡萄园里，免得你所种的全部收成和葡萄园的出产，都要被充公归与圣所 。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可把两样种子种在你的葡萄园里，免得你撒种所结的和葡萄园的果子都要充公。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest the whole yield be forfeited, the crop that you have sown and the yield of the vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not sow your vineyard with different kinds of seed, lest the yield of the seed which you have sown and the fruit of your vineyard be defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not plant any other crop between the rows of your vineyard. If you do, you are forbidden to use either the grapes from the vineyard or the other crop.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, otherwise all the produce of the seed which you have sown and the yield of the vineyard will be forfeited to the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.

verses.textZh: 你不可用牛和驴一同耕地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可用牛和驴一同耕地。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可并用牛、驴耕地。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not plow with an ox and a donkey harnessed together.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
verses.textEn: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.

verses.textZh: 不可穿羊毛和细麻混合织成的布料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可穿羊毛和细麻混合织成的布料。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可穿羊毛、细麻两样搀杂料做的衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not wear cloth of wool and linen mixed together.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not wear a garment of different sorts, suchas wool and linen mixed together.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not wear clothing made of wool and linen woven together.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not wear a material of wool and linen combined together.
verses.textEn: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

verses.textZh: "你要在所披的外衣上，四边做繸子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要在所披的外衣上，四边做繸子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要在所披的外衣上四围做䍁子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make yourself tassels on the four corners of the garment with which you cover yourself.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make tassels on the four corners of the clothing with which you cover yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must put four tassels on the hem of the cloak with which you cover yourself—on the front, back, and sides.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall make yourself tassels on the four corners of your garment with which you cover yourself.
verses.textEn: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.

verses.textZh: "如果人娶妻，和她同房之后，就恨她，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人娶妻，和她同房之后，就恨她，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若娶妻，与她同房之后恨恶她，
verses.textEnNiv: If a man takes a wife and, after sleeping with her, dislikes her
verses.textEnEsv: "If any man takes a wife and goes in to her and then hates her
verses.textEnNkjv: "If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, and detests her,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a man marries a woman, but after sleeping with her, he turns against her
verses.textEnNasb: "If any man takes a wife and goes in to her and then turns against her,
verses.textEn: If a man takes a wife and, after sleeping with her, dislikes her

verses.textZh: 捏造可耻的事毁谤她，破坏她的名誉，说：‘我娶了这个女子，和她亲近的时候，发现她没有贞洁的凭据。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 捏造可耻的事毁谤她，破坏她的名誉，说：‘我娶了这个女子，和她亲近的时候，发现她没有贞洁的凭据。’
verses.textZhCuv: 信口说她，将丑名加在她身上，说：『我娶了这女子，与她同房，见她没有贞洁的凭据』；
verses.textEnNiv: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, "I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,"
verses.textEnEsv: and accuses her of misconduct and brings a bad name upon her, saying, ‘I took this woman, and when I came near her, I did not find in her evidence of virginity,’
verses.textEnNkjv: and charges her with shameful conduct, and brings a bad name on her, and says, ‘I took this woman, and when I came to her I found she was not a virgin,’
verses.textEnNlt: and publicly accuses her of shameful conduct, saying, ‘When I married this woman, I discovered she was not a virgin.’
verses.textEnNasb: and he charges her with shameful behavior and publicly defames her, and says, ‘I took this woman, but when I came near her, I did not find her to have evidence of virginity,’
verses.textEn: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, "I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,"

verses.textZh: 那少女的父母就要把那少女的贞洁凭据拿出来，带到城门去见本城的长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那少女的父母就要把那少女的贞洁凭据拿出来，带到城门去见本城的长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 女子的父母就要把女子贞洁的凭据拿出来，带到本城门长老那里。
verses.textEnNiv: then the young woman’s father and mother shall bring to the town elders at the gate proof that she was a virgin.
verses.textEnEsv: then the father of the young woman and her mother shall take and bring out the evidence of her virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the father and mother of the young woman shall take and bring out theevidenceof the young woman’s virginity to the elders of the city at the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the woman’s father and mother must bring the proof of her virginity to the elders as they hold court at the town gate.
verses.textEnNasb: then the girl’s father and her mother shall take and bring out the evidence of the girl’s virginity to the elders of the city at the gate.
verses.textEn: then the young woman’s father and mother shall bring to the town elders at the gate proof that she was a virgin.

verses.textZh: 少女的父亲要对长老说：‘我把我的女儿给这人作妻子，他却恨她，
verses.textZhCnvs: 少女的父亲要对长老说：‘我把我的女儿给这人作妻子，他却恨她，
verses.textZhCuv: 女子的父亲要对长老说：『我将我的女儿给这人为妻，他恨恶她，
verses.textEnNiv: Her father will say to the elders, "I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.
verses.textEnEsv: And the father of the young woman shall say to the elders, ‘I gave my daughter to this man to marry, and he hates her;
verses.textEnNkjv: And the young woman’s father shall say to the elders, ‘I gave my daughter to this man as wife, and he detests her.
verses.textEnNlt: Her father must say to them, ‘I gave my daughter to this man to be his wife, and now he has turned against her.
verses.textEnNasb: And the girl’s father shall say to the elders, ‘I gave my daughter to this man as a wife, but he turned against her;
verses.textEn: Her father will say to the elders, "I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.

verses.textZh: 捏造可耻的事毁谤她，说："我发现你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据。"其实这就是我女儿的凭据。’于是，他们就把衣服铺在那城的长老面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 捏造可耻的事毁谤她，说："我发现你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据。"其实这就是我女儿的凭据。’于是，他们就把衣服铺在那城的长老面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 信口说她，说：我见你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据；其实这就是我女儿贞洁的凭据。』父母就把那布铺在本城的长老面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Now he has slandered her and said, ‘I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.’ But here is the proof of my daughter’s virginity." Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,
verses.textEnEsv: and behold, he has accused her of misconduct, saying, "I did not find in your daughter evidence of virginity." And yet this is the evidence of my daughter’s virginity.’ And they shall spread the cloak before the elders of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he has charged her with shameful conduct, saying, "I found your daughter was not a virgin," and yet these aretheevidencesof my daughter’s virginity.’ And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: He has accused her of shameful conduct, saying, "I discovered that your daughter was not a virgin." But here is the proof of my daughter’s virginity.’ Then they must spread her bed sheet before the elders.
verses.textEnNasb: and behold, he has charged her with shameful behavior, saying, "I did not find your daughter to have evidence of virginity." But this is the evidence of my daughter’s virginity.’ And they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
verses.textEn: Now he has slandered her and said, ‘I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.’ But here is the proof of my daughter’s virginity." Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,

verses.textZh: 那城的长老要把那人捉住，惩罚他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那城的长老要把那人捉住，惩罚他，
verses.textZhCuv: 本城的长老要拿住那人，惩治他，
verses.textEnNiv: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and whip him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the elders of that city shall take that man and punish him;
verses.textEnNlt: The elders must then take the man and punish him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and rebuke him,
verses.textEn: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.

verses.textZh: 罚他一千一百四十克银子，交给那少女的父亲，因为他破坏了一个以色列处女的名誉；那少女仍要作他的妻子，终生不能休她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罚他一千一百四十克银子，交给那少女的父亲，因为他破坏了一个以色列处女的名誉；那少女仍要作他的妻子，终生不能休她。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要罚他一百舍客勒银子，给女子的父亲，因为他将丑名加在以色列的一个处女身上。女子仍作他的妻，终身不可休她。
verses.textEnNiv: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the father of the young woman, because he has brought a bad name upon a virgin of Israel. And she shall be his wife. He may not divorce her all his days.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver and give them to the father of the young woman, because he has brought a bad name on a virgin of Israel. And she shall be his wife; he cannot divorce her all his days.
verses.textEnNlt: They must also fine him 100 pieces of silver, which he must pay to the woman’s father because he publicly accused a virgin of Israel of shameful conduct. The woman will then remain the man’s wife, and he may never divorce her.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give it to the girl’s father, because he publicly defamed a virgin of Israel. And she shall remain his wife; he is not allowed to divorce her all his days.
verses.textEn: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.

verses.textZh: 但如果这事是真的，少女没有贞洁的凭据，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果这事是真的，少女没有贞洁的凭据，
verses.textZhCuv: 但这事若是真的，女子没有贞洁的凭据，
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, the charge is true and no proof of the young woman’s virginity can be found,
verses.textEnEsv: But if the thing is true, that evidence of virginity was not found in the young woman,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if the thing is true, andevidencesof virginity are not found for the young woman,
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose the man’s accusations are true, and he can show that she was not a virgin.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if this charge is true, and they did not find the girl to have evidence of virginity,
verses.textEn: If, however, the charge is true and no proof of the young woman’s virginity can be found,

verses.textZh: 就要把那少女带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头把她打死，因为她在以色列中作了丑事，在她父家行了淫乱；这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要把那少女带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头把她打死，因为她在以色列中作了丑事，在她父家行了淫乱；这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除去。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要将女子带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头将她打死；因为她在父家行了淫乱，在以色列中做了丑事。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: she shall be brought to the door of her father’s house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done an outrageous thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father’s house. You must purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnEsv: then they shall bring out the young woman to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done an outrageous thing in Israel by whoring in her father’s house. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: then they shall bring out the young woman to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done a disgraceful thing in Israel, to play the harlot in her father’s house. So you shall put away the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman must be taken to the door of her father’s home, and there the men of the town must stone her to death, for she has committed a disgraceful crime in Israel by being promiscuous while living in her parents’ home. In this way, you will purge this evil from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: then they shall bring the girl out to the doorway of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death, because she has committed a disgraceful sin in Israel by playing the prostitute in her father’s house; so you shall eliminate the evil from among you.
verses.textEn: she shall be brought to the door of her father’s house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done an outrageous thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father’s house. You must purge the evil from among you.

verses.textZh: "如果发现有人和有夫之妇同寝，就要把奸夫淫妇二人都处死；这样，你就把那恶从以色列中除掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果发现有人和有夫之妇同寝，就要把奸夫淫妇二人都处死；这样，你就把那恶从以色列中除掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: If a man is found sleeping with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man is found lying with the wife of another man, both of them shall die, the man who lay with the woman, and the woman. So you shall purge the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then both of them shall die—the man that lay with the woman, and the woman; so you shall put away the evil from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man is discovered committing adultery, both he and the woman must die. In this way, you will purge Israel of such evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a man is found sleeping with a married woman, then both of them shall die, the man who slept with the woman, and the woman; so you shall eliminate the evil from Israel.
verses.textEn: If a man is found sleeping with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.

verses.textZh: "如果有个少女，本来是处女，已经许配了人，有人在城里遇见了她，和她同寝，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有个少女，本来是处女，已经许配了人，有人在城里遇见了她，和她同寝，
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有处女已经许配丈夫，有人在城里遇见她，与她行淫，
verses.textEnNiv: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,
verses.textEnEsv: "If there is a betrothed virgin, and a man meets her in the city and lies with her,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a young woman whois a virgin is betrothed to a husband, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a man meets a young woman, a virgin who is engaged to be married, and he has sexual intercourse with her. If this happens within a town,
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is a girl who is a virgin betrothed to a man, and another man finds her in the city and sleeps with her,
verses.textEn: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,

verses.textZh: 你们就要把他们二人带到当地的城门口，用石头打死他们。那少女该死，是因为她虽在城里，却没有呼叫；那男人该死，是因为他玷污了邻舍的妻子；这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就要把他们二人带到当地的城门口，用石头打死他们。那少女该死，是因为她虽在城里，却没有呼叫；那男人该死，是因为他玷污了邻舍的妻子；这样，你就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死－女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫；男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death—the young woman because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man’s wife. You must purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones, the young woman because she did not cry for help though she was in the city, and the man because he violated his neighbor’s wife. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones, the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he humbled his neighbor’s wife; so you shall put away the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: you must take both of them to the gates of that town and stone them to death. The woman is guilty because she did not scream for help. The man must die because he violated another man’s wife. In this way, you will purge this evil from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city and you shall stone them to death: the girl, because she did not cry out for help though she was in the city, and the man, because he has violated his neighbor’s wife. So you shall eliminate the evil from among you.
verses.textEn: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death—the young woman because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man’s wife. You must purge the evil from among you.

verses.textZh: 如果有人在田间遇见了已经许配人的少女，拉住她，和她同寝，只要把那和她同寝的人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人在田间遇见了已经许配人的少女，拉住她，和她同寝，只要把那和她同寝的人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有男子在田野遇见已经许配人的女子，强与她行淫，只要将那男子治死。
verses.textEnNiv: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a young woman pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if in the open country a man meets a young woman who is betrothed, and the man seizes her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if a man finds a betrothed young woman in the countryside, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: "But if the man meets the engaged woman out in the country, and he rapes her, then only the man must die.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if the man finds the girl who is betrothed in the field, and the man seizes her and rapes her, then only the man who raped her shall die.
verses.textEn: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a young woman pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.

verses.textZh: 但你不可对付那少女，她并没有该死的罪。这件事就像一个人忽然起来攻击自己的邻舍，你把他杀了一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你不可对付那少女，她并没有该死的罪。这件事就像一个人忽然起来攻击自己的邻舍，你把他杀了一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但不可办女子；她本没有该死的罪，这事就类乎人起来攻击邻舍，将他杀了一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Do nothing to the woman; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders a neighbor,
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall do nothing to the young woman; she has committed no offense punishable by death. For this case is like that of a man attacking and murdering his neighbor,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall do nothing to the young woman; thereis in the young woman no sin deserving of death, for just as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: Do nothing to the young woman; she has committed no crime worthy of death. She is as innocent as a murder victim.
verses.textEnNasb: And you are not to do anything to the girl; there is no sin in the girl worthy of death, for just as a man rises against his neighbor and murders him, so is this case.
verses.textEn: Do nothing to the woman; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders a neighbor,

verses.textZh: 因为那人在田间遇见那少女，那已经许配人的少女呼叫了，却没有人救她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那人在田间遇见那少女，那已经许配人的少女呼叫了，却没有人救她。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为男子是在田野遇见那已经许配人的女子，女子喊叫，并无人救她。
verses.textEnNiv: for the man found the young woman out in the country, and though the betrothed woman screamed, there was no one to rescue her.
verses.textEnEsv: because he met her in the open country, and though the betrothed young woman cried for help there was no one to rescue her.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he found her in the countryside, and the betrothed young woman cried out, but therewas no one to save her.
verses.textEnNlt: Since the man raped her out in the country, it must be assumed that she screamed, but there was no one to rescue her.
verses.textEnNasb: When he found her in the field, the betrothed girl cried out, but there was no one to save her.
verses.textEn: for the man found the young woman out in the country, and though the betrothed woman screamed, there was no one to rescue her.

verses.textZh: "如果有人遇见一个少女，原是处女，还没有许配过人，就抓住她，和她同寝，又被人发现，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人遇见一个少女，原是处女，还没有许配过人，就抓住她，和她同寝，又被人发现，
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有男子遇见没有许配人的处女，抓住她，与她行淫，被人看见，
verses.textEnNiv: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man meets a virgin who is not betrothed, and seizes her and lies with her, and they are found,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man finds a young woman whois a virgin, who is not betrothed, and he seizes her and lies with her, and they are found out,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a man has intercourse with a young woman who is a virgin but is not engaged to be married. If they are discovered,
verses.textEnNasb: "If a man finds a girl who is a virgin, who is not betrothed, and he seizes her and has sexual relations with her, and they are discovered,
verses.textEn: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,

verses.textZh: 那和她同寝的人就要把五百七十克银子给那少女的父亲，那少女要归作他的妻子，因为他玷污了她；他终生不能休她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那和她同寝的人就要把五百七十克银子给那少女的父亲，那少女要归作他的妻子，因为他玷污了她；他终生不能休她。
verses.textZhCuv: 这男子就要拿五十舍客勒银子给女子的父亲；因他玷污了这女子，就要娶她为妻，终身不可休她。
verses.textEnNiv: he shall pay her father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the young woman, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.
verses.textEnEsv: then the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the young woman fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife, because he has violated her. He may not divorce her all his days.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the man who lay with her shall give to the young woman’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife because he has humbled her; he shall not be permitted to divorce her all his days.
verses.textEnNlt: he must pay her father fifty pieces of silver. Then he must marry the young woman because he violated her, and he may never divorce her as long as he lives.
verses.textEnNasb: then the man who had sexual relations with her shall give the girl’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall become his wife, because he has violated her; he is not allowed to divorce her all his days.
verses.textEn: he shall pay her father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the young woman, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.

verses.textZh: "人不可娶父亲的妻子，也不可揭开父亲的衣襟。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "人不可娶父亲的妻子，也不可揭开父亲的衣襟。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「人不可娶继母为妻；不可掀开他父亲的衣襟。」
verses.textEnNiv: A man is not to marry his father’s wife; he must not dishonor his father’s bed.
verses.textEnEsv: "A man shall not take his father’s wife, so that he does not uncover his father’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "A man shall not take his father’s wife, nor uncover his father’s bed.
verses.textEnNlt: "A man must not marry his father’s former wife, for this would violate his father.
verses.textEnNasb: " A man shall not take his father’s wife in marriage, so that he does not uncover his father’s garment.
verses.textEn: A man is not to marry his father’s wife; he must not dishonor his father’s bed.

verses.textZh: "睾丸受伤的，或生殖器被割除的，不可进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCnvs: "睾丸受伤的，或生殖器被割除的，不可进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡外肾受伤的，或被阉割的，不可入耶和华的会。
verses.textEnNiv: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "No one whose testicles are crushed or whose male organ is cut off shall enter the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who is emasculated by crushing or mutilation shall not enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man’s testicles are crushed or his penis is cut off, he may not be admitted to the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "No one who is emasculated or has his male organ cut off may enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEn: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 私生子不可进耶和华的会；他的后代直到第十代，也不可进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 私生子不可进耶和华的会；他的后代直到第十代，也不可进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCuv: 「私生子不可入耶和华的会；他的子孙，直到十代，也不可入耶和华的会。
verses.textEnNiv: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , not even in the tenth generation.
verses.textEnEsv: "No one born of a forbidden union may enter the assembly of the Lord . Even to the tenth generation, none of his descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "One of illegitimate birth shall not enter the assembly of the Lord; even to the tenth generation none of his descendants shall enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a person is illegitimate by birth, neither he nor his descendants for ten generations may be admitted to the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: No one of illegitimate birth may enter the assembly of the Lord; none of his descendants, even to the tenth generation, may enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEn: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , not even in the tenth generation.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人或摩押人不可进耶和华的会；他们的后代直到第十代，也永远不可进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人或摩押人不可进耶和华的会；他们的后代直到第十代，也永远不可进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚扪人或是摩押人不可入耶和华的会；他们的子孙，虽过十代，也永不可入耶和华的会。
verses.textEnNiv: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , not even in the tenth generation.
verses.textEnEsv: "No Ammonite or Moabite may enter the assembly of the Lord . Even to the tenth generation, none of them may enter the assembly of the Lord forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: "An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter the assembly of the Lord; even to the tenth generation none of his descendants shall enter the assembly of the Lord forever,
verses.textEnNlt: "No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants for ten generations may be admitted to the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: No Ammonite or Moabite may enter the assembly of the Lord; none of their descendants, even to the tenth generation, may ever enter the assembly of the Lord,
verses.textEn: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , not even in the tenth generation.

verses.textZh: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因为他们从两河之间的亚兰的毘夺雇了比珥的儿子巴兰，来攻击你，咒诅你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因为他们从两河之间的亚兰的毘夺雇了比珥的儿子巴兰，来攻击你，咒诅你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因他们雇了美索不达米亚的毗夺人比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。
verses.textEnNiv: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.
verses.textEnEsv: because they did not meet you with bread and with water on the way, when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they did not meet you with bread and water on the road when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
verses.textEnNlt: These nations did not welcome you with food and water when you came out of Egypt. Instead, they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in distant Aram-naharaim to curse you.
verses.textEnNasb: because they did not meet you with food and water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
verses.textEn: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华你的神不愿听从巴兰；耶和华你的神使咒诅的话变为你的祝福，因为耶和华你的神爱你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华你的神不愿听从巴兰；耶和华你的神使咒诅的话变为你的祝福，因为耶和华你的神爱你。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而耶和华－你的神不肯听从巴兰，却使那咒诅的言语变为祝福的话，因为耶和华－你的神爱你。
verses.textEnNiv: However, the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam; instead the Lord your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loved you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam, but the Lord your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord your God refused to listen to Balaam. He turned the intended curse into a blessing because the Lord your God loves you.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the Lord your God was unwilling to listen to Balaam, but the Lord your God turned the curse into a blessing for you because the Lord your God loves you.
verses.textEn: However, the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you.

verses.textZh: 你一生一世永不可寻求他们的平安和他们的福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一生一世永不可寻求他们的平安和他们的福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你一生一世永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not seek their peace or their prosperity all your days forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.
verses.textEnNlt: As long as you live, you must never promote the welfare and prosperity of the Ammonites or Moabites.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall never seek their peace or their prosperity all your days.
verses.textEn: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.

verses.textZh: "你不可厌恶以东人，因为他是你的兄弟；不可厌恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你不可厌恶以东人，因为他是你的兄弟；不可厌恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可憎恶以东人，因为他是你的弟兄。不可憎恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not despise an Edomite, for the Edomites are related to you. Do not despise an Egyptian, because you resided as foreigners in their country.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were a sojourner in his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were an alien in his land.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not detest the Edomites or the Egyptians, because the Edomites are your relatives and you lived as foreigners among the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not loathe an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not loathe an Egyptian, because you were a stranger in his land.
verses.textEn: Do not despise an Edomite, for the Edomites are related to you. Do not despise an Egyptian, because you resided as foreigners in their country.

verses.textZh: 他们所生的子孙到了第三代，就可以进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所生的子孙到了第三代，就可以进耶和华的会。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们第三代子孙可以入耶和华的会。」
verses.textEnNiv: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Children born to them in the third generation may enter the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of the third generation born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The third generation of Edomites and Egyptians may enter the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of the third generation who are born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你出兵安营攻打仇敌的时候，要谨守自己，远避一切恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你出兵安营攻打仇敌的时候，要谨守自己，远避一切恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你出兵攻打仇敌，就要远避诸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: When you are encamped against your enemies, keep away from everything impure.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you are encamped against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every evil thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the army goes out against your enemies, then keep yourself from every wicked thing.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you go to war against your enemies, be sure to stay away from anything that is impure.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you go out as an army against your enemies, you shall be on guard against every evil thing.
verses.textEn: When you are encamped against your enemies, keep away from everything impure.

verses.textZh: "如果你们中间有人因为夜间偶然梦遗而不洁净，就要出到营外去，不可进入营中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们中间有人因为夜间偶然梦遗而不洁净，就要出到营外去，不可进入营中。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们中间，若有人夜间偶然梦遗，不洁净，就要出到营外，不可入营；
verses.textEnNiv: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.
verses.textEnEsv: "If any man among you becomes unclean because of a nocturnal emission, then he shall go outside the camp. He shall not come inside the camp,
verses.textEnNkjv: If there is any man among you who becomes unclean by some occurrence in the night, then he shall go outside the camp; he shall not come inside the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: "Any man who becomes ceremonially defiled because of a nocturnal emission must leave the camp and stay away all day.
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is among you any man who is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, then he must go outside the camp; he may not reenter the camp.
verses.textEn: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.

verses.textZh: 到了黄昏的时候，他要用水洗澡；日落了，他才可以进入营中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了黄昏的时候，他要用水洗澡；日落了，他才可以进入营中。
verses.textZhCuv: 到傍晚的时候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入营。
verses.textEnNiv: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: but when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water, and as the sun sets, he may come inside the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it shall be, when evening comes, that he shall wash with water; and when the sun sets, he may come into the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: Toward evening he must bathe himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: But when evening approaches, he shall bathe himself with water, and at sundown he may reenter the camp.
verses.textEn: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.

verses.textZh: 你在营外要有厕所，你可以出到那里去便溺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在营外要有厕所，你可以出到那里去便溺。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你在营外也该定出一个地方作为便所。
verses.textEnNiv: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall have a place outside the camp, and you shall go out to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also you shall have a place outside the camp, where you may go out;
verses.textEnNlt: "You must have a designated area outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also have a place allocated outside the camp, so that you may go out there to relieve yourself,
verses.textEn: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.

verses.textZh: 在你的器械中，要有一把锹；你在外面便溺以后，可以用来铲土，转身把粪便掩盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你的器械中，要有一把锹；你在外面便溺以后，可以用来铲土，转身把粪便掩盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你器械之中当预备一把锹，你出营外便溺以后，用以铲土，转身掩盖。
verses.textEnNiv: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall have a trowel with your tools, and when you sit down outside, you shall dig a hole with it and turn back and cover up your excrement.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall have an implement among your equipment, and when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it and turn and cover your refuse.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of you must have a spade as part of your equipment. Whenever you relieve yourself, dig a hole with the spade and cover the excrement.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall have a spade among your tools, and it shall be when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it and shall turn and cover up your excrement.
verses.textEn: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你的神常在你的营中行走，要拯救你，要把你的仇敌交在你的面前；所以你的营要圣洁，免得他看见你那里有污秽的东西，就离开你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你的神常在你的营中行走，要拯救你，要把你的仇敌交在你的面前；所以你的营要圣洁，免得他看见你那里有污秽的东西，就离开你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你的神常在你营中行走，要救护你，将仇敌交给你，所以你的营理当圣洁，免得他见你那里有污秽，就离开你。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.
verses.textEnEsv: Because the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you and to give up your enemies before you, therefore your camp must be holy, so that he may not see anything indecent among you and turn away from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you and give your enemies over to you; therefore your camp shall be holy, that He may see no unclean thing among you, and turn away from you.
verses.textEnNlt: The camp must be holy, for the Lord your God moves around in your camp to protect you and to defeat your enemies. He must not see any shameful thing among you, or he will turn away from you.
verses.textEnNasb: Since the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp to save you and to defeat your enemies before you, your camp must be holy; so He must not see anything indecent among you or He will turn away from you.
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.

verses.textZh: "如果一个奴仆离开了他的主人，逃到你那里来，你不可把他送交他的主人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果一个奴仆离开了他的主人，逃到你那里来，你不可把他送交他的主人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有奴仆脱了主人的手，逃到你那里，你不可将他交付他的主人。
verses.textEnNiv: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand them over to their master.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not give up to his master a slave who has escaped from his master to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not give back to his master the slave who has escaped from his master to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If slaves should escape from their masters and take refuge with you, you must not hand them over to their masters.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not hand over to his master a slave who has escaped from his master to you.
verses.textEn: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand them over to their master.

verses.textZh: 他要在你中间和你同住，住在他自己选择的地方，住在他喜欢的城市，你不可欺负他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在你中间和你同住，住在他自己选择的地方，住在他喜欢的城市，你不可欺负他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必在你那里与你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他选择一个所喜悦的地方居住；你不可欺负他。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them live among you wherever they like and in whatever town they choose. Do not oppress them.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall dwell with you, in your midst, in the place that he shall choose within one of your towns, wherever it suits him. You shall not wrong him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He may dwell with you in your midst, in the place which he chooses within one of your gates, where it seems best to him; you shall not oppress him.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them live among you in any town they choose, and do not oppress them.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall live with you in your midst, in the place that he chooses in one of your towns where it pleases him; you shall not mistreat him.
verses.textEn: Let them live among you wherever they like and in whatever town they choose. Do not oppress them.

verses.textZh: "以色列的女子中不可有庙妓，以色列的男子中不可有男庙妓。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列的女子中不可有庙妓，以色列的男子中不可有男庙妓。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列的女子中不可有妓女；以色列的男子中不可有娈童。
verses.textEnNiv: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.
verses.textEnEsv: "None of the daughters of Israel shall be a cult prostitute, and none of the sons of Israel shall be a cult prostitute.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There shall be no ritual harlot of the daughters of Israel, or a perverted one of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "No Israelite, whether man or woman, may become a temple prostitute.
verses.textEnNasb: "None of the daughters of Israel shall be a cult prostitute, nor shall any of the sons of Israel be a cult prostitute.
verses.textEn: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.

verses.textZh: 妓女所得的酬金，或男妓所得的代价，你不可带入耶和华你的神的殿里还任何的愿，因为这两样都是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妓女所得的酬金，或男妓所得的代价，你不可带入耶和华你的神的殿里还任何的愿，因为这两样都是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 娼妓所得的钱，或娈童 所得的价，你不可带入耶和华－你神的殿还愿，因为这两样都是耶和华－你神所憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the Lord your God to pay any vow, because the Lord your God detests them both.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not bring the fee of a prostitute or the wages of a dog into the house of the Lord your God in payment for any vow, for both of these are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not bring the wages of a harlot or the price of a dog to the house of the Lord your God for any vowed offering, for both of these are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: When you are bringing an offering to fulfill a vow, you must not bring to the house of the Lord your God any offering from the earnings of a prostitute, whether a man or a woman, for both are detestable to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not bring the earnings of a prostitute or the money for a dog into the house of the Lord your God as payment for any vowed offering, because both of these are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the Lord your God to pay any vow, because the Lord your God detests them both.

verses.textZh: 你借给你兄弟的银钱、食物，或是任何可以生利的东西，都不可取利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你借给你兄弟的银钱、食物，或是任何可以生利的东西，都不可取利。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你借给你弟兄的，或是钱财或是粮食，无论什么可生利的物，都不可取利。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not charge a fellow Israelite interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not charge interest on loans to your brother, interest on money, interest on food, interest on anything that is lent for interest.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not charge interest to your brother—interest on money or food or anything that is lent out at interest.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not charge interest on the loans you make to a fellow Israelite, whether you loan money, or food, or anything else.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are not to charge interest to your countrymen: interest on money, food, or anything that may be loaned on interest.
verses.textEn: Do not charge a fellow Israelite interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.

verses.textZh: 借给外族人，你倒可以取利；只是借给你的兄弟，你就不可取利；好使耶和华你的神，在你要去得为业的地上，和你手里所办的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 借给外族人，你倒可以取利；只是借给你的兄弟，你就不可取利；好使耶和华你的神，在你要去得为业的地上，和你手里所办的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 借给外邦人可以取利，只是借给你弟兄不可取利。这样，耶和华－你神必在你所去得为业的地上和你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
verses.textEnNiv: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a fellow Israelite, so that the Lord your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: You may charge a foreigner interest, but you may not charge your brother interest, that the Lord your God may bless you in all that you undertake in the land that you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: To a foreigner you may charge interest, but to your brother you shall not charge interest, that the Lord your God may bless you in all to which you set your hand in the land which you are entering to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: You may charge interest to foreigners, but you may not charge interest to Israelites, so that the Lord your God may bless you in everything you do in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: You may charge interest to a foreigner, but to your countrymen you shall not charge interest, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all that you undertake in the land which you are about to enter to possess.
verses.textEn: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a fellow Israelite, so that the Lord your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.

verses.textZh: "如果你向耶和华你的神许了愿，就不可迟延还愿，因为耶和华你的神必向你追讨，那时你就有罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你向耶和华你的神许了愿，就不可迟延还愿，因为耶和华你的神必向你追讨，那时你就有罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你向耶和华－你的神许愿，偿还不可迟延；因为耶和华－你的神必定向你追讨，你不偿还就有罪。
verses.textEnNiv: If you make a vow to the Lord your God, do not be slow to pay it, for the Lord your God will certainly demand it of you and you will be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you make a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay fulfilling it, for the Lord your God will surely require it of you, and you will be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you make a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay to pay it; for the Lord your God will surely require it of you, and it would be sin to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you make a vow to the Lord your God, be prompt in fulfilling whatever you promised him. For the Lord your God demands that you promptly fulfill all your vows, or you will be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you make a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay to pay it, for the Lord your God will certainly require it of you, and it will be a sin for you.
verses.textEn: If you make a vow to the Lord your God, do not be slow to pay it, for the Lord your God will certainly demand it of you and you will be guilty of sin.

verses.textZh: 如果你不许愿，你倒没有罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你不许愿，你倒没有罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若不许愿，倒无罪。
verses.textEnNiv: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you refrain from vowing, you will not be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you abstain from vowing, it shall not be sin to you.
verses.textEnNlt: However, it is not a sin to refrain from making a vow.
verses.textEnNasb: However, if you refrain from making vows, it will not be a sin for you.
verses.textEn: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.

verses.textZh: 你嘴里说出来的，你要谨守；你亲口应许的甘心祭，就是你向耶和华你的神许的愿，你要实行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你嘴里说出来的，你要谨守；你亲口应许的甘心祭，就是你向耶和华你的神许的愿，你要实行。
verses.textZhCuv: 你嘴里所出的，就是你口中应许甘心所献的，要照你向耶和华－你神所许的愿谨守遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever your lips utter you must be sure to do, because you made your vow freely to the Lord your God with your own mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be careful to do what has passed your lips, for you have voluntarily vowed to the Lord your God what you have promised with your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: That which has gone from your lips you shall keep and perform, for you voluntarily vowed to the Lord your God what you have promised with your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: But once you have voluntarily made a vow, be careful to fulfill your promise to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall be careful and perform what goes out of your lips, since in fact you have vowed a voluntary offering to the Lord your God, whatever you have promised.
verses.textEn: Whatever your lips utter you must be sure to do, because you made your vow freely to the Lord your God with your own mouth.

verses.textZh: "你进了你邻舍的葡萄园，你可以随意吃饱葡萄，只是不可装在你的器皿里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你进了你邻舍的葡萄园，你可以随意吃饱葡萄，只是不可装在你的器皿里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你进了邻舍的葡萄园，可以随意吃饱了葡萄，只是不可装在器皿中。
verses.textEnNiv: If you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but do not put any in your basket.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you go into your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, as many as you wish, but you shall not put any in your bag.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes at your pleasure, but you shall not put any in your container.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, but you must not carry any away in a basket.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat grapes until you are satisfied; but you are not to put any in your basket.
verses.textEn: If you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but do not put any in your basket.

verses.textZh: 你进了你邻舍的麦田，你可以用手摘麦穗，只是不可在你邻舍的麦田里挥动镰刀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你进了你邻舍的麦田，你可以用手摘麦穗，只是不可在你邻舍的麦田里挥动镰刀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你进了邻舍站着的禾稼，可以用手摘穗子，只是不可用镰刀割取禾稼。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pick kernels with your hands, but you must not put a sickle to their standing grain.
verses.textEnEsv: If you go into your neighbor’s standing grain, you may pluck the ears with your hand, but you shall not put a sickle to your neighbor’s standing grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, you may pluck the heads with your hand, but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
verses.textEnNlt: And when you enter your neighbor’s field of grain, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you must not harvest it with a sickle.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you enter your neighbor’s standing grain, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you are not to use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
verses.textEn: If you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pick kernels with your hands, but you must not put a sickle to their standing grain.

verses.textZh: "人娶了妻子，得着她以后，如果发现她有丑事，以致不喜悦她，他就可以给她写休书，交在她手里，叫她离开夫家；
verses.textZhCnvs: "人娶了妻子，得着她以后，如果发现她有丑事，以致不喜悦她，他就可以给她写休书，交在她手里，叫她离开夫家；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若娶妻以后，见她有什么不合理的事，不喜悦她，就可以写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家。
verses.textEnNiv: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man takes a wife and marries her, if then she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some indecency in her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce and puts it in her hand and sends her out of his house, and she departs out of his house,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it happens that she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some uncleanness in her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a man marries a woman but she does not please him. Having discovered something wrong with her, he writes a document of divorce, hands it to her, and sends her away from his house.
verses.textEnNasb: "When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it happens, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some indecency in her, that he writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her away from his house,
verses.textEn: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,

verses.textZh: 她离开夫家以后，就可以去再嫁别人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她离开夫家以后，就可以去再嫁别人。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人离开夫家以后，可以去嫁别人。
verses.textEnNiv: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,
verses.textEnEsv: and if she goes and becomes another man’s wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: when she has departed from his house, and goes and becomes another man’s wife,
verses.textEnNlt: When she leaves his house, she is free to marry another man.
verses.textEnNasb: and she leaves his house and goes and becomes another man’s wife,
verses.textEn: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,

verses.textZh: 如果后夫又恨她，也给她写休书，交在她手里，叫她离开他的家；或者娶她为妻的后夫死了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果后夫又恨她，也给她写休书，交在她手里，叫她离开他的家；或者娶她为妻的后夫死了；
verses.textZhCuv: 后夫若恨恶她，写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家，或是娶她为妻的后夫死了，
verses.textEnNiv: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,
verses.textEnEsv: and the latter man hates her and writes her a certificate of divorce and puts it in her hand and sends her out of his house, or if the latter man dies, who took her to be his wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: if the latter husband detests her and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house, or if the latter husband dies who took her as his wife,
verses.textEnNlt: But if the second husband also turns against her, writes a document of divorce, hands it to her, and sends her away, or if he dies,
verses.textEnNasb: and the latter husband turns against her, writes her a certificate of divorce and puts it in her hand, and sends her away from his house, or if the latter husband who took her to be his wife dies,
verses.textEn: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,

verses.textZh: 那么，叫她离开的前夫，不可在她受了污辱以后，再娶她为妻，因为这在耶和华面前是可厌可恶的事；你不可使耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的土地蒙受罪污。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，叫她离开的前夫，不可在她受了污辱以后，再娶她为妻，因为这在耶和华面前是可厌可恶的事；你不可使耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的土地蒙受罪污。
verses.textZhCuv: 打发她去的前夫不可在妇人玷污之后再娶她为妻，因为这是耶和华所憎恶的；不可使耶和华－你神所赐为业之地被玷污了。」
verses.textEnNiv: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the Lord . Do not bring sin upon the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: then her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination before the Lord . And you shall not bring sin upon the land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: then her former husband who divorced her must not take her back to be his wife after she has been defiled; for that is an abomination before the Lord, and you shall not bring sin on the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: the first husband may not marry her again, for she has been defiled. That would be detestable to the Lord . You must not bring guilt upon the land the Lord your God is giving you as a special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: then her former husband who sent her away is not allowed to take her again to be his wife, after she has been defiled; for that is an abomination before the Lord, and you shall not bring sin on the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the Lord . Do not bring sin upon the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

verses.textZh: "如果人娶了新妇，不可从军出征，也不可派他担任甚么公务，他可以在家赋闲一年，使他所娶的妻子快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人娶了新妇，不可从军出征，也不可派他担任甚么公务，他可以在家赋闲一年，使他所娶的妻子快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 「新娶妻之人不可从军出征，也不可托他办理什么公事，可以在家清闲一年，使他所娶的妻快活。
verses.textEnNiv: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man is newly married, he shall not go out with the army or be liable for any other public duty. He shall be free at home one year to be happy with his wife whom he has taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When a man has taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war or be charged with any business; he shall be free at home one year, and bring happiness to his wife whom he has taken.
verses.textEnNlt: "A newly married man must not be drafted into the army or be given any other official responsibilities. He must be free to spend one year at home, bringing happiness to the wife he has married.
verses.textEnNasb: "When a man takes a new wife, he is not to go out with the army, nor be assigned any duty; he shall be free at home for one year and shall make his wife whom he has taken happy.
verses.textEn: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.

verses.textZh: "不可拿人的磨，或是上磨石作抵押，因为这等于拿人的生命作抵押。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可拿人的磨，或是上磨石作抵押，因为这等于拿人的生命作抵押。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可拿人的全盘磨石或是上磨石作当头，因为这是拿人的命作当头。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take a pair of millstones—not even the upper one—as security for a debt, because that would be taking a person’s livelihood as security.
