verses.textEnEsv: "No one shall take a mill or an upper millstone in pledge, for that would be taking a life in pledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No man shall take the lower or the upper millstone in pledge, for he takes one’s living in pledge.
verses.textEnNlt: "It is wrong to take a set of millstones, or even just the upper millstone, as security for a loan, for the owner uses it to make a living.
verses.textEnNasb: "No one shall seize a handmill or an upper millstone as a pledge for a loan, since he would be seizing the debtor’s means of life as a pledge.
verses.textEn: Do not take a pair of millstones—not even the upper one—as security for a debt, because that would be taking a person’s livelihood as security.

verses.textZh: "如果发现有人拐带了以色列人的一个兄弟，把他当作奴隶看待，或是把他卖了，那拐带人的就要处死；这样，你就把那恶从你中间除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果发现有人拐带了以色列人的一个兄弟，把他当作奴隶看待，或是把他卖了，那拐带人的就要处死；这样，你就把那恶从你中间除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若遇见人拐带以色列中的一个弟兄，当奴才待他，或是卖了他，那拐带人的就必治死。这样，便将那恶从你们中间除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: If someone is caught kidnapping a fellow Israelite and treating or selling them as a slave, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man is found stealing one of his brothers of the people of Israel, and if he treats him as a slave or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man is found kidnapping any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and mistreats him or sells him, then that kidnapper shall die; and you shall put away the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If anyone kidnaps a fellow Israelite and treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. In this way, you will purge the evil from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: "If someone is caught kidnapping any of his countrymen of the sons of Israel, and he treats him as merchandise and sells him, then that thief shall die; so you shall eliminate the evil from among you.
verses.textEn: If someone is caught kidnapping a fellow Israelite and treating or selling them as a slave, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.

verses.textZh: "在大痲风的灾病上，你要谨慎自己，照利未支派的祭司指教你们的一切，认真地谨守遵行；我怎样吩咐了他们，你们就要怎样谨守遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在大痲风的灾病上，你要谨慎自己，照利未支派的祭司指教你们的一切，认真地谨守遵行；我怎样吩咐了他们，你们就要怎样谨守遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在大麻风的灾病上，你们要谨慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你们的留意遵行。我怎样吩咐他们，你们要怎样遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: In cases of defiling skin diseases, be very careful to do exactly as the Levitical priests instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take care, in a case of leprous disease, to be very careful to do according to all that the Levitical priests shall direct you. As I commanded them, so you shall be careful to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take heed in an outbreak of leprosy, that you carefully observe and do according to all that the priests, the Levites, shall teach you; just as I commanded them, so you shall be careful to do.
verses.textEnNlt: "In all cases involving serious skin diseases, be careful to follow the instructions of the Levitical priests; obey all the commands I have given them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be careful about an infestation of leprosy, that you are very attentive and act in accordance with everything that the Levitical priests teach you; just as I have commanded them, you shall be careful to act.
verses.textEn: In cases of defiling skin diseases, be very careful to do exactly as the Levitical priests instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.

verses.textZh: 你当记得你们出了埃及，在路上的时候，耶和华你的神向米利暗所行的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你当记得你们出了埃及，在路上的时候，耶和华你的神向米利暗所行的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 当记念出埃及后，在路上，耶和华－你神向米利暗所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam on the way as you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam on the way when you came out of Egypt!
verses.textEnNlt: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam as you were coming from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam on the way as you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: "如果你借东西给你的邻舍，不论所借的是甚么，总不可走进他的家里去拿抵押。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你借东西给你的邻舍，不论所借的是甚么，总不可走进他的家里去拿抵押。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你借给邻舍，不拘是什么，不可进他家拿他的当头。
verses.textEnNiv: When you make a loan of any kind to your neighbor, do not go into their house to get what is offered to you as a pledge.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you make your neighbor a loan of any sort, you shall not go into his house to collect his pledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you lend your brother anything, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you lend anything to your neighbor, do not enter his house to pick up the item he is giving as security.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you make your neighbor a loan of any kind, you shall not enter his house to take his pledge.
verses.textEn: When you make a loan of any kind to your neighbor, do not go into their house to get what is offered to you as a pledge.

verses.textZh: 你要站在外面，等那向你借贷的人把抵押拿出来给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要站在外面，等那向你借贷的人把抵押拿出来给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 要站在外面，等那向你借贷的人把当头拿出来交给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Stay outside and let the neighbor to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you make the loan shall bring the pledge out to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge out to you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must wait outside while he goes in and brings it out to you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall stand outside, and the person to whom you are making the loan shall bring the pledge outside to you.
verses.textEn: Stay outside and let the neighbor to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.

verses.textZh: 他若是个穷人，你不可留他的抵押过夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若是个穷人，你不可留他的抵押过夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若是穷人，你不可留他的当头过夜。
verses.textEnNiv: If the neighbor is poor, do not go to sleep with their pledge in your possession.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he is a poor man, you shall not sleep in his pledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if the man is poor, you shall not keep his pledge overnight.
verses.textEnNlt: If your neighbor is poor and gives you his cloak as security for a loan, do not keep the cloak overnight.
verses.textEnNasb: And if he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
verses.textEn: If the neighbor is poor, do not go to sleep with their pledge in your possession.

verses.textZh: 到了日落的时候，你要把抵押品还给他，好使他可以用自己的衣服盖着睡觉，他就给你祝福，这在耶和华你的神面前，就算是你的义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了日落的时候，你要把抵押品还给他，好使他可以用自己的衣服盖着睡觉，他就给你祝福，这在耶和华你的神面前，就算是你的义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 日落的时候，总要把当头还他，使他用那件衣服盖着睡觉，他就为你祝福；这在耶和华－你神面前就是你的义了。
verses.textEnNiv: Return their cloak by sunset so that your neighbor may sleep in it. Then they will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall restore to him the pledge as the sun sets, that he may sleep in his cloak and bless you. And it shall be righteousness for you before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall in any case return the pledge to him again when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his own garment and bless you; and it shall be righteousness to you before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Return the cloak to its owner by sunset so he can stay warm through the night and bless you, and the Lord your God will count you as righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sun goes down you shall certainly return the pledge to him, so that he may sleep in his cloak and bless you; and it will be righteousness for you before the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Return their cloak by sunset so that your neighbor may sleep in it. Then they will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "困苦贫穷的雇工，无论是你的兄弟，或是寄居在你的地上你的城里的，你都不可欺压他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "困苦贫穷的雇工，无论是你的兄弟，或是寄居在你的地上你的城里的，你都不可欺压他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「困苦穷乏的雇工，无论是你的弟兄或是在你城里寄居的，你不可欺负他。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take advantage of a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether that worker is a fellow Israelite or a foreigner residing in one of your towns.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not oppress a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the sojourners who are in your land within your towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not oppress a hired servant whois poor and needy, whether one of your brethren or one of the aliens who is in your land within your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: "Never take advantage of poor and destitute laborers, whether they are fellow Israelites or foreigners living in your towns.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not exploit a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your countrymen or one of your strangers who are in your land in your towns.
verses.textEn: Do not take advantage of a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether that worker is a fellow Israelite or a foreigner residing in one of your towns.

verses.textZh: 你要当日给他工钱，不可等到日落，因为他贫穷，把心放在工钱上，免得他对你不满而呼求耶和华，你就有罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要当日给他工钱，不可等到日落，因为他贫穷，把心放在工钱上，免得他对你不满而呼求耶和华，你就有罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 要当日给他工价，不可等到日落－因为他穷苦，把心放在工价上－恐怕他因你求告耶和华，罪便归你了。
verses.textEnNiv: Pay them their wages each day before sunset, because they are poor and are counting on it. Otherwise they may cry to the Lord against you, and you will be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall give him his wages on the same day, before the sun sets (for he is poor and counts on it), lest he cry against you to the Lord , and you be guilty of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each day you shall give him his wages, and not let the sun go down on it, for he is poor and has set his heart on it; lest he cry out against you to the Lord, and it be sin to you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must pay them their wages each day before sunset because they are poor and are counting on it. If you don’t, they might cry out to the Lord against you, and it would be counted against you as sin.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall give him his wages on his day before the sun sets—for he is poor and sets his heart on it—so that he does not cry out against you to the Lord, and it becomes a sin in you.
verses.textEn: Pay them their wages each day before sunset, because they are poor and are counting on it. Otherwise they may cry to the Lord against you, and you will be guilty of sin.

verses.textZh: "不可因儿子的罪处死父亲，也不可因父亲的罪处死儿子；各人要因自己的罪被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可因儿子的罪处死父亲，也不可因父亲的罪处死儿子；各人要因自己的罪被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子；凡被杀的都为本身的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.
verses.textEnEsv: "Fathers shall not be put to death because of their children, nor shall children be put to death because of their fathers. Each one shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall children be put to death for their fathers; a person shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.textEnNlt: "Parents must not be put to death for the sins of their children, nor children for the sins of their parents. Those deserving to die must be put to death for their own crimes.
verses.textEnNasb: "Fathers shall not be put to death for their sons, nor shall sons be put to death for their fathers; everyone shall be put to death for his own sin alone.
verses.textEn: Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.

verses.textZh: "你不可向寄居的和孤儿屈枉正直，也不可拿寡妇的衣服作抵押。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你不可向寄居的和孤儿屈枉正直，也不可拿寡妇的衣服作抵押。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你不可向寄居的和孤儿屈枉正直，也不可拿寡妇的衣裳作当头。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not pervert the justice due to the sojourner or to the fatherless, or take a widow’s garment in pledge,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not pervert justice due the stranger or the fatherless, nor take a widow’s garment as a pledge.
verses.textEnNlt: "True justice must be given to foreigners living among you and to orphans, and you must never accept a widow’s garment as security for her debt.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not pervert the justice due a stranger or an orphan, nor seize a widow’s garment as a pledge.
verses.textEn: Do not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.

verses.textZh: 你要记住你在埃及作过奴仆，耶和华你的神把你从那里救赎出来；所以我吩咐你要遵行这话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记住你在埃及作过奴仆，耶和华你的神把你从那里救赎出来；所以我吩咐你要遵行这话。
verses.textZhCuv: 要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。耶和华－你的神从那里将你救赎，所以我吩咐你这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Always remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord your God redeemed you from your slavery. That is why I have given you this command.
verses.textEnNasb: But you are to remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and that the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.textEn: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.

verses.textZh: "你在田间收割庄稼的时候，如果遗留一捆在田里，就不可再回去拾取，要留给寄居的、孤儿和寡妇；好使耶和华你的神，在你手里所办的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你在田间收割庄稼的时候，如果遗留一捆在田里，就不可再回去拾取，要留给寄居的、孤儿和寡妇；好使耶和华你的神，在你手里所办的一切事上，赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你在田间收割庄稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。这样，耶和华－你神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
verses.textEnNiv: When you are harvesting in your field and you overlook a sheaf, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it. It shall be for the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you reap your harvest in your field, and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it; it shall be for the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you are harvesting your crops and forget to bring in a bundle of grain from your field, don’t go back to get it. Leave it for the foreigners, orphans, and widows. Then the Lord your God will bless you in all you do.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you are not to go back to get it; it shall belong to the stranger, the orphan, and to the widow, in order that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.textEn: When you are harvesting in your field and you overlook a sheaf, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

verses.textZh: 你打橄榄树以后，枝上剩下的不可再打，要留给寄居的、孤儿和寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你打橄榄树以后，枝上剩下的不可再打，要留给寄居的、孤儿和寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你打橄榄树，枝上剩下的，不可再打；要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: When you beat the olives from your trees, do not go over the branches a second time. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
verses.textEnEsv: When you beat your olive trees, you shall not go over them again. It shall be for the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you beat your olive trees, you shall not go over the boughs again; it shall be for the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow.
verses.textEnNlt: When you beat the olives from your olive trees, don’t go over the boughs twice. Leave the remaining olives for the foreigners, orphans, and widows.
verses.textEnNasb: When you beat the olives off your olive tree, you are not to search through the branches again; that shall be left for the stranger, the orphan, and for the widow.
verses.textEn: When you beat the olives from your trees, do not go over the branches a second time. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.

verses.textZh: 你收取葡萄园的葡萄以后，剩下的不可再摘，要留给寄居的、孤儿和寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你收取葡萄园的葡萄以后，剩下的不可再摘，要留给寄居的、孤儿和寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你摘葡萄园的葡萄，所剩下的，不可再摘；要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: When you harvest the grapes in your vineyard, do not go over the vines again. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
verses.textEnEsv: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not strip it afterward. It shall be for the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not glean it afterward; it shall be for the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow.
verses.textEnNlt: When you gather the grapes in your vineyard, don’t glean the vines after they are picked. Leave the remaining grapes for the foreigners, orphans, and widows.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you are not to go over it again; that shall be left for the stranger, the orphan, and the widow.
verses.textEn: When you harvest the grapes in your vineyard, do not go over the vines again. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.

verses.textZh: 你要记住你在埃及作过奴仆，所以我吩咐你遵行这话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记住你在埃及作过奴仆，所以我吩咐你遵行这话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，所以我吩咐你这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. That is why I am giving you this command.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.textEn: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.

verses.textZh: "如果人与人之间有争讼的事，就上法庭去；审判官审判他们的时候，要定义人有理，定恶人有罪；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人与人之间有争讼的事，就上法庭去；审判官审判他们的时候，要定义人有理，定恶人有罪；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若有争讼，来听审判，审判官就要定义人有理，定恶人有罪。
verses.textEnNiv: When people have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.
verses.textEnEsv: "If there is a dispute between men and they come into court and the judges decide between them, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If there is a dispute between men, and they come to court, that thejudges may judge them, and they justify the righteous and condemn the wicked,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose two people take a dispute to court, and the judges declare that one is right and the other is wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is a dispute between people and they go to court, and the judges decide their case, and they declare the righteous innocent and pronounce the wicked guilty,
verses.textEn: When people have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.

verses.textZh: 如果有罪的人应受责打，审判官就要叫他伏下，当面按着他的罪，照着数目责打他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有罪的人应受责打，审判官就要叫他伏下，当面按着他的罪，照着数目责打他。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人若该受责打，审判官就要叫他当面伏在地上，按着他的罪照数责打。
verses.textEnNiv: If the guilty person deserves to be beaten, the judge shall make them lie down and have them flogged in his presence with the number of lashes the crime deserves,
verses.textEnEsv: then if the guilty man deserves to be beaten, the judge shall cause him to lie down and be beaten in his presence with a number of stripes in proportion to his offense.
verses.textEnNkjv: then it shall be, if the wicked man deserves to be beaten, that the judge will cause him to lie down and be beaten in his presence, according to his guilt, with a certain number of blows.
verses.textEnNlt: If the person in the wrong is sentenced to be flogged, the judge must command him to lie down and be beaten in his presence with the number of lashes appropriate to the crime.
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall be if the wicked person deserves to be beaten, the judge shall then make him lie down and have him beaten in his presence with the number of lashes according to his wrongful act.
verses.textEn: If the guilty person deserves to be beaten, the judge shall make them lie down and have them flogged in his presence with the number of lashes the crime deserves,

verses.textZh: 只可打他四十下，不可再多；恐怕你多打了他，过了这数目，你的兄弟就在你眼前受辱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只可打他四十下，不可再多；恐怕你多打了他，过了这数目，你的兄弟就在你眼前受辱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 只可打他四十下，不可过数；若过数，便是轻贱你的弟兄了。
verses.textEnNiv: but the judge must not impose more than forty lashes. If the guilty party is flogged more than that, your fellow Israelite will be degraded in your eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Forty stripes may be given him, but not more, lest, if one should go on to beat him with more stripes than these, your brother be degraded in your sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Forty blows he may give him and no more, lest he should exceed this and beat him with many blows above these, and your brother be humiliated in your sight.
verses.textEnNlt: But never give more than forty lashes; more than forty lashes would publicly humiliate your neighbor.
verses.textEnNasb: He may have him beaten forty times, but not more, so that he does not have him beaten with many more lashes than these, and that your brother does not become contemptible in your eyes.
verses.textEn: but the judge must not impose more than forty lashes. If the guilty party is flogged more than that, your fellow Israelite will be degraded in your eyes.

verses.textZh: "牛在踹谷的时候，不可笼住牠的嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: "牛在踹谷的时候，不可笼住牠的嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 「牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not muzzle an ox when it is treading out the grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out thegrain.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not muzzle the ox while it is threshing.
verses.textEn: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.

verses.textZh: "兄弟住在一起，他们中间如果有一个死了，没有留下儿子，死者的妻子就不可出嫁外人；她丈夫的兄弟要向她尽兄弟的本分，娶她为妻，和她同房。
verses.textZhCnvs: "兄弟住在一起，他们中间如果有一个死了，没有留下儿子，死者的妻子就不可出嫁外人；她丈夫的兄弟要向她尽兄弟的本分，娶她为妻，和她同房。
verses.textZhCuv: 「弟兄同居，若死了一个，没有儿子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，她丈夫的兄弟当尽弟兄的本分，娶她为妻，与她同房。
verses.textEnNiv: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband’s brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.
verses.textEnEsv: "If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead man shall not be married outside the family to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her and take her as his wife and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the widow of the dead man shall not be married to a stranger outside thefamily; her husband’s brother shall go in to her, take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
verses.textEnNlt: "If two brothers are living together on the same property and one of them dies without a son, his widow may not be married to anyone from outside the family. Instead, her husband’s brother should marry her and have intercourse with her to fulfill the duties of a brother-in-law.
verses.textEnNasb: "When brothers live together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the deceased shall not be married outside the family to a strange man. Her husband’s brother shall have relations with her and take her to himself as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
verses.textEn: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband’s brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.

verses.textZh: 她所生的长子要归亡兄的名下，免得他的名字从以色列中被涂抹了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她所生的长子要归亡兄的名下，免得他的名字从以色列中被涂抹了。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人生的长子必归死兄的名下，免得他的名在以色列中涂抹了。
verses.textEnNiv: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the first son whom she bears shall succeed to the name of his dead brother, that his name may not be blotted out of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that the firstborn son which she bears will succeed to the name of his dead brother, that his name may not be blotted out of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The first son she bears to him will be considered the son of the dead brother, so that his name will not be forgotten in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall then be that the firstborn to whom she gives birth shall assume the name of his father’s deceased brother, so that his name will not be wiped out from Israel.
verses.textEn: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.

verses.textZh: 那人如果不喜欢娶他兄弟的妻子，他兄弟的妻子就要到城门去见长老，说：‘我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中为自己的哥哥立名，不肯对我尽兄弟的本分。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人如果不喜欢娶他兄弟的妻子，他兄弟的妻子就要到城门去见长老，说：‘我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中为自己的哥哥立名，不肯对我尽兄弟的本分。’
verses.textZhCuv: 那人若不愿意娶她哥哥的妻，他哥哥的妻就要到城门长老那里，说：『我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中兴起他哥哥的名字，不给我尽弟兄的本分。』
verses.textEnNiv: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother’s wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, "My husband’s brother refuses to carry on his brother’s name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me."
verses.textEnEsv: And if the man does not wish to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders and say, ‘My husband’s brother refuses to perpetuate his brother’s name in Israel; he will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the man does not want to take his brother’s wife, then let his brother’s wife go up to the gate to the elders, and say, ‘My husband’s brother refuses to raise up a name to his brother in Israel; he will not perform the duty of my husband’s brother.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But if the man refuses to marry his brother’s widow, she must go to the town gate and say to the elders assembled there, ‘My husband’s brother refuses to preserve his brother’s name in Israel—he refuses to fulfill the duties of a brother-in-law by marrying me.’
verses.textEnNasb: But if the man does not desire to take his brother’s widow, then his brother’s widow shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, ‘My husband’s brother refuses to establish a name for his brother in Israel; he is not willing to perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.’
verses.textEn: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother’s wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, "My husband’s brother refuses to carry on his brother’s name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me."

verses.textZh: 本城的长老就要把那人叫来，对他说明；如果他坚持说：‘我不乐意娶她’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 本城的长老就要把那人叫来，对他说明；如果他坚持说：‘我不乐意娶她’，
verses.textZhCuv: 本城的长老就要召那人来问他，他若执意说：『我不愿意娶她』，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, "I do not want to marry her,"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the elders of his city shall call him and speak to him, and if he persists, saying, ‘I do not wish to take her,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the elders of his city shall call him and speak to him. But if he stands firm and says, ‘I do not want to take her,’
verses.textEnNlt: The elders of the town will then summon him and talk with him. If he still refuses and says, ‘I don’t want to marry her,’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak to him. And if he persists and says, ‘I do not desire to take her,’
verses.textEn: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, "I do not want to marry her,"

verses.textZh: 他哥哥的妻子就要当着长老的面前，走到那人跟前，脱去他脚上的鞋子，吐唾沫在他的脸上，说：‘那不为自己哥哥建立家室的，人人都要这样对待他。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他哥哥的妻子就要当着长老的面前，走到那人跟前，脱去他脚上的鞋子，吐唾沫在他的脸上，说：‘那不为自己哥哥建立家室的，人人都要这样对待他。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他哥哥的妻就要当着长老到那人的跟前，脱了他的鞋，吐唾沫在他脸上，说：『凡不为哥哥建立家室的都要这样待他。』
verses.textEnNiv: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face and say, "This is what is done to the man who will not build up his brother’s family line."
verses.textEnEsv: then his brother’s wife shall go up to him in the presence of the elders and pull his sandal off his foot and spit in his face. And she shall answer and say, ‘So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, remove his sandal from his foot, spit in his face, and answer and say, ‘So shall it be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s house.’
verses.textEnNlt: the widow must walk over to him in the presence of the elders, pull his sandal from his foot, and spit in his face. Then she must declare, ‘This is what happens to a man who refuses to provide his brother with children.’
verses.textEnNasb: then his brother’s widow shall come up to him in the sight of the elders, and pull his sandal off his foot and spit in his face; and she shall declare, ‘This is what is done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house!’
verses.textEn: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face and say, "This is what is done to the man who will not build up his brother’s family line."

verses.textZh: 从此，在以色列中他的名字 必称为‘脱鞋者之家’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此，在以色列中他的名字 必称为‘脱鞋者之家’。
verses.textZhCuv: 在以色列中，他的名必称为脱鞋之家。」
verses.textEnNiv: That man’s line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.
verses.textEnEsv: And the name of his house shall be called in Israel, ‘The house of him who had his sandal pulled off.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And his name shall be called in Israel, ‘The house of him who had his sandal removed.’
verses.textEnNlt: Ever afterward in Israel his family will be referred to as ‘the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off’!
verses.textEnNasb: And in Israel his family shall be called by the name, ‘The house of him whose sandal was removed.’
verses.textEn: That man’s line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.

verses.textZh: "有两个人在一起打斗，如果其中一人的妻子走前来，要救她的丈夫脱离那打她丈夫的人的手，就伸手抓住那人的下体，
verses.textZhCnvs: "有两个人在一起打斗，如果其中一人的妻子走前来，要救她的丈夫脱离那打她丈夫的人的手，就伸手抓住那人的下体，
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有二人争斗，这人的妻近前来，要救她丈夫脱离那打她丈夫之人的手，抓住那人的下体，
verses.textEnNiv: If two men are fighting and the wife of one of them comes to rescue her husband from his assailant, and she reaches out and seizes him by his private parts,
verses.textEnEsv: "When men fight with one another and the wife of the one draws near to rescue her husband from the hand of him who is beating him and puts out her hand and seizes him by the private parts,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If two men fight together, and the wife of one draws near to rescue her husband from the hand of the one attacking him, and puts out her hand and seizes him by the genitals,
verses.textEnNlt: "If two Israelite men get into a fight and the wife of one tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the testicles of the other man,
verses.textEnNasb: "If two men, a man and his countryman, have a fight with each other, and the wife of one comes up to save her husband from the hand of the one who is hitting him, and she reaches out with her hand and grasps that man’s genitals,
verses.textEn: If two men are fighting and the wife of one of them comes to rescue her husband from his assailant, and she reaches out and seizes him by his private parts,

verses.textZh: 你就要砍掉那妇人的手；你的眼不可顾惜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要砍掉那妇人的手；你的眼不可顾惜。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要砍断妇人的手，眼不可顾惜她。
verses.textEnNiv: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall cut off her hand; your eye shall not pity her.
verses.textEnNlt: you must cut off her hand. Show her no pity.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall cut off her hand; you shall not show pity.
verses.textEn: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.

verses.textZh: "你袋里不可有两样不同的法码，一大一小；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你袋里不可有两样不同的法码，一大一小；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你囊中不可有一大一小两样的法码。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not have two differing weights in your bag—one heavy, one light.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not have in your bag two kinds of weights, a large and a small.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not have in your bag differing weights, a heavy and a light.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must use accurate scales when you weigh out merchandise,
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not have in your bag differing weights, a large and a small.
verses.textEn: Do not have two differing weights in your bag—one heavy, one light.

verses.textZh: 你家里不可有两样不同的升斗，一大一小。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你家里不可有两样不同的升斗，一大一小。
verses.textZhCuv: 你家里不可有一大一小两样的升斗。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not have two differing measures in your house—one large, one small.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not have in your house two kinds of measures, a large and a small.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not have in your house differing measures, a large and a small.
verses.textEnNlt: and you must use full and honest measures.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not have in your house differing measures, a large and a small.
verses.textEn: Do not have two differing measures in your house—one large, one small.

verses.textZh: 你要有准确公正的法码，你要有准确公正的升斗，好使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，得享长寿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要有准确公正的法码，你要有准确公正的升斗，好使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，得享长寿。
verses.textZhCuv: 当用对准公平的法码，公平的升斗。这样，在耶和华－你神所赐你的地上，你的日子就可以长久。
verses.textEnNiv: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: A full and fair weight you shall have, a full and fair measure you shall have, that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure, that your days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, always use honest weights and measures, so that you may enjoy a long life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall have a correct and honest weight; you shall have a correct and honest measure, so that your days may be prolonged in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEn: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.textZh: 因为所有行这些事的，就是行不义的事的，都是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所有行这些事的，就是行不义的事的，都是耶和华你的神厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为行非义之事的人都是耶和华－你神所憎恶的。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.
verses.textEnEsv: For all who do such things, all who act dishonestly, are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all who do such things, all who behave unrighteously, are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: All who cheat with dishonest weights and measures are detestable to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: For everyone who does these things, everyone who acts unjustly is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.

verses.textZh: "你要记住你们出了埃及以后，亚玛力人在路上怎样对待你；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要记住你们出了埃及以后，亚玛力人在路上怎样对待你；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要记念你们出埃及的时候，亚玛力人在路上怎样待你。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember what Amalek did to you on the way as you came out of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember what Amalek did to you on the way as you were coming out of Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: "Never forget what the Amalekites did to you as you came from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came out of Egypt,
verses.textEn: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 怎样在路上遇见了你，趁你疲倦困乏的时候，攻击你后方所有软弱无力的人，并不敬畏神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 怎样在路上遇见了你，趁你疲倦困乏的时候，攻击你后方所有软弱无力的人，并不敬畏神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在路上遇见你，趁你疲乏困倦击杀你尽后边软弱的人，并不敬畏神。
verses.textEnNiv: When you were weary and worn out, they met you on your journey and attacked all who were lagging behind; they had no fear of God.
verses.textEnEsv: how he attacked you on the way when you were faint and weary, and cut off your tail, those who were lagging behind you, and he did not fear God.
verses.textEnNkjv: how he met you on the way and attacked your rear ranks, all the stragglers at your rear, when you were tired and weary; and he did not fear God.
verses.textEnNlt: They attacked you when you were exhausted and weary, and they struck down those who were straggling behind. They had no fear of God.
verses.textEnNasb: how he confronted you on the way and attacked among you all the stragglers at your rear when you were tired and weary; and he did not fear God.
verses.textEn: When you were weary and worn out, they met you on your journey and attacked all who were lagging behind; they had no fear of God.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华你的神使你脱离四围所有的仇敌，在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地上，得享太平的时候，你务要把亚玛力这名号从天下涂抹，不可忘记。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华你的神使你脱离四围所有的仇敌，在耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地上，得享太平的时候，你务要把亚玛力这名号从天下涂抹，不可忘记。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华－你神使你不被四围一切的仇敌扰乱，在耶和华－你神赐你为业的地上得享平安。那时，你要将亚玛力的名号从天下涂抹了，不可忘记。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore when the Lord your God has given you rest from all your enemies around you, in the land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance to possess, you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven; you shall not forget.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it shall be, when the Lord your God has given you rest from your enemies all around, in the land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance, that you will blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven. You shall not forget.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, when the Lord your God has given you rest from all your enemies in the land he is giving you as a special possession, you must destroy the Amalekites and erase their memory from under heaven. Never forget this!
verses.textEnNasb: So it shall come about, when the Lord your God has given you rest from all your surrounding enemies in the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, that you shall wipe out the mention of the name Amalek from under heaven; you must not forget.
verses.textEn: When the Lord your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!

verses.textZh: "将来，你进了耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地，占领那地，并且住在那里以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "将来，你进了耶和华你的神赐给你作产业的地，占领那地，并且住在那里以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你进去得了耶和华－你神所赐你为业之地居住，
verses.textEnNiv: When you have entered the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance and have taken possession of it and settled in it,
verses.textEnEsv: "When you come into the land that the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance and have taken possession of it and live in it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be, when you come into the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you possess it and dwell in it,
verses.textEnNlt: "When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you as a special possession and you have conquered it and settled there,
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it shall be, when you enter the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and live in it,
verses.textEn: When you have entered the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance and have taken possession of it and settled in it,

verses.textZh: 就要从耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，把地上各种初熟果子取些来，放在篮子里，到耶和华你的神选择立为他名的居所的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要从耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，把地上各种初熟果子取些来，放在篮子里，到耶和华你的神选择立为他名的居所的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 就要从耶和华－你神赐你的地上将所收的各种初熟的土产取些来，盛在筐子里，往耶和华－你神所选择要立为他名的居所去，
verses.textEnNiv: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the Lord your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name
verses.textEnEsv: you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you harvest from your land that the Lord your God is giving you, and you shall put it in a basket, and you shall go to the place that the Lord your God will choose, to make his name to dwell there.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you shall take some of the first of all the produce of the ground, which you shall bring from your land that the Lord your God is giving you, and put it in a basket and go to the place where the Lord your God chooses to make His name abide.
verses.textEnNlt: put some of the first produce from each crop you harvest into a basket and bring it to the designated place of worship—the place the Lord your God chooses for his name to be honored.
verses.textEnNasb: that you shall take some of the first of all the produce of the ground which you bring in from your land that the Lord your God gives you, and you shall put it in a basket and go to the place where the Lord your God chooses to establish His name.
verses.textEn: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the Lord your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name

verses.textZh: 去见当时作祭司的，对他说：‘我今日向耶和华你的神表明，我已经来到了耶和华向我们的列祖起誓应许要赐给我们的地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 去见当时作祭司的，对他说：‘我今日向耶和华你的神表明，我已经来到了耶和华向我们的列祖起誓应许要赐给我们的地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 见当时作祭司的，对他说：『我今日向耶和华－你神明认，我已来到耶和华向我们列祖起誓应许赐给我们的地。』
verses.textEnNiv: and say to the priest in office at the time, "I declare today to the Lord your God that I have come to the land the Lord swore to our ancestors to give us."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall go to the priest who is in office at that time and say to him, ‘I declare today to the Lord your God that I have come into the land that the Lord swore to our fathers to give us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall go to the one who is priest in those days, and say to him, ‘I declare today to the Lord your God that I have come to the country which the Lord swore to our fathers to give us.’
verses.textEnNlt: Go to the priest in charge at that time and say to him, ‘With this gift I acknowledge to the Lord your God that I have entered the land he swore to our ancestors he would give us.’
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall go to the priest who is in office at that time and say to him, ‘I declare today to the Lord my God that I have entered the land which the Lord swore to our fathers to give us.’
verses.textEn: and say to the priest in office at the time, "I declare today to the Lord your God that I have come to the land the Lord swore to our ancestors to give us."

verses.textZh: 祭司就要从你手里接过篮子，放在耶和华你的神的祭坛前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司就要从你手里接过篮子，放在耶和华你的神的祭坛前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就从你手里取过筐子来，放在耶和华－你神的坛前。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hand and set it down before the altar of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the priest shall take the basket out of your hand and set it down before the altar of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then take the basket from your hand and set it before the altar of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hand and set it before the altar of the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 然后你要在耶和华你的神面前说：‘我的祖先原是个飘泊流亡的亚兰人；他下到埃及，在那里寄居；他人数稀少，在那里却成了又大又强、人数又多的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后你要在耶和华你的神面前说：‘我的祖先原是个飘泊流亡的亚兰人；他下到埃及，在那里寄居；他人数稀少，在那里却成了又大又强、人数又多的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在耶和华－你神面前说：『我祖原是一个将亡的亚兰人，下到埃及寄居。他人口稀少，在那里却成了又大又强、人数很多的国民。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you shall declare before the Lord your God: "My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you shall make response before the Lord your God, ‘A wandering Aramean was my father. And he went down into Egypt and sojourned there, few in number, and there he became a nation, great, mighty, and populous.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall answer and say before the Lord your God: ‘My father was a Syrian, about to perish, and he went down to Egypt and dwelt there, few in number; and there he became a nation, great, mighty, and populous.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must then say in the presence of the Lord your God, ‘My ancestor Jacob was a wandering Aramean who went to live as a foreigner in Egypt. His family arrived few in number, but in Egypt they became a large and mighty nation.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall respond and say before the Lord your God, ‘My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt and resided there, few in number; but there he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
verses.textEn: Then you shall declare before the Lord your God: "My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.

verses.textZh: 埃及人恶待我们，苦害我们，把苦工加在我们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人恶待我们，苦害我们，把苦工加在我们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人恶待我们，苦害我们，将苦工加在我们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, subjecting us to harsh labor.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Egyptians treated us harshly and humiliated us and laid on us hard labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and laid hard bondage on us.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Egyptians oppressed and humiliated us by making us their slaves,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Egyptians treated us badly and oppressed us, and imposed hard labor on us.
verses.textEn: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, subjecting us to harsh labor.

verses.textZh: 于是我们向耶和华我们列祖的神呼求，耶和华听见了我们的声音，看见了我们所受的困苦、劳碌和压迫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我们向耶和华我们列祖的神呼求，耶和华听见了我们的声音，看见了我们所受的困苦、劳碌和压迫，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我们哀求耶和华－我们列祖的神，耶和华听见我们的声音，看见我们所受的困苦、劳碌、欺压，
verses.textEnNiv: Then we cried out to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.
verses.textEnEsv: Then we cried to the Lord , the God of our fathers, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then we cried out to the Lord God of our fathers, and the Lord heard our voice and looked on our affliction and our labor and our oppression.
verses.textEnNlt: we cried out to the Lord , the God of our ancestors. He heard our cries and saw our hardship, toil, and oppression.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we cried out to the Lord, the God of our fathers, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our wretched condition, our trouble, and our oppression;
verses.textEn: Then we cried out to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.

verses.textZh: 耶和华就用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，以及大而可畏的事、神迹和奇事，把我们从埃及领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，以及大而可畏的事、神迹和奇事，把我们从埃及领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事与神迹奇事，领我们出了埃及，
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with signs and wonders.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great deeds of terror, with signs and wonders.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm, with great terror and with signs and wonders.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a strong hand and powerful arm, with overwhelming terror, and with miraculous signs and wonders.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, an outstretched arm, and with great terror, and with signs and wonders;
verses.textEn: So the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with signs and wonders.

verses.textZh: 把我们领进这地方，把这地赐给我们，就是流奶与蜜的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把我们领进这地方，把这地赐给我们，就是流奶与蜜的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 将我们领进这地方，把这流奶与蜜之地赐给我们。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought us into this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has brought us to this place and has given us this land, "a land flowing with milk and honey";
verses.textEnNlt: He brought us to this place and gave us this land flowing with milk and honey!
verses.textEnNasb: and He has brought us to this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEn: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，现在你看，我把你赐给我的土地的初熟果子带了来。’随后你要把篮子放在耶和华你的神面前，在耶和华你的神面前下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，现在你看，我把你赐给我的土地的初熟果子带了来。’随后你要把篮子放在耶和华你的神面前，在耶和华你的神面前下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，现在我把你所赐给我地上初熟的土产奉了来。』随后你要把筐子放在耶和华－你神面前，向耶和华－你的神下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, Lord , have given me." Place the basket before the Lord your God and bow down before him.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, now I bring the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, O Lord , have given me.’ And you shall set it down before the Lord your God and worship before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land which you, O Lord, have given me.’ "Then you shall set it before the Lord your God, and worship before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, O Lord , I have brought you the first portion of the harvest you have given me from the ground.’ Then place the produce before the Lord your God, and bow to the ground in worship before him.
verses.textEnNasb: And now behold, I have brought the first of the produce of the ground which You, Lord have given me.’ Then you shall set it before the Lord your God, and worship before the Lord your God;
verses.textEn: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, Lord , have given me." Place the basket before the Lord your God and bow down before him.

verses.textZh: 你和利未人，以及住在你们中间的外族人，都要因耶和华你的神赐给你和你的家的一切好处而欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和利未人，以及住在你们中间的外族人，都要因耶和华你的神赐给你和你的家的一切好处而欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和利未人，并在你们中间寄居的，要因耶和华－你神所赐你和你家的一切福分欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you and the Levites and the foreigners residing among you shall rejoice in all the good things the Lord your God has given to you and your household.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall rejoice in all the good that the Lord your God has given to you and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the sojourner who is among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall rejoice in every good thing which the Lord your God has given to you and your house, you and the Levite and the stranger who is among you.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward you may go and celebrate because of all the good things the Lord your God has given to you and your household. Remember to include the Levites and the foreigners living among you in the celebration.
verses.textEnNasb: and you, the Levite, and the stranger who is among you shall rejoice in all the good which the Lord your God has given you and your household.
verses.textEn: Then you and the Levites and the foreigners residing among you shall rejoice in all the good things the Lord your God has given to you and your household.

verses.textZh: "每逢第三年，就是十分献一之年，你把一切出产的十分之一完全取出，分给利未人、寄居的和孤儿寡妇，使他们在你的城中吃饱了以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "每逢第三年，就是十分献一之年，你把一切出产的十分之一完全取出，分给利未人、寄居的和孤儿寡妇，使他们在你的城中吃饱了以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 「每逢三年，就是十分取一之年，你取完了一切土产的十分之一，要分给利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，使他们在你城中可以吃得饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: When you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you shall give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you have finished paying all the tithe of your produce in the third year, which is the year of tithing, giving it to the Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, so that they may eat within your towns and be filled,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you have finished laying aside all the tithe of your increase in the third year— the year of tithing—and have given it to the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, so that they may eat within your gates and be filled,
verses.textEnNlt: "Every third year you must offer a special tithe of your crops. In this year of the special tithe you must give your tithes to the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows, so that they will have enough to eat in your towns.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you have finished paying all the tithe of your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the stranger, to the orphan, and to the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.
verses.textEn: When you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you shall give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.

verses.textZh: 你就要在耶和华你的神面前说：‘我已经把圣物从家里除去了，也分给了利未人、寄居的和孤儿寡妇，都照着你吩咐我的一切诫命；你的命令我都没有违背，也没有忘记。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要在耶和华你的神面前说：‘我已经把圣物从家里除去了，也分给了利未人、寄居的和孤儿寡妇，都照着你吩咐我的一切诫命；你的命令我都没有违背，也没有忘记。
verses.textZhCuv: 你又要在耶和华－你神面前说：『我已将圣物从我家里拿出来，给了利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，是照你所吩咐我的一切命令。你的命令我都没有违背，也没有忘记。
verses.textEnNiv: Then say to the Lord your God: "I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall say before the Lord your God, ‘I have removed the sacred portion out of my house, and moreover, I have given it to the Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all your commandment that you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, nor have I forgotten them.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall say before the Lord your God: ‘I have removed the holy tithe from my house, and also have given them to the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all Your commandments which You have commanded me; I have not transgressed Your commandments, nor have I forgotten them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you must declare in the presence of the Lord your God, ‘I have taken the sacred gift from my house and have given it to the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows, just as you commanded me. I have not violated or forgotten any of your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say before the Lord your God, ‘I have removed the sacred portion from my house, and have also given it to the Levite, the stranger, the orphan, and the widow, in accordance with all Your commandments which You have commanded me; I have not violated or forgotten any of Your commandments.
verses.textEn: Then say to the Lord your God: "I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.

verses.textZh: 我守丧的时候，没有吃这圣物；我不洁的时候，没有把它除去，也没有把它送给死人；我听从了耶和华我的神的话，都照着你吩咐我的一切行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我守丧的时候，没有吃这圣物；我不洁的时候，没有把它除去，也没有把它送给死人；我听从了耶和华我的神的话，都照着你吩咐我的一切行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我守丧的时候，没有吃这圣物；不洁净的时候，也没有拿出来，又没有为死人送去。我听从了耶和华－我神的话，都照你所吩咐的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor have I offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the Lord my God; I have done everything you commanded me.
verses.textEnEsv: I have not eaten of the tithe while I was mourning, or removed any of it while I was unclean, or offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the voice of the Lord my God. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not eaten any of it when in mourning, nor have I removed any of it for an unclean use, nor given any of it for the dead. I have obeyed the voice of the Lord my God, and have done according to all that You have commanded me.
verses.textEnNlt: I have not eaten any of it while in mourning; I have not handled it while I was ceremonially unclean; and I have not offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the Lord my God and have done everything you commanded me.
verses.textEnNasb: I have not eaten of it while mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor offered any of it to the dead. I have listened to the voice of the Lord my God; I have acted in accordance with everything that You have commanded me.
verses.textEn: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor have I offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the Lord my God; I have done everything you commanded me.

verses.textZh: 求你从天上你圣洁的居所垂看，赐福给你的子民以色列，和你赐给我们的土地，就是你向我们的列祖起誓应许的那流奶与蜜的地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上你圣洁的居所垂看，赐福给你的子民以色列，和你赐给我们的土地，就是你向我们的列祖起誓应许的那流奶与蜜的地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上、你的圣所垂看，赐福给你的百姓以色列与你所赐给我们的地，就是你向我们列祖起誓赐我们流奶与蜜之地。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Look down from heaven, your holy dwelling place, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us as you promised on oath to our ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.textEnEsv: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel and the ground that you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land which You have given us, just as You swore to our fathers, "a land flowing with milk and honey." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Now look down from your holy dwelling place in heaven and bless your people Israel and the land you swore to our ancestors to give us—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
verses.textEnNasb: Look down from Your holy dwelling place, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel, and the ground which You have given us, a land flowing with milk and honey just as You swore to our fathers.’
verses.textEn: Look down from heaven, your holy dwelling place, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us as you promised on oath to our ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey."

verses.textZh: "耶和华你的神今日吩咐你遵行这些律例和典章，所以你要一心一意谨守遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华你的神今日吩咐你遵行这些律例和典章，所以你要一心一意谨守遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－你的神今日吩咐你行这些律例典章，所以你要尽心尽性谨守遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God commands you this day to follow these decrees and laws; carefully observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnEsv: "This day the Lord your God commands you to do these statutes and rules. You shall therefore be careful to do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This day the Lord your God commands you to observe these statutes and judgments; therefore you shall be careful to observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: "Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey all these decrees and regulations. So be careful to obey them wholeheartedly.
verses.textEnNasb: "This day the Lord your God commands you to perform these statutes and ordinances. Therefore you shall be careful to perform them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God commands you this day to follow these decrees and laws; carefully observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.textZh: 你今日承认了耶和华是你的神，要遵行他的道，谨守他的律例、诫命和典章，听从他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你今日承认了耶和华是你的神，要遵行他的道，谨守他的律例、诫命和典章，听从他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你今日认耶和华为你的神，应许遵行他的道，谨守他的律例、诫命、典章，听从他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: You have declared this day that the Lord is your God and that you will walk in obedience to him, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws—that you will listen to him.
verses.textEnEsv: You have declared today that the Lord is your God, and that you will walk in his ways, and keep his statutes and his commandments and his rules, and will obey his voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Today you have proclaimed the Lord to be your God, and that you will walk in His ways and keep His statutes, His commandments, and His judgments, and that you will obey His voice.
verses.textEnNlt: You have declared today that the Lord is your God. And you have promised to walk in his ways, and to obey his decrees, commands, and regulations, and to do everything he tells you.
verses.textEnNasb: Today you have declared the Lord to be your God, and that you will walk in His ways and keep His statutes, His commandments, and His ordinances, and listen to His voice.
verses.textEn: You have declared this day that the Lord is your God and that you will walk in obedience to him, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws—that you will listen to him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华今日照着他应许你的，也承认了你是他珍贵的子民，使你谨守他的一切诫命；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华今日照着他应许你的，也承认了你是他珍贵的子民，使你谨守他的一切诫命；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华今日照他所应许你的，也认你为他的子民，使你谨守他的一切诫命，
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord has declared today that you are a people for his treasured possession, as he has promised you, and that you are to keep all his commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also today the Lord has proclaimed you to be His special people, just as He promised you, that you should keep all His commandments,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has declared today that you are his people, his own special treasure, just as he promised, and that you must obey all his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord has today declared you to be His people, His personal possession, just as He promised you, and that you are to keep all His commandments;
verses.textEn: And the Lord has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.

verses.textZh: 他又使你得称赞、名誉和尊贵，超过他所造的列国之上，并且照着他说过的使你作圣洁的子民，归于耶和华你的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又使你得称赞、名誉和尊贵，超过他所造的列国之上，并且照着他说过的使你作圣洁的子民，归于耶和华你的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又使你得称赞、美名、尊荣，超乎他所造的万民之上，并照他所应许的使你归耶和华－你神为圣洁的民。」
verses.textEnNiv: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the Lord your God, as he promised.
verses.textEnEsv: and that he will set you in praise and in fame and in honor high above all nations that he has made, and that you shall be a people holy to the Lord your God, as he promised."
verses.textEnNkjv: and that He will set you high above all nations which He has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the Lord your God, just as He has spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: And if you do, he will set you high above all the other nations he has made. Then you will receive praise, honor, and renown. You will be a nation that is holy to the Lord your God, just as he promised."
verses.textEnNasb: and that He will put you high above all the nations which He has made, for glory, fame, and honor; and that you shall be a consecrated people to the Lord your God, just as He has spoken."
verses.textEn: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the Lord your God, as he promised.

verses.textZh: 摩西和以色列的长老吩咐人民："你们要遵守我今日吩咐你们的一切诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和以色列的长老吩咐人民："你们要遵守我今日吩咐你们的一切诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和以色列的众长老吩咐百姓说：「你们要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: "Keep all these commands that I give you today.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, "Keep the whole commandment that I command you today.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses, with the elders of Israel, commanded the people, saying: "Keep all the commandments which I command you today.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses and the leaders of Israel gave this charge to the people: "Obey all these commands that I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, "Keep all the commandments which I am commanding you today.
verses.textEn: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: "Keep all these commands that I give you today.

verses.textZh: 将来你们过约旦河，到了耶和华你的神赐给你的土地的那一天，你要立起几块大石头，墁上石灰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 将来你们过约旦河，到了耶和华你的神赐给你的土地的那一天，你要立起几块大石头，墁上石灰。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们过约旦河，到了耶和华－你神所赐给你的地，当天要立起几块大石头，墁上石灰，
verses.textEnNiv: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land the Lord your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the day you cross over the Jordan to the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you shall set up large stones and plaster them with plaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, on the day when you cross over the Jordan to the land which the Lord your God is giving you, that you shall set up for yourselves large stones, and whitewash them with lime.
verses.textEnNlt: When you cross the Jordan River and enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.
verses.textEnNasb: So it shall be on the day when you cross the Jordan to the land which the Lord your God is giving you, that you shall set up for yourself large stones and coat them with lime
verses.textEn: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land the Lord your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.

verses.textZh: 你过河以后，要把这律法的一切话都写在石头上面，使你可以进入耶和华你的神赐给你的土地，就是流奶与蜜的地，正如耶和华你列祖的神应许你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你过河以后，要把这律法的一切话都写在石头上面，使你可以进入耶和华你的神赐给你的土地，就是流奶与蜜的地，正如耶和华你列祖的神应许你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 把这律法的一切话写在石头上。你过了河，可以进入耶和华－你神所赐你流奶与蜜之地，正如耶和华－你列祖之神所应许你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall write on them all the words of this law, when you cross over to enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the Lord , the God of your fathers, has promised you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have crossed over, that you may enter the land which the Lord your God is giving you, ‘a land flowing with milk and honey,’ just as the Lord God of your fathers promised you.
verses.textEnNlt: Write this whole body of instruction on them when you cross the river to enter the land the Lord your God is giving you—a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.
verses.textEnNasb: and write on them all the words of this Law, when you cross over, so that you may enter the land which the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, promised you.
verses.textEn: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.

verses.textZh: 所以，将来你们过了约旦河，就要在以巴路山上，照着我今日吩咐你们的，把这些石头立起来，墁上石灰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，将来你们过了约旦河，就要在以巴路山上，照着我今日吩咐你们的，把这些石头立起来，墁上石灰。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们过了约旦河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，将这些石头立起来，墁上石灰。
verses.textEnNiv: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you have crossed over the Jordan, you shall set up these stones, concerning which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall plaster them with plaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that on Mount Ebal you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, and you shall whitewash them with lime.
verses.textEnNlt: When you cross the Jordan, set up these stones at Mount Ebal and coat them with plaster, as I am commanding you today.
verses.textEnNasb: So it shall be when you cross the Jordan, you shall set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you shall coat them with lime.
verses.textEn: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.

verses.textZh: 在那里你要为耶和华你的神筑一座石坛，在石头上你不可动铁器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里你要为耶和华你的神筑一座石坛，在石头上你不可动铁器。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里要为耶和华－你的神筑一座石坛；在石头上不可动铁器。
verses.textEnNiv: Build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And there you shall build an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. You shall wield no iron tool on them;
verses.textEnNkjv: And there you shall build an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones; you shall not use an iron tool on them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then build an altar there to the Lord your God, using natural, uncut stones. You must not shape the stones with an iron tool.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, you shall build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones; you shall not wield an iron tool on them.
verses.textEn: Build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool on them.

verses.textZh: 你要用没有凿过的整块石头筑耶和华你的神的坛；在坛上你要献上燔祭给耶和华你的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用没有凿过的整块石头筑耶和华你的神的坛；在坛上你要献上燔祭给耶和华你的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 要用没有凿过的石头筑耶和华－你神的坛，在坛上要将燔祭献给耶和华－你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Build the altar of the Lord your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall build an altar to the Lord your God of uncut stones. And you shall offer burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall build with whole stones the altar of the Lord your God, and offer burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Build the altar of uncut stones, and use it to offer burnt offerings to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall build the altar of the Lord your God of uncut stones, and you shall offer on it burnt offerings to the Lord your God;
verses.textEn: Build the altar of the Lord your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 又要献上平安祭，并且在那里吃喝；也要在耶和华你的神面前欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要献上平安祭，并且在那里吃喝；也要在耶和华你的神面前欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要献平安祭，且在那里吃，在耶和华－你的神面前欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall sacrifice peace offerings and shall eat there, and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Also sacrifice peace offerings on it, and celebrate by feasting there before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall sacrifice peace offerings and eat there, and rejoice before the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你要把这律法的一切话，都清清楚楚写在石头上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这律法的一切话，都清清楚楚写在石头上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将这律法的一切话明明地写在石头上。」
verses.textEnNiv: And you shall write very clearly all the words of this law on these stones you have set up."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall write very plainly on the stones all the words of this law."
verses.textEnNlt: You must clearly write all these instructions on the stones coated with plaster."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall write on the stones all the words of this Law very clearly."
verses.textEn: And you shall write very clearly all the words of this law on these stones you have set up."

verses.textZh: 摩西和利未支派的祭司对以色列众人说："以色列啊，要默默静听；今日你已经成为耶和华你的神的子民了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和利未支派的祭司对以色列众人说："以色列啊，要默默静听；今日你已经成为耶和华你的神的子民了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和祭司利未人晓谕以色列众人说：「以色列啊，要默默静听。你今日成为耶和华－你神的百姓了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, "Be silent, Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, "Keep silence and hear, O Israel: this day you have become the people of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying, "Take heed and listen, O Israel: This day you have become the people of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses and the Levitical priests addressed all Israel as follows: "O Israel, be quiet and listen! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, "Be silent and listen, Israel! This day you have become a people for the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, "Be silent, Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 所以你要听从耶和华你的神的话，遵行他的诫命和律例，就是我今日吩咐你的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要听从耶和华你的神的话，遵行他的诫命和律例，就是我今日吩咐你的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以要听从耶和华－你神的话，遵行他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Obey the Lord your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall therefore obey the voice of the Lord your God, keeping his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall obey the voice of the Lord your God, and observe His commandments and His statutes which I command you today."
verses.textEnNlt: So you must obey the Lord your God by keeping all these commands and decrees that I am giving you today."
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall obey the Lord your God, and do His commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today."
verses.textEn: Obey the Lord your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today."

verses.textZh: 那天摩西又吩咐人民：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天摩西又吩咐人民：
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，摩西嘱咐百姓说：
verses.textEnNiv: On the same day Moses commanded the people:
verses.textEnEsv: That day Moses charged the people, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses commanded the people on the same day, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: That same day Moses also gave this charge to the people:
verses.textEnNasb: Moses also commanded the people on that day, saying,
verses.textEn: On the same day Moses commanded the people:

verses.textZh: "你们过了约旦河以后，西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、约瑟、便雅悯等支派的人，要站在基利心山上为人民祝福；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们过了约旦河以后，西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、约瑟、便雅悯等支派的人，要站在基利心山上为人民祝福；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们过了约旦河，西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、约瑟、便雅悯六个支派的人都要站在基利心山上为百姓祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you have crossed over the Jordan, these shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin;
verses.textEnNlt: "When you cross the Jordan River, the tribes of Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin must stand on Mount Gerizim to proclaim a blessing over the people.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you cross the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.textEn: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 流本、迦得、亚设、西布伦、但、拿弗他利等支派的人，要站在以巴路山上宣布咒诅的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本、迦得、亚设、西布伦、但、拿弗他利等支派的人，要站在以巴路山上宣布咒诅的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便、迦得、亚设、西布伦、但、拿弗他利六个支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: and these shall stand on Mount Ebal to curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNlt: And the tribes of Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali must stand on Mount Ebal to proclaim a curse.
verses.textEnNasb: For the curse, these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.textEn: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 利未人要向以色列众人大声说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人要向以色列众人大声说：
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人要向以色列众人高声说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levites shall declare to all the men of Israel in a loud voice:
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Levites shall speak with a loud voice and say to all the men of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Levites will shout to all the people of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites shall then respond and say to all the people of Israel with a loud voice,
verses.textEn: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:

verses.textZh: "‘制造耶和华厌恶的雕像或铸像，工人手中做的，并且在暗处设立的，那人必受咒诅。’众民都要应声说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘制造耶和华厌恶的雕像或铸像，工人手中做的，并且在暗处设立的，那人必受咒诅。’众民都要应声说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『有人制造耶和华所憎恶的偶像，或雕刻，或铸造，就是工匠手所做的，在暗中设立，那人必受咒诅！』百姓都要答应说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who makes an idol—a thing detestable to the Lord , the work of skilled hands—and sets it up in secret." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be the man who makes a carved or cast metal image, an abomination to the Lord , a thing made by the hands of a craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ And all the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who makes a carved or molded image, an abomination to the Lord, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ "And all the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who carves or casts an idol and secretly sets it up. These idols, the work of craftsmen, are detestable to the Lord .’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is the person who makes a carved image or cast metal image, an abomination to the Lord, the work of the hands of a craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ And all the people shall reply and say, ‘Amen.’
