verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who makes an idol—a thing detestable to the Lord , the work of skilled hands—and sets it up in secret." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘轻慢父母的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘轻慢父母的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『轻慢父母的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who dishonors their father or mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who dishonors his father or his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who treats his father or his mother with contempt.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who dishonors father or mother.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is one who treats his father or mother contemptuously.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who dishonors their father or mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘移动邻舍地界的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘移动邻舍地界的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『挪移邻舍地界的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who moves their neighbor’s boundary stone." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who steals property from a neighbor by moving a boundary marker.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is one who displaces his neighbor’s boundary marker.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who moves their neighbor’s boundary stone." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘使瞎子走错路的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘使瞎子走错路的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『使瞎子走差路的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who leads the blind astray on the road." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who misleads a blind man on the road.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who makes the blind to wander off the road.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who leads a blind person astray on the road.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is one who misleads a person who is blind on the road.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who leads the blind astray on the road." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘对寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉正直的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘对寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉正直的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『向寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉正直的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who perverts the justice due to the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who perverts the justice due the stranger, the fatherless, and widow.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who denies justice to foreigners, orphans, or widows.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is one who distorts the justice due a stranger, an orphan, or a widow.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘和父亲的妻子同寝的，必受咒诅，因为他揭开了他父亲的衣襟。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘和父亲的妻子同寝的，必受咒诅，因为他揭开了他父亲的衣襟。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『与继母行淫的，必受咒诅！因为掀开他父亲的衣襟。』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he dishonors his father’s bed." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who lies with his father’s wife, because he has uncovered his father’s nakedness.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with his father’s wife, because he has uncovered his father’s bed.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with one of his father’s wives, for he has violated his father.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, because he has uncovered his father’s garment.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he dishonors his father’s bed." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘和任何野兽同寝的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘和任何野兽同寝的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『与兽淫合的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who has sexual relations with any animal." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who lies with any kind of animal.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with any kind of animal.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with an animal.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is one who has sexual intercourse with any animal.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who has sexual relations with any animal." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘和同父异母，或是同母异父的姊妹同寝的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘和同父异母，或是同母异父的姊妹同寝的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『与异母同父，或异父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who lies with his sister, whether the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with his sister, whether she is the daughter of his father or his mother.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or of his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘和岳母同寝的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘和岳母同寝的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『与岳母行淫的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘暗中杀害邻舍的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘暗中杀害邻舍的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『暗中杀人的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who kills their neighbor secretly." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who attacks his neighbor secretly.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who attacks a neighbor in secret.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is he who attacks his neighbor in secret.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who kills their neighbor secretly." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘接受贿赂杀人，流无辜人的血的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘接受贿赂杀人，流无辜人的血的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「『受贿赂害死无辜之人的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who takes a bribe to shed innocent blood.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who takes a bribe to slay an innocent person.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who accepts payment to kill an innocent person.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to attack an innocent person.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "‘不坚守这律法的话去遵行的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘不坚守这律法的话去遵行的，必受咒诅。’众民都要说：‘阿们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「『不坚守遵行这律法言语的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Cursed is anyone who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cursed be anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Cursed is the one who does not confirm all the words of this law by observing them.’ "And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Cursed is anyone who does not affirm and obey the terms of these instructions.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cursed is anyone who does not fulfill the words of this Law by doing them.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.textEn: "Cursed is anyone who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.textZh: "如果你实在听从耶和华你的神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日吩咐你的，耶和华你的神必使你超过地上所有的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你实在听从耶和华你的神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日吩咐你的，耶和华你的神必使你超过地上所有的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若留意听从耶和华－你神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下万民之上。
verses.textEnNiv: If you fully obey the Lord your God and carefully follow all his commands I give you today, the Lord your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "And if you faithfully obey the voice of the Lord your God, being careful to do all his commandments that I command you today, the Lord your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now it shall come to pass, if you diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God, to observe carefully all His commandments which I command you today, that the Lord your God will set you high above all nations of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you fully obey the Lord your God and carefully keep all his commands that I am giving you today, the Lord your God will set you high above all the nations of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now it shall be, if you diligently obey the Lord your God, being careful to do all His commandments which I am commanding you today, that the Lord your God will put you high above all the nations of the earth.
verses.textEn: If you fully obey the Lord your God and carefully follow all his commands I give you today, the Lord your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.

verses.textZh: 如果你听从耶和华你的神的话，以下这一切福气必临到你身上，必把你追上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你听从耶和华你的神的话，以下这一切福气必临到你身上，必把你追上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若听从耶和华－你神的话，这以下的福必追随你，临到你身上：
verses.textEnNiv: All these blessings will come on you and accompany you if you obey the Lord your God:
verses.textEnEsv: And all these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you, if you obey the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you, because you obey the voice of the Lord your God:
verses.textEnNlt: You will experience all these blessings if you obey the Lord your God:
verses.textEnNasb: And all these blessings will come to you and reach you if you obey the Lord your God:
verses.textEn: All these blessings will come on you and accompany you if you obey the Lord your God:

verses.textZh: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the country.
verses.textEnNlt: Your towns and your fields will be blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed will you be in the city, and blessed will you be in the country.
verses.textEn: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

verses.textZh: 你身所生的、土地所出的、牲畜所出的、牛生殖的和羊所产的，都必蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你身所生的、土地所出的、牲畜所出的、牛生殖的和羊所产的，都必蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你身所生的，地所产的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the crops of your land and the young of your livestock—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed shall be the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground and the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your herds and the young of your flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed shallbe the fruit of your body, the produce of your ground and the increase of your herds, the increase of your cattle and the offspring of your flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: Your children and your crops will be blessed. The offspring of your herds and flocks will be blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed will be the children of your womb, the produce of your ground, and the offspring of your animals: the newborn of your herd and the young of your flock.
verses.textEn: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the crops of your land and the young of your livestock—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

verses.textZh: 你的篮子和你的抟面盆，都必蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的篮子和你的抟面盆，都必蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed shallbe your basket and your kneading bowl.
verses.textEnNlt: Your fruit baskets and breadboards will be blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed will be your basket and your kneading bowl.
verses.textEn: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.

verses.textZh: 你出必蒙福，你入也必蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你出必蒙福，你入也必蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever you go and whatever you do, you will be blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed will you be when you come in, and blessed will you be when you go out.
verses.textEn: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.

verses.textZh: "那起来攻击你的仇敌，耶和华必使他们在你面前被击败；他们从一条路出来攻击你，必在你面前从七条路逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那起来攻击你的仇敌，耶和华必使他们在你面前被击败；他们从一条路出来攻击你，必在你面前从七条路逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 「仇敌起来攻击你，耶和华必使他们在你面前被你杀败；他们从一条路来攻击你，必从七条路逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord will cause your enemies who rise against you to be defeated before you. They shall come out against you one way and flee before you seven ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will cause your enemies who rise against you to be defeated before your face; they shall come out against you one way and flee before you seven ways.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will conquer your enemies when they attack you. They will attack you from one direction, but they will scatter from you in seven!
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be defeated by you; they will go out against you one way and will flee at your presence seven ways.
verses.textEn: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.

verses.textZh: 在你的仓房里和你手所办的一切事上，耶和华必吩咐福气临到你；在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，他必赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你的仓房里和你手所办的一切事上，耶和华必吩咐福气临到你；在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上，他必赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你仓房里，并你手所办的一切事上，耶和华所命的福必临到你。耶和华－你神也要在所给你的地上赐福与你。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to. The Lord your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will command the blessing on you in your barns and in all that you undertake. And he will bless you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will command the blessing on you in your storehouses and in all to which you set your hand, and He will bless you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will guarantee a blessing on everything you do and will fill your storehouses with grain. The Lord your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will command the blessing for you in your barns and in everything that you put your hand to, and He will bless you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEn: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to. The Lord your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.

verses.textZh: 如果你谨守耶和华你的神的诫命，遵守他的道路，耶和华就必照着他向你起过的誓，立你作他自己的圣民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你谨守耶和华你的神的诫命，遵守他的道路，耶和华就必照着他向你起过的誓，立你作他自己的圣民。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若谨守耶和华－你神的诫命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作为自己的圣民。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath, if you keep the commands of the Lord your God and walk in obedience to him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will establish you as a people holy to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the Lord your God and walk in his ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will establish you as a holy people to Himself, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the Lord your God and walk in His ways.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you obey the commands of the Lord your God and walk in his ways, the Lord will establish you as his holy people as he swore he would do.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will establish you as a holy people to Himself, as He swore to you, if you keep the commandments of the Lord your God and walk in His ways.
verses.textEn: The Lord will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath, if you keep the commands of the Lord your God and walk in obedience to him.

verses.textZh: 地上万民见你被称为耶和华名下的人，就必惧怕你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上万民见你被称为耶和华名下的人，就必惧怕你。
verses.textZhCuv: 天下万民见你归在耶和华的名下，就要惧怕你。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the peoples on earth will see that you are called by the name of the Lord , and they will fear you.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of the Lord , and they shall be afraid of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of the Lord, and they shall be afraid of you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the nations of the world will see that you are a people claimed by the Lord , and they will stand in awe of you.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
verses.textEn: Then all the peoples on earth will see that you are called by the name of the Lord , and they will fear you.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许要赐给你的土地上，他必使你身上所生的、牲畜所产的、土地所出的，都丰富有余。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许要赐给你的土地上，他必使你身上所生的、牲畜所产的、土地所出的，都丰富有余。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许赐你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所产的，都绰绰有余。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will grant you abundant prosperity—in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground—in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will make you abound in prosperity, in the fruit of your womb and in the fruit of your livestock and in the fruit of your ground, within the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will grant you plenty of goods, in the fruit of your body, in the increase of your livestock, and in the produce of your ground, in the land of which the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will give you prosperity in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you, blessing you with many children, numerous livestock, and abundant crops.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will give you more than enough prosperity, in the children of your womb, in the offspring of your livestock, and in the produce of your ground, in the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.textEn: The Lord will grant you abundant prosperity—in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground—in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必为你打开他天上的宝库，按时降雨在你的地上，在你手里所作的一切事上赐福给你；你要借贷给许多国的民，却不会向人借贷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必为你打开他天上的宝库，按时降雨在你的地上，在你手里所作的一切事上赐福给你；你要借贷给许多国的民，却不会向人借贷。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必为你开天上的府库，按时降雨在你的地上。在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不致向他们借贷。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will open to you his good treasury, the heavens, to give the rain to your land in its season and to bless all the work of your hands. And you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will open to you His good treasure, the heavens, to give the rain to your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will send rain at the proper time from his rich treasury in the heavens and will bless all the work you do. You will lend to many nations, but you will never need to borrow from them.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will open for you His good storehouse, the heavens, to give rain to your land in its season and to bless every work of your hand; and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.
verses.textEn: The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使你作头不作尾，居上不居下，只要你听从耶和华你的神的诫命，就是我今日吩咐你的，谨守遵行；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使你作头不作尾，居上不居下，只要你听从耶和华你的神的诫命，就是我今日吩咐你的，谨守遵行；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若不听从耶和华－你神的话，不谨守遵行他的一切诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，这以下的咒诅都必追随你，临到你身上：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God that I give you this day and carefully follow them, you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will make you the head and not the tail, and you shall only go up and not down, if you obey the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you today, being careful to do them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will make you the head and not the tail; you shall be above only, and not be beneath, if you heed the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you today, and are careful to observe them.
verses.textEnNlt: If you listen to these commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today, and if you carefully obey them, the Lord will make you the head and not the tail, and you will always be on top and never at the bottom.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will make you the head and not the tail, and you will only be above, and not be underneath, if you listen to the commandments of the Lord your God which I am commanding you today, to follow them carefully,
verses.textEn: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God that I give you this day and carefully follow them, you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.

verses.textZh: 不可偏离我今日吩咐你的一切话，不偏左也不偏右，以致去随从和事奉别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可偏离我今日吩咐你的一切话，不偏左也不偏右，以致去随从和事奉别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not turn aside from any of the commands I give you today, to the right or to the left, following other gods and serving them.
verses.textEnEsv: and if you do not turn aside from any of the words that I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall not turn aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right or the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not turn away from any of the commands I am giving you today, nor follow after other gods and worship them.
verses.textEnNasb: and do not turn aside from any of the words which I am commanding you today, to the right or the left, to pursue other gods to serve them.
verses.textEn: Do not turn aside from any of the commands I give you today, to the right or to the left, following other gods and serving them.

verses.textZh: "但是，如果你不听从耶和华你神的话，不谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的一切诫命和律例，以下这一切咒诅就必临到你身上，把你赶上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但是，如果你不听从耶和华你神的话，不谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的一切诫命和律例，以下这一切咒诅就必临到你身上，把你赶上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: However, if you do not obey the Lord your God and do not carefully follow all his commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come on you and overtake you:
verses.textEnEsv: "But if you will not obey the voice of the Lord your God or be careful to do all his commandments and his statutes that I command you today, then all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But it shall come to pass, if you do not obey the voice of the Lord your God, to observe carefully all His commandments and His statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
verses.textEnNlt: "But if you refuse to listen to the Lord your God and do not obey all the commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come and overwhelm you:
verses.textEnNasb: "But it shall come about, if you do not obey the Lord your God, to be careful to follow all His commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today, that all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
verses.textEn: However, if you do not obey the Lord your God and do not carefully follow all his commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come on you and overtake you:

verses.textZh: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 你身所生的，地所产的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the country.
verses.textEnNlt: Your towns and your fields will be cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Cursed will you be in the city, and cursed will you be in the country.
verses.textEn: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.

verses.textZh: 你的篮子和抟面盆都必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的篮子和抟面盆都必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 你出也受咒诅，入也受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Cursed shallbe your basket and your kneading bowl.
verses.textEnNlt: Your fruit baskets and breadboards will be cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Cursed will be your basket and your kneading bowl.
verses.textEn: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

verses.textZh: 你身所生的、土地所出的、牛生殖的和羊所产的，都必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你身所生的、土地所出的、牛生殖的和羊所产的，都必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华因你行恶离弃他，必在你手里所办的一切事上，使咒诅、扰乱、责罚临到你，直到你被毁灭，速速地灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the crops of your land, and the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed shall be the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, the increase of your herds and the young of your flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Cursed shallbe the fruit of your body and the produce of your land, the increase of your cattle and the offspring of your flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: Your children and your crops will be cursed. The offspring of your herds and flocks will be cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Cursed will be the children of your womb, the produce of your ground, the newborn of your herd, and the offspring of your flock.
verses.textEn: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the crops of your land, and the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

verses.textZh: 你出必受咒诅，你入也必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你出必受咒诅，你入也必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使瘟疫贴在你身上，直到他将你从所进去得为业的地上灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever you go and whatever you do, you will be cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Cursed will you be when you come in, and cursed will you be when you go out.
verses.textEn: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

verses.textZh: "耶和华必在你手所作的一切事上，使咒诅、纷乱和责备临到你身上，直到你被消灭，速速地灭亡，因为你行恶，离弃了我的缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华必在你手所作的一切事上，使咒诅、纷乱和责备临到你身上，直到你被消灭，速速地灭亡，因为你行恶，离弃了我的缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要用痨病、热病、火症、疟疾、刀剑、旱风 、霉烂攻击你。这都要追赶你，直到你灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will send on you curses, confusion and rebuke in everything you put your hand to, until you are destroyed and come to sudden ruin because of the evil you have done in forsaking him.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord will send on you curses, confusion, and frustration in all that you undertake to do, until you are destroyed and perish quickly on account of the evil of your deeds, because you have forsaken me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you set your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the wickedness of your doings in which you have forsaken Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord himself will send on you curses, confusion, and frustration in everything you do, until at last you are completely destroyed for doing evil and abandoning me.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord will send against you curses, panic, and rebuke, in everything you undertake to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, on account of the evil of your deeds, because you have abandoned Me.
verses.textEn: The Lord will send on you curses, confusion and rebuke in everything you put your hand to, until you are destroyed and come to sudden ruin because of the evil you have done in forsaking him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使瘟疫随着你，直到他把你从你进去得为业的地上灭绝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使瘟疫随着你，直到他把你从你进去得为业的地上灭绝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你头上的天要变为铜，脚下的地要变为铁。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will plague you with diseases until he has destroyed you from the land you are entering to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will make the pestilence stick to you until he has consumed you off the land that you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will make the plague cling to you until He has consumed you from the land which you are going to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will afflict you with diseases until none of you are left in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will make the plague cling to you until He has eliminated you from the land where you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEn: The Lord will plague you with diseases until he has destroyed you from the land you are entering to possess.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必用痨病、热病、炎症、疟疾、干旱、旱风和霉烂打击你；它们必追赶你，直到你灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必用痨病、热病、炎症、疟疾、干旱、旱风和霉烂打击你；它们必追赶你，直到你灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要使那降在你地上的雨变为尘沙，从天临在你身上，直到你灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, with blight and mildew, which will plague you until you perish.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will strike you with wasting disease and with fever, inflammation and fiery heat, and with drought and with blight and with mildew. They shall pursue you until you perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with severe burning fever, with the sword, with scorching, and with mildew; they shall pursue you until you perish.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will strike you with wasting diseases, fever, and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew. These disasters will pursue you until you die.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will strike you with consumption, inflammation, fever, feverish heat, and with the sword, with blight, and with mildew, and they will pursue you until you perish.
verses.textEn: The Lord will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, with blight and mildew, which will plague you until you perish.

verses.textZh: 你头上的天必变成铜，你脚下的地必变成铁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你头上的天必变成铜，你脚下的地必变成铁。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华必使你败在仇敌面前，你从一条路去攻击他们，必从七条路逃跑。你必在天下万国中抛来抛去。
verses.textEnNiv: The sky over your head will be bronze, the ground beneath you iron.
verses.textEnEsv: And the heavens over your head shall be bronze, and the earth under you shall be iron.
verses.textEnNkjv: And your heavens which are over your head shall be bronze, and the earth which is under you shallbe iron.
verses.textEnNlt: The skies above will be as unyielding as bronze, and the earth beneath will be as hard as iron.
verses.textEnNasb: The heaven which is over your head shall be bronze, and the earth which is under you, iron.
verses.textEn: The sky over your head will be bronze, the ground beneath you iron.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使你地上的雨水变为飞沙尘土，从天上下到你身上，直到你被消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使你地上的雨水变为飞沙尘土，从天上下到你身上，直到你被消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物，并无人哄赶。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will turn the rain of your country into dust and powder; it will come down from the skies until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will make the rain of your land powder. From heaven dust shall come down on you until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will change the rain of your land to powder and dust; from the heaven it shall come down on you until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will change the rain that falls on your land into powder, and dust will pour down from the sky until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will make the rain of your land powder and dust; from heaven it shall come down on you until you are destroyed.
verses.textEn: The Lord will turn the rain of your country into dust and powder; it will come down from the skies until you are destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使你在仇敌面前被击败；你从一条路出去攻击他们，必在他们面前从七条路逃跑；你必成为天下万国惊骇的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使你在仇敌面前被击败；你从一条路出去攻击他们，必在他们面前从七条路逃跑；你必成为天下万国惊骇的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必用埃及人的疮并痔疮、牛皮癣与疥攻击你，使你不能医治。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but flee from them in seven, and you will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You shall go out one way against them and flee seven ways before them. And you shall be a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will cause you to be defeated before your enemies; you shall go out one way against them and flee seven ways before them; and you shall become troublesome to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will cause you to be defeated by your enemies. You will attack your enemies from one direction, but you will scatter from them in seven! You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord will cause you to be defeated by your enemies; you will go out one way against them, but you will flee seven ways from their presence, and you will be an example of terror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEn: The Lord will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but flee from them in seven, and you will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms on earth.

verses.textZh: 你的尸体必成为空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽的食物；必没有人来把牠们吓走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的尸体必成为空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽的食物；必没有人来把牠们吓走。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必用癫狂、眼瞎、心惊攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.
verses.textEnEsv: And your dead body shall be food for all birds of the air and for the beasts of the earth, and there shall be no one to frighten them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your carcasses shall be food for all the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and no one shall frighten them away.
verses.textEnNlt: Your corpses will be food for all the scavenging birds and wild animals, and no one will be there to chase them away.
verses.textEnNasb: Your dead bodies will serve as food for all birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away.
verses.textEn: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

verses.textZh: "耶和华必用埃及人的疮、痔漏、牛皮癣、红疹打击你，这是你不能医治的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华必用埃及人的疮、痔漏、牛皮癣、红疹打击你，这是你不能医治的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。你所行的必不亨通，时常遭遇欺压、抢夺，无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, festering sores and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will strike you with the boils of Egypt, and with tumors and scabs and itch, of which you cannot be healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors, with the scab, and with the itch, from which you cannot be healed.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, scurvy, and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, the festering rash, and with scabies, from which you cannot be healed.
verses.textEn: The Lord will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, festering sores and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必用癫狂、眼瞎、心乱打击你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必用癫狂、眼瞎、心乱打击你；
verses.textZhCuv: 你聘定了妻，别人必与她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其内；你栽种葡萄园，也不得用其中的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will afflict you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will strike you with madness and blindness and confusion of mind,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will strike you with madness and blindness and confusion of heart.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will strike you with madness, blindness, and panic.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will strike you with insanity, blindness, and with confusion of mind;
verses.textEn: The Lord will afflict you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.

verses.textZh: 你必在中午的时候摸索，好象瞎子在黑暗中摸索一样；你的道路必不亨通；你必日日受欺压、被抢夺，没有人拯救你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必在中午的时候摸索，好象瞎子在黑暗中摸索一样；你的道路必不亨通；你必日日受欺压、被抢夺，没有人拯救你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃它的肉；你的驴在你眼前被抢夺，不得归还；你的羊归了仇敌，无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: At midday you will grope about like a blind person in the dark. You will be unsuccessful in everything you do; day after day you will be oppressed and robbed, with no one to rescue you.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall grope at noonday, as the blind grope in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. And you shall be only oppressed and robbed continually, and there shall be no one to help you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall grope at noonday, as a blind man gropes in darkness; you shall not prosper in your ways; you shall be only oppressed and plundered continually, and no one shall save you.
verses.textEnNlt: You will grope around in broad daylight like a blind person groping in the darkness, but you will not find your way. You will be oppressed and robbed continually, and no one will come to save you.
verses.textEnNasb: and you will be groping about at noon, just as a person who is blind gropes in the darkness, and you will not be successful in your ways; but you will only be oppressed and robbed all the time, with no one to save you.
verses.textEn: At midday you will grope about like a blind person in the dark. You will be unsuccessful in everything you do; day after day you will be oppressed and robbed, with no one to rescue you.

verses.textZh: 你和女子订了婚，别人必和她同寝；你建造房屋，必不得住在里面；你栽种葡萄园，必不得享用它的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和女子订了婚，别人必和她同寝；你建造房屋，必不得住在里面；你栽种葡萄园，必不得享用它的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的儿女必归与别国的民；你的眼目终日切望，甚至失明，你手中无力拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be pledged to be married to a woman, but another will take her and rape her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not even begin to enjoy its fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall betroth a wife, but another man shall ravish her. You shall build a house, but you shall not dwell in it. You shall plant a vineyard, but you shall not enjoy its fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall betroth a wife, but another man shall lie with her; you shall build a house, but you shall not dwell in it; you shall plant a vineyard, but shall not gather its grapes.
verses.textEnNlt: "You will be engaged to a woman, but another man will sleep with her. You will build a house, but someone else will live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will never enjoy its fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: You will betroth a woman, but another man will violate her; you will build a house, but you will not live in it; you will plant a vineyard, but you will not make use of its fruit.
verses.textEn: You will be pledged to be married to a woman, but another will take her and rape her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not even begin to enjoy its fruit.

verses.textZh: 你的牛在你眼前被宰了，你必不得吃牠的肉；你的驴从你面前被抢夺了，必不归还给你；你的羊群交给了你的仇敌，必没有人拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的牛在你眼前被宰了，你必不得吃牠的肉；你的驴从你面前被抢夺了，必不归还给你；你的羊群交给了你的仇敌，必没有人拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的土产和你劳碌得来的，必被你所不认识的国民吃尽。你时常被欺负，受压制，
verses.textEnNiv: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be forcibly taken from you and will not be returned. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.
verses.textEnEsv: Your ox shall be slaughtered before your eyes, but you shall not eat any of it. Your donkey shall be seized before your face, but shall not be restored to you. Your sheep shall be given to your enemies, but there shall be no one to help you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your ox shallbe slaughtered before your eyes, but you shall not eat of it; your donkey shallbe violently taken away from before you, and shall not be restored to you; your sheep shallbe given to your enemies, and you shall have no one to rescue them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your ox will be butchered before your eyes, but you will not eat a single bite of the meat. Your donkey will be taken from you, never to be returned. Your sheep and goats will be given to your enemies, and no one will be there to help you.
verses.textEnNasb: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat of it; your donkey will be snatched away from you, and will not be restored to you; your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
verses.textEn: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be forcibly taken from you and will not be returned. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.

verses.textZh: 你的儿女必被交给别国的民，你必亲眼看见，日日为他们焦虑；你必无能为力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的儿女必被交给别国的民，你必亲眼看见，日日为他们焦虑；你必无能为力。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至你因眼中所看见的，必致疯狂。
verses.textEnNiv: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Your sons and your daughters shall be given to another people, while your eyes look on and fail with longing for them all day long, but you shall be helpless.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your sons and your daughters shallbe given to another people, and your eyes shall look and fail withlonging for them all day long; and thereshallbe no strength in your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: You will watch as your sons and daughters are taken away as slaves. Your heart will break for them, but you won’t be able to help them.
verses.textEnNasb: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people, while your eyes look on and long for them constantly; but there will be nothing you can do.
verses.textEn: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.

verses.textZh: 你土地的出产和你劳碌得来的一切，都必被你不认识的民族吃尽；你必常常受压迫和压制；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你土地的出产和你劳碌得来的一切，都必被你不认识的民族吃尽；你必常常受压迫和压制；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必攻击你，使你膝上腿上，从脚掌到头顶，长毒疮无法医治。
verses.textEnNiv: A people that you do not know will eat what your land and labor produce, and you will have nothing but cruel oppression all your days.
verses.textEnEsv: A nation that you have not known shall eat up the fruit of your ground and of all your labors, and you shall be only oppressed and crushed continually,
verses.textEnNkjv: A nation whom you have not known shall eat the fruit of your land and the produce of your labor, and you shall be only oppressed and crushed continually.
verses.textEnNlt: A foreign nation you have never heard about will eat the crops you worked so hard to grow. You will suffer under constant oppression and harsh treatment.
verses.textEnNasb: A people whom you do not know will eat the produce of your ground and every product of your labor, and you will never be anything but oppressed and mistreated continually.
verses.textEn: A people that you do not know will eat what your land and labor produce, and you will have nothing but cruel oppression all your days.

verses.textZh: 你因亲眼看见的，必要疯狂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因亲眼看见的，必要疯狂。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华必将你和你所立的王领到你和你列祖素不认识的国去；在那里你必事奉木头石头的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The sights you see will drive you mad.
verses.textEnEsv: so that you are driven mad by the sights that your eyes see.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall be driven mad because of the sight which your eyes see.
verses.textEnNlt: You will go mad because of all the tragedy you see around you.
verses.textEnNasb: You will also be driven insane by the sight of what you see.
verses.textEn: The sights you see will drive you mad.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必用毒疮打击你的双膝和双腿，由踵至顶，使你无法医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必用毒疮打击你的双膝和双腿，由踵至顶，使你无法医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在耶和华领你到的各国中，要令人惊骇、笑谈、讥诮。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will afflict your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will strike you on the knees and on the legs with grievous boils of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will strike you in the knees and on the legs with severe boils which cannot be healed, and from the sole of your foot to the top of your head.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will cover your knees and legs with incurable boils. In fact, you will be covered from head to foot.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will strike you on the knees and thighs with severe boils from which you cannot be healed, and strike you from the sole of your foot to the top of your head.
verses.textEn: The Lord will afflict your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必把你和你所立统治你的君王，领到你和你的列祖都不认识的国那里去；在那里你必事奉别的神，就是木头石头所做的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必把你和你所立统治你的君王，领到你和你的列祖都不认识的国那里去；在那里你必事奉别的神，就是木头石头所做的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你带到田间的种子虽多，收进来的却少，因为被蝗虫吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will drive you and the king you set over you to a nation unknown to you or your ancestors. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord will bring you and your king whom you set over you to a nation that neither you nor your fathers have known. And there you shall serve other gods of wood and stone.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will bring you and the king whom you set over you to a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods—wood and stone.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will exile you and your king to a nation unknown to you and your ancestors. There in exile you will worship gods of wood and stone!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will bring you and your king, whom you appoint over you, to a nation that neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods, made of wood and stone.
verses.textEn: The Lord will drive you and the king you set over you to a nation unknown to you or your ancestors. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华要领你去的各民族中，你必成为使人惊骇、使人嘲笑和讽刺的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华要领你去的各民族中，你必成为使人惊骇、使人嘲笑和讽刺的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 你栽种、修理葡萄园，却不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因为被虫子吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: You will become a thing of horror, a byword and an object of ridicule among all the peoples where the Lord will drive you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall become a horror, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the Lord will lead you away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all nations where the Lord will drive you.
verses.textEnNlt: You will become an object of horror, ridicule, and mockery among all the nations to which the Lord sends you.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will become an object of horror, a song of mockery, and an object of taunting among all the peoples where the Lord drives you.
verses.textEn: You will become a thing of horror, a byword and an object of ridicule among all the peoples where the Lord will drive you.

verses.textZh: "你带到田间的种子虽然很多，但收进来的却很少，因为蝗虫把它吞吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你带到田间的种子虽然很多，但收进来的却很少，因为蝗虫把它吞吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你全境有橄榄树，却不得其油抹身，因为树上的橄榄不熟自落了。
verses.textEnNiv: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall carry much seed into the field and shall gather in little, for the locust shall consume it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall carry much seed out to the field but gather little in, for the locust shall consume it.
verses.textEnNlt: "You will plant much but harvest little, for locusts will eat your crops.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will bring out a great amount of seed to the field, but you will gather in little, because the locust will devour it.
verses.textEn: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.

verses.textZh: 你栽种修理葡萄园，必不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因为虫子把它吃尽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你栽种修理葡萄园，必不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因为虫子把它吃尽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你生儿养女，却不算是你的，因为必被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall plant vineyards and dress them, but you shall neither drink of the wine nor gather the grapes, for the worm shall eat them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall plant vineyards and tend them, but you shall neither drink of the wine nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.textEnNlt: You will plant vineyards and care for them, but you will not drink the wine or eat the grapes, for worms will destroy the vines.
verses.textEnNasb: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but you will neither drink of the wine nor bring in the harvest, because the worm will eat it.
verses.textEn: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

verses.textZh: 你全境必有橄榄树，却没有油抹身，因为你的橄榄还未成熟就脱落了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你全境必有橄榄树，却没有油抹身，因为你的橄榄还未成熟就脱落了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所有的树木和你地里的出产必被蝗虫所吃。
verses.textEnNiv: You will have olive trees throughout your country but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall have olive trees throughout all your territory, but you shall not anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives shall drop off.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall have olive trees throughout all your territory, but you shall not anoint yourself with the oil; for your olives shall drop off.
verses.textEnNlt: You will grow olive trees throughout your land, but you will never use the olive oil, for the fruit will drop before it ripens.
verses.textEnNasb: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but you will not anoint yourself with the oil, because your olives will drop off prematurely.
verses.textEn: You will have olive trees throughout your country but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.

verses.textZh: 你必生儿养女，却不是属你的，因为他们都要被掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必生儿养女，却不是属你的，因为他们都要被掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你中间寄居的，必渐渐上升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。
verses.textEnNiv: You will have sons and daughters but you will not keep them, because they will go into captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall father sons and daughters, but they shall not be yours, for they shall go into captivity.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall beget sons and daughters, but they shall not be yours; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: You will have sons and daughters, but you will lose them, for they will be led away into captivity.
verses.textEnNasb: You will father sons and daughters but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.
verses.textEn: You will have sons and daughters but you will not keep them, because they will go into captivity.

verses.textZh: 你所有的树木和你土地的出产，都必被害虫吃光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所有的树木和你土地的出产，都必被害虫吃光。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作首，你必作尾。
verses.textEnNiv: Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.
verses.textEnEsv: The cricket shall possess all your trees and the fruit of your ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Locusts shall consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
verses.textEnNlt: Swarms of insects will destroy your trees and crops.
verses.textEnNasb: The cricket will take possession of all your trees and the produce of your ground.
verses.textEn: Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.

verses.textZh: 住在你中间的寄居者必渐渐高升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在你中间的寄居者必渐渐高升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切咒诅必追随你，赶上你，直到你灭亡；因为你不听从耶和华－你神的话，不遵守他所吩咐的诫命律例。
verses.textEnNiv: The foreigners who reside among you will rise above you higher and higher, but you will sink lower and lower.
verses.textEnEsv: The sojourner who is among you shall rise higher and higher above you, and you shall come down lower and lower.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The alien who is among you shall rise higher and higher above you, and you shall come down lower and lower.
verses.textEnNlt: "The foreigners living among you will become stronger and stronger, while you become weaker and weaker.
verses.textEnNasb: The stranger who is among you will rise above you higher and higher, and you will go down lower and lower.
verses.textEn: The foreigners who reside among you will rise above you higher and higher, but you will sink lower and lower.

verses.textZh: 他要借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作头，你必作尾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作头，你必作尾。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远！
verses.textEnNiv: They will lend to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, but you will be the tail.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall lend to you, and you shall not lend to him. He shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall lend to you, but you shall not lend to him; he shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.
verses.textEnNlt: They will lend money to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, and you will be the tail!
verses.textEnNasb: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him; he will be the head, and you will be the tail.
verses.textEn: They will lend to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, but you will be the tail.

verses.textZh: 这一切咒诅必临到你，必追赶你，必把你追上，直到你被消灭，因为你不听从耶和华你的神的话，没有遵守他吩咐你的诫命和律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切咒诅必临到你，必追赶你，必把你追上，直到你被消灭，因为你不听从耶和华你的神的话，没有遵守他吩咐你的诫命和律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因为你富有的时候，不欢心乐意地事奉耶和华－你的神，
verses.textEnNiv: All these curses will come on you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the Lord your God and observe the commands and decrees he gave you.
verses.textEnEsv: "All these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you till you are destroyed, because you did not obey the voice of the Lord your God, to keep his commandments and his statutes that he commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover all these curses shall come upon you and pursue and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which He commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you refuse to listen to the Lord your God and to obey the commands and decrees he has given you, all these curses will pursue and overtake you until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "So all these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you would not obey the Lord your God by keeping His commandments and His statutes which He commanded you.
verses.textEn: All these curses will come on you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the Lord your God and observe the commands and decrees he gave you.

verses.textZh: 这些咒诅必在你和你的后裔身上成为异迹和奇事，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些咒诅必在你和你的后裔身上成为异迹和奇事，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你必在饥饿、干渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和华所打发来攻击你的仇敌。他必把铁轭加在你的颈项上，直到将你灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be a sign and a wonder to you and your descendants forever.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall be a sign and a wonder against you and your offspring forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall be upon you for a sign and a wonder, and on your descendants forever.
verses.textEnNlt: These horrors will serve as a sign and warning among you and your descendants forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will become a sign and a wonder against you and your descendants forever.
verses.textEn: They will be a sign and a wonder to you and your descendants forever.

verses.textZh: 因为你在这样富足的时候，没有以欢乐和高兴的心来事奉耶和华你的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你在这样富足的时候，没有以欢乐和高兴的心来事奉耶和华你的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华要从远方、地极带一国的民，如鹰飞来攻击你。这民的言语，你不懂得。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you did not serve the Lord your God joyfully and gladly in the time of prosperity,
verses.textEnEsv: Because you did not serve the Lord your God with joyfulness and gladness of heart, because of the abundance of all things,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because you did not serve the Lord your God with joy and gladness of heart, for the abundance of everything,
verses.textEnNlt: If you do not serve the Lord your God with joy and enthusiasm for the abundant benefits you have received,
verses.textEnNasb: "Since you did not serve the Lord your God with joy and a cheerful heart, in gratitude for the abundance of all things,
verses.textEn: Because you did not serve the Lord your God joyfully and gladly in the time of prosperity,

verses.textZh: 所以你必在饥饿、干渴、赤身露体和缺乏之中，去事奉耶和华派来攻击你的仇敌；他必把铁轭放在你的颈项上，直到把你消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你必在饥饿、干渴、赤身露体和缺乏之中，去事奉耶和华派来攻击你的仇敌；他必把铁轭放在你的颈项上，直到把你消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 这民的面貌凶恶，不顾恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and dire poverty, you will serve the enemies the Lord sends against you. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore you shall serve your enemies whom the Lord will send against you, in hunger and thirst, in nakedness, and lacking everything. And he will put a yoke of iron on your neck until he has destroyed you.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore you shall serve your enemies, whom the Lord will send against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in need of everything; and He will put a yoke of iron on your neck until He has destroyed you.
verses.textEnNlt: you will serve your enemies whom the Lord will send against you. You will be left hungry, thirsty, naked, and lacking in everything. The Lord will put an iron yoke on your neck, oppressing you harshly until he has destroyed you.
verses.textEnNasb: you will serve your enemies whom the Lord will send against you, in hunger, thirst, nakedness, and devoid of all things; and He will put an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.
verses.textEn: therefore in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and dire poverty, you will serve the enemies the Lord sends against you. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

verses.textZh: "耶和华必从远方，从地极把一国的民带来，像鹰一般飞来攻击你；这民的语言你不会听；
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华必从远方，从地极把一国的民带来，像鹰一般飞来攻击你；这民的语言你不会听；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所产的，直到你灭亡。你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔，都不给你留下，直到将你灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, like an eagle swooping down, a nation whose language you will not understand,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, swooping down like the eagle, a nation whose language you do not understand,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will bring a nation against you from afar, from the end of the earth, asswift as the eagle flies, a nation whose language you will not understand,
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will bring a distant nation against you from the end of the earth, and it will swoop down on you like a vulture. It is a nation whose language you do not understand,
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle swoops down; a nation whose language you will not understand,
verses.textEn: The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, like an eagle swooping down, a nation whose language you will not understand,

verses.textZh: 这民脸无羞耻，不顾老年人的情面，也不恩待青年人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这民脸无羞耻，不顾老年人的情面，也不恩待青年人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必将你困在你各城里，直到你所倚靠、高大坚固的城墙都被攻塌。他们必将你困在耶和华－你神所赐你遍地的各城里。
verses.textEnNiv: a fierce-looking nation without respect for the old or pity for the young.
verses.textEnEsv: a hard-faced nation who shall not respect the old or show mercy to the young.
verses.textEnNkjv: a nation of fierce countenance, which does not respect the elderly nor show favor to the young.
verses.textEnNlt: a fierce and heartless nation that shows no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
verses.textEnNasb: a nation with a defiant attitude, who will have no respect for the old, nor show favor to the young.
verses.textEn: a fierce-looking nation without respect for the old or pity for the young.

verses.textZh: 他们必吞吃你牲畜所生的和你土地所产的，直到把你消灭；必不给你留下五谷、新酒和油、幼小的牛，以及肥嫩的羊，直到使你灭亡为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必吞吃你牲畜所生的和你土地所产的，直到把你消灭；必不给你留下五谷、新酒和油、幼小的牛，以及肥嫩的羊，直到使你灭亡为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在仇敌围困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和华－你神所赐给你的儿女之肉。
verses.textEnNiv: They will devour the young of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or olive oil, nor any calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until you are ruined.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall eat the offspring of your cattle and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed; it also shall not leave you grain, wine, or oil, the increase of your herds or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall eat the increase of your livestock and the produce of your land, until you are destroyed; they shall not leave you grain or new wine or oil, or the increase of your cattle or the offspring of your flocks, until they have destroyed you.
verses.textEnNlt: Its armies will devour your livestock and crops, and you will be destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine, olive oil, calves, or lambs, and you will starve to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, it will eat the offspring of your herd and the produce of your ground until you are destroyed; a nation that will leave you no grain, new wine, or oil, nor the newborn of your cattle or the young of your flock, until they have eliminated you.
verses.textEn: They will devour the young of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or olive oil, nor any calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until you are ruined.

verses.textZh: 他们必把你围困在你的各城里，直到在你的全境内你所倚靠高大和坚固的城墙都被攻陷；他们必把你围困在耶和华你的神赐给你的全地的各城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必把你围困在你的各城里，直到在你的全境内你所倚靠高大和坚固的城墙都被攻陷；他们必把你围困在耶和华你的神赐给你的全地的各城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的人必恶眼看他弟兄和他怀中的妻，并他余剩的儿女；
verses.textEnNiv: They will lay siege to all the cities throughout your land until the high fortified walls in which you trust fall down. They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: "They shall besiege you in all your towns, until your high and fortified walls, in which you trusted, come down throughout all your land. And they shall besiege you in all your towns throughout all your land, which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall besiege you at all your gates until your high and fortified walls, in which you trust, come down throughout all your land; and they shall besiege you at all your gates throughout all your land which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnNlt: They will attack your cities until all the fortified walls in your land—the walls you trusted to protect you—are knocked down. They will attack all the towns in the land the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will besiege you in all your towns until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout your land, and it will besiege you in all your towns throughout your land which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEn: They will lay siege to all the cities throughout your land until the high fortified walls in which you trust fall down. They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.textZh: 你在仇敌围困和窘迫你的时候，要吃你身所生的，就是吃耶和华你的神赐给你的儿女的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在仇敌围困和窘迫你的时候，要吃你身所生的，就是吃耶和华你的神赐给你的儿女的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中，他要吃儿女的肉，不肯分一点给他的亲人，因为他一无所剩。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your sons and daughters, whom the Lord your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies shall distress you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and your daughters whom the Lord your God has given you, in the siege and desperate straits in which your enemy shall distress you.
verses.textEnNlt: "The siege and terrible distress of the enemy’s attack will be so severe that you will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters, whom the Lord your God has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will eat the offspring of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters whom the Lord your God has given you, during the siege and the hardship by which your enemy will oppress you.
verses.textEn: Because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the Lord your God has given you.

verses.textZh: 你们中间温柔嫩弱的男人，必敌视自己的兄弟、怀中的妻子和余剩的儿女；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间温柔嫩弱的男人，必敌视自己的兄弟、怀中的妻子和余剩的儿女；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的妇人，是因娇嫩柔弱不肯把脚踏地的，必恶眼看她怀中的丈夫和她的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the most gentle and sensitive man among you will have no compassion on his own brother or the wife he loves or his surviving children,
verses.textEnEsv: The man who is the most tender and refined among you will begrudge food to his brother, to the wife he embraces, and to the last of the children whom he has left,
verses.textEnNkjv: The sensitive and very refined man among you will be hostile toward his brother, toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the rest of his children whom he leaves behind,
verses.textEnNlt: The most tenderhearted man among you will have no compassion for his own brother, his beloved wife, and his surviving children.
verses.textEnNasb: The man who is refined and very delicate among you will be hostile toward his brother, toward the wife he cherishes, and toward the rest of his children who are left,
verses.textEn: Even the most gentle and sensitive man among you will have no compassion on his own brother or the wife he loves or his surviving children,

verses.textZh: 甚至在你的仇敌围困和窘迫你在各城里的时候，他要吃自己儿女的肉，却不肯分给他们任何人，因为他没有甚么剩下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至在你的仇敌围困和窘迫你在各城里的时候，他要吃自己儿女的肉，却不肯分给他们任何人，因为他没有甚么剩下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她两腿中间出来的婴孩与她所要生的儿女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中将他们暗暗地吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: and he will not give to one of them any of the flesh of his children that he is eating. It will be all he has left because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of all your cities.
verses.textEnEsv: so that he will not give to any of them any of the flesh of his children whom he is eating, because he has nothing else left, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy shall distress you in all your towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that he will not give any of them the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left in the siege and desperate straits in which your enemy shall distress you at all your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: He will refuse to share with them the flesh he is devouring—the flesh of one of his own children—because he has nothing else to eat during the siege and terrible distress that your enemy will inflict on all your towns.
verses.textEnNasb: so that he will not give even one of them any of the flesh of his children which he will eat, since he has nothing else left, during the siege and the hardship by which your enemy will oppress you in all your towns.
verses.textEn: and he will not give to one of them any of the flesh of his children that he is eating. It will be all he has left because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of all your cities.

verses.textZh: 你们中间温柔娇嫩的妇人，素来因为温柔娇嫩不肯把脚掌踏在地上，现在必敌视自己怀中的丈夫和自己的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间温柔娇嫩的妇人，素来因为温柔娇嫩不肯把脚掌踏在地上，现在必敌视自己怀中的丈夫和自己的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 也必使你所惧怕、埃及人的病都临到你，贴在你身上，
verses.textEnNiv: The most gentle and sensitive woman among you—so sensitive and gentle that she would not venture to touch the ground with the sole of her foot—will begrudge the husband she loves and her own son or daughter
verses.textEnEsv: The most tender and refined woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground because she is so delicate and tender, will begrudge to the husband she embraces, to her son and to her daughter,
verses.textEnNkjv: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground because of her delicateness and sensitivity, will refuse to the husband of her bosom, and to her son and her daughter,
verses.textEnNlt: The most tender and delicate woman among you—so delicate she would not so much as touch the ground with her foot—will be selfish toward the husband she loves and toward her own son or daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: The refined and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground because of her delicateness and tenderness, will be hostile toward the husband she cherishes and toward her son and daughter,
verses.textEn: The most gentle and sensitive woman among you—so sensitive and gentle that she would not venture to touch the ground with the sole of her foot—will begrudge the husband she loves and her own son or daughter

verses.textZh: 她暗中把自己两腿之间出来的胞衣，和自己生的儿女吃掉，因为在你的仇敌围困和窘迫你在各城里的时候，她甚么都没有了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她暗中把自己两腿之间出来的胞衣，和自己生的儿女吃掉，因为在你的仇敌围困和窘迫你在各城里的时候，她甚么都没有了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又必将没有写在这律法书上的各样疾病、灾殃降在你身上，直到你灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: the afterbirth from her womb and the children she bears. For in her dire need she intends to eat them secretly because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of your cities.
verses.textEnEsv: her afterbirth that comes out from between her feet and her children whom she bears, because lacking everything she will eat them secretly, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy shall distress you in your towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: her placenta which comes out from between her feet and her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of everything in the siege and desperate straits in which your enemy shall distress you at all your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: She will hide from them the afterbirth and the new baby she has borne, so that she herself can secretly eat them. She will have nothing else to eat during the siege and terrible distress that your enemy will inflict on all your towns.
verses.textEnNasb: and toward her afterbirth that comes from between her legs, and toward her children to whom she gives birth, because she will eat them secretly for lack of anything else, during the siege and the hardship with which your enemy will oppress you in your towns.
verses.textEn: the afterbirth from her womb and the children she bears. For in her dire need she intends to eat them secretly because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of your cities.

verses.textZh: "如果你不谨守遵行写在这书上的这律法的一切话，不敬畏这荣耀和可畏的名，就是耶和华你的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你不谨守遵行写在这书上的这律法的一切话，不敬畏这荣耀和可畏的名，就是耶和华你的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们先前虽然像天上的星那样多，却因不听从耶和华－你神的话，所剩的人数就稀少了。
verses.textEnNiv: If you do not carefully follow all the words of this law, which are written in this book, and do not revere this glorious and awesome name—the Lord your God—
verses.textEnEsv: "If you are not careful to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name, the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you do not carefully observe all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name, THE Lord YOUR GOD,
verses.textEnNlt: "If you refuse to obey all the words of instruction that are written in this book, and if you do not fear the glorious and awesome name of the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNasb: "If you are not careful to follow all the words of this Law that are written in this book, to fear this honored and awesome name, the Lord your God,
verses.textEn: If you do not carefully follow all the words of this law, which are written in this book, and do not revere this glorious and awesome name—the Lord your God—

verses.textZh: 耶和华就必使你和你的后裔遭受奇灾，就是大而长久的灾，毒而长久的病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就必使你和你的后裔遭受奇灾，就是大而长久的灾，毒而长久的病。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前耶和华怎样喜悦善待你们，使你们众多，也要照样喜悦毁灭你们，使你们灭亡；并且你们从所要进去得的地上必被拔除。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord will send fearful plagues on you and your descendants, harsh and prolonged disasters, and severe and lingering illnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: then the Lord will bring on you and your offspring extraordinary afflictions, afflictions severe and lasting, and sicknesses grievous and lasting.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the Lord will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary plagues—great and prolonged plagues—and serious and prolonged sicknesses.
verses.textEnNlt: then the Lord will overwhelm you and your children with indescribable plagues. These plagues will be intense and without relief, making you miserable and unbearably sick.
verses.textEnNasb: then the Lord will bring extraordinary plagues on you and your descendants, severe and lasting plagues, and miserable and chronic sicknesses.
verses.textEn: the Lord will send fearful plagues on you and your descendants, harsh and prolonged disasters, and severe and lingering illnesses.

verses.textZh: 他必使你惧怕的埃及人的各种疾病都临到你身上，紧紧地缠着你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必使你惧怕的埃及人的各种疾病都临到你身上，紧紧地缠着你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中，从地这边到地那边，你必在那里事奉你和你列祖素不认识、木头石头的神。
verses.textEnNiv: He will bring on you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will bring upon you again all the diseases of Egypt, of which you were afraid, and they shall cling to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He will bring back on you all the diseases of Egypt, of which you were afraid, and they shall cling to you.
verses.textEnNlt: He will afflict you with all the diseases of Egypt that you feared so much, and you will have no relief.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will bring back on you every disease of Egypt of which you were afraid, and they will cling to you.
verses.textEn: He will bring on you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.

verses.textZh: 又把这律法书上没有记载的各样灾病，都降在你身上，直到你被消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把这律法书上没有记载的各样灾病，都降在你身上，直到你被消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些国中，你必不得安逸，也不得落脚之地；耶和华却使你在那里心中跳动，眼目失明，精神消耗。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Every sickness also and every affliction that is not recorded in the book of this law, the Lord will bring upon you, until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also every sickness and every plague, which is not written in this Book of the Law, will the Lord bring upon you until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will afflict you with every sickness and plague there is, even those not mentioned in this Book of Instruction, until you are destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Also every sickness and every plague, which are not written in the book of this Law, the Lord will bring on you until you are destroyed.
verses.textEn: The Lord will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.

verses.textZh: 你们以前虽然像天上的星那么多，现在剩下的人数却寥寥可数，因为你不听从耶和华你的神的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们以前虽然像天上的星那么多，现在剩下的人数却寥寥可数，因为你不听从耶和华你的神的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的性命必悬悬无定；你昼夜恐惧，自料性命难保。
verses.textEnNiv: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Whereas you were as numerous as the stars of heaven, you shall be left few in number, because you did not obey the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of heaven in multitude, because you would not obey the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Though you become as numerous as the stars in the sky, few of you will be left because you would not listen to the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will be left few in number, whereas you were as numerous as the stars of heaven, because you did not obey the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 先前耶和华怎样喜欢使你们得好处，使你们人数众多，将来也必怎样喜欢把你们灭亡，把你们消灭；你们必从要进去得为业的地上被拔除。
