verses.textZhCnvs: 先前耶和华怎样喜欢使你们得好处，使你们人数众多，将来也必怎样喜欢把你们灭亡，把你们消灭；你们必从要进去得为业的地上被拔除。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因心里所恐惧的，眼中所看见的，早晨必说，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必说，巴不得到早晨才好。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as it pleased the Lord to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: And as the Lord took delight in doing you good and multiplying you, so the Lord will take delight in bringing ruin upon you and destroying you. And you shall be plucked off the land that you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, that just as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good and multiply you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you and bring you to nothing; and you shall be plucked from off the land which you go to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: "Just as the Lord has found great pleasure in causing you to prosper and multiply, the Lord will find pleasure in destroying you. You will be torn from the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that, just as the Lord rejoiced over you to be good to you, and make you numerous, so will the Lord rejoice over you to wipe you out and destroy you; and you will be torn away from the land which you are entering to possess.
verses.textEn: Just as it pleased the Lord to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使你分散在万民中，从地的这边到地的那边；在那里你要事奉你和你的列祖不认识的别的神，就是木头和石头做的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使你分散在万民中，从地的这边到地的那边；在那里你要事奉你和你的列祖不认识的别的神，就是木头和石头做的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告诉你不得再见的路；在那里你必卖己身与仇敌作奴婢，却无人买。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your ancestors have known.
verses.textEnEsv: "And the Lord will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you shall serve other gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the Lord will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known—wood and stone.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will scatter you among all the nations from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship foreign gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known, gods made of wood and stone!
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, the Lord will scatter you among all the peoples, from one end of the earth to the other; and there you will serve other gods, made of wood and stone, which you and your fathers have not known.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your ancestors have known.

verses.textZh: 在那些国中，你必不得安息，也没有脚掌歇息的地方；耶和华却必使你在那里心中发颤，眼目憔悴，精神颓废。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些国中，你必不得安息，也没有脚掌歇息的地方；耶和华却必使你在那里心中发颤，眼目憔悴，精神颓废。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些国中，你必不得安息，也没有脚掌歇息的地方；耶和华却必使你在那里心中发颤，眼目憔悴，精神颓废。
verses.textEnNiv: Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the Lord will give you an anxious mind, eyes weary with longing, and a despairing heart.
verses.textEnEsv: And among these nations you shall find no respite, and there shall be no resting place for the sole of your foot, but the Lord will give you there a trembling heart and failing eyes and a languishing soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: And among those nations you shall find no rest, nor shall the sole of your foot have a resting place; but there the Lord will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and anguish of soul.
verses.textEnNlt: There among those nations you will find no peace or place to rest. And the Lord will cause your heart to tremble, your eyesight to fail, and your soul to despair.
verses.textEnNasb: Among those nations you will find no peace, and there will be no resting place for the sole of your foot; but there the Lord will give you a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and despair of soul.
verses.textEn: Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the Lord will give you an anxious mind, eyes weary with longing, and a despairing heart.

verses.textZh: 你未来的生命必悬而不定；你必昼夜恐惧，生命难保。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你未来的生命必悬而不定；你必昼夜恐惧，生命难保。
verses.textZhCuv: 你未来的生命必悬而不定；你必昼夜恐惧，生命难保。
verses.textEnNiv: You will live in constant suspense, filled with dread both night and day, never sure of your life.
verses.textEnEsv: Your life shall hang in doubt before you. Night and day you shall be in dread and have no assurance of your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your life shall hang in doubt before you; you shall fear day and night, and have no assurance of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Your life will constantly hang in the balance. You will live night and day in fear, unsure if you will survive.
verses.textEnNasb: So your lives will be hanging in doubt before you; and you will be terrified night and day, and have no assurance of your life.
verses.textEn: You will live in constant suspense, filled with dread both night and day, never sure of your life.

verses.textZh: 因你心里的惧怕惊恐和你眼中看见的景象，早晨你必说：‘但愿现在是晚上！’晚上你必说：‘但愿现在是早晨！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你心里的惧怕惊恐和你眼中看见的景象，早晨你必说：‘但愿现在是晚上！’晚上你必说：‘但愿现在是早晨！’
verses.textZhCuv: 因你心里的惧怕惊恐和你眼中看见的景象，早晨你必说：‘但愿现在是晚上！’晚上你必说：‘但愿现在是早晨！’
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning you will say, "If only it were evening!" and in the evening, "If only it were morning!"—because of the terror that will fill your hearts and the sights that your eyes will see.
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning you shall say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and at evening you shall say, ‘If only it were morning!’ because of the dread that your heart shall feel, and the sights that your eyes shall see.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the morning you shall say, ‘Oh, that it were evening!’ And at evening you shall say, ‘Oh, that it were morning!’ because of the fear which terrifies your heart, and because of the sight which your eyes see.
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were night!’ And in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’ For you will be terrified by the awful horrors you see around you.
verses.textEnNasb: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ And at evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’ because of the terror of your heart which you fear, and the sight of your eyes which you will see.
verses.textEn: In the morning you will say, "If only it were evening!" and in the evening, "If only it were morning!"—because of the terror that will fill your hearts and the sights that your eyes will see.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必用船把你送回埃及去，走我曾经告诉你，你不得再见的那条路；在那里你们必卖身给你的仇敌作奴仆和作婢女，却没有人买。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必用船把你送回埃及去，走我曾经告诉你，你不得再见的那条路；在那里你们必卖身给你的仇敌作奴仆和作婢女，却没有人买。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必用船把你送回埃及去，走我曾经告诉你，你不得再见的那条路；在那里你们必卖身给你的仇敌作奴仆和作婢女，却没有人买。"
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will send you back in ships to Egypt on a journey I said you should never make again. There you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will bring you back in ships to Egypt, a journey that I promised that you should never make again; and there you shall offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but there will be no buyer."
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Lord will take you back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said to you, ‘You shall never see it again.’ And there you shall be offered for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will send you back to Egypt in ships, to a destination I promised you would never see again. There you will offer to sell yourselves to your enemies as slaves, but no one will buy you."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way about which I said to you, ‘You will never see it again!’ And there you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but there will be no buyer."
verses.textEn: The Lord will send you back in ships to Egypt on a journey I said you should never make again. There you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.

verses.textZh: 这些是耶和华在摩押地，吩咐摩西与以色列人所立的约的话，是耶和华和他们在何烈山所立的约以外的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些是耶和华在摩押地，吩咐摩西与以色列人所立的约的话，是耶和华和他们在何烈山所立的约以外的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华在摩押地吩咐摩西与以色列人立约的话，是在他和他们于何烈山所立的约之外。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the terms of the covenant the Lord commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the words of the covenant that the Lord commanded Moses to make with the people of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that he had made with them at Horeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the words of the covenant which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the terms of the covenant the Lord commanded Moses to make with the Israelites while they were in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the words of the covenant which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which He had made with them at Horeb.
verses.textEn: These are the terms of the covenant the Lord commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.

verses.textZh: 摩西把以色列众人召了来，对他们说："耶和华在埃及地，在你们面前，向法老和他的众臣仆，以及他的全国所行的一切，你们都看见了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把以色列众人召了来，对他们说："耶和华在埃及地，在你们面前，向法老和他的众臣仆，以及他的全国所行的一切，你们都看见了，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西召了以色列众人来，对他们说：「耶和华在埃及地，在你们眼前向法老和他众臣仆，并他全地所行的一切事，你们都看见了，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: "You have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses called all Israel and said to them: "You have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land—
verses.textEnNlt: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them, "You have seen with your own eyes everything the Lord did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to his whole country—
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, "You have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and all his servants, and to all his land;
verses.textEn: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.

verses.textZh: 就是你亲眼见过的大试验和神迹，以及那些大奇事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是你亲眼见过的大试验和神迹，以及那些大奇事；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验和神迹，并那些大奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those signs and great wonders.
verses.textEnEsv: the great trials that your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
verses.textEnNkjv: the great trials which your eyes have seen, the signs, and those great wonders.
verses.textEnNlt: all the great tests of strength, the miraculous signs, and the amazing wonders.
verses.textEnNasb: the great trials which your eyes have seen, those great signs and wonders.
verses.textEn: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those signs and great wonders.

verses.textZh: 但是直到今日，耶和华还没有给你们一颗能明白的心，能看见的眼睛，能听见的耳朵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是直到今日，耶和华还没有给你们一颗能明白的心，能看见的眼睛，能听见的耳朵。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华到今日没有使你们心能明白，眼能看见，耳能听见。
verses.textEnNiv: But to this day the Lord has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.
verses.textEnEsv: But to this day the Lord has not given you a heart to understand or eyes to see or ears to hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the Lord has not given you a heart to perceive and eyes to see and ears to hear, to this very day.
verses.textEnNlt: But to this day the Lord has not given you minds that understand, nor eyes that see, nor ears that hear!
verses.textEnNasb: Yet to this day the Lord has not given you a heart to know, nor eyes to see, nor ears to hear.
verses.textEn: But to this day the Lord has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.

verses.textZh: 我在旷野四十年之久领导你们；你们身上的衣服没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在旷野四十年之久领导你们；你们身上的衣服没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 我领你们在旷野四十年，你们身上的衣服并没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet the Lord says, "During the forty years that I led you through the wilderness, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.
verses.textEnEsv: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not worn out on you, and your sandals have not worn off your feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not worn out on you, and your sandals have not worn out on your feet.
verses.textEnNlt: For forty years I led you through the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.
verses.textEnNasb: And I have led you in the wilderness for forty years; your clothes have not worn out on you, and your sandal has not worn out on your foot.
verses.textEn: Yet the Lord says, "During the forty years that I led you through the wilderness, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.

verses.textZh: 饭你们没有吃，清酒或烈酒你们没有喝，这是要使你们知道耶和华是你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 饭你们没有吃，清酒或烈酒你们没有喝，这是要使你们知道耶和华是你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们没有吃饼，也没有喝清酒浓酒。这要使你们知道，耶和华是你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: You have not eaten bread, and you have not drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have not eaten bread, nor have you drunk wine or similar drink, that you may know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other alcoholic drink, but he provided for you so you would know that he is the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You have not eaten bread, nor have you drunk wine or other strong drink, in order that you might know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 你们来到了这地方，希实本王西宏和巴珊王噩就出来，与我们交战，我们击败了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们来到了这地方，希实本王西宏和巴珊王噩就出来，与我们交战，我们击败了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们来到这地方，希实本王西宏、巴珊王噩都出来与我们交战，我们就击杀了他们，
verses.textEnNiv: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, but we defeated them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you came to this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we conquered them.
verses.textEnNlt: "When we came here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.
verses.textEnNasb: When you reached this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out to meet us for battle, but we defeated them;
verses.textEn: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.

verses.textZh: 夺取了他们的地，分给流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夺取了他们的地，分给流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 取了他们的地给吕便支派、迦得支派，和玛拿西半支派为业。
verses.textEnNiv: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: We took their land and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.textEnNkjv: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: We took their land and gave it to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh as their grant of land.
verses.textEnNasb: and we took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.textEn: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要谨守这约的话，并且遵行，好使你们在所行的一切事上都亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要谨守这约的话，并且遵行，好使你们在所行的一切事上都亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要谨守遵行这约的话，好叫你们在一切所行的事上亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore keep the words of this covenant, and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, obey the terms of this covenant so that you will prosper in everything you do.
verses.textEnNasb: So you will keep the words of this covenant and do them, in order that you may be successful in everything that you do.
verses.textEn: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.

verses.textZh: "今日你们全都站在耶和华你们的神面前；你们的首领、族长、长老、官长和以色列所有的男子，
verses.textZhCnvs: "今日你们全都站在耶和华你们的神面前；你们的首领、族长、长老、官长和以色列所有的男子，
verses.textZhCuv: 为要你顺从耶和华－你神今日与你所立的约，向你所起的誓。
verses.textEnNiv: All of you are standing today in the presence of the Lord your God—your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: "You are standing today, all of you, before the Lord your God: the heads of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, all the men of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: "All of you stand today before the Lord your God: your leaders and your tribes and your elders and your officers, all the men of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: All of you—tribal leaders, elders, officers, all the men of Israel—are standing today in the presence of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "You stand today, all of you, before the Lord your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders and your officers, that is, all the men of Israel,
verses.textEn: All of you are standing today in the presence of the Lord your God—your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,

verses.textZh: 你们的小孩、妻子和在你营中的寄居者，以及为你们劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和华你们的神面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的小孩、妻子和在你营中的寄居者，以及为你们劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和华你们的神面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他要照他向你所应许的话，又向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: together with your children and your wives, and the foreigners living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.
verses.textEnEsv: your little ones, your wives, and the sojourner who is in your camp, from the one who chops your wood to the one who draws your water,
verses.textEnNkjv: your little ones and your wives—also the stranger who is in your camp, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water—
verses.textEnNlt: Your little ones and your wives are with you, as well as the foreigners living among you who chop your wood and carry your water.
verses.textEnNasb: your little ones, your wives, and the stranger who is within your camps, from the one who gathers your firewood to the one who draws your water,
verses.textEn: together with your children and your wives, and the foreigners living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.

verses.textZh: 为要叫你遵守耶和华你的神今日与你所立的约，和他向你所起的誓；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要叫你遵守耶和华你的神今日与你所立的约，和他向你所起的誓；
verses.textZhCuv: 我不但与你们立这约，起这誓，
verses.textEnNiv: You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the Lord your God, a covenant the Lord is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,
verses.textEnEsv: so that you may enter into the sworn covenant of the Lord your God, which the Lord your God is making with you today,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may enter into covenant with the Lord your God, and into His oath, which the Lord your God makes with you today,
verses.textEnNlt: You are standing here today to enter into the covenant of the Lord your God. The Lord is making this covenant, including the curses.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you may enter into the covenant with the Lord your God, and into His oath which the Lord your God is making with you today,
verses.textEn: You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the Lord your God, a covenant the Lord is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,

verses.textZh: 这样，他今日可以立你作他的子民，他可以作你的神，正如他曾经对你说过的，又对你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起过誓的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他今日可以立你作他的子民，他可以作你的神，正如他曾经对你说过的，又对你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起过誓的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡与我们一同站在耶和华－我们神面前的，并今日不在我们这里的人，我也与他们立这约，起这誓。
verses.textEnNiv: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he promised you, and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: that He may establish you today as a people for Himself, and that He may be God to you, just as He has spoken to you, and just as He has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: By entering into the covenant today, he will establish you as his people and confirm that he is your God, just as he promised you and as he swore to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: in order that He may establish you today as His people, and that He may be your God, just as He spoke to you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEn: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

verses.textZh: "我不但与你们立这约，起这誓；
verses.textZhCnvs: "我不但与你们立这约，起这誓；
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们曾住过埃及地，也从列国经过；这是你们知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you
verses.textEnEsv: It is not with you alone that I am making this sworn covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: "I make this covenant and this oath, not with you alone,
verses.textEnNlt: "But you are not the only ones with whom I am making this covenant with its curses.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now it is not with you alone that I am making this covenant and this oath,
verses.textEn: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you

verses.textZh: 而且也与那些今日和我们在这里，一同站在耶和华我们的神面前的人，以及那些今日不与我们同在这里的人立这约，起这誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且也与那些今日和我们在这里，一同站在耶和华我们的神面前的人，以及那些今日不与我们同在这里的人立这约，起这誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也看见他们中间可憎之物，并他们木、石、金、银的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the Lord our God but also with those who are not here today.
verses.textEnEsv: but with whoever is standing here with us today before the Lord our God, and with whoever is not here with us today.
verses.textEnNkjv: but with him who stands here with us today before the Lord our God, as well as with him who is not here with us today
verses.textEnNlt: I am making this covenant both with you who stand here today in the presence of the Lord our God, and also with the future generations who are not standing here today.
verses.textEnNasb: but both with those who stand here with us today in the presence of the Lord our God, and with those who are not with us here today
verses.textEn: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the Lord our God but also with those who are not here today.

verses.textZh: 你们清楚知道我们怎样在埃及地住过，怎样从列国中经过；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们清楚知道我们怎样在埃及地住过，怎样从列国中经过；
verses.textZhCuv: 惟恐你们中间，或男或女，或族长或支派长，今日心里偏离耶和华－我们的神，去事奉那些国的神；又怕你们中间有恶根生出苦菜和茵陈来，
verses.textEnNiv: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.
verses.textEnEsv: "You know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the midst of the nations through which you passed.
verses.textEnNkjv: (for you know that we dwelt in the land of Egypt and that we came through the nations which you passed by,
verses.textEnNlt: "You remember how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we traveled through the lands of enemy nations as we left.
verses.textEnNasb: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we passed through the midst of the nations through which you passed;
verses.textEn: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.

verses.textZh: 你们也见过他们的可憎之物，和他们那里那些木、石、金、银的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也见过他们的可憎之物，和他们那里那些木、石、金、银的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 听见这咒诅的话，心里仍是自夸说：『我虽然行事心里顽梗，连累众人，却还是平安。』
verses.textEnNiv: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And you have seen their detestable things, their idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold, which were among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you saw their abominations and their idols which were among them—wood and stone and silver and gold);
verses.textEnNlt: You have seen their detestable practices and their idols made of wood, stone, silver, and gold.
verses.textEnNasb: moreover, you have seen their abominations and their idols made of wood and stone, silver and gold, which they had with them);
verses.textEn: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

verses.textZh: 恐怕你们中间有男人或女人，家族或支派，今日心里偏离了耶和华我们的神，去事奉那些国的神，又恐怕你们中间有恶根，生出毒草和苦堇来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕你们中间有男人或女人，家族或支派，今日心里偏离了耶和华我们的神，去事奉那些国的神，又恐怕你们中间有恶根，生出毒草和苦堇来；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必不饶恕他；耶和华的怒气与愤恨要向他发作，如烟冒出，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都加在他身上。耶和华又要从天下涂抹他的名，
verses.textEnNiv: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the Lord our God to go and worship the gods of those nations; make sure there is no root among you that produces such bitter poison.
verses.textEnEsv: Beware lest there be among you a man or woman or clan or tribe whose heart is turning away today from the Lord our God to go and serve the gods of those nations. Beware lest there be among you a root bearing poisonous and bitter fruit,
verses.textEnNkjv: so that there may not be among you man or woman or family or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the Lord our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations, and that there may not be among you a root bearing bitterness or wormwood;
verses.textEnNlt: I am making this covenant with you so that no one among you—no man, woman, clan, or tribe—will turn away from the Lord our God to worship these gods of other nations, and so that no root among you bears bitter and poisonous fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: so that there will not be among you a man or woman, or family or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the Lord our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; that there will not be among you a root bearing poisonous fruit and wormwood.
verses.textEn: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the Lord our God to go and worship the gods of those nations; make sure there is no root among you that produces such bitter poison.

verses.textZh: 如果人听了这咒诅的话，心里仍然自夸说：‘我虽然照着顽梗的心而行，使好人和恶人一起灭亡，我还有平安。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人听了这咒诅的话，心里仍然自夸说：‘我虽然照着顽梗的心而行，使好人和恶人一起灭亡，我还有平安。’
verses.textZhCuv: 也必照着写在律法书上、约中的一切咒诅将他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他受祸。
verses.textEnNiv: When such a person hears the words of this oath and they invoke a blessing on themselves, thinking, "I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way," they will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.
verses.textEnEsv: one who, when he hears the words of this sworn covenant, blesses himself in his heart, saying, ‘I shall be safe, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart.’ This will lead to the sweeping away of moist and dry alike.
verses.textEnNkjv: and so it may not happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he blesses himself in his heart, saying, ‘I shall have peace, even though I follow the dictates of my heart’— as though the drunkard could be included with the sober.
verses.textEnNlt: "Those who hear the warnings of this curse should not congratulate themselves, thinking, ‘I am safe, even though I am following the desires of my own stubborn heart.’ This would lead to utter ruin!
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be when he hears the words of this curse, that he will consider himself fortunate in his heart, saying, ‘I will do well though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart in order to destroy the watered land along with the dry.’
verses.textEn: When such a person hears the words of this oath and they invoke a blessing on themselves, thinking, "I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way," they will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必不肯饶恕他；耶和华的怒气和愤恨必向这人发作，这书上所写的一切咒诅都要降在那人身上，耶和华也必从天下涂抹他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必不肯饶恕他；耶和华的怒气和愤恨必向这人发作，这书上所写的一切咒诅都要降在那人身上，耶和华也必从天下涂抹他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的后代，就是以后兴起来的子孙，和远方来的外人，看见这地的灾殃，并耶和华所降与这地的疾病，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will never be willing to forgive them; his wrath and zeal will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will fall on them, and the Lord will blot out their names from under heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will not be willing to forgive him, but rather the anger of the Lord and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and the curses written in this book will settle upon him, and the Lord will blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord would not spare him; for then the anger of the Lord and His jealousy would burn against that man, and every curse that is written in this book would settle on him, and the Lord would blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will never pardon such people. Instead his anger and jealousy will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will come down on them, and the Lord will erase their names from under heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will not be willing to forgive him, but rather the anger of the Lord and His wrath will burn against that person, and every curse that is written in this book will lie upon him, and the Lord will wipe out his name from under heaven.
verses.textEn: The Lord will never be willing to forgive them; his wrath and zeal will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will fall on them, and the Lord will blot out their names from under heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必照着写在这律法书上的约的一切咒诅，把他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他遭受灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必照着写在这律法书上的约的一切咒诅，把他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他遭受灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 又看见遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火迹，没有耕种，没有出产，连草都不生长－好像耶和华在忿怒中所倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁一样－
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will single them out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will single him out from all the tribes of Israel for calamity, in accordance with all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord would separate him from all the tribes of Israel for adversity, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this Book of the Law,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will separate them from all the tribes of Israel, to pour out on them all the curses of the covenant recorded in this Book of Instruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord will single him out for disaster from all the tribes of Israel, in accordance with all the curses of the covenant which is written in this Book of the Law.
verses.textEn: The Lord will single them out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

verses.textZh: "后代的人，就是你们以后兴起来的子孙，和从远方来的外族人，看见了这地的灾难和耶和华降与这地的疾病，
verses.textZhCnvs: "后代的人，就是你们以后兴起来的子孙，和从远方来的外族人，看见了这地的灾难和耶和华降与这地的疾病，
verses.textZhCuv: 所看见的人，连万国人，都必问说：『耶和华为何向此地这样行呢？这样大发烈怒是什么意思呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the Lord has afflicted it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the next generation, your children who rise up after you, and the foreigner who comes from a far land, will say, when they see the afflictions of that land and the sicknesses with which the Lord has made it sick—
verses.textEnNkjv: so that the coming generation of your children who rise up after you, and the foreigner who comes from a far land, would say, when they see the plagues of that land and the sicknesses which the Lord has laid on it:
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the generations to come, both your own descendants and the foreigners who come from distant lands, will see the devastation of the land and the diseases the Lord inflicts on it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now the future generation, your sons who rise up after you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land, when they see the plagues of that land and the diseases with which the Lord has afflicted it, will say,
verses.textEn: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the Lord has afflicted it.

verses.textZh: 又看见了遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火烧，没有播种，没有出产，寸草不生，好象耶和华在烈怒和怒火中毁灭的所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又看见了遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火烧，没有播种，没有出产，寸草不生，好象耶和华在烈怒和怒火中毁灭的所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 人必回答说：『是因这地的人离弃了耶和华－他们列祖的神，领他们出埃及地的时候与他们所立的约，
verses.textEnNiv: The whole land will be a burning waste of salt and sulfur—nothing planted, nothing sprouting, no vegetation growing on it. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, which the Lord overthrew in fierce anger.
verses.textEnEsv: the whole land burned out with brimstone and salt, nothing sown and nothing growing, where no plant can sprout, an overthrow like that of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the Lord overthrew in his anger and wrath—
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The whole land is brimstone, salt, and burning; it is not sown, nor does it bear, nor does any grass grow there, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the Lord overthrew in His anger and His wrath.’
verses.textEnNlt: They will exclaim, ‘The whole land is devastated by sulfur and salt. It is a wasteland with nothing planted and nothing growing, not even a blade of grass. It is like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the Lord destroyed in his intense anger.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All its land is brimstone and salt, burned debris, unsown and unproductive, and no grass grows on it, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the Lord overthrew in His anger and in His wrath.’
verses.textEn: The whole land will be a burning waste of salt and sulfur—nothing planted, nothing sprouting, no vegetation growing on it. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, which the Lord overthrew in fierce anger.

verses.textZh: 看见了这些的人和万国的人都要问：‘耶和华为甚么向这地这样行呢？为甚么大发烈怒呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见了这些的人和万国的人都要问：‘耶和华为甚么向这地这样行呢？为甚么大发烈怒呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 去事奉敬拜素不认识的别神，是耶和华所未曾给他们安排的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the nations will ask: "Why has the Lord done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?"
verses.textEnEsv: all the nations will say, ‘Why has the Lord done thus to this land? What caused the heat of this great anger?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "All nations would say, ‘Why has the Lord done so to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?’
verses.textEnNlt: "And all the surrounding nations will ask, ‘Why has the Lord done this to this land? Why was he so angry?’
verses.textEnNasb: All the nations will say, ‘Why has the Lord done all this to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’
verses.textEn: All the nations will ask: "Why has the Lord done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?"

verses.textZh: 人就必回答：‘是因为他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神的约，就是耶和华把他们从埃及地领出来的时候，与他们所立的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 人就必回答：‘是因为他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神的约，就是耶和华把他们从埃及地领出来的时候，与他们所立的；
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华的怒气向这地发作，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上。
verses.textEnNiv: And the answer will be: "It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Then people will say, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord , the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then people would say: ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt;
verses.textEnNlt: "And the answer will be, ‘This happened because the people of the land abandoned the covenant that the Lord , the God of their ancestors, made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then people will say, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: And the answer will be: "It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 去事奉别的神，向他们叩拜，就是他们不认识的神，也是耶和华没有给他们指定要拜的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 去事奉别的神，向他们叩拜，就是他们不认识的神，也是耶和华没有给他们指定要拜的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在怒气、忿怒、大恼恨中将他们从本地拔出来，扔在别的地上，像今日一样。』
verses.textEnNiv: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.
verses.textEnEsv: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods whom they had not known and whom he had not allotted to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: for they went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they did not know and that He had not given to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they turned away to serve and worship gods they had not known before, gods that were not from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And they went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they have not known and whom He had not assigned to them.
verses.textEn: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华向这地大发烈怒，把这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华向这地大发烈怒，把这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上；
verses.textZhCuv: 「隐秘的事是属耶和华－我们神的；惟有明显的事是永远属我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord ’s anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against this land, bringing upon it all the curses written in this book,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against this land, to bring on it every curse that is written in this book.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord ’s anger has burned against this land, bringing down on it every curse recorded in this book.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, the anger of the Lord burned against that land, to bring upon it every curse which is written in this book;
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord ’s anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华在烈怒、忿怒和大怒中，把他们从他们的地土拔出来，丢在别的地方，像今天一样。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华在烈怒、忿怒和大怒中，把他们从他们的地土拔出来，丢在别的地方，像今天一样。’
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华在烈怒、忿怒和大怒中，把他们从他们的地土拔出来，丢在别的地方，像今天一样。’
verses.textEnNiv: In furious anger and in great wrath the Lord uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now."
verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord uprooted them from their land in anger and fury and great wrath, and cast them into another land, as they are this day.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord uprooted them from their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as itis this day.’
verses.textEnNlt: In great anger and fury the Lord uprooted his people from their land and banished them to another land, where they still live today!’
verses.textEnNasb: and the Lord uprooted them from their land in anger, fury, and in great wrath, and hurled them into another land, as it is this day.’
verses.textEn: In furious anger and in great wrath the Lord uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now."

verses.textZh: "奥秘的事，是属于耶和华我们的神的，只有显露的事，是永远属于我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "奥秘的事，是属于耶和华我们的神的，只有显露的事，是永远属于我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。"
verses.textZhCuv: "奥秘的事，是属于耶和华我们的神的，只有显露的事，是永远属于我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。"
verses.textEnNiv: The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.
verses.textEnEsv: "The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The secret thingsbelong to the Lord our God, but those thingswhichare revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord our God has secrets known to no one. We are not accountable for them, but we and our children are accountable forever for all that he has revealed to us, so that we may obey all the terms of these instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: "The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our sons forever, so that we may follow all the words of this Law.
verses.textEn: The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.

verses.textZh: "当这一切事，就是我摆在你面前的祝福和咒诅，都临到你身上的时候，你在耶和华你的神赶逐你去的万国中，你心里必回想这些话，
verses.textZhCnvs: "当这一切事，就是我摆在你面前的祝福和咒诅，都临到你身上的时候，你在耶和华你的神赶逐你去的万国中，你心里必回想这些话，
verses.textZhCuv: 「我所陈明在你面前的这一切咒诅都临到你身上；你在耶和华－你神追赶你到的万国中必心里追念祝福的话；
verses.textEnNiv: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come on you and you take them to heart wherever the Lord your God disperses you among the nations,
verses.textEnEsv: "And when all these things come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you call them to mind among all the nations where the Lord your God has driven you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now it shall come to pass, when all these things come upon you, the blessing and the curse which I have set before you, and you call them to mind among all the nations where the Lord your God drives you,
verses.textEnNlt: "In the future, when you experience all these blessings and curses I have listed for you, and when you are living among the nations to which the Lord your God has exiled you, take to heart all these instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: "So it will be when all of these things have come upon you, the blessing and the curse which I have placed before you, and you call them to mind in all the nations where the Lord your God has scattered you,
verses.textEn: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come on you and you take them to heart wherever the Lord your God disperses you among the nations,

verses.textZh: 你和你的子孙必一心一意归向耶和华你的神，照着我今日吩咐你的一切听从他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的子孙必一心一意归向耶和华你的神，照着我今日吩咐你的一切听从他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的子孙若尽心尽性归向耶和华－你的神，照着我今日一切所吩咐的听从他的话；
verses.textEnNiv: and when you and your children return to the Lord your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,
verses.textEnEsv: and return to the Lord your God, you and your children, and obey his voice in all that I command you today, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnNkjv: and you return to the Lord your God and obey His voice, according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.textEnNlt: If at that time you and your children return to the Lord your God, and if you obey with all your heart and all your soul all the commands I have given you today,
verses.textEnNasb: and you return to the Lord your God and obey Him with all your heart and soul in accordance with everything that I am commanding you today, you and your sons,
verses.textEn: and when you and your children return to the Lord your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华你的神就必使你这被掳的人回归，他必怜悯你；耶和华你的神必从你被分散到的万民中，把你再召集回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华你的神就必使你这被掳的人回归，他必怜悯你；耶和华你的神必从你被分散到的万民中，把你再召集回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华－你的神必怜恤你，救回你这被掳的子民；耶和华－你的神要回转过来，从分散你到的万民中将你招聚回来。
verses.textEnNiv: then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.
verses.textEnEsv: then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes and have mercy on you, and he will gather you again from all the peoples where the Lord your God has scattered you.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord your God will bring you back from captivity, and have compassion on you, and gather you again from all the nations where the Lord your God has scattered you.
verses.textEnNlt: then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes. He will have mercy on you and gather you back from all the nations where he has scattered you.
verses.textEnNasb: then the Lord your God will restore you from captivity, and have compassion on you, and will gather you again from all the peoples where the Lord your God has scattered you.
verses.textEn: then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.

verses.textZh: 你被赶逐的人，就是在天涯海角，耶和华你的神也必从那里把你召集回来，从那里把你带回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你被赶逐的人，就是在天涯海角，耶和华你的神也必从那里把你召集回来，从那里把你带回。
verses.textZhCuv: 你被赶散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和华－你的神也必从那里将你招聚回来。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the Lord your God will gather you and bring you back.
verses.textEnEsv: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of heaven, from there the Lord your God will gather you, and from there he will take you.
verses.textEnNkjv: If any of you are driven out to the farthest parts under heaven, from there the Lord your God will gather you, and from there He will bring you.
verses.textEnNlt: Even though you are banished to the ends of the earth, the Lord your God will gather you from there and bring you back again.
verses.textEnNasb: If any of your scattered countrymen are at the ends of the earth, from there the Lord your God will gather you, and from there He will bring you back.
verses.textEn: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the Lord your God will gather you and bring you back.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神必领你进入你列祖所得之地，使你可以得着这地；他必善待你，他也必使你的人数增多，胜过你的列祖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神必领你进入你列祖所得之地，使你可以得着这地；他必善待你，他也必使你的人数增多，胜过你的列祖。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神必领你进入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得着；又必善待你，使你的人数比你列祖众多。
verses.textEnNiv: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord your God will bring you into the land that your fathers possessed, that you may possess it. And he will make you more prosperous and numerous than your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord your God will bring you to the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it. He will prosper you and multiply you more than your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God will return you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will possess that land again. Then he will make you even more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; and He will be good to you and make you more numerous than your fathers.
verses.textEn: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神必把你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，要你一心一意爱耶和华你的神，使你可以存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神必把你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，要你一心一意爱耶和华你的神，使你可以存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你神必将你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，好叫你尽心尽性爱耶和华－你的神，使你可以存活。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring, so that you will love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your descendants, to love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord your God will change your heart and the hearts of all your descendants, so that you will love him with all your heart and soul and so you may live!
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, the Lord your God will circumcise your heart and the hearts of your descendants, to love the Lord your God with all your heart and all your soul, so that you may live.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神必把这一切咒诅，加在你的仇敌和恨恶你、逼迫你的人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神必把这一切咒诅，加在你的仇敌和恨恶你、逼迫你的人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神必将这一切咒诅加在你仇敌和恨恶你、逼迫你的人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord your God will put all these curses on your foes and enemies who persecuted you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also the Lord your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God will inflict all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate and persecute you.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord your God will inflict all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.

verses.textZh: 你却要再听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日吩咐你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却要再听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日吩咐你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必归回，听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will again obey the Lord and follow all his commands I am giving you today.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall again obey the voice of the Lord and keep all his commandments that I command you today.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will again obey the voice of the Lord and do all His commandments which I command you today.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will again obey the Lord and keep all his commands that I am giving you today.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will again obey the Lord, and follow all His commandments which I am commanding you today.
verses.textEn: You will again obey the Lord and follow all his commands I am giving you today.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神必使你手里所办的一切事、你身所生的、牲畜所出的、地土所产的，都丰盛有余，因为耶和华必再喜悦你，使你得福，像从前喜悦你的列祖一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神必使你手里所办的一切事、你身所生的、牲畜所出的、地土所产的，都丰盛有余，因为耶和华必再喜悦你，使你得福，像从前喜悦你的列祖一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 「我今日所吩咐你的诫命不是你难行的，也不是离你远的；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The Lord will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your ancestors,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord your God will make you abundantly prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your womb and in the fruit of your cattle and in the fruit of your ground. For the Lord will again take delight in prospering you, as he took delight in your fathers,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord your God will make you abound in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the increase of your livestock, and in the produce of your land for good. For the Lord will again rejoice over you for good as He rejoiced over your fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord your God will then make you successful in everything you do. He will give you many children and numerous livestock, and he will cause your fields to produce abundant harvests, for the Lord will again delight in being good to you as he was to your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord your God will prosper you abundantly in every work of your hand, in the children of your womb, the offspring of your cattle, and in the produce of your ground, for the Lord will again rejoice over you for good, just as He rejoiced over your fathers;
verses.textEn: Then the Lord your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The Lord will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your ancestors,

verses.textZh: 只要你听从耶和华你的神的话，谨守这律法书上所写的诫命和律例；只要你一心一意回转归向耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要你听从耶和华你的神的话，谨守这律法书上所写的诫命和律例；只要你一心一意回转归向耶和华你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 不是在天上，使你说：『谁替我们上天取下来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: if you obey the Lord your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnEsv: when you obey the voice of the Lord your God, to keep his commandments and his statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, when you turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: if you obey the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord your God will delight in you if you obey his voice and keep the commands and decrees written in this Book of Instruction, and if you turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and soul.
verses.textEnNasb: if you obey the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which are written in this Book of the Law, if you turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and soul.
verses.textEn: if you obey the Lord your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.textZh: "其实我今日吩咐你的这诫命，对你并不太难，离你也不太远。
verses.textZhCnvs: "其实我今日吩咐你的这诫命，对你并不太难，离你也不太远。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不是在海外，使你说：『谁替我们过海取了来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.
verses.textEnEsv: "For this commandment that I command you today is not too hard for you, neither is it far off.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For this commandment which I command you today is not too mysterious for you, nor is it far off.
verses.textEnNlt: "This command I am giving you today is not too difficult for you, and it is not beyond your reach.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this commandment which I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you, nor is it far away.
verses.textEn: Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.

verses.textZh: 这诫命不是在天上，以致你说：‘谁替我们上到天上去，为我们取下来，使我们听见，就可以遵行呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这诫命不是在天上，以致你说：‘谁替我们上到天上去，为我们取下来，使我们听见，就可以遵行呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 这话却离你甚近，就在你口中，在你心里，使你可以遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, "Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"
verses.textEnEsv: It is not in heaven, that you should say, ‘Who will ascend to heaven for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?’
verses.textEnNkjv: It is not in heaven, that you should say, ‘Who will ascend into heaven for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?’
verses.textEnNlt: It is not kept in heaven, so distant that you must ask, ‘Who will go up to heaven and bring it down so we can hear it and obey?’
verses.textEnNasb: It is not in heaven, that you could say, ‘Who will go up to heaven for us and get it for us, and proclaim it to us, so that we may follow it?’
verses.textEn: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, "Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

verses.textZh: 也不是在海外，以致你说：‘谁替我们过海去，为我们取回来，使我们听见，就可以遵行呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不是在海外，以致你说：‘谁替我们过海去，为我们取回来，使我们听见，就可以遵行呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，我今日将生与福，死与祸，陈明在你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"
verses.textEnEsv: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, ‘Who will go over the sea for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor is it beyond the sea, that you should say, ‘Who will go over the sea for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?’
verses.textEnNlt: It is not kept beyond the sea, so far away that you must ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to bring it to us so we can hear it and obey?’
verses.textEnNasb: Nor is it beyond the sea, that you could say, ‘Who will cross the sea for us and get it for us and proclaim it to us, so that we may follow it?’
verses.textEn: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

verses.textZh: 其实这话离你很近，就在你口里，也在你心里，使你可以遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实这话离你很近，就在你口里，也在你心里，使你可以遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐你爱耶和华－你的神，遵行他的道，谨守他的诫命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华－你神就必在你所要进去得为业的地上赐福与你。
verses.textEnNiv: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.
verses.textEnEsv: But the word is very near you. It is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you can do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
verses.textEnNlt: No, the message is very close at hand; it is on your lips and in your heart so that you can obey it.
verses.textEnNasb: On the contrary, the word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may follow it.
verses.textEn: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.

verses.textZh: "你看，我今日把生命和福乐，死亡与灾祸，都摆在你的面前了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你看，我今日把生命和福乐，死亡与灾祸，都摆在你的面前了。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你心里偏离，不肯听从，却被勾引去敬拜事奉别神，
verses.textEnNiv: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: "See, I have set before you today life and good, death and evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: "See, I have set before you today life and good, death and evil,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now listen! Today I am giving you a choice between life and death, between prosperity and disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: "See, I have placed before you today life and happiness, and death and adversity,
verses.textEn: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.

verses.textZh: 因此我今日吩咐你要爱耶和华你的神，行他的道路，谨守他的诫命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华你的神就必在你要进去得为业的地上赐福给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我今日吩咐你要爱耶和华你的神，行他的道路，谨守他的诫命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华你的神就必在你要进去得为业的地上赐福给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日明明告诉你们，你们必要灭亡；在你过约旦河、进去得为业的地上，你的日子必不长久。
verses.textEnNiv: For I command you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the Lord your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: If you obey the commandments of the Lord your God that I command you today, by loving the Lord your God, by walking in his ways, and by keeping his commandments and his statutes and his rules, then you shall live and multiply, and the Lord your God will bless you in the land that you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: in that I command you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, His statutes, and His judgments, that you may live and multiply; and the Lord your God will bless you in the land which you go to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: For I command you this day to love the Lord your God and to keep his commands, decrees, and regulations by walking in his ways. If you do this, you will live and multiply, and the Lord your God will bless you and the land you are about to enter and occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: in that I am commanding you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in His ways and to keep His commandments, His statutes, and His judgments, so that you may live and become numerous, and that the Lord your God may bless you in the land where you are entering to take possession of it.
verses.textEn: For I command you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the Lord your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.

verses.textZh: 但是，如果你的心偏离了，不肯听从，却被人勾引，去敬拜和事奉别的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，如果你的心偏离了，不肯听从，却被人勾引，去敬拜和事奉别的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日呼天唤地向你作见证；我将生死祸福陈明在你面前，所以你要拣选生命，使你和你的后裔都得存活；
verses.textEnNiv: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnEsv: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away to worship other gods and serve them,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if your heart turns away so that you do not hear, and are drawn away, and worship other gods and serve them,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if your heart turns away and you refuse to listen, and if you are drawn away to serve and worship other gods,
verses.textEnNasb: But if your heart turns away and you will not obey, but allow yourself to be led astray and you worship other gods and serve them,
verses.textEn: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

verses.textZh: 我今日郑重地告诉你们，你们必要灭亡；在你过约旦河，进去得为业的地上，你的年日必不长久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今日郑重地告诉你们，你们必要灭亡；在你过约旦河，进去得为业的地上，你的年日必不长久。
verses.textZhCuv: 且爱耶和华－你的神，听从他的话，专靠他；因为他是你的生命，你的日子长久也在乎他。这样，你就可以在耶和华向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许所赐的地上居住。」
verses.textEnNiv: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.
verses.textEnEsv: I declare to you today, that you shall surely perish. You shall not live long in the land that you are going over the Jordan to enter and possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: I announce to you today that you shall surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land which you cross over the Jordan to go in and possess.
verses.textEnNlt: then I warn you now that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live a long, good life in the land you are crossing the Jordan to occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: I declare to you today that you will certainly perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you are crossing the Jordan to enter and take possession of it.
verses.textEn: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.

verses.textZh: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作证，我把生与死，福与祸，都摆在你面前了；所以你要选择生命，好让你和你的后裔都可以活着，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作证，我把生与死，福与祸，都摆在你面前了；所以你要选择生命，好让你和你的后裔都可以活着，
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作证，我把生与死，福与祸，都摆在你面前了；所以你要选择生命，好让你和你的后裔都可以活着，
verses.textEnNiv: This day I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live
verses.textEnEsv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and curse. Therefore choose life, that you and your offspring may live,
verses.textEnNkjv: I call heaven and earth as witnesses today against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing; therefore choose life, that both you and your descendants may live;
verses.textEnNlt: "Today I have given you the choice between life and death, between blessings and curses. Now I call on heaven and earth to witness the choice you make. Oh, that you would choose life, so that you and your descendants might live!
verses.textEnNasb: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have placed before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. So choose life in order that you may live, you and your descendants,
verses.textEn: This day I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live

verses.textZh: 爱耶和华你的神，听从他的话，紧靠他，因为那就是你的生命，你的长寿；这样，你才能在耶和华向你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许要赐给他们的地上居住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱耶和华你的神，听从他的话，紧靠他，因为那就是你的生命，你的长寿；这样，你才能在耶和华向你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许要赐给他们的地上居住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 爱耶和华你的神，听从他的话，紧靠他，因为那就是你的生命，你的长寿；这样，你才能在耶和华向你的列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许要赐给他们的地上居住。"
verses.textEnNiv: and that you may love the Lord your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the Lord is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: loving the Lord your God, obeying his voice and holding fast to him, for he is your life and length of days, that you may dwell in the land that the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them."
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may love the Lord your God, that you may obey His voice, and that you may cling to Him, for He is your life and the length of your days; and that you may dwell in the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give them."
verses.textEnNlt: You can make this choice by loving the Lord your God, obeying him, and committing yourself firmly to him. This is the key to your life. And if you love and obey the Lord , you will live long in the land the Lord swore to give your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob."
verses.textEnNasb: by loving the Lord your God, by obeying His voice, and by holding close to Him; for this is your life and the length of your days, so that you may live in the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give them."
verses.textEn: and that you may love the Lord your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the Lord is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

verses.textZh: 摩西又把这些话告诉以色列众人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西又把这些话告诉以色列众人，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西去告诉以色列众人
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses went out and spoke these words to all Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses continued to speak these words to all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses had finished giving these instructions to all the people of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Moses went out and spoke these words to all Israel:

verses.textZh: 对他们说："我现今一百二十岁，不能再照常出入了；耶和华也曾对我说：你必不得过这约旦河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："我现今一百二十岁，不能再照常出入了；耶和华也曾对我说：你必不得过这约旦河。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我现在一百二十岁了，不能照常出入；耶和华也曾对我说：『你必不得过这约旦河。』
verses.textEnNiv: "I am now a hundred and twenty years old and I am no longer able to lead you. The Lord has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "I am 120 years old today. I am no longer able to go out and come in. The Lord has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them: "I am one hundred and twenty years old today. I can no longer go out and come in. Also the Lord has said to me, ‘You shall not cross over this Jordan.’
verses.textEnNlt: he said, "I am now 120 years old, and I am no longer able to lead you. The Lord has told me, ‘You will not cross the Jordan River.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "I am 120 years old today; I am no longer able to go out and come in, and the Lord has told me, ‘You shall not cross this Jordan.’
verses.textEn: "I am now a hundred and twenty years old and I am no longer able to lead you. The Lord has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神要亲自领你们过去，从你们面前消灭这些国的民，使你们得着他们的地，照着耶和华说过的，约书亚要亲自领你们过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神要亲自领你们过去，从你们面前消灭这些国的民，使你们得着他们的地，照着耶和华说过的，约书亚要亲自领你们过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你们的神必引导你们过去，将这些国民在你们面前灭绝，你们就得他们的地。约书亚必引导你们过去，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua also will cross over ahead of you, as the Lord said.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations before you, so that you shall dispossess them, and Joshua will go over at your head, as the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord your God Himself crosses over before you; He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua himself crosses over before you, just as the Lord has said.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy the nations living there, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua will lead you across the river, just as the Lord promised.
verses.textEnNasb: It is the Lord your God who is going to cross ahead of you; He Himself will destroy these nations before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua is the one who is going to cross ahead of you, just as the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua also will cross over ahead of you, as the Lord said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对待他们，必好象从前对待他消灭的亚摩利人的两个王西宏和噩，以及他们的国一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对待他们，必好象从前对待他消灭的亚摩利人的两个王西宏和噩，以及他们的国一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必待他们，如同从前待他所灭绝的亚摩利二王西宏与噩以及他们的国一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord will do to them what he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, whom he destroyed along with their land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will do to them as he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites and their land, when He destroyed them.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will destroy the nations living in the land, just as he destroyed Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will do to them just as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when He destroyed them.
verses.textEn: And the Lord will do to them what he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, whom he destroyed along with their land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必把他们交给你们，你们照着我吩咐你们的一切命令对待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必把他们交给你们，你们照着我吩咐你们的一切命令对待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必将他们交给你们；你们要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will deliver them to you, and you must do to them all that I have commanded you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will give them over to you, and you shall do to them according to the whole commandment that I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will give them over to you, that you may do to them according to every commandment which I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will hand over to you the people who live there, and you must deal with them as I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will turn them over to you, and you will do to them in accordance with all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.textEn: The Lord will deliver them to you, and you must do to them all that I have commanded you.

verses.textZh: 你们要坚强勇敢；不要害怕，也不要因他们畏惧，因为耶和华你的神与你同去；他决不撇下你，也不离弃你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要坚强勇敢；不要害怕，也不要因他们畏惧，因为耶和华你的神与你同去；他决不撇下你，也不离弃你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要害怕，也不要畏惧他们，因为耶和华－你的神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you."
verses.textEnEsv: Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be in dread of them, for it is the Lord your God who goes with you. He will not leave you or forsake you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be strong and of good courage, do not fear nor be afraid of them; for the Lord your God, He is the One who goes with you. He will not leave you nor forsake you."
verses.textEnNlt: So be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid and do not panic before them. For the Lord your God will personally go ahead of you. He will neither fail you nor abandon you."
verses.textEnNasb: Be strong and courageous, do not be afraid or in dread of them, for the Lord your God is the One who is going with you. He will not desert you or abandon you."
verses.textEn: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you."

verses.textZh: 摩西把约书亚召了来，在以色列众人面前对他说："你要坚强勇敢，因为你要和这人民一同进入耶和华向他们的列祖起誓，应许要赐给他们的地；你也要使他们得着那地为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把约书亚召了来，在以色列众人面前对他说："你要坚强勇敢，因为你要和这人民一同进入耶和华向他们的列祖起誓，应许要赐给他们的地；你也要使他们得着那地为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西召了约书亚来，在以色列众人眼前对他说：「你当刚强壮胆！因为，你要和这百姓一同进入耶和华向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地；你也要使他们承受那地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land that the Lord swore to their ancestors to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land that the Lord has sworn to their fathers to give them, and you shall put them in possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses called Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and of good courage, for you must go with this people to the land which the Lord has sworn to their fathers to give them, and you shall cause them to inherit it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses called for Joshua, and as all Israel watched, he said to him, "Be strong and courageous! For you will lead these people into the land that the Lord swore to their ancestors he would give them. You are the one who will divide it among them as their grants of land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses called to Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land which the Lord has sworn to their fathers to give them, and you will give it to them as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land that the Lord swore to their ancestors to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 耶和华亲自在你前头行，与你同在；他决不撇下你，也不离弃你；你不要害怕，也不要惊慌。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华亲自在你前头行，与你同在；他决不撇下你，也不离弃你；你不要害怕，也不要惊慌。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必在你前面行；他必与你同在，必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."
verses.textEnEsv: It is the Lord who goes before you. He will be with you; he will not leave you or forsake you. Do not fear or be dismayed."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord, He is the One who goes before you. He will be with you, He will not leave you nor forsake you; do not fear nor be dismayed."
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord will personally go ahead of you. He will be with you; he will neither fail you nor abandon you."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord is the One who is going ahead of you; He will be with you. He will not desert you or abandon you. Do not fear and do not be dismayed."
verses.textEn: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

verses.textZh: 摩西把这律法写好了，就交给抬耶和华约柜的利未支派的祭司子孙，和以色列的众长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把这律法写好了，就交给抬耶和华约柜的利未支派的祭司子孙，和以色列的众长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将这律法写出来，交给抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未子孙和以色列的众长老。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses wrote this entire body of instruction in a book and gave it to the priests, who carried the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant, and to the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses wrote this Law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEn: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to all the elders of Israel.

verses.textZh: 摩西吩咐他们："每逢七年的最后一年，就是在豁免年的定期，住棚节期间，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西吩咐他们："每逢七年的最后一年，就是在豁免年的定期，住棚节期间，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西吩咐他们说：「每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚节的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses commanded them: "At the end of every seven years, in the year for canceling debts, during the Festival of Tabernacles,
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses commanded them, "At the end of every seven years, at the set time in the year of release, at the Feast of Booths,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses commanded them, saying: "At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of release, at the Feast of Tabernacles,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses gave them this command: "At the end of every seventh year, the Year of Release, during the Festival of Shelters,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses commanded them, saying, "At the end of every seven years, at the time of the year of the release of debts, at the Feast of Booths,
verses.textEn: Then Moses commanded them: "At the end of every seven years, in the year for canceling debts, during the Festival of Tabernacles,

verses.textZh: 以色列众人来到耶和华你的神选择的地方朝见他的时候，你要在以色列众人面前把这律法宣读给他们听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人来到耶和华你的神选择的地方朝见他的时候，你要在以色列众人面前把这律法宣读给他们听。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人来到耶和华－你神所选择的地方朝见他。那时，你要在以色列众人面前将这律法念给他们听。
verses.textEnNiv: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose, you shall read this law before them in their hearing.
verses.textEnEsv: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God at the place that he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.textEnNkjv: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God in the place which He chooses, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.textEnNlt: you must read this Book of Instruction to all the people of Israel when they assemble before the Lord your God at the place he chooses.
verses.textEnNasb: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God at the place which He will choose, you shall read this Law before all Israel so that they hear it.
verses.textEn: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose, you shall read this law before them in their hearing.

verses.textZh: 你要召集人民、男人、女人、孩子，以及你城里的寄居者，叫他们可以听见，叫他们可以学习，好敬畏耶和华你们的神，谨守遵行这律法的一切话，
