verses.textZhCnvs: 你要召集人民、男人、女人、孩子，以及你城里的寄居者，叫他们可以听见，叫他们可以学习，好敬畏耶和华你们的神，谨守遵行这律法的一切话，
verses.textZhCuv: 要招聚他们男、女、孩子，并城里寄居的，使他们听，使他们学习，好敬畏耶和华－你们的神，谨守、遵行这律法的一切话，
verses.textEnNiv: Assemble the people—men, women and children, and the foreigners residing in your towns—so they can listen and learn to fear the Lord your God and follow carefully all the words of this law.
verses.textEnEsv: Assemble the people, men, women, and little ones, and the sojourner within your towns, that they may hear and learn to fear the Lord your God, and be careful to do all the words of this law,
verses.textEnNkjv: Gather the people together, men and women and little ones, and the stranger who is within your gates, that they may hear and that they may learn to fear the Lord your God and carefully observe all the words of this law,
verses.textEnNlt: Call them all together—men, women, children, and the foreigners living in your towns—so they may hear this Book of Instruction and learn to fear the Lord your God and carefully obey all the terms of these instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Assemble the people, the men, the women, the children, and the stranger who is in your town, so that they may hear and learn and fear the Lord your God, and be careful to follow all the words of this Law.
verses.textEn: Assemble the people—men, women and children, and the foreigners residing in your towns—so they can listen and learn to fear the Lord your God and follow carefully all the words of this law.

verses.textZh: 也叫他们还不认识这律法的儿女可以听见，使他们在你们过约旦河去得为业的地上生活的时候，一生学习敬畏耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也叫他们还不认识这律法的儿女可以听见，使他们在你们过约旦河去得为业的地上生活的时候，一生学习敬畏耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也使他们未曾晓得这律法的儿女得以听见，学习敬畏耶和华－你们的神，在你们过约旦河要得为业之地，存活的日子，常常这样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the Lord your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEnEsv: and that their children, who have not known it, may hear and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as you live in the land that you are going over the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEnNkjv: and that their children, who have not known it, may hear and learn to fear the Lord your God as long as you live in the land which you cross the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEnNlt: Do this so that your children who have not known these instructions will hear them and will learn to fear the Lord your God. Do this as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to occupy."
verses.textEnNasb: And their children, who have not known, will hear and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as you live on the land which you are about to cross the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEn: Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the Lord your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，你的死期临近了；你要把约书亚召来，你们二人要站在会幕里，我好吩咐他。"于是摩西和约书亚前去，一同站在会幕里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，你的死期临近了；你要把约书亚召来，你们二人要站在会幕里，我好吩咐他。"于是摩西和约书亚前去，一同站在会幕里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你的死期临近了；要召约书亚来，你们二人站在会幕里，我好嘱咐他。」于是摩西和约书亚去站在会幕里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, where I will commission him." So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, the days approach when you must die. Call Joshua and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may commission him." And Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, the days approach when you must die; call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of meeting, that I may inaugurate him." So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves in the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The time has come for you to die. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tabernacle, so that I may commission him there." So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, the time for you to die is near; call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, and I will commission him." So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, where I will commission him." So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在会幕里，在云柱中显现，这云柱停在会幕的门口上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在会幕里，在云柱中显现，这云柱停在会幕的门口上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在会幕里云柱中显现，云柱停在会幕门以上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud. And the pillar of cloud stood over the entrance of the tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord appeared at the tabernacle in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood above the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord appeared to them in a pillar of cloud that stood at the entrance to the sacred tent.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the entrance of the tent.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，你快要和你的列祖长眠了；这人民要起来，在他们所要去的地方，在那地的人中，与外族人的神行邪淫，离弃我，破坏我与他们所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，你快要和你的列祖长眠了；这人民要起来，在他们所要去的地方，在那地的人中，与外族人的神行邪淫，离弃我，破坏我与他们所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对摩西说：「你必和你列祖同睡。这百姓要起来，在他们所要去的地上，在那地的人中，随从外邦神行邪淫，离弃我，违背我与他们所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Moses: "You are going to rest with your ancestors, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, you are about to lie down with your fathers. Then this people will rise and whore after the foreign gods among them in the land that they are entering, and they will forsake me and break my covenant that I have made with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses: "Behold, you will rest with your fathers; and this people will rise and play the harlot with the gods of the foreigners of the land, where they go tobe among them, and they will forsake Me and break My covenant which I have made with them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "You are about to die and join your ancestors. After you are gone, these people will begin to worship foreign gods, the gods of the land where they are going. They will abandon me and break my covenant that I have made with them.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Moses, "Behold, you are about to lie down with your fathers; and this people will arise and play the prostitute with the foreign gods of the land into the midst of which they are going, and they will abandon Me and break My covenant which I have made with them.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Moses: "You are going to rest with your ancestors, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.

verses.textZh: 到了那日，我必向他们大发烈怒，离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，他们就必被吞灭，并且遭遇很多灾祸和患难。到了那日，他们必说：‘我们遭遇这些灾祸，不是因为我们的神不在我们中间吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那日，我必向他们大发烈怒，离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，他们就必被吞灭，并且遭遇很多灾祸和患难。到了那日，他们必说：‘我们遭遇这些灾祸，不是因为我们的神不在我们中间吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我的怒气必向他们发作；我也必离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，以致他们被吞灭，并有许多的祸患灾难临到他们。那日他们必说：『这些祸患临到我们，岂不是因我们的神不在我们中间吗？』
verses.textEnNiv: And in that day I will become angry with them and forsake them; I will hide my face from them, and they will be destroyed. Many disasters and calamities will come on them, and in that day they will ask, ‘Have not these disasters come on us because our God is not with us?’
verses.textEnEsv: Then my anger will be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them and hide my face from them, and they will be devoured. And many evils and troubles will come upon them, so that they will say in that day, ‘Have not these evils come upon us because our God is not among us?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then My anger shall be aroused against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide My face from them, and they shall be devoured. And many evils and troubles shall befall them, so that they will say in that day, ‘Have not these evils come upon us because our God is not among us?’
verses.textEnNlt: Then my anger will blaze forth against them. I will abandon them, hiding my face from them, and they will be devoured. Terrible trouble will come down on them, and on that day they will say, ‘These disasters have come down on us because God is no longer among us!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then My anger will be kindled against them on that day, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, and they will be consumed, and many evils and troubles will find them; so they will say on that day, ‘Is it not because our God is not among us that these evils have found us?’
verses.textEn: And in that day I will become angry with them and forsake them; I will hide my face from them, and they will be destroyed. Many disasters and calamities will come on them, and in that day they will ask, ‘Have not these disasters come on us because our God is not with us?’

verses.textZh: 到了那日，因为他们偏向了别的神，和所作的一切恶事，我必掩面不顾他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那日，因为他们偏向了别的神，和所作的一切恶事，我必掩面不顾他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，因他们偏向别神所行的一切恶，我必定掩面不顾他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will certainly hide my face in that day because of all their wickedness in turning to other gods.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will surely hide my face in that day because of all the evil that they have done, because they have turned to other gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will surely hide My face in that day because of all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time I will hide my face from them on account of all the evil they commit by worshiping other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will assuredly hide My face on that day because of all the evil that they will have done, for they will have turned away to other gods.
verses.textEn: And I will certainly hide my face in that day because of all their wickedness in turning to other gods.

verses.textZh: 所以，现在你们要为自己写下这首诗歌来，教导以色列人，放在他们口中，使这首诗歌成为我反对他们的见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，现在你们要为自己写下这首诗歌来，教导以色列人，放在他们口中，使这首诗歌成为我反对他们的见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要写一篇歌，教导以色列人，传给他们，使这歌见证他们的不是；
verses.textEnNiv: "Now write down this song and teach it to the Israelites and have them sing it, so that it may be a witness for me against them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now therefore write this song and teach it to the people of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, write down this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel; put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for Me against the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "So write down the words of this song, and teach it to the people of Israel. Help them learn it, so it may serve as a witness for me against them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the sons of Israel; put it on their lips, so that this song may be a witness for Me against the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: "Now write down this song and teach it to the Israelites and have them sing it, so that it may be a witness for me against them.

verses.textZh: 因为我把他们领进了我向他们的列祖起誓应许的地，就是流奶与蜜的地，他们在那里吃饱了，发胖了，就必偏向别的神，事奉他们，藐视我，破坏我的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我把他们领进了我向他们的列祖起誓应许的地，就是流奶与蜜的地，他们在那里吃饱了，发胖了，就必偏向别的神，事奉他们，藐视我，破坏我的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我将他们领进我向他们列祖起誓应许那流奶与蜜之地，他们在那里吃得饱足，身体肥胖，就必偏向别神，事奉他们，藐视我，背弃我的约。
verses.textEnNiv: When I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, the land I promised on oath to their ancestors, and when they eat their fill and thrive, they will turn to other gods and worship them, rejecting me and breaking my covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: For when I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, which I swore to give to their fathers, and they have eaten and are full and grown fat, they will turn to other gods and serve them, and despise me and break my covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I have brought them to the land flowing with milk and honey, of which I swore to their fathers, and they have eaten and filled themselves and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods and serve them; and they will provoke Me and break My covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: For I will bring them into the land I swore to give their ancestors—a land flowing with milk and honey. There they will become prosperous, eat all the food they want, and become fat. But they will begin to worship other gods; they will despise me and break my covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: For when I bring them into the land flowing with milk and honey, which I swore to their fathers, and they eat and are satisfied and become prosperous, then they will turn to other gods and serve them, and spurn Me and break My covenant.
verses.textEn: When I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, the land I promised on oath to their ancestors, and when they eat their fill and thrive, they will turn to other gods and worship them, rejecting me and breaking my covenant.

verses.textZh: 他们遭遇许多灾祸和患难的时候，这首诗歌就必在他们面前作证，因为这首诗歌必不会从他们后裔的口中忘记。其实，我还未领他们进入我起誓应许之地以先，他们今日心里所怀的意念，我都知道了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们遭遇许多灾祸和患难的时候，这首诗歌就必在他们面前作证，因为这首诗歌必不会从他们后裔的口中忘记。其实，我还未领他们进入我起誓应许之地以先，他们今日心里所怀的意念，我都知道了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有许多祸患灾难临到他们，这歌必在他们面前作见证，他们后裔的口中必念诵不忘。我未领他们到我所起誓应许之地以先，他们所怀的意念我都知道了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And when many disasters and calamities come on them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. I know what they are disposed to do, even before I bring them into the land I promised them on oath."
verses.textEnEsv: And when many evils and troubles have come upon them, this song shall confront them as a witness (for it will live unforgotten in the mouths of their offspring). For I know what they are inclined to do even today, before I have brought them into the land that I swore to give."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be, when many evils and troubles have come upon them, that this song will testify against them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten in the mouths of their descendants, for I know the inclination of their behavior today, even before I have brought them to the land of which I swore togivethem."
verses.textEnNlt: And when great disasters come down on them, this song will stand as evidence against them, for it will never be forgotten by their descendants. I know the intentions of these people, even now before they have entered the land I swore to give them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then it will come about, when many evils and troubles find them, that this song will testify before them as a witness (for it shall not be forgotten from the mouth of their descendants); for I know their inclination which they are developing today, before I bring them into the land which I swore."
verses.textEn: And when many disasters and calamities come on them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. I know what they are disposed to do, even before I bring them into the land I promised them on oath."

verses.textZh: 摩西就在那一天写下了这首诗歌，教导以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就在那一天写下了这首诗歌，教导以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日摩西就写了一篇歌，教导以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses wrote down this song that day and taught it to the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses wrote this song the same day and taught it to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So that very day Moses wrote down the words of the song and taught it to the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses wrote down this song on the same day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: So Moses wrote down this song that day and taught it to the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐嫩的儿子约书亚，说："你当坚强勇敢，因为你要领以色列人进我向他们起誓应许的地，我必与你同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐嫩的儿子约书亚，说："你当坚强勇敢，因为你要领以色列人进我向他们起誓应许的地，我必与你同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华嘱咐嫩的儿子约书亚说：「你当刚强壮胆，因为你必领以色列人进我所起誓应许他们的地；我必与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord gave this command to Joshua son of Nun: "Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I promised them on oath, and I myself will be with you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord commissioned Joshua the son of Nun and said, "Be strong and courageous, for you shall bring the people of Israel into the land that I swore to give them. I will be with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He inaugurated Joshua the son of Nun, and said, "Be strong and of good courage; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land of which I swore to them, and I will be with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord commissioned Joshua son of Nun with these words: "Be strong and courageous, for you must bring the people of Israel into the land I swore to give them. I will be with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, "Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the sons of Israel into the land which I swore to them, and I will be with you."
verses.textEn: The Lord gave this command to Joshua son of Nun: "Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I promised them on oath, and I myself will be with you."

verses.textZh: 摩西把这律法的话写在书上，直到写完了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把这律法的话写在书上，直到写完了，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将这律法的话写在书上，及至写完了，
verses.textEnNiv: After Moses finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book to the very end,
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Moses had completed writing the words of this law in a book, when they were finished,
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses had finished writing this entire body of instruction in a book,
verses.textEnNasb: It came about, when Moses finished writing the words of this Law in a book until they were complete,
verses.textEn: After Moses finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,

verses.textZh: 摩西就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说：
verses.textEnNiv: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: Moses commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: that Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant:
verses.textEnNasb: that Moses commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord :

verses.textZh: "你们要把这律法书，放在耶和华你们的神的约柜旁，可以在那里作反对你们的见证，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要把这律法书，放在耶和华你们的神的约柜旁，可以在那里作反对你们的见证，
verses.textZhCuv: 「将这律法书放在耶和华－你们神的约柜旁，可以在那里见证以色列人的不是；
verses.textEnNiv: "Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God. There it will remain as a witness against you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take this Book of the Law and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there for a witness against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take this Book of the Law, and put it beside the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there as a witness against you;
verses.textEnNlt: "Take this Book of Instruction and place it beside the Ark of the Covenant of the Lord your God, so it may remain there as a witness against the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
verses.textEn: "Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God. There it will remain as a witness against you.

verses.textZh: 因为我知道你们的悖逆和顽固。看哪，我今日还活着与你们同在的时候，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死了以后呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道你们的悖逆和顽固。看哪，我今日还活着与你们同在的时候，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死了以后呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我知道你们是悖逆的，是硬着颈项的。我今日还活着与你们同在，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死后呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you have been rebellious against the Lord while I am still alive and with you, how much more will you rebel after I die!
verses.textEnEsv: For I know how rebellious and stubborn you are. Behold, even today while I am yet alive with you, you have been rebellious against the Lord . How much more after my death!
verses.textEnNkjv: for I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. If today, while I am yet alive with you, you have been rebellious against the Lord, then how much more after my death?
verses.textEnNlt: For I know how rebellious and stubborn you are. Even now, while I am still alive and am here with you, you have rebelled against the Lord . How much more rebellious will you be after my death!
verses.textEnNasb: For I know your rebellion and your stubbornness; behold, as long as I have been alive with you until today, you have been rebellious against the Lord; how much more, then, after my death?
verses.textEn: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you have been rebellious against the Lord while I am still alive and with you, how much more will you rebel after I die!

verses.textZh: 你们要把你们各支派的众长老和官长都召集到我这里来，我好把这些话说给他们听，并且呼天唤地对他们作证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把你们各支派的众长老和官长都召集到我这里来，我好把这些话说给他们听，并且呼天唤地对他们作证。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将你们支派的众长老和官长都招聚了来，我好将这些话说与他们听，并呼天唤地见证他们的不是。
verses.textEnNiv: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officials, so that I can speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth to testify against them.
verses.textEnEsv: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gather to me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now summon all the elders and officials of your tribes, so that I can speak to them directly and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.textEnNasb: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against them.
verses.textEn: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officials, so that I can speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth to testify against them.

verses.textZh: 因为我知道我死了以后，你们必完全败坏，偏离我吩咐你们的道路；在末后的日子必有灾祸临到你们身上，因为你们必行耶和华看为恶的事，以你们手所作的事，惹他发怒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道我死了以后，你们必完全败坏，偏离我吩咐你们的道路；在末后的日子必有灾祸临到你们身上，因为你们必行耶和华看为恶的事，以你们手所作的事，惹他发怒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道我死后，你们必全然败坏，偏离我所吩咐你们的道，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，以手所做的惹他发怒；日后必有祸患临到你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: For I know that after my death you are sure to become utterly corrupt and to turn from the way I have commanded you. In days to come, disaster will fall on you because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord and arouse his anger by what your hands have made."
verses.textEnEsv: For I know that after my death you will surely act corruptly and turn aside from the way that I have commanded you. And in the days to come evil will befall you, because you will do what is evil in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger through the work of your hands."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you. And evil will befall you in the latter days, because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger through the work of your hands."
verses.textEnNlt: I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and will turn from the way I have commanded you to follow. In the days to come, disaster will come down on you, for you will do what is evil in the Lord ’s sight, making him very angry with your actions."
verses.textEnNasb: For I know that after my death you will behave very corruptly and turn from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will confront you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the sight of the Lord, provoking Him to anger with the work of your hands."
verses.textEn: For I know that after my death you are sure to become utterly corrupt and to turn from the way I have commanded you. In days to come, disaster will fall on you because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord and arouse his anger by what your hands have made."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西把这首诗歌的话，都说给以色列的全体会众听，直到说完了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西把这首诗歌的话，都说给以色列的全体会众听，直到说完了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将这一篇歌的话都说与以色列全会众听。
verses.textEnNiv: And Moses recited the words of this song from beginning to end in the hearing of the whole assembly of Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses spoke the words of this song until they were finished, in the ears of all the assembly of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song until they were ended:
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses recited this entire song publicly to the assembly of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were complete:
verses.textEn: And Moses recited the words of this song from beginning to end in the hearing of the whole assembly of Israel:

verses.textZh: "天哪，留心吧，我要说话； 地啊，聆听我口中的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: "天哪，留心吧，我要说话； 地啊，聆听我口中的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天哪，侧耳，我要说话； 愿地也听我口中的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, you heavens, and I will speak; hear, you earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: "Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak, and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; And hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, O heavens, and I will speak! Hear, O earth, the words that I say!
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen, you heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth!
verses.textEn: Listen, you heavens, and I will speak; hear, you earth, the words of my mouth.

verses.textZh: 我的教训下降如雨， 我的言语滴落如露， 像细雨落在青草上， 像甘霖降在蔬菜上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的教训下降如雨， 我的言语滴落如露， 像细雨落在青草上， 像甘霖降在蔬菜上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的教训要淋漓如雨； 我的言语要滴落如露， 如细雨降在嫩草上， 如甘霖降在菜蔬中。
verses.textEnNiv: Let my teaching fall like rain and my words descend like dew, like showers on new grass, like abundant rain on tender plants.
verses.textEnEsv: May my teaching drop as the rain, my speech distill as the dew, like gentle rain upon the tender grass, and like showers upon the herb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my teaching drop as the rain, My speech distill as the dew, As raindrops on the tender herb, And as showers on the grass.
verses.textEnNlt: Let my teaching fall on you like rain; let my speech settle like dew. Let my words fall like rain on tender grass, like gentle showers on young plants.
verses.textEnNasb: "May my teaching drip as the rain, My speech trickle as the dew, As droplets on the fresh grass, And as the showers on the vegetation.
verses.textEn: Let my teaching fall like rain and my words descend like dew, like showers on new grass, like abundant rain on tender plants.

verses.textZh: 因为我要宣告耶和华的名； 你们要尊崇我们的神的伟大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我要宣告耶和华的名； 你们要尊崇我们的神的伟大。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要宣告耶和华的名； 你们要将大德归与我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: I will proclaim the name of the Lord . Oh, praise the greatness of our God!
verses.textEnEsv: For I will proclaim the name of the Lord ; ascribe greatness to our God!
verses.textEnNkjv: For I proclaim the name of the Lord: Ascribe greatness to our God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will proclaim the name of the Lord ; how glorious is our God!
verses.textEnNasb: "For I proclaim the name of the Lord; Ascribe greatness to our God!
verses.textEn: I will proclaim the name of the Lord . Oh, praise the greatness of our God!

verses.textZh: 他是盘石，他的作为完全， 因为他一切所行的全都公平； 他是诚实无伪的神， 又公义，又正直。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是盘石，他的作为完全， 因为他一切所行的全都公平； 他是诚实无伪的神， 又公义，又正直。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是磐石，他的作为完全； 他所行的无不公平， 是诚实无伪的神， 又公义，又正直。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Rock, his work is perfect, for all his ways are justice. A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, just and upright is he.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heis the Rock, His work is perfect; For all His ways are justice, A God of truth and without injustice; Righteous and upright is He.
verses.textEnNlt: He is the Rock; his deeds are perfect. Everything he does is just and fair. He is a faithful God who does no wrong; how just and upright he is!
verses.textEnNasb: "The Rock! His work is perfect, For all His ways are just; A God of faithfulness and without injustice, Righteous and just is He.
verses.textEn: He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he.

verses.textZh: 这世代向他行事败坏，就不是他的儿女，满有弊病， 这实在是个乖僻弯曲的世代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这世代向他行事败坏，就不是他的儿女，满有弊病， 这实在是个乖僻弯曲的世代。
verses.textZhCuv: 这乖僻弯曲的世代向他行事邪僻； 有这弊病就不是他的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: They are corrupt and not his children; to their shame they are a warped and crooked generation.
verses.textEnEsv: They have dealt corruptly with him; they are no longer his children because they are blemished; they are a crooked and twisted generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They have corrupted themselves; Theyare not His children, Because of their blemish: A perverse and crooked generation.
verses.textEnNlt: "But they have acted corruptly toward him; when they act so perversely, are they really his children? They are a deceitful and twisted generation.
verses.textEnNasb: " They have acted corruptly against Him, They are not His children, because of their defect; But are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.textEn: They are corrupt and not his children; to their shame they are a warped and crooked generation.

verses.textZh: 愚昧无知的人民哪， 你们这样报答耶和华吗？ 他不是你的父，不是把你买回来的吗？ 他造了你，建立了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧无知的人民哪， 你们这样报答耶和华吗？ 他不是你的父，不是把你买回来的吗？ 他造了你，建立了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧无知的民哪，你们这样报答耶和华吗？ 他岂不是你的父、将你买来的吗？ 他是制造你、建立你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Is this the way you repay the Lord , you foolish and unwise people? Is he not your Father, your Creator, who made you and formed you?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you thus repay the Lord , you foolish and senseless people? Is not he your father, who created you, who made you and established you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you thus deal with the Lord, O foolish and unwise people? Is He not your Father, who bought you? Has He not made you and established you?
verses.textEnNlt: Is this the way you repay the Lord , you foolish and senseless people? Isn’t he your Father who created you? Has he not made you and established you?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is this what you do to the Lord, You foolish and unwise people? Is He not your Father who has purchased you? He has made you and established you.
verses.textEn: Is this the way you repay the Lord , you foolish and unwise people? Is he not your Father, your Creator, who made you and formed you?

verses.textZh: 你要回想古时的日子， 思念历代以来的年月； 问你的父亲，他必告诉你； 问你的长者，他们必对你说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要回想古时的日子， 思念历代以来的年月； 问你的父亲，他必告诉你； 问你的长者，他们必对你说。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当追想上古之日， 思念历代之年； 问你的父亲，他必指示你； 问你的长者，他必告诉你。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember the days of old; consider the generations long past. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will explain to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember the days of old; consider the years of many generations; ask your father, and he will show you, your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; Your elders, and they will tell you:
verses.textEnNlt: Remember the days of long ago; think about the generations past. Ask your father, and he will inform you. Inquire of your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember the days of old, Consider the years of all generations. Ask your father and he will inform you, Your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.textEn: Remember the days of old; consider the generations long past. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will explain to you.

verses.textZh: 至高者把地业赐给列国的时候， 把人类分开的时候， 就照着以色列子孙的数目， 立定了万民的境界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至高者把地业赐给列国的时候， 把人类分开的时候， 就照着以色列子孙的数目， 立定了万民的境界。
verses.textZhCuv: 至高者将地业赐给列邦，将世人分开， 就照以色列人的数目立定万民的疆界。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided all mankind, he set up boundaries for the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he divided mankind, he fixed the borders of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Most High divided their inheritance to the nations, When He separated the sons of Adam, He set the boundaries of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Most High assigned lands to the nations, when he divided up the human race, he established the boundaries of the peoples according to the number in his heavenly court.
verses.textEnNasb: "When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, When He separated the sons of mankind, He set the boundaries of the peoples According to the number of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided all mankind, he set up boundaries for the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华的分就是他的子民， 他的产业就是雅各。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华的分就是他的子民， 他的产业就是雅各。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的分本是他的百姓； 他的产业本是雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord ’s portion is his people, Jacob his allotted inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord ’s portion is his people, Jacob his allotted heritage.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord’s portion is His people; Jacob is the place of His inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the people of Israel belong to the Lord ; Jacob is his special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the Lord’s portion is His people; Jacob is the allotment of His inheritance.
verses.textEn: For the Lord ’s portion is his people, Jacob his allotted inheritance.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在旷野之地遇见了他， 在荒凉之地和野兽吼叫的荒野，遇见了他， 就环绕他，看顾他， 保护他，好象保护自己眼中的瞳人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在旷野之地遇见了他， 在荒凉之地和野兽吼叫的荒野，遇见了他， 就环绕他，看顾他， 保护他，好象保护自己眼中的瞳人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华遇见他在旷野－ 荒凉野兽吼叫之地， 就环绕他，看顾他， 保护他，如同保护眼中的瞳人。
verses.textEnNiv: In a desert land he found him, in a barren and howling waste. He shielded him and cared for him; he guarded him as the apple of his eye,
verses.textEnEsv: "He found him in a desert land, and in the howling waste of the wilderness; he encircled him, he cared for him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He found him in a desert land And in the wasteland, a howling wilderness; He encircled him, He instructed him, He kept him as the apple of His eye.
verses.textEnNlt: He found them in a desert land, in an empty, howling wasteland. He surrounded them and watched over them; he guarded them as he would guard his own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "He found him in a desert land, And in the howling wasteland of a wilderness; He encircled him, He cared for him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
verses.textEn: In a desert land he found him, in a barren and howling waste. He shielded him and cared for him; he guarded him as the apple of his eye,

verses.textZh: 又像老鹰搅动巢窝， 飞翔在雏鹰之上， 搧展翅膀，接取雏鹰， 背在自己的两翼之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又像老鹰搅动巢窝， 飞翔在雏鹰之上， 搧展翅膀，接取雏鹰， 背在自己的两翼之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又如鹰搅动巢窝， 在雏鹰以上两翅搧展， 接取雏鹰，背在两翼之上。
verses.textEnNiv: like an eagle that stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, that spreads its wings to catch them and carries them aloft.
verses.textEnEsv: Like an eagle that stirs up its nest, that flutters over its young, spreading out its wings, catching them, bearing them on its pinions,
verses.textEnNkjv: As an eagle stirs up its nest, Hovers over its young, Spreading out its wings, taking them up, Carrying them on its wings,
verses.textEnNlt: Like an eagle that rouses her chicks and hovers over her young, so he spread his wings to take them up and carried them safely on his pinions.
verses.textEnNasb: "As an eagle stirs up its nest, And hovers over its young, He spread His wings, He caught them, He carried them on His pinions.
verses.textEn: like an eagle that stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, that spreads its wings to catch them and carries them aloft.

verses.textZh: 耶和华独自领导了他， 并没有外族人的神与他同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华独自领导了他， 并没有外族人的神与他同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，耶和华独自引导他， 并无外邦神与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord alone led him; no foreign god was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord alone guided him, no foreign god was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord alone led him, And therewas no foreign god with him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord alone guided them; they followed no foreign gods.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord alone guided him, And there was no foreign god with him.
verses.textEn: The Lord alone led him; no foreign god was with him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处， 得吃田间的土产； 又使他从岩石中吸蜜， 从坚固的盘石中取油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处， 得吃田间的土产； 又使他从岩石中吸蜜， 从坚固的盘石中取油。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处， 得吃田间的土产； 又使他从磐石中咂蜜， 从坚石中吸油；
verses.textEnNiv: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him with the fruit of the fields. He nourished him with honey from the rock, and with oil from the flinty crag,
verses.textEnEsv: He made him ride on the high places of the land, and he ate the produce of the field, and he suckled him with honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He made him ride in the heights of the earth, That he might eat the produce of the fields; He made him draw honey from the rock, And oil from the flinty rock;
verses.textEnNlt: He let them ride over the highlands and feast on the crops of the fields. He nourished them with honey from the rock and olive oil from the stony ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "He had him ride on the high places of the earth, And he ate the produce of the field; And He had him suck honey from the rock, And oil from the flinty rock,
verses.textEn: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him with the fruit of the fields. He nourished him with honey from the rock, and with oil from the flinty crag,

verses.textZh: 也吃牛酪和羊乳， 羊羔的脂肪， 巴珊的公牛和公山羊， 以及上好的麦子； 也喝了葡萄汁酿成的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也吃牛酪和羊乳， 羊羔的脂肪， 巴珊的公牛和公山羊， 以及上好的麦子； 也喝了葡萄汁酿成的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 也吃牛的奶油， 羊的奶，羊羔的脂油， 巴珊所出的公绵羊和山羊， 与上好的麦子， 也喝葡萄汁酿的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: with curds and milk from herd and flock and with fattened lambs and goats, with choice rams of Bashan and the finest kernels of wheat. You drank the foaming blood of the grape.
verses.textEnEsv: Curds from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of Bashan and goats, with the very finest of the wheat— and you drank foaming wine made from the blood of the grape.
verses.textEnNkjv: Curds from the cattle, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs; And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the choicest wheat; And you drank wine, the blood of the grapes.
verses.textEnNlt: He fed them yogurt from the herd and milk from the flock, together with the fat of lambs. He gave them choice rams from Bashan, and goats, together with the choicest wheat. You drank the finest wine, made from the juice of grapes.
verses.textEnNasb: Curds of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs And rams, the breed of Bashan, and of goats, With the best of the wheat; And you drank wine of the blood of grapes.
verses.textEn: with curds and milk from herd and flock and with fattened lambs and goats, with choice rams of Bashan and the finest kernels of wheat. You drank the foaming blood of the grape.

verses.textZh: 但耶书仑肥胖了，就踢跳， ‘你肥胖了，你粗壮了，你饱满了，’ 他离弃了造他的神， 轻看了救他的盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶书仑肥胖了，就踢跳， ‘你肥胖了，你粗壮了，你饱满了，’ 他离弃了造他的神， 轻看了救他的盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶书仑渐渐肥胖，粗壮， 光润，踢跳，奔跑， 便离弃造他的神， 轻看救他的磐石；
verses.textEnNiv: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; filled with food, they became heavy and sleek. They abandoned the God who made them and rejected the Rock their Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: "But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked; you grew fat, stout, and sleek; then he forsook God who made him and scoffed at the Rock of his salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; You grew fat, you grew thick, You are obese! Then he forsook God who made him, And scornfully esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: "But Israel soon became fat and unruly; the people grew heavy, plump, and stuffed! Then they abandoned the God who had made them; they made light of the Rock of their salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: "But Jeshurun became fat and kicked— You have become fat, thick, and obstinate— Then he abandoned God who made him, And rejected the Rock of his salvation.
verses.textEn: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; filled with food, they became heavy and sleek. They abandoned the God who made them and rejected the Rock their Savior.

verses.textZh: 他们以外族人的神激动了神的愤恨， 以可憎之事惹起了他的怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以外族人的神激动了神的愤恨， 以可憎之事惹起了他的怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬拜别神，触动神的愤恨， 行可憎恶的事，惹了他的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: They made him jealous with their foreign gods and angered him with their detestable idols.
verses.textEnEsv: They stirred him to jealousy with strange gods; with abominations they provoked him to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: They provoked Him to jealousy with foreign gods; With abominations they provoked Him to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: They stirred up his jealousy by worshiping foreign gods; they provoked his fury with detestable deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "They made Him jealous with strange gods; With abominations they provoked Him to anger.
verses.textEn: They made him jealous with their foreign gods and angered him with their detestable idols.

verses.textZh: 他们献祭给鬼魔 ， 就是他们从来不认识的神， 是近来新兴的， 是你们的列祖所不惧怕的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们献祭给鬼魔 ， 就是他们从来不认识的神， 是近来新兴的， 是你们的列祖所不惧怕的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所祭祀的鬼魔并非真神， 乃是素不认识的神， 是近来新兴的， 是你列祖所不畏惧的。
verses.textEnNiv: They sacrificed to false gods, which are not God— gods they had not known, gods that recently appeared, gods your ancestors did not fear.
verses.textEnEsv: They sacrificed to demons that were not God, to gods they had never known, to new gods that had come recently, whom your fathers had never dreaded.
verses.textEnNkjv: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, Togods they did not know, To new gods, new arrivals That your fathers did not fear.
verses.textEnNlt: They offered sacrifices to demons, which are not God, to gods they had not known before, to new gods only recently arrived, to gods their ancestors had never feared.
verses.textEnNasb: "They sacrificed to demons, who were not God, To gods whom they have not known, New gods who came lately, Whom your fathers did not know.
verses.textEn: They sacrificed to false gods, which are not God— gods they had not known, gods that recently appeared, gods your ancestors did not fear.

verses.textZh: 你轻忽了生你的盘石， 你忘记了产你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你轻忽了生你的盘石， 你忘记了产你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你轻忽生你的磐石， 忘记产你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You deserted the Rock, who fathered you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
verses.textEnEsv: You were unmindful of the Rock that bore you, and you forgot the God who gave you birth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the Rock who begot you, you are unmindful, And have forgotten the God who fathered you.
verses.textEnNlt: You neglected the Rock who had fathered you; you forgot the God who had given you birth.
verses.textEnNasb: "You forgot the Rock who fathered you, And forgot the God who gave you birth.
verses.textEn: You deserted the Rock, who fathered you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.

verses.textZh: 因为他的儿女激怒了神， 耶和华看见了，就弃绝了他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的儿女激怒了神， 耶和华看见了，就弃绝了他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华看见他的儿女惹动他， 就厌恶他们，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord saw this and rejected them because he was angered by his sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord saw it and spurned them, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when the Lord saw it, He spurned them, Because of the provocation of His sons and His daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord saw this and drew back, provoked to anger by his own sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord saw this, and spurned them Because of the provocation by His sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: The Lord saw this and rejected them because he was angered by his sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 说：‘我必掩面不顾他们， 要看看他们的结局怎样； 因为他们是乖曲的一代， 心里没有信实的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘我必掩面不顾他们， 要看看他们的结局怎样； 因为他们是乖曲的一代， 心里没有信实的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要向他们掩面， 看他们的结局如何。 他们本是极乖僻的族类， 心中无诚实的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will hide my face from them," he said, "and see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children who are unfaithful.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘I will hide my face from them; I will see what their end will be, for they are a perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said: ‘I will hide My face from them, I will see what their end willbe, For they are a perverse generation, Children in whom is no faith.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, ‘I will abandon them; then see what becomes of them. For they are a twisted generation, children without integrity.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then He said, ‘I will hide My face from them, I will see what their end will be; For they are a perverse generation, Sons in whom there is no faithfulness.
verses.textEn: "I will hide my face from them," he said, "and see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children who are unfaithful.

verses.textZh: 他们以不是神的神激动了我的愤恨， 以虚无之物惹动了我的怒气； 我也以不是子民的人激动他们的愤恨， 以愚昧的国民惹动他们的怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以不是神的神激动了我的愤恨， 以虚无之物惹动了我的怒气； 我也以不是子民的人激动他们的愤恨， 以愚昧的国民惹动他们的怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们以那「不算为神」的触动我的愤恨， 以虚无的神惹了我的怒气。 我也要以那「不成子民」的触动他们的愤恨， 以愚昧的国民惹了他们的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: They made me jealous by what is no god and angered me with their worthless idols. I will make them envious by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation that has no understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: They have made me jealous with what is no god; they have provoked me to anger with their idols. So I will make them jealous with those who are no people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have provoked Me to jealousy by what is not God; They have moved Me to anger by their foolish idols. But I will provoke them to jealousy by thosewhoare not a nation; I will move them to anger by a foolish nation.
verses.textEnNlt: They have roused my jealousy by worshiping things that are not God; they have provoked my anger with their useless idols. Now I will rouse their jealousy through people who are not even a people; I will provoke their anger through the foolish Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They have made Me jealous with what is not God; They have provoked Me to anger with their idols. So I will make them jealous with those who are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation,
verses.textEn: They made me jealous by what is no god and angered me with their worthless idols. I will make them envious by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation that has no understanding.

verses.textZh: 因为在我的怒中有火燃烧起来， 烧到阴间的深处， 把大地和地的出产尽都吞灭， 连山的根基也烧着了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在我的怒中有火燃烧起来， 烧到阴间的深处， 把大地和地的出产尽都吞灭， 连山的根基也烧着了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在我怒中有火烧起， 直烧到极深的阴间， 把地和地的出产尽都焚烧， 山的根基也烧着了。
verses.textEnNiv: For a fire will be kindled by my wrath, one that burns down to the realm of the dead below. It will devour the earth and its harvests and set afire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: For a fire is kindled by my anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol, devours the earth and its increase, and sets on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a fire is kindled in My anger, And shall burn to the lowest hell; It shall consume the earth with her increase, And set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: For my anger blazes forth like fire and burns to the depths of the grave. It devours the earth and all its crops and ignites the foundations of the mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: For a fire has flared in My anger, And it burns to the lowest part of Sheol, And devours the earth with its yield, And sets on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.textEn: For a fire will be kindled by my wrath, one that burns down to the realm of the dead below. It will devour the earth and its harvests and set afire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.textZh: 我要把灾祸加在他们身上， 把我的箭向他们射尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把灾祸加在他们身上， 把我的箭向他们射尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将祸患堆在他们身上， 把我的箭向他们射尽。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will heap calamities on them and spend my arrows against them.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend my arrows on them;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I will heap disasters on them; I will spend My arrows on them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will heap disasters upon them and shoot them down with my arrows.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I will add misfortunes to them; I will use up My arrows on them.
verses.textEn: "I will heap calamities on them and spend my arrows against them.

verses.textZh: 他们必因饥荒消瘦，被热病和毒症消灭； 我也要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们， 和土中的蛇类用毒液害他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必因饥荒消瘦，被热病和毒症消灭； 我也要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们， 和土中的蛇类用毒液害他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必因饥饿消瘦， 被炎热苦毒吞灭。 我要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们， 并土中腹行的，用毒气害他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: they shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured by plague and poisonous pestilence; I will send the teeth of beasts against them, with the venom of things that crawl in the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: Theyshallbe wasted with hunger, Devoured by pestilence and bitter destruction; I will also send against them the teeth of beasts, With the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: I will weaken them with famine, burning fever, and deadly disease. I will send the fangs of wild beasts and poisonous snakes that glide in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They will be wasted by famine, and emaciated by plague And a bitter epidemic; And the teeth of beasts I will send against them, With the venom of crawling things of the dust.
verses.textEn: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

verses.textZh: 外有刀剑， 内有惊恐，使人丧亡， 使少男少女， 婴孩和白发老人，尽都丧亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外有刀剑， 内有惊恐，使人丧亡， 使少男少女， 婴孩和白发老人，尽都丧亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 外头有刀剑，内室有惊恐， 使人丧亡，使少男、童女、 吃奶的、白发的，尽都灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. The young men and young women will perish, the infants and those with gray hair.
verses.textEnEsv: Outdoors the sword shall bereave, and indoors terror, for young man and woman alike, the nursing child with the man of gray hairs.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sword shall destroy outside; Thereshallbe terror within For the young man and virgin, The nursing child with the man of gray hairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Outside, the sword will bring death, and inside, terror will strike both young men and young women, both infants and the aged.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Outside the sword will make them childless, And inside, terror— Both young man and virgin, The nursing child with the man of gray hair.
verses.textEn: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. The young men and young women will perish, the infants and those with gray hair.

verses.textZh: 我原想："我要把他们分散到各处， 把他们的名号都从人间除灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我原想："我要把他们分散到各处， 把他们的名号都从人间除灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我说，我必将他们分散远方， 使他们的名号从人间除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: I said I would scatter them and erase their name from human memory,
verses.textEnEsv: I would have said, "I will cut them to pieces; I will wipe them from human memory,"
verses.textEnNkjv: I would have said, "I will dash them in pieces, I will make the memory of them to cease from among men,"
verses.textEnNlt: I would have annihilated them, wiping out even the memory of them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I would have said, "I will wipe them out, I will remove the mention of their name from humanity,"
verses.textEn: I said I would scatter them and erase their name from human memory,

verses.textZh: 但我惧怕仇人激动我， 恐怕敌人误会了， 又恐怕他们说："是我们的手高举了， 并不是耶和华作了这一切事。"’
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我惧怕仇人激动我， 恐怕敌人误会了， 又恐怕他们说："是我们的手高举了， 并不是耶和华作了这一切事。"’
verses.textZhCuv: 惟恐仇敌惹动我， 只怕敌人错看，说：是我们手的能力， 并非耶和华所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: but I dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest the adversary misunderstand and say, ‘Our hand has triumphed; the Lord has not done all this.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: had I not feared provocation by the enemy, lest their adversaries should misunderstand, lest they should say, "Our hand is triumphant, it was not the Lord who did all this."’
verses.textEnNkjv: Had I not feared the wrath of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should misunderstand, Lest they should say, "Our hand is high; And it is not the Lord who has done all this." ’
verses.textEnNlt: But I feared the taunt of Israel’s enemy, who might misunderstand and say, "Our own power has triumphed! The Lord had nothing to do with this!"’
verses.textEnNasb: Had I not feared the provocation by the enemy, That their adversaries would misjudge, That they would say, "Our hand is triumphant, And the Lord has not performed all this." ’
verses.textEn: but I dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest the adversary misunderstand and say, ‘Our hand has triumphed; the Lord has not done all this.’ "

verses.textZh: 因为他们是缺乏计谋的国， 他们心中没有见识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们是缺乏计谋的国， 他们心中没有见识。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列民毫无计谋， 心中没有聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: They are a nation without sense, there is no discernment in them.
verses.textEnEsv: "For they are a nation void of counsel, and there is no understanding in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For they are a nation void of counsel, Nor isthereany understanding in them.
verses.textEnNlt: "But Israel is a senseless nation; the people are foolish, without understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: "For they are a nation destitute of counsel, And there is no understanding in them.
verses.textEn: They are a nation without sense, there is no discernment in them.

verses.textZh: 如果你们有智慧，就可以明白这事， 认清自己将来的结局了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们有智慧，就可以明白这事， 认清自己将来的结局了。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿他们有智慧， 能明白这事，肯思念他们的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: If only they were wise and would understand this and discern what their end will be!
verses.textEnEsv: If they were wise, they would understand this; they would discern their latter end!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that they were wise, that they understood this, That they would consider their latter end!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that they were wise and could understand this! Oh, that they might know their fate!
verses.textEnNasb: "If only they were wise and they understood this; If only they would discern their future!
verses.textEn: If only they were wise and would understand this and discern what their end will be!

verses.textZh: 如果不是他们的盘石把他们出卖了， 如果不是耶和华把他们交出来， 一人怎能追赶一千人， 二人怎能使万人逃跑呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果不是他们的盘石把他们出卖了， 如果不是耶和华把他们交出来， 一人怎能追赶一千人， 二人怎能使万人逃跑呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是他们的磐石卖了他们， 若不是耶和华交出他们， 一人焉能追赶他们千人？ 二人焉能使万人逃跑呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How could one man chase a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the Lord had given them up?
verses.textEnEsv: How could one have chased a thousand, and two have put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had given them up?
verses.textEnNkjv: How could one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Unless their Rock had sold them, And the Lord had surrendered them?
verses.textEnNlt: How could one person chase a thousand of them, and two people put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the Lord had given them up?
verses.textEnNasb: "How could one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Unless their Rock had sold them, And the Lord had given them up?
verses.textEn: How could one man chase a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the Lord had given them up?

verses.textZh: 连我们的仇敌也自己断定， 他们的盘石不像我们的盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连我们的仇敌也自己断定， 他们的盘石不像我们的盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 据我们的仇敌自己断定， 他们的磐石不如我们的磐石。
verses.textEnNiv: For their rock is not like our Rock, as even our enemies concede.
verses.textEnEsv: For their rock is not as our Rock; our enemies are by themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their rock is not like our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.textEnNlt: But the rock of our enemies is not like our Rock, as even they recognize.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, their rock is not like our Rock; Even our enemies themselves judge this.
verses.textEn: For their rock is not like our Rock, as even our enemies concede.

verses.textZh: 因为他们的葡萄树，是所多玛的葡萄树所出的， 是蛾摩拉的田地所生的； 他们的葡萄是毒葡萄， 每一挂都是苦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的葡萄树，是所多玛的葡萄树所出的， 是蛾摩拉的田地所生的； 他们的葡萄是毒葡萄， 每一挂都是苦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的葡萄树是所多玛的葡萄树， 蛾摩拉田园所生的； 他们的葡萄是毒葡萄， 全挂都是苦的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are filled with poison, and their clusters with bitterness.
verses.textEnEsv: For their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah; their grapes are grapes of poison; their clusters are bitter;
verses.textEnNkjv: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom And of the fields of Gomorrah; Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter.
verses.textEnNlt: Their vine grows from the vine of Sodom, from the vineyards of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison, and their clusters are bitter.
verses.textEnNasb: "For their vine is from the vine of Sodom, And from the fields of Gomorrah; Their grapes are grapes of poison, Their clusters, bitter.
verses.textEn: Their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are filled with poison, and their clusters with bitterness.

verses.textZh: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒液， 是虺蛇的剧毒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒液， 是虺蛇的剧毒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒气， 是虺蛇残害的恶毒。
verses.textEnNiv: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
verses.textEnEsv: their wine is the poison of serpents and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their wine is the poison of serpents, And the cruel venom of cobras.
verses.textEnNlt: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their wine is the venom of serpents, And the deadly poison of vipers.
verses.textEn: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.

verses.textZh: 这不是贮藏在我这里， 封闭在我的宝库中吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不是贮藏在我这里， 封闭在我的宝库中吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这不都是积蓄在我这里， 封锁在我府库中吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Have I not kept this in reserve and sealed it in my vaults?
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Is not this laid up in store with me, sealed up in my treasuries?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Is this not laid up in store with Me, Sealed up among My treasures?
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord says, ‘Am I not storing up these things, sealing them away in my treasury?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Is it not stored up with Me, Sealed up in My treasuries?
verses.textEn: "Have I not kept this in reserve and sealed it in my vaults?

verses.textZh: 等到他们失足的时候， 我要伸冤报应； 因为他们遭遇灾难的日子近了， 那预备要临到他们身上的事，必快快临到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到他们失足的时候， 我要伸冤报应； 因为他们遭遇灾难的日子近了， 那预备要临到他们身上的事，必快快临到。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们失脚的时候，伸冤报应在我； 因他们遭灾的日子近了； 那要临在他们身上的必速速来到。
verses.textEnNiv: It is mine to avenge; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; their day of disaster is near and their doom rushes upon them."
verses.textEnEsv: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, for the time when their foot shall slip; for the day of their calamity is at hand, and their doom comes swiftly.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Vengeance is Mine, and recompense; Their foot shall slip in due time; For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things to come hasten upon them.’
verses.textEnNlt: I will take revenge; I will pay them back. In due time their feet will slip. Their day of disaster will arrive, and their destiny will overtake them.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Vengeance is Mine, and retribution; In due time their foot will slip. For the day of their disaster is near, And the impending things are hurrying to them.’
verses.textEn: It is mine to avenge; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; their day of disaster is near and their doom rushes upon them."

verses.textZh: 耶和华要为自己的子民伸冤， 为自己的仆人难过， 因为耶和华看见他们的能力已经消逝， 为奴的或自由的都没有剩下一人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华要为自己的子民伸冤， 为自己的仆人难过， 因为耶和华看见他们的能力已经消逝， 为奴的或自由的都没有剩下一人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华见他百姓毫无能力， 无论困住的、自由的都没有剩下， 就必为他们伸冤， 为他的仆人后悔。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will vindicate his people and relent concerning his servants when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone and there is none remaining, bond or free.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the Lord will judge His people And have compassion on His servants, When He sees that their power is gone, And thereis no one remaining, bond or free.
verses.textEnNlt: "Indeed, the Lord will give justice to his people, and he will change his mind about his servants, when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the Lord will vindicate His people, And will have compassion on His servants, When He sees that their strength is gone, And there is none remaining, bond or free.
verses.textEn: The Lord will vindicate his people and relent concerning his servants when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.

verses.textZh: 他必说：‘他们的神在哪里呢？ 他们投靠的盘石在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必说：‘他们的神在哪里呢？ 他们投靠的盘石在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他必说：他们的神， 他们所投靠的磐石，
verses.textEnNiv: He will say: "Now where are their gods, the rock they took refuge in,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he will say, ‘Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
verses.textEnNkjv: He will say: ‘Where are their gods, The rock in which they sought refuge?
verses.textEnNlt: Then he will ask, ‘Where are their gods, the rocks they fled to for refuge?
verses.textEnNasb: "And He will say, ‘Where are their gods, The rock in which they took refuge?
verses.textEn: He will say: "Now where are their gods, the rock they took refuge in,

verses.textZh: 就是向来吃他们祭牲脂肪的， 喝他们奠祭之酒的神在哪里呢？ 让他们兴起来帮助你们吧， 愿他们保护你们吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是向来吃他们祭牲脂肪的， 喝他们奠祭之酒的神在哪里呢？ 让他们兴起来帮助你们吧， 愿他们保护你们吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 就是向来吃他们祭牲的脂油， 喝他们奠祭之酒的，在哪里呢？ 他可以兴起帮助你们， 护卫你们。
verses.textEnNiv: the gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up to help you! Let them give you shelter!
verses.textEnEsv: who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you; let them be your protection!
verses.textEnNkjv: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices, And drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise and help you, And be your refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: Where now are those gods, who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their offerings? Let those gods arise and help you! Let them provide you with shelter!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Those who ate the fat of their sacrifices, And drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you, Let them be your protection!
verses.textEn: the gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up to help you! Let them give you shelter!

verses.textZh: 现在你们要知道，只有我是那一位， 除我以外，并没有别的神； 我使人死，也使人活； 我打伤，我也医治； 没有人可以从我的手里抢救出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要知道，只有我是那一位， 除我以外，并没有别的神； 我使人死，也使人活； 我打伤，我也医治； 没有人可以从我的手里抢救出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们如今要知道： 我，惟有我是神； 在我以外并无别神。 我使人死，我使人活； 我损伤，我也医治， 并无人能从我手中救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "See now that I myself am he! There is no god besides me. I put to death and I bring to life, I have wounded and I will heal, and no one can deliver out of my hand.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god beside me; I kill and I make alive; I wound and I heal; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Now see that I, even I, am He, And thereis no God besides Me; I kill and I make alive; I wound and I heal; Nor isthereany who can deliver from My hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Look now; I myself am he! There is no other god but me! I am the one who kills and gives life; I am the one who wounds and heals; no one can be rescued from my powerful hand!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘See now that I, I am He, And there is no god besides Me; It is I who put to death and give life. I have wounded and it is I who heal, And there is no one who can save anyone from My hand.
verses.textEn: "See now that I myself am he! There is no god besides me. I put to death and I bring to life, I have wounded and I will heal, and no one can deliver out of my hand.

verses.textZh: 我向天举手 说：我活到永永远远；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向天举手 说：我活到永永远远；
verses.textZhCuv: 我向天举手说： 我凭我的永生起誓：
verses.textEnNiv: I lift my hand to heaven and solemnly swear: As surely as I live forever,
verses.textEnEsv: For I lift up my hand to heaven and swear, As I live forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I raise My hand to heaven, And say, "As I live forever,
verses.textEnNlt: Now I raise my hand to heaven and declare, "As surely as I live,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Indeed, I raise My hand to heaven, And say, as I live forever,
verses.textEn: I lift my hand to heaven and solemnly swear: As surely as I live forever,

verses.textZh: 如果我磨亮了我的刀剑， 如果我掌握了审判权， 就必向我的仇敌伸冤， 必向恨我的人报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我磨亮了我的刀剑， 如果我掌握了审判权， 就必向我的仇敌伸冤， 必向恨我的人报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若磨我闪亮的刀， 手掌审判之权， 就必报复我的敌人， 报应恨我的人。
verses.textEnNiv: when I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and repay those who hate me.
verses.textEnEsv: if I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand takes hold on judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and will repay those who hate me.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I whet My glittering sword, And My hand takes hold on judgment, I will render vengeance to My enemies, And repay those who hate Me.
verses.textEnNlt: when I sharpen my flashing sword and begin to carry out justice, I will take revenge on my enemies and repay those who reject me.
verses.textEnNasb: If I have sharpened My flashing sword, And My hand has taken hold of justice, I will return vengeance on My adversaries, And I will repay those who hate Me.
verses.textEn: when I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and repay those who hate me.

verses.textZh: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉， 就是被杀的人和被掳的人的血； 我的刀剑要吃肉，就是吃仇敌长发首领的肉。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉， 就是被杀的人和被掳的人的血； 我的刀剑要吃肉，就是吃仇敌长发首领的肉。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉， 就是被杀被掳之人的血。 我的刀要吃肉， 乃是仇敌中首领之头的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, while my sword devours flesh: the blood of the slain and the captives, the heads of the enemy leaders."
verses.textEnEsv: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh— with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the long-haired heads of the enemy.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, And My sword shall devour flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the heads of the leaders of the enemy." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword will devour flesh— the blood of the slaughtered and the captives, and the heads of the enemy leaders."’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I will make My arrows drunk with blood, And My sword will devour flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the long-haired leaders of the enemy.’
verses.textEn: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, while my sword devours flesh: the blood of the slain and the captives, the heads of the enemy leaders."

verses.textZh: 列国啊，你们当与耶和华的子民一同欢呼， 因为他要伸他仆人流血的冤，他要向他的仇人报复， 他要救赎他的地和他的子民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国啊，你们当与耶和华的子民一同欢呼， 因为他要伸他仆人流血的冤，他要向他的仇人报复， 他要救赎他的地和他的子民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼； 因他要伸他仆人流血的冤， 报应他的敌人， 洁净他的地，救赎他的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take vengeance on his enemies and make atonement for his land and people.
verses.textEnEsv: "Rejoice with him, O heavens; bow down to him, all gods, for he avenges the blood of his children and takes vengeance on his adversaries. He repays those who hate him and cleanses his people’s land."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people; For He will avenge the blood of His servants, And render vengeance to His adversaries; He will provide atonement for His land and His people."
verses.textEnNlt: "Rejoice with him, you heavens, and let all of God’s angels worship him. Rejoice with his people, you Gentiles, and let all the angels be strengthened in him. For he will avenge the blood of his children ; he will take revenge against his enemies. He will repay those who hate him and cleanse his people’s land."
verses.textEnNasb: "Rejoice, you nations, with His people; For He will avenge the blood of His servants, And will return vengeance on His adversaries, And will atone for His land and His people."
verses.textEn: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take vengeance on his enemies and make atonement for his land and people.

verses.textZh: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚前来，把这首诗歌的一切话都说给人民听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚前来，把这首诗歌的一切话都说给人民听。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚去将这歌的一切话说给百姓听。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses came and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses came with Joshua the son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song to the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he, with Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEn: Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.

verses.textZh: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切话，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切的话，
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: And when Moses had finished speaking all these words to all Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to the people of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: When Moses had finished speaking all these words to all Israel,
verses.textEn: When Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel,

verses.textZh: 就对他们说："我今日警告你们的一切话，你们都要放在心上，好吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对他们说："我今日警告你们的一切话，你们都要放在心上，好吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「我今日所警教你们的，你们都要放在心上；要吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的话。
verses.textEnNiv: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.
verses.textEnEsv: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words by which I am warning you today, that you may command them to your children, that they may be careful to do all the words of this law.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he said to them: "Set your hearts on all the words which I testify among you today, which you shall command your children to be careful to observe—all the words of this law.
verses.textEnNlt: he added: "Take to heart all the words of warning I have given you today. Pass them on as a command to your children so they will obey every word of these instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: he said to them, "Take to your heart all the words with which I am warning you today, which you will command your sons to follow carefully, all the words of this Law.
verses.textEn: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.

verses.textZh: 因为这不是空洞、与你们无关重要的事，而是你们的生命；借着这事，你们在过约旦河去得为业的地上，才可以日子长久。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这不是空洞、与你们无关重要的事，而是你们的生命；借着这事，你们在过约旦河去得为业的地上，才可以日子长久。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这不是虚空、与你们无关的事，乃是你们的生命；在你们过约旦河要得为业的地上必因这事日子得以长久。」
verses.textEnNiv: They are not just idle words for you—they are your life. By them you will live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEnEsv: For it is no empty word for you, but your very life, and by this word you shall live long in the land that you are going over the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is not a futile thing for you, because it is your life, and by this word you shall prolong your days in the land which you cross over the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEnNlt: These instructions are not empty words—they are your life! By obeying them you will enjoy a long life in the land you will occupy when you cross the Jordan River."
verses.textEnNasb: For it is not a trivial matter for you; indeed it is your life. And by this word you will prolong your days in the land, which you are about to cross the Jordan to possess."
verses.textEn: They are not just idle words for you—they are your life. By them you will live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."

verses.textZh: 就在那一天，耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那一天，耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: On that same day the Lord told Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: That very day the Lord spoke to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses that very same day, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: That same day the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses that very same day, saying,
verses.textEn: On that same day the Lord told Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要上这亚巴琳山去，就是尼波山，在耶利哥对面的摩押地，观看我赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要上这亚巴琳山去，就是尼波山，在耶利哥对面的摩押地，观看我赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你上这亚巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地与耶利哥相对，观看我所要赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, opposite Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the people of Israel for a possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, across from Jericho; view the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel as a possession;
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to Moab, to the mountains east of the river, and climb Mount Nebo, which is across from Jericho. Look out across the land of Canaan, the land I am giving to the people of Israel as their own special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go up to this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab opposite Jericho, and look at the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession.
verses.textEn: "Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.

verses.textZh: 你必死在你登上的山上，归到你的族人那里去，像你的哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归到他的族人那里去一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必死在你登上的山上，归到你的族人那里去，像你的哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归到他的族人那里去一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必死在你所登的山上，归你列祖 去，像你哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归他的列祖一样。
verses.textEnNiv: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnEsv: And die on the mountain which you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died in Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,
verses.textEnNkjv: and die on the mountain which you ascend, and be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people;
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will die there on the mountain. You will join your ancestors, just as Aaron, your brother, died on Mount Hor and joined his ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you are to die on the mountain where you ascend, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,
verses.textEn: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

verses.textZh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，在加低斯米利巴水边，在以色列人中间悖逆我，在以色列人中间没有尊我为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们在寻的旷野，在加低斯米利巴水边，在以色列人中间悖逆我，在以色列人中间没有尊我为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们在寻的旷野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中没有尊我为圣，得罪了我。
verses.textEnNiv: This is because both of you broke faith with me in the presence of the Israelites at the waters of Meribah Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and because you did not uphold my holiness among the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: because you broke faith with me in the midst of the people of Israel at the waters of Meribah-kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, and because you did not treat me as holy in the midst of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: because you trespassed against Me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin, because you did not hallow Me in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: For both of you betrayed me with the Israelites at the waters of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin. You failed to demonstrate my holiness to the people of Israel there.
verses.textEnNasb: because you broke faith with Me in the midst of the sons of Israel at the waters of Meribah-kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not treat Me as holy in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: This is because both of you broke faith with me in the presence of the Israelites at the waters of Meribah Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and because you did not uphold my holiness among the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 我赐给以色列人的地，你可以从对面观看，却不得进去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我赐给以色列人的地，你可以从对面观看，却不得进去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我所赐给以色列人的地，你可以远远地观看，却不得进去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: For you shall see the land before you, but you shall not go there, into the land that I am giving to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you shall see the land before you, though you shall not go there, into the land which I am giving to the children of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: So you will see the land from a distance, but you may not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: For you will see the land at a distance but you will not go there, into the land which I am giving the sons of Israel."
verses.textEn: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."

verses.textZh: 这是神人摩西，在死前给以色列人所祝的福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是神人摩西，在死前给以色列人所祝的福。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先为以色列人所祝的福：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced on the Israelites before his death.
