verses.textEnEsv: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the people of Israel before his death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the blessing that Moses, the man of God, gave to the people of Israel before his death:
verses.textEnNasb: Now this is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the sons of Israel before his death.
verses.textEn: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced on the Israelites before his death.

verses.textZh: 他说： "耶和华从西奈而来， 从西珥光照他们， 从巴兰山射出光辉， 在千万圣者中来临， 在他的右手有烈火的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说： "耶和华从西奈而来， 从西珥光照他们， 从巴兰山射出光辉， 在千万圣者中来临， 在他的右手有烈火的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：耶和华从西奈而来， 从西珥向他们显现， 从巴兰山发出光辉， 从万万圣者中来临， 从他右手为百姓传出烈火的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "The Lord came from Sinai and dawned over them from Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with myriads of holy ones from the south, from his mountain slopes.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "The Lord came from Sinai and dawned from Seir upon us; he shone forth from Mount Paran; he came from the ten thousands of holy ones, with flaming fire at his right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "The Lord came from Sinai, And dawned on them from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran, And He came with ten thousands of saints; From His right hand Came a fiery law for them.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord came from Mount Sinai and dawned upon us from Mount Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran and came from Meribah-kadesh with flaming fire at his right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "The Lord came from Sinai, And dawned on them from Seir; He shone from Mount Paran, And He came from the midst of myriads of holy ones; At His right hand there was flashing lightning for them.
verses.textEn: He said: "The Lord came from Sinai and dawned over them from Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with myriads of holy ones from the south, from his mountain slopes.

verses.textZh: 他实在爱人民， 他的众圣者都在你的手里； 他们坐在你的脚前， 各自领受你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他实在爱人民， 他的众圣者都在你的手里； 他们坐在你的脚前， 各自领受你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他疼爱百姓； 众圣徒都在他手中。 他们坐在他的脚下， 领受他的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely it is you who love the people; all the holy ones are in your hand. At your feet they all bow down, and from you receive instruction,
verses.textEnEsv: Yes, he loved his people, all his holy ones were in his hand; so they followed in your steps, receiving direction from you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, He loves the people; All His saints are in Your hand; They sit down at Your feet; Everyone receives Your words.
verses.textEnNlt: Indeed, he loves his people; all his holy ones are in his hands. They follow in his steps and accept his teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, He loves the people; All Your holy ones are in Your hand, And they followed in Your steps; Everyone takes of Your words.
verses.textEn: Surely it is you who love the people; all the holy ones are in your hand. At your feet they all bow down, and from you receive instruction,

verses.textZh: 摩西把律法吩咐我们， 作为雅各会众的基业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把律法吩咐我们， 作为雅各会众的基业。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将律法传给我们， 作为雅各会众的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: when Moses commanded us a law, as a possession for the assembly of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses commanded a law for us, A heritage of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses gave us the Lord ’s instruction, the special possession of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moses issued to us the Law, A possession for the assembly of Jacob.
verses.textEn: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 人民的众首领，以色列的各支派， 一同会合的时候， 耶和华就在耶书仑作王了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民的众首领，以色列的各支派， 一同会合的时候， 耶和华就在耶书仑作王了。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓的众首领， 以色列的各支派， 一同聚会的时候， 耶和华 在耶书仑中为王。
verses.textEnNiv: He was king over Jeshurun when the leaders of the people assembled, along with the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the Lord became king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was King in Jeshurun, When the leaders of the people were gathered, All the tribes of Israel together.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord became king in Israel — when the leaders of the people assembled, when the tribes of Israel gathered as one."
verses.textEnNasb: "And He was king in Jeshurun, When the heads of the people gathered, The tribes of Israel together.
verses.textEn: He was king over Jeshurun when the leaders of the people assembled, along with the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 愿流本生存，不致死亡， 愿他的人数不致稀少。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿流本生存，不致死亡， 愿他的人数不致稀少。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿吕便存活，不致死亡； 愿他人数不致稀少。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let Reuben live and not die, nor his people be few."
verses.textEnEsv: "Let Reuben live, and not die, but let his men be few."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let Reuben live, and not die, Nor let his men be few."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Reuben: "Let the tribe of Reuben live and not die out, though they are few in number."
verses.textEnNasb: "May Reuben live and not die, Nor may his people be few."
verses.textEn: "Let Reuben live and not die, nor his people be few."

verses.textZh: 论到犹大，他这样说： "耶和华啊，求你垂听犹大的声音， 领他归回自己的族人那里； 他曾用手为自己奋斗， 愿你帮助他抵挡仇敌。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到犹大，他这样说： "耶和华啊，求你垂听犹大的声音， 领他归回自己的族人那里； 他曾用手为自己奋斗， 愿你帮助他抵挡仇敌。"
verses.textZhCuv: 为犹大祝福说： 求耶和华俯听犹大的声音， 引导他归于本族； 他曾用手为自己争战， 你必帮助他攻击敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: And this he said about Judah: "Hear, Lord , the cry of Judah; bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause. Oh, be his help against his foes!"
verses.textEnEsv: And this he said of Judah: "Hear, O Lord , the voice of Judah, and bring him in to his people. With your hands contend for him, and be a help against his adversaries."
verses.textEnNkjv: And this he said of Judah: "Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, And bring him to his people; Let his hands be sufficient for him, And may You be a help against his enemies."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Judah: "O Lord , hear the cry of Judah and bring them together as a people. Give them strength to defend their cause; help them against their enemies!"
verses.textEnNasb: And this was regarding Judah; so he said: "Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, And bring him to his people. With his hands he contended for them, And may You be a help against his adversaries."
verses.textEn: And this he said about Judah: "Hear, Lord , the cry of Judah; bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause. Oh, be his help against his foes!"

verses.textZh: 论到利未，他说： "耶和华啊，愿你的土明和乌陵属于对你忠心的人 ， 就是你在玛撒试验过的， 在米利巴水边与他们争论过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到利未，他说： "耶和华啊，愿你的土明和乌陵属于对你忠心的人 ， 就是你在玛撒试验过的， 在米利巴水边与他们争论过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 论利未说： 耶和华啊，你的土明和乌陵 都在你的虔诚人那里。 你在玛撒曾试验他， 在米利巴水与他争论。
verses.textEnNiv: About Levi he said: "Your Thummim and Urim belong to your faithful servant. You tested him at Massah; you contended with him at the waters of Meribah.
verses.textEnEsv: And of Levi he said, "Give to Levi your Thummim, and your Urim to your godly one, whom you tested at Massah, with whom you quarreled at the waters of Meribah;
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Levi he said: "Let Your Thummim and Your Urim be with Your holy one, Whom You tested at Massah, And with whom You contended at the waters of Meribah,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Levi: "O Lord , you have given your Thummim and Urim—the sacred lots— to your faithful servants the Levites. You put them to the test at Massah and struggled with them at the waters of Meribah.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Levi he said, "Let Your Thummim and Your Urim belong to Your godly man, Whom You tested at Massah, With whom You contended at the waters of Meribah;
verses.textEn: About Levi he said: "Your Thummim and Urim belong to your faithful servant. You tested him at Massah; you contended with him at the waters of Meribah.

verses.textZh: 利未人论到自己的父母说：‘我没有看顾他们’； 他不承认自己的兄弟， 也不认识自己的儿女； 因为他们谨守你的话，持守你的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人论到自己的父母说：‘我没有看顾他们’； 他不承认自己的兄弟， 也不认识自己的儿女； 因为他们谨守你的话，持守你的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 他论自己的父母说： 我未曾看见； 他也不承认弟兄， 也不认识自己的儿女。 这是因利未人遵行你的话， 谨守你的约。
verses.textEnNiv: He said of his father and mother, ‘I have no regard for them.’ He did not recognize his brothers or acknowledge his own children, but he watched over your word and guarded your covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: who said of his father and mother, ‘I regard them not’; he disowned his brothers and ignored his children. For they observed your word and kept your covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who says of his father and mother, ‘I have not seen them’; Nor did he acknowledge his brothers, Or know his own children; For they have observed Your word And kept Your covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites obeyed your word and guarded your covenant. They were more loyal to you than to their own parents. They ignored their relatives and did not acknowledge their own children.
verses.textEnNasb: Who said of his father and his mother, ‘I did not consider them’; And he did not acknowledge his brothers, Nor did he regard his own sons, For they kept Your word, And complied with Your covenant.
verses.textEn: He said of his father and mother, ‘I have no regard for them.’ He did not recognize his brothers or acknowledge his own children, but he watched over your word and guarded your covenant.

verses.textZh: 他们要把你的典章教训雅各， 把你的律法教训以色列； 他们要把香焚在你面前， 把全牲的燔祭献在你的祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要把你的典章教训雅各， 把你的律法教训以色列； 他们要把香焚在你面前， 把全牲的燔祭献在你的祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要将你的典章教训雅各， 将你的律法教训以色列。 他们要把香焚在你面前， 把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: He teaches your precepts to Jacob and your law to Israel. He offers incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall teach Jacob your rules and Israel your law; they shall put incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall teach Jacob Your judgments, And Israel Your law. They shall put incense before You, And a whole burnt sacrifice on Your altar.
verses.textEnNlt: They teach your regulations to Jacob; they give your instructions to Israel. They present incense before you and offer whole burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will teach Your ordinances to Jacob, And Your Law to Israel. They shall put incense before You, And whole burnt offerings on Your altar.
verses.textEn: He teaches your precepts to Jacob and your law to Israel. He offers incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你赐福他的能力， 悦纳他手中的作为； 那些起来攻击他和恨他的人，愿你刺透他们的腰， 使他们不能再起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你赐福他的能力， 悦纳他手中的作为； 那些起来攻击他和恨他的人，愿你刺透他们的腰， 使他们不能再起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求耶和华降福在他的财物上， 悦纳他手里所办的事。 那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人， 愿你刺透他们的腰， 使他们不得再起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Bless all his skills, Lord , and be pleased with the work of his hands. Strike down those who rise against him, his foes till they rise no more."
verses.textEnEsv: Bless, O Lord , his substance, and accept the work of his hands; crush the loins of his adversaries, of those who hate him, that they rise not again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless his substance, Lord, And accept the work of his hands; Strike the loins of those who rise against him, And of those who hate him, that they rise not again."
verses.textEnNlt: Bless the ministry of the Levites, O Lord , and accept all the work of their hands. Hit their enemies where it hurts the most; strike down their foes so they never rise again."
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord, bless his strength, And accept the work of his hands; Smash the hips of those who rise up against him, And those who hate him, so that they do not rise again."
verses.textEn: Bless all his skills, Lord , and be pleased with the work of his hands. Strike down those who rise against him, his foes till they rise no more."

verses.textZh: 论到便雅悯，他说： "耶和华所爱的，必在耶和华身边安然居住； 耶和华终日庇护他， 也必住在他的两肩之间。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到便雅悯，他说： "耶和华所爱的，必在耶和华身边安然居住； 耶和华终日庇护他， 也必住在他的两肩之间。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论便雅悯说： 耶和华所亲爱的必同耶和华安然居住； 耶和华终日遮蔽他，也住在他两肩之中。
verses.textEnNiv: About Benjamin he said: "Let the beloved of the Lord rest secure in him, for he shields him all day long, and the one the Lord loves rests between his shoulders."
verses.textEnEsv: Of Benjamin he said, "The beloved of the Lord dwells in safety. The High God surrounds him all day long, and dwells between his shoulders."
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Benjamin he said: "The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by Him, Who shelters him all the day long; And he shall dwell between His shoulders."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Benjamin: "The people of Benjamin are loved by the Lord and live in safety beside him. He surrounds them continuously and preserves them from every harm."
verses.textEnNasb: Of Benjamin he said, "May the beloved of the Lord live in security beside Him Who shields him all the day long, And he lives between His shoulders."
verses.textEn: About Benjamin he said: "Let the beloved of the Lord rest secure in him, for he shields him all day long, and the one the Lord loves rests between his shoulders."

verses.textZh: 论到约瑟，他说： "愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福， 得着从天上而来的上好甘露， 以及蕴藏在地里的泉水；
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到约瑟，他说： "愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福， 得着从天上而来的上好甘露， 以及蕴藏在地里的泉水；
verses.textZhCuv: 论约瑟说： 愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福， 得天上的宝物、甘露， 以及地里所藏的泉水；
verses.textEnNiv: About Joseph he said: "May the Lord bless his land with the precious dew from heaven above and with the deep waters that lie below;
verses.textEnEsv: And of Joseph he said, "Blessed by the Lord be his land, with the choicest gifts of heaven above, and of the deep that crouches beneath,
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Joseph he said: "Blessed of the Lordis his land, With the precious things of heaven, with the dew, And the deep lying beneath,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribes of Joseph: "May their land be blessed by the Lord with the precious gift of dew from the heavens and water from beneath the earth;
verses.textEnNasb: Of Joseph he said, "Blessed of the Lordbe his land, With the choice things of heaven, with the dew, And from the deep waters lying beneath,
verses.textEn: About Joseph he said: "May the Lord bless his land with the precious dew from heaven above and with the deep waters that lie below;

verses.textZh: 得着从太阳而来的上好之物， 每月所产的佳果；
verses.textZhCnvs: 得着从太阳而来的上好之物， 每月所产的佳果；
verses.textZhCuv: 得太阳所晒熟的美果， 月亮所养成的宝物；
verses.textEnNiv: with the best the sun brings forth and the finest the moon can yield;
verses.textEnEsv: with the choicest fruits of the sun and the rich yield of the months,
verses.textEnNkjv: With the precious fruits of the sun, With the precious produce of the months,
verses.textEnNlt: with the rich fruit that grows in the sun, and the rich harvest produced each month;
verses.textEnNasb: And with the choice yield of the sun, And the choice produce of the months;
verses.textEn: with the best the sun brings forth and the finest the moon can yield;

verses.textZh: 得着从太古之山而来的上品， 从永远之岭而来的上好之物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 得着从太古之山而来的上品， 从永远之岭而来的上好之物；
verses.textZhCuv: 得上古之山的至宝， 永世之岭的宝物；
verses.textEnNiv: with the choicest gifts of the ancient mountains and the fruitfulness of the everlasting hills;
verses.textEnEsv: with the finest produce of the ancient mountains and the abundance of the everlasting hills,
verses.textEnNkjv: With the best things of the ancient mountains, With the precious things of the everlasting hills,
verses.textEnNlt: with the finest crops of the ancient mountains, and the abundance from the everlasting hills;
verses.textEnNasb: And with the best things of the ancient mountains, With the choice things of the everlasting hills,
verses.textEn: with the choicest gifts of the ancient mountains and the fruitfulness of the everlasting hills;

verses.textZh: 得着从地所出的上好之物，和其中所充满的； 得着那住在荆棘中的耶和华的恩宠； 愿这些都临到约瑟的头上， 就是临到那在兄弟中作王子的人的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得着从地所出的上好之物，和其中所充满的； 得着那住在荆棘中的耶和华的恩宠； 愿这些都临到约瑟的头上， 就是临到那在兄弟中作王子的人的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 得地和其中所充满的宝物， 并住荆棘中上主的喜悦。 愿这些福都归于约瑟的头上， 归于那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。
verses.textEnNiv: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwelt in the burning bush. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwells in the bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph, on the pate of him who is prince among his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the precious things of the earth and its fullness, And the favor of Him who dwelt in the bush. Let theblessing come ‘on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him whowas separate from his brothers.’
verses.textEnNlt: with the best gifts of the earth and its bounty, and the favor of the one who appeared in the burning bush. May these blessings rest on Joseph’s head, crowning the brow of the prince among his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: And with the choice things of the earth and its fullness, And the favor of Him who dwelt in the bush. Let it come to the head of Joseph, And to the top of the head of the one who was prince among his brothers.
verses.textEn: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwelt in the burning bush. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

verses.textZh: 他头生的公牛大有威严； 他的两角是野牛的角， 用来抵触万民， 直到地极； 这角是以法莲的万万， 那角是玛拿西的千千。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他头生的公牛大有威严； 他的两角是野牛的角， 用来抵触万民， 直到地极； 这角是以法莲的万万， 那角是玛拿西的千千。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他为牛群中头生的，有威严； 他的角是野牛的角， 用以抵触万邦，直到地极。 这角是以法莲的万万， 玛拿西的千千。
verses.textEnNiv: In majesty he is like a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even those at the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim; such are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.textEnEsv: A firstborn bull —he has majesty, and his horns are the horns of a wild ox; with them he shall gore the peoples, all of them, to the ends of the earth; they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.textEnNkjv: His glory islike a firstborn bull, And his horns like the horns of the wild ox; Together with them He shall push the peoples To the ends of the earth; They are the ten thousands of Ephraim, And they are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph has the majesty of a young bull; he has the horns of a wild ox. He will gore distant nations, even to the ends of the earth. This is my blessing for the multitudes of Ephraim and the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.textEnNasb: "As the firstborn of his ox, majesty is his, And his horns are the horns of the wild ox; With them he will gore the peoples All at once, to the ends of the earth. And those are the ten thousands of Ephraim, And those are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.textEn: In majesty he is like a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even those at the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim; such are the thousands of Manasseh."

verses.textZh: 论到西布伦，他说： "西布伦啊，你出外的时候，要喜乐； 以萨迦啊，你在帐棚里的时候，也要喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到西布伦，他说： "西布伦啊，你出外的时候，要喜乐； 以萨迦啊，你在帐棚里的时候，也要喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 论西布伦说： 西布伦哪，你出外可以欢喜。 以萨迦啊，在你帐棚里可以快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: About Zebulun he said: "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and you, Issachar, in your tents.
verses.textEnEsv: And of Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar, in your tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Zebulun he said: "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, And Issachar in your tents!
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribes of Zebulun and Issachar : "May the people of Zebulun prosper in their travels. May the people of Issachar prosper at home in their tents.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, And, Issachar, in your tents.
verses.textEn: About Zebulun he said: "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and you, Issachar, in your tents.

verses.textZh: 他们要把万民召到山上来， 在那里要献上公义的祭； 因为他们要吸取海洋的丰富， 沙土中埋藏着的宝藏。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要把万民召到山上来， 在那里要献上公义的祭； 因为他们要吸取海洋的丰富， 沙土中埋藏着的宝藏。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要将列邦召到山上， 在那里献公义的祭； 因为他们要吸取海里的丰富， 并沙中所藏的珍宝。
verses.textEnNiv: They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer the sacrifices of the righteous; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand."
verses.textEnEsv: They shall call peoples to their mountain; there they offer right sacrifices; for they draw from the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand."
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall call the peoples to the mountain; There they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness; For they shall partake of the abundance of the seas And of treasures hidden in the sand."
verses.textEnNlt: They summon the people to the mountain to offer proper sacrifices there. They benefit from the riches of the sea and the hidden treasures in the sand."
verses.textEnNasb: "They will call peoples to the mountain; There they will offer righteous sacrifices; For they will draw out the abundance of the seas, And the hidden treasures of the sand."
verses.textEn: They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer the sacrifices of the righteous; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand."

verses.textZh: 论到迦得，他说： "那使迦得扩张的，是应该称颂的， 迦得蹲下如母狮， 他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到迦得，他说： "那使迦得扩张的，是应该称颂的， 迦得蹲下如母狮， 他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 论迦得说： 使迦得扩张的应当称颂！ 迦得住如母狮； 他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。
verses.textEnNiv: About Gad he said: "Blessed is he who enlarges Gad’s domain! Gad lives there like a lion, tearing at arm or head.
verses.textEnEsv: And of Gad he said, "Blessed be he who enlarges Gad! Gad crouches like a lion; he tears off arm and scalp.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Gad he said: "Blessed is he who enlarges Gad; He dwells as a lion, And tears the arm and the crown of his head.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Gad: "Blessed is the one who enlarges Gad’s territory! Gad is poised there like a lion to tear off an arm or a head.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Gad he said, "Blessed is the one who enlarges Gad; He lies down as a lion, And tears the arm, also the crown of the head.
verses.textEn: About Gad he said: "Blessed is he who enlarges Gad’s domain! Gad lives there like a lion, tearing at arm or head.

verses.textZh: 他为自己选择了头一份， 因为在那里有指挥者的分存留着； 他与人民的众首领一同来， 他施行耶和华的公义， 以及与以色列有关的典章。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为自己选择了头一份， 因为在那里有指挥者的分存留着； 他与人民的众首领一同来， 他施行耶和华的公义， 以及与以色列有关的典章。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他为自己选择头一段地， 因在那里有设立律法者的分存留。 他与百姓的首领同来； 他施行耶和华的公义 和耶和华与以色列所立的典章。
verses.textEnNiv: He chose the best land for himself; the leader’s portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the Lord ’s righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: He chose the best of the land for himself, for there a commander’s portion was reserved; and he came with the heads of the people, with Israel he executed the justice of the Lord , and his judgments for Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: He provided the first part for himself, Because a lawgiver’s portion was reserved there. He came with the heads of the people; He administered the justice of the Lord, And His judgments with Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Gad took the best land for themselves; a leader’s share was assigned to them. When the leaders of the people were assembled, they carried out the Lord ’s justice and obeyed his regulations for Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: "Then he selected the choicest part for himself, For there the ruler’s portion was reserved; And he came with the leaders of the people; He executed the justice of the Lord, And His ordinances with Israel."
verses.textEn: He chose the best land for himself; the leader’s portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the Lord ’s righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel."

verses.textZh: 论到但，他说： "但是只幼狮， 从巴珊跳出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到但，他说： "但是只幼狮， 从巴珊跳出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论但说： 但为小狮子， 从巴珊跳出来。
verses.textEnNiv: About Dan he said: "Dan is a lion’s cub, springing out of Bashan."
verses.textEnEsv: And of Dan he said, "Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps from Bashan."
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Dan he said: "Dan is a lion’s whelp; He shall leap from Bashan."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Dan: "Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out from Bashan."
verses.textEnNasb: Of Dan he said, "Dan is a lion’s cub; He leaps out from Bashan."
verses.textEn: About Dan he said: "Dan is a lion’s cub, springing out of Bashan."

verses.textZh: 论到拿弗他利，他说： "拿弗他利啊，你饱受恩宠， 满得耶和华的福， 可以取得西方和南方为业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到拿弗他利，他说： "拿弗他利啊，你饱受恩宠， 满得耶和华的福， 可以取得西方和南方为业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论拿弗他利说： 拿弗他利啊，你足沾恩惠， 满得耶和华的福， 可以得西方和南方为业。
verses.textEnNiv: About Naphtali he said: "Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the Lord and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake."
verses.textEnEsv: And of Naphtali he said, "O Naphtali, sated with favor, and full of the blessing of the Lord , possess the lake and the south."
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Naphtali he said: "O Naphtali, satisfied with favor, And full of the blessing of the Lord, Possess the west and the south."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Naphtali: "O Naphtali, you are rich in favor and full of the Lord ’s blessings; may you possess the west and the south."
verses.textEnNasb: Of Naphtali he said, "Naphtali, satisfied with favor, And full of the blessing of the Lord, Take possession of the sea and the south."
verses.textEn: About Naphtali he said: "Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the Lord and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake."

verses.textZh: 论到亚设，他说： "愿亚设蒙福，胜过众子， 愿他得兄弟的喜悦； 愿他把脚蘸在油中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到亚设，他说： "愿亚设蒙福，胜过众子， 愿他得兄弟的喜悦； 愿他把脚蘸在油中。
verses.textZhCuv: 论亚设说： 愿亚设享受多子的福乐， 得他弟兄的喜悦， 可以把脚蘸在油中。
verses.textEnNiv: About Asher he said: "Most blessed of sons is Asher; let him be favored by his brothers, and let him bathe his feet in oil.
verses.textEnEsv: And of Asher he said, "Most blessed of sons be Asher; let him be the favorite of his brothers, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Asher he said: "Asher is most blessed of sons; Let him be favored by his brothers, And let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said this about the tribe of Asher: "May Asher be blessed above other sons; may he be esteemed by his brothers; may he bathe his feet in olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Asher he said, "More blessed than sons is Asher; May he be favored by his brothers, And may he dip his foot in olive oil.
verses.textEn: About Asher he said: "Most blessed of sons is Asher; let him be favored by his brothers, and let him bathe his feet in oil.

verses.textZh: 你的门闩是铜的，是铁的， 你的日子怎样，你的力量也必怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的门闩是铜的，是铁的， 你的日子怎样，你的力量也必怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的门闩 是铜的，铁的。 你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。
verses.textEnNiv: The bolts of your gates will be iron and bronze, and your strength will equal your days.
verses.textEnEsv: Your bars shall be iron and bronze, and as your days, so shall your strength be.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your sandals shallbe iron and bronze; As your days, soshall your strength be.
verses.textEnNlt: May the bolts of your gates be of iron and bronze; may you be secure all your days."
verses.textEnNasb: "Your bars will be iron and bronze, And as your days, so will your strength be.
verses.textEn: The bolts of your gates will be iron and bronze, and your strength will equal your days.

verses.textZh: 没有人像耶书仑的神， 为了帮助你，他乘驾诸天， 在他的威严中，他腾空行云。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人像耶书仑的神， 为了帮助你，他乘驾诸天， 在他的威严中，他腾空行云。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶书仑哪，没有能比神的。 他为帮助你，乘在天空， 显其威荣，驾行穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides across the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: "There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides through the heavens to your help, through the skies in his majesty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thereis no one like the God of Jeshurun, Who rides the heavens to help you, And in His excellency on the clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: "There is no one like the God of Israel. He rides across the heavens to help you, across the skies in majestic splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, Who rides the heavens to your help, And the clouds in His majesty.
verses.textEn: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides across the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty.

verses.textZh: 亘古的神是你的居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他把仇敌从你面前赶出去， 他发令说：‘毁灭吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 亘古的神是你的居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他把仇敌从你面前赶出去， 他发令说：‘毁灭吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 永生的神是你的居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他在你前面撵出仇敌， 说：毁灭吧。
verses.textEnNiv: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemies before you, saying, ‘Destroy them!’
verses.textEnEsv: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy before you and said, ‘Destroy.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The eternal God isyour refuge, And underneath are the everlasting arms; He will thrust out the enemy from before you, And will say, ‘Destroy!’
verses.textEnNlt: The eternal God is your refuge, and his everlasting arms are under you. He drives out the enemy before you; he cries out, ‘Destroy them!’
verses.textEnNasb: "The eternal God is a hiding place, And underneath are the everlasting arms; And He drove out the enemy from you, And said, ‘Destroy!’
verses.textEn: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemies before you, saying, ‘Destroy them!’

verses.textZh: 所以以色列可以安然居住， 雅各的本源， 独处在产五谷新酒之地； 他的天也滴下甘露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以以色列可以安然居住， 雅各的本源， 独处在产五谷新酒之地； 他的天也滴下甘露。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列安然居住； 雅各的本源独居五谷新酒之地。 他的天也滴甘露。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel will live in safety; Jacob will dwell secure in a land of grain and new wine, where the heavens drop dew.
verses.textEnEsv: So Israel lived in safety, Jacob lived alone, in a land of grain and wine, whose heavens drop down dew.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel shall dwell in safety, The fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine; His heavens shall also drop dew.
verses.textEnNlt: So Israel will live in safety, prosperous Jacob in security, in a land of grain and new wine, while the heavens drop down dew.
verses.textEnNasb: "So Israel lives in security, The fountain of Jacob secluded, In a land of grain and new wine; His heavens also drip down dew.
verses.textEn: So Israel will live in safety; Jacob will dwell secure in a land of grain and new wine, where the heavens drop dew.

verses.textZh: 以色列啊，你是有福的； 有谁像你呢？ 你这蒙耶和华拯救的子民， 他是帮助你的盾牌， 他是你威严的刀剑。 你的仇敌必向你屈服； 你必践踏他们的背脊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊，你是有福的； 有谁像你呢？ 你这蒙耶和华拯救的子民， 他是帮助你的盾牌， 他是你威严的刀剑。 你的仇敌必向你屈服； 你必践踏他们的背脊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你是有福的！ 谁像你这蒙耶和华所拯救的百姓呢？ 他是你的盾牌，帮助你， 是你威荣的刀剑。 你的仇敌必投降你； 你必踏在他们的高处。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord ? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will tread on their heights."
verses.textEnEsv: Happy are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord , the shield of your help, and the sword of your triumph! Your enemies shall come fawning to you, and you shall tread upon their backs."
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord, The shield of your help And the sword of your majesty! Your enemies shall submit to you, And you shall tread down their high places."
verses.textEnNlt: How blessed you are, O Israel! Who else is like you, a people saved by the Lord ? He is your protecting shield and your triumphant sword! Your enemies will cringe before you, and you will stomp on their backs!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are you, Israel; Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord, The shield of your help, And He who is the sword of your majesty! So your enemies will cringe before you, And you will trample on their high places."
verses.textEn: Blessed are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord ? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will tread on their heights."

verses.textZh: 摩西从摩押平原上了尼波山，就是上了耶利哥对面的毘斯迦山顶。耶和华把全地指给他看，就是把基列直到但，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西从摩押平原上了尼波山，就是上了耶利哥对面的毘斯迦山顶。耶和华把全地指给他看，就是把基列直到但，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西从摩押平原登尼波山，上了那与耶利哥相对的毗斯迦山顶。耶和华把基列全地直到但，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the Lord showed him the whole land—from Gilead to Dan,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho. And the Lord showed him all the land, Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is across from Jericho. And the Lord showed him all the land of Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses went up to Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab and climbed Pisgah Peak, which is across from Jericho. And the Lord showed him the whole land, from Gilead as far as Dan;
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho. And the Lord showed him all the land, Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.textEn: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the Lord showed him the whole land—from Gilead to Dan,

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲和玛拿西之地，犹大全地，直到西海，
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲和玛拿西之地，犹大全地，直到西海，
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲、玛拿西的地，犹大全地直到西海，
verses.textEnNiv: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea,
verses.textEnEsv: all Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: all Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea,
verses.textEnNlt: all the land of Naphtali; the land of Ephraim and Manasseh; all the land of Judah, extending to the Mediterranean Sea ;
verses.textEnNasb: and all Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,
verses.textEn: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea,

verses.textZh: 南地和那平原，就是棕树城耶利哥的盆地，直到琐珥，都指给他看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南地和那平原，就是棕树城耶利哥的盆地，直到琐珥，都指给他看。
verses.textZhCuv: 南地和棕树城耶利哥的平原，直到琐珥，都指给他看。
verses.textEnNiv: the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho, the City of Palms, as far as Zoar.
verses.textEnEsv: the Negeb, and the Plain, that is, the Valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.
verses.textEnNkjv: the South, and the plain of the Valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.
verses.textEnNlt: the Negev; the Jordan Valley with Jericho—the city of palms—as far as Zoar.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Negev and the territory in the Valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.
verses.textEn: the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho, the City of Palms, as far as Zoar.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对他说："这就是我曾经向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，说：‘我要把这地赐给你的后裔。’现在我让你亲眼看见了，可是你不能过到那边去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对他说："这就是我曾经向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，说：‘我要把这地赐给你的后裔。’现在我让你亲眼看见了，可是你不能过到那边去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对他说：「这就是我向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，说：『我必将这地赐给你的后裔。』现在我使你眼睛看见了，你却不得过到那里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "This is the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land of which I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not cross over there."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have now allowed you to see it with your own eyes, but you will not enter the land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants’; I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not go over there."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华的仆人摩西，照着耶和华所说的，死在摩押地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华的仆人摩西，照着耶和华所说的，死在摩押地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华的仆人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: And Moses the servant of the Lord died there in Moab, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses, the servant of the Lord , died there in the land of Moab, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, in accordance with the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And Moses the servant of the Lord died there in Moab, as the Lord had said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把他埋葬在摩押地，伯．毘珥对面的山谷里，只是直到今日还没有人知道埋葬他的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把他埋葬在摩押地，伯．毘珥对面的山谷里，只是直到今日还没有人知道埋葬他的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将他埋葬在摩押地、伯‧毗珥对面的谷中，只是到今日没有人知道他的坟墓。
verses.textEnNiv: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.
verses.textEnEsv: and he buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth-peor; but no one knows the place of his burial to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth Peor; but no one knows his grave to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord buried him in a valley near Beth-peor in Moab, but to this day no one knows the exact place.
verses.textEnNasb: And He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor; but no one knows his burial place to this day.
verses.textEn: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.

verses.textZh: 摩西死的时候，已经一百二十岁；他的眼睛没有昏花，他的精力也没有衰退。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西死的时候，已经一百二十岁；他的眼睛没有昏花，他的精力也没有衰退。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西死的时候年一百二十岁；眼目没有昏花，精神没有衰败。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses was 120 years old when he died. His eye was undimmed, and his vigor unabated.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eyes were not dim nor his natural vigor diminished.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses was 120 years old when he died, yet his eyesight was clear, and he was as strong as ever.
verses.textEnNasb: Although Moses was 120 years old when he died, his eyesight was not dim, nor had his vigor left him.
verses.textEn: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日；然后为摩西守丧哀哭的日子就满了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日；然后为摩西守丧哀哭的日子就满了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日，为摩西居丧哀哭的日子就满了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. Then the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. So the days of weeping and mourning for Moses ended.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel mourned for Moses on the plains of Moab for thirty days, until the customary period of mourning was over.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab for thirty days; then the days of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
verses.textEn: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.

verses.textZh: 嫩的儿子约书亚，因为摩西曾经按手在他身上，就充满了智慧的灵；以色列人就听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的去行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 嫩的儿子约书亚，因为摩西曾经按手在他身上，就充满了智慧的灵；以色列人就听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的去行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 嫩的儿子约书亚；因为摩西曾按手在他头上，就被智慧的灵充满，以色列人便听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. So the people of Israel obeyed him and did as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him; so the children of Israel heeded him, and did as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Joshua son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. So the people of Israel obeyed him, doing just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua the son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands on him; and the sons of Israel listened to him and did as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 以后在以色列中，再没有兴起一位先知像摩西一样的；他是耶和华面对面所认识的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后在以色列中，再没有兴起一位先知像摩西一样的；他是耶和华面对面所认识的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后以色列中再没有兴起先知像摩西的。他是耶和华面对面所认识的。
verses.textEnNiv: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.textEnEsv: And there has not arisen a prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.textEnNkjv: But since then there has not arisen in Israel a prophet like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.textEnNlt: There has never been another prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face.
verses.textEnNasb: Since that time no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.textEn: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

verses.textZh: 耶和华差遣他在埃及地，向法老和他的一切臣仆，以及他的全地行了一切神迹和奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华差遣他在埃及地，向法老和他的一切臣仆，以及他的全地行了一切神迹和奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华打发他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣仆，并他的全地，行各样神迹奇事，
verses.textEnNiv: who did all those signs and wonders the Lord sent him to do in Egypt—to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.
verses.textEnEsv: none like him for all the signs and the wonders that the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land,
verses.textEnNkjv: in all the signs and wonders which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt, before Pharaoh, before all his servants, and in all his land,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord sent him to perform all the miraculous signs and wonders in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, and all his servants, and his entire land.
verses.textEnNasb: for all the signs and wonders which the Lord sent him to perform in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, all his servants, and all his land—
verses.textEn: who did all those signs and wonders the Lord sent him to do in Egypt—to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.

verses.textZh: 摩西又在以色列众人眼前行了一切大能的事，和一切大而可畏的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西又在以色列众人眼前行了一切大能的事，和一切大而可畏的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在以色列众人眼前显大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
verses.textEnNiv: For no one has ever shown the mighty power or performed the awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and for all the mighty power and all the great deeds of terror that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: and by all that mighty power and all the great terror which Moses performed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: With mighty power, Moses performed terrifying acts in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: and for all the mighty power and all the great terror which Moses performed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEn: For no one has ever shown the mighty power or performed the awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
